arabic_text: ٣٠- وَيَا قَوْمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّـهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. “ And O my People ! Who would help me against God If I drove them away ? Will ye not then take heed ?

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّـهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّـهُ خَيْرًا ۖ اللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ إِنِّي إِذًا لَّمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. “ I tell you not that With me are the Treasures Of God, nor do I know What is hidden, Nor claim I to be An angel. Nor yet Do I say, of those whom Your eyes do despise That God will not grant them (All) that is good : God knoweth best What is in their souls: I should, if I did, Indeed be a wrong-doer.”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالُوا يَا نُوحُ قَدْ جَادَلْتَنَا فَأَكْثَرْتَ جِدَالَنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. They said : “ O Noah ! Thou hast disputed with us, And (much) hast thou prolonged The dispute with us : now Bring upon us what thou Threatenest us with, if thou Speakest the truth !? ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأْتِيكُم بِهِ اللَّـهُ إِن شَاءَ وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. He said : “ Truly, God Will bring it on you If He wills,—and then, Ye will not be able To frustrate it !

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَا يَنفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي إِنْ أَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَنصَحَ لَكُمْ إِن كَانَ اللَّـهُ يُرِيدُ أَن يُغْوِيَكُمْ ۚ هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. “ Of no profit will be My counsel to you, Much as I desire To give you (good) counsel, If it be that God Willeth to leave you astray : He is your Lord ! And to Him will ye return ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَعَلَيَّ إِجْرَامِي وَأَنَا بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 35.Or do they say, “ He has forged it ”? Say : “ If I had forged it, On me were my sin ! And I am free Of the sins of whichYeare guilty !

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَأُوحِيَ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ أَنَّهُ لَن يُؤْمِنَ مِن قَوْمِكَ إِلَّا مَن قَدْ آمَنَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 36.It was revealed to Noah : “ None of thy People will believe Except those who have believed Already ! So grieve no longer Over their (evil) deeds.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. “ But construct an Ark Under Our eyes and Our Inspiration, and address Me No (further) on behalf Of those who are in sin : For they are about to be Overwhelmed (in the Flood).”

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِّن قَوْمِهِ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُ ۚ قَالَ إِن تَسْخَرُوا مِنَّا فَإِنَّا نَسْخَرُ مِنكُمْ كَمَا تَسْخَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. Forthwith he (starts) Constructing the Ark : Every time that the Chiefs Of his People passed by him, They threw ridicule on him. They threw ridicule on him. He said : “ If ye ridicule Us now, we (in our turn) Can look down on you With ridicule likewise !

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 39. “ But soon will ye know Who it is on whom Will descend a Penalty That will cover them With shame,—on whom will be Unloosed a Penalty lasting : ”

arabic_text: ٤٠- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا احْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ آمَنَ ۚ وَمَا آمَنَ مَعَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ◯
english_translation: 40.At length, behold ! There came Our Command, And the fountains of the earth Gushed forth ! We said : “ Embark therein, of each kind Two, male and female, And your family—except Those against whom the Word Has already gone forth,— And the Believers.” But only a few Believed with him.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَقَالَ ارْكَبُوا فِيهَا بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ مَجْرَاهَا وَمُرْسَاهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 41. So he said : “ Embark ye On the Ark, In the name of God, Whether it move Or be at rest ! For my Lord is, be sure, Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَهِيَ تَجْرِي بِهِمْ فِي مَوْجٍ كَالْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ابْنَهُ وَكَانَ فِي مَعْزِلٍ يَا بُنَيَّ ارْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 42. So the Ark floated With them on the waves (Towering) like mountains, And Noah called out To his son, who had Separated himself (from the rest) : “ O my son ! embark With us, and be not With the Unbelievers ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٣- قَالَ سَآوِي إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍ يَعْصِمُنِي مِنَ الْمَاءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّـهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ◯
english_translation: 43. The son replied : “ I will Betake myself to some mountain : It will save me from The water.” Noah said : “ This day nothing can save, From the Command of God, Any but those on whom He hath mercy ! ”— And the waves came Between them, and the son Was among those Overwhelmed in the Flood.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 44.Then when the word went forth : “ O earth ! swallow up Thy water, and O sky ! Withhold (thy rain) ! ” And the water abated, And the matter was ended. The Ark rested on Mount Jūdī, and the word Went forth : “ Away With those who do wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ رَّبَّهُ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ابْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِي وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ الْحَاكِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 45.And Noah called upon His Lord, and said : “ O my Lord ! surely My son is of my family ! And Thy promise is true, And Thou art The Justest of Judges ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٦- قَالَ يَا نُوحُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ ۖ فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّي أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. He said : “ O Noah ! He is not of thy family : For his conduct is unrighteous. So ask not of Me That of which thou Hast no knowledge ! I give thee counsel, lest Thou act like the ignorant ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٧- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. Noah said : “ O my Lord ! I do seek refuge with Thee, Lest I ask Thee for that Of which I have no knowledge. And unless Thou forgive me And have Mercy on me, I should indeed be lost ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- قِيلَ يَا نُوحُ اهْبِطْ بِسَلَامٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَاتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَأُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 48. The word came : “ O Noah ! Come down (from the Ark) With Peace from Us, And Blessing on thee And on some of the Peoples (Who will spring) from those With thee : but (there will be Other) Peoples to whom We Shall grant their pleasures (For a time), but in the end Will a grievous Penalty Reach them from Us.”

arabic_text: ٤٩- تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَا إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَا أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَا ۖ فَاصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 49.Such are some of the stories Of the Unseen, which We Have revealed unto thee : Before this, neither thou Nor thy People knew them. So persevere patiently : For the End is for those Who are righteous.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 50.To the ‘Ād People (We sent) Hūd, one Of their own brethren. He said : “ O my people ! Worship God ! ye have No other god but Him. (Your other gods) ye do nothing But invent !

arabic_text: ٥١- يَا قَوْمِ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 51. “ O my people ! I ask of you No reward for this (Message). My reward is from none But Him Who created me : Will ye not then understand ?

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 52. “ And O my people ! Ask Forgiveness of your Lord, And turn to Him (in repentance) : He will send you the skies Pouring abundant rain, And add strength To your strength : So turn ye not back In sin ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٣- قَالُوا يَا هُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِي آلِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. They said : “ O Hūd ! No Clear (Sign) hast thou Brought us, and we are not The ones to desert our gods On thy word ! Nor shall we Believe in thee !

arabic_text: ٥٤- إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا اعْتَرَاكَ بَعْضُ آلِهَتِنَا بِسُوءٍ ۗ قَالَ إِنِّي أُشْهِدُ اللَّـهَ وَاشْهَدُوا أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. “ We say nothing but that (Perhaps) some of our gods May have seized thee With imbecility.” He said : “ I call God to witness, And do ye bear witness, That I am free from the sin Of ascribing, to Him,

arabic_text: ٥٥- مِن دُونِهِ ۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ◯
english_translation: 55. “ Other gods as partners ! So scheme (your worst) against me, All of you, and give me No respite.

arabic_text: ٥٦- إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّـهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 56. “ I put my trust in God, My Lord and your Lord ! There is not a moving Creature, but He hath Grasp of its fore-lock. Verily, it is my Lord That is on a straight Path.

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّي قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ◯
english_translation: 57. “ If ye turn away,— I (at least) have conveyed The Message with which I Was sent to you. My Lord Will make another People To succeed you, and you Will not harm Him In the least. For my Lord Hath care and watch Over all things.”

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ◯
english_translation: 58.So when Our decree Issued, We saved Hūd And those who believed With him, by (special) Grace From Ourselves : We saved them From a severe Penalty.

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَتِلْكَ عَادٌ ۖ جَحَدُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 59. Such were the ‘Ād people : They rejected the Signs Of their Lord and Cherisher ; Disobeyed His Apostles ; And followed the command Of every powerful, obstinate Transgressor.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوْمِ هُودٍ◯
english_translation: 60. And they were pursued By a Curse in this Life,— And on the Day of Judgment. Ah ! Behold ! for the ‘Ād rejected their Lord and Cherisher ! Ah ! Behold ! Removed (from sight) Were ‘Ād the People of Hūd !

arabic_text: ٦١- وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 61.To theThamūd People (We sent) Ṣāliḥ, one Of their own brethren. He said : “ O my People ! Worship God : ye have No other god but Him. It is He Who hath produced you From the earth and settled you Therein : then ask forgiveness Of Him, and turn to Him (In repentance) : for my Lord Is (always) near, ready To answer.”

arabic_text: ٦٢- قَالُوا يَا صَالِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّا قَبْلَ هَـٰذَا ۖ أَتَنْهَانَا أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 62. They said : “ O Ṣāliḥ ! Thou hast been of us !— A center of our hopes Hitherto ! Dost thou (now) Forbid us the worship Of what our fathers worshipped ? But we are really In suspicious (disquieting) Doubt as to that to which Thou invitest us.”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَآتَانِي مِنْهُ رَحْمَةً فَمَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ اللَّـهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِي غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 63. He said : “ O my people ! Do ye see ?—If I have a Clear (Sign) from my Lord And He hath sent Mercy Unto me from Himself,—who Then can help me Against God if I were To disobey Him ? What Then would ye add To my (portion) but perdition ?

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَيَا قَوْمِ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّـهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّـهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌ قَرِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 64. “ And O my people ! This she-camel of God is A symbol to you : Leave her to feed On God’s (free) earth, And inflict no harm On her, or a swift Penalty Will seize you ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا فِي دَارِكُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍ◯
english_translation: 65. But they did ham-string her. So he said : “ Enjoy yourselves In your homes for three days : (Then will be your ruin) : (Behold) there a promise Not to be belied ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٦- فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَالِحًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْيِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ◯
english_translation: 66. When Our Decree issued, We saved Ṣāliḥ and those Who believed with him, By (special) Grace from Ourselves— And from the Ignominy Of that Day. For thy Lord— He is the Strong One, and Able To enforce His Will.

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَأَخَذَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 67. The (mighty) Blast overtook The wrong-doers, and they Lay prostrate in their homes Before the morning,—

arabic_text: ٦٨- كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ ثَمُودَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّثَمُودَ◯
english_translation: 68. As if they had never Dwelt and flourished there. Ah ! Behold ! For theThamūd Rejected their Lord and Cherisher ! Ah ! Behold ! Removed (From sight) were theThamūd !

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَلَقَدْ جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا سَلَامًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَامٌ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍ◯
english_translation: 69.There came Our Messengers To Abraham with glad tidings. They said, “ Peace ! ” He answered, “ Peace ! ” and hastened To entertain them With a roasted calf.

arabic_text: ٧٠- فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ◯
english_translation: 70. But when he saw Their hands went not Towards the (meal), he felt Some mistrust of them, And conceived a fear of them. They said : “ Fear not : We have been sent Against the people of Lūṭ.”

arabic_text: ٧١- وَامْرَأَتُهُ قَائِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَاهَا بِإِسْحَاقَ وَمِن وَرَاءِ إِسْحَاقَ يَعْقُوبَ◯
english_translation: 71. And his wife was standing (There), and she laughed : But We gave her Glad tidings of Isaac, And after him, of Jacob.

arabic_text: ٧٢- قَالَتْ يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ أَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ وَهَـٰذَا بَعْلِي شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 72. She said : “ Alas for me ! Shall I bear a child, Seeing I am an old woman, And my husband here Is an old man ? That would indeed Be a wonderful thing ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٣- قَالُوا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّـهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ اللَّـهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 73. They said : “ Dost thou Wonder at God’s decree ? The grace of God And His blessings on you, O ye people of the house ! For He is indeed Worthy of all praise, Full of all glory ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٤- فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ وَجَاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَادِلُنَا فِي قَوْمِ لُوطٍ◯
english_translation: 74.When fear had passed From (the mind of) Abraham And the glad tidings Had reached him, he Began to plead with Us For Lūṭ’s people.

arabic_text: ٧٥- إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 75. For Abraham was, Without doubt, forbearing (Of faults), compassionate, And given to look to God.

arabic_text: ٧٦- يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَـٰذَا ۖ إِنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ آتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍ◯
english_translation: 76. O Abraham ! Seek not this. The decree of thy Lord Hath gone forth : for them There cometh a Penalty That cannot be turned back !

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 77.When Our Messengers Came to Lūṭ, he was Grieved on their account And felt himself powerless (To protect) them. He said : “ This is a distressful day.”

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 78. And his people came Rushing towards him, And they had been long In the habit of practicing Abominations. He said : “ O my people ! Here are My daughters : they are purer For you (if ye marry) ! Now fear God, and cover me not With shame about my guests ! Is there not among you A single right-minded man ? ”

arabic_text: ٧٩- قَالُوا لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِي بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ◯
english_translation: 79. They said : “ Well dost thou Know we have no need Of thy daughters : indeed Thou knowest quite well What we want ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٠- قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ آوِي إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 80. He said : “ Would that I Had power to suppress you Or that I could betake Myself to some powerful support.”

arabic_text: ٨١- قَالُوا يَا لُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوا إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُ مُصِيبُهَا مَا أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 81. (The Messengers) said : “ O Lūṭ ! We are Messengers from thy Lord ! By no means shall they Reach thee ! Now travel With thy family while yet A part of the night remains, And let not any of you Look back : but thy wife (Will remain behind) : To her will happen What happens to the people. Morning is their time appointed : Is not the morning nigh ? ”

arabic_text: ٨٢- فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ مَّنضُودٍ◯
english_translation: 82. When Our decree issued, We turned (the cities) Upside down, and rained down On them brimstones Hard as baked clay, Spread, layer on layer,—

arabic_text: ٨٣- مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 83. Marked as from thy Lord : Nor are they ever far From those who do wrong !

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّي أَرَاكُم بِخَيْرٍ وَإِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ مُّحِيطٍ◯
english_translation: 84.To the Madyan people (We sent) Shu’aib, one Of their own brethren : he said : “ O my people ! worship God : Ye have no other god But Him. And give not Short measure or weight : I see you in prosperity, But I fear for you The Penalty of a Day That will compass (you) all round.

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَيَا قَوْمِ أَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 85. “ And O my people ! give Just measure and weight, Nor withhold from the people The things that are their due : Commit not evil in the land With intent to do mischief.

arabic_text: ٨٦- بَقِيَّتُ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍ◯
english_translation: 86. “ That which is left you By God is best for you, If ye (but) believed ! But I am not set Over you to keep watch ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٧- قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ أَصَلَاتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِي أَمْوَالِنَا مَا نَشَاءُ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ الْحَلِيمُ الرَّشِيدُ◯
english_translation: 87. They said : “ Oh Shu’aib ! Does thy (religion of) prayer Command thee that we Leave off the worship which Our fathers practised, or That we leave off doing What we like with our property ? Truly, though art the one That forbeareth with faults And is right-minded ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٨- قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّي وَرَزَقَنِي مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا الْإِصْلَاحَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّـهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ◯
english_translation: 88. He said : “ O my people ! See ye whether I have A Clear (Sign) from my Lord, And He hath given me Sustenance (pure and) good As from Himself ? I wish not, In opposition to you, to do That which I forbid you to do. I only desire (your) betterment To the best of my power ; And my success (in my task) Can only come from God. In Him I trust, And unto Him I look.

arabic_text: ٨٩- وَيَا قَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 89. “ And O my people ! Let not my dissent (from you) Cause you to sin, Lest ye suffer A fate similar to that Of the people of Noah Or of Hūd or of Ṣāliḥ, Nor are the people of Lūṭ Far off from you !

arabic_text: ٩٠- وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ◯
english_translation: 90. “ But ask forgiveness Of your Lord, and turn Unto Him (in repentance) : For my Lord is indeed Full of mercy and loving-kindness.”

arabic_text: ٩١- قَالُوا يَا شُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَاكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًا ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَاكَ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍ◯
english_translation: 91. They said : “ O Shu’aib ! Much of what thou sayest We do not understand ! In fact among us we see That thou hast no strength ! Were it not for thy family, We should certainly Have stoned thee ! For thou hast among us No great position ! ”

arabic_text: ٩٢- قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَرَهْطِي أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَاءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ◯
english_translation: 92. He said : “ O my people ! Is then my family Of more consideration with you Than God ? For ye cast Him Away behind your backs (With contempt). But verily My Lord encompasseth On all sides All that ye do !

arabic_text: ٩٣- وَيَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ ۖ وَارْتَقِبُوا إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 93. “ And O my people ! Do whatever ye can : I will do (my part) : Soon will ye know Who it is on whom Descends the Penalty Of ignominy, and who Is a liar ! And watch ye ! For I too am watching With you ! ”

arabic_text: ٩٤- وَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دِيَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 94. When Our decree issued, We saved Shu’aib and those Who believed with him, By (special) Mercy from Ourselves : But the (mighty) Blast did seize The wrong-doers, and they Lay prostrate in their homes By the morning,—

arabic_text: ٩٥- كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا فِيهَا ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ◯
english_translation: 95. As if they had never Dwelt and flourished there ! Ah ! Behold ! How the Madyan Were removed (from sight) As were removed theThamūd !

arabic_text: ٩٦- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 96.And We sent Moses, With Our Clear (Signs) And an authority manifest,

arabic_text: ٩٧- إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاتَّبَعُوا أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۖ وَمَا أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 97. Unto Pharaoh and his Chiefs : But they followed the command Of Pharaoh, and the command Of Pharaoh was no right (guide).

arabic_text: ٩٨- يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ النَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْوِرْدُ الْمَوْرُودُ◯
english_translation: 98. He will go before his people On the Day of Judgment, And lead them into the Fire (As cattle are led to water) : But woeful indeed will be The place to which they are led !

arabic_text: ٩٩- وَأُتْبِعُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ◯
english_translation: 99. And they are followed By a curse in this (life) And on the Day of Judgment : And woeful is the gift Which shall be given (Unto them) !

arabic_text: ١٠٠- ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَائِمٌ وَحَصِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 100.These are some of the stories Of communities which We Relate unto thee : of them Some are standing, and some Have been mown down (By the sickle of time).

arabic_text: ١٠١- وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ ۖ فَمَا أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ آلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِي يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ لَّمَّا جَاءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 101. It was not We that wronged them : They wronged their own souls : The deities, other than God, Whom they invoked, profited them No whit when there issued The decree of thy Lord : Nor did they add aught (To their lot) but perdition !

arabic_text: ١٠٢- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرَىٰ وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 102. Such is the chastisement Of thy Lord when He chastises Communities in the midst of Their wrong : grievous, indeed, And severe is His chastisement.

arabic_text: ١٠٣- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ الْآخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّجْمُوعٌ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَّشْهُودٌ◯
english_translation: 103. In that is a Sign For those who fear The Penalty of the Hereafter : That is a Day for which mankind Will be gathered together : That will be a Day Of Testimony.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍ مَّعْدُودٍ◯
english_translation: 104. Nor shall We delay it But for a term appointed.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِيٌّ وَسَعِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 105.The day it arrives, No soul shall speak Except by His leave : Of those (gathered) some Will be wretched and some Will be blessed.

arabic_text: ١٠٦- فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ شَقُوا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَشَهِيقٌ◯
english_translation: 106. Those who are wretched Shall be in the Fire : There will be for them Therein (nothing but) the heaving Of sighs and sobs :

arabic_text: ١٠٧- خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ◯
english_translation: 107. They will dwell therein For all the time that The heavens and the earth Endure, except as thy Lord Willeth : for thy Lord Is the (sure) Accomplisher Of what He planneth.

arabic_text: ١٠٨- وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا فَفِي الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَاءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍ◯
english_translation: 108. And those who are blessed Shall be in the Garden : They will dwell therein For all the time that The heavens and the earth Endure, except as thy Lord Willeth : a gift without break.

arabic_text: ١٠٩- فَلَا تَكُ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍ◯
english_translation: 109. Be not then in doubt As to what these men Worship. They worship nothing But what their fathers worshipped Before (them) : but verily We shall pay them back (In full) their portion Without (the least) abatement.

arabic_text: ١١٠- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 110.We certainly gave the Book To Moses, but differences Arose therein : had it not been That a Word had gone forth Before from thy Lord, the matter Would have been decided Between them : but they Are in suspicious doubt Concerning it.

arabic_text: ١١١- وَإِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 111. And of a surety, to all Will your Lord pay back (In full the recompense) Of their deeds : for He Knoweth well all that they do.

arabic_text: ١١٢- فَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا ۚ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 112. Therefore stand firm (in the straight Path) as thou art commanded,— Thou and those who with thee Turn (unto God) ; and transgress not (From the Path) : for He seeth Well all that ye do.

arabic_text: ١١٣- وَلَا تَرْكَنُوا إِلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 113. And incline not to those Who do wrong, or the Fire Will seize you ; and ye have No protectors other than God, Nor shall ye be helped.

arabic_text: ١١٤- وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّاكِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 114. And establish regular prayers At the two ends of the day And at the approaches of the night : For those things that are good Remove those that are evil : Be that the word of remembrance To those who remember (their Lord) :

arabic_text: ١١٥- وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 115. And be steadfast in patience ; For verily God will not suffer The reward of the righteous To perish.

arabic_text: ١١٦- فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُولُو بَقِيَّةٍ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْفَسَادِ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا أُتْرِفُوا فِيهِ وَكَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 116.Why were there not, Among the generations before you, Persons possessed of balanced Good sense, prohibiting (men) From mischief in the earth— Except a few among them Whom We saved (from harm) ? But the wrong-doers pursued The enjoyment of the good things Of life which were given them, And persisted in sin.

arabic_text: ١١٧- وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 117. Nor would thy Lord be The One to destroy Communities for a single wrong-doing, If its members were likely To mend.

arabic_text: ١١٨- وَلَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 118. If thy Lord had so willed, He could have made mankind One People : but they Will not cease to dispute,

arabic_text: ١١٩- إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 119. Except those on whom thy Lord Hath bestowed His Mercy : And for this did He create Them : and the Word Of thy Lord shall be fulfilled : “ I will fill Hell with jinns And men all together.”

arabic_text: ١٢٠- وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَـٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 120.All that We relate to thee Of the stories of the apostles,— With it We make firm Thy heart : in them there cometh To thee the Truth, as well as An exhortation and a message Of remembrance to those who believe.

arabic_text: ١٢١- وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَامِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 121. Say to those who do not Believe : “ Do whatever ye can : We shall do our part ;

arabic_text: ١٢٢- وَانتَظِرُوا إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 122. “ And wait ye ! We too shall wait.”

arabic_text: ١٢٣- وَلِلَّـهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ الْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُ فَاعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 123. To God do belong The unseen (secrets) Of the heavens and the earth, And to Him goeth back Every affair (for decision) : Then worship Him, And put thy trust in Him. And thy Lord is not Unmindful of aught That ye do.

arabic_text: ١- الر ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 1.A. L. R.These are The Symbols (or Verses) Of the Perspicuous Book.

arabic_text: ٢- إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. We have sent it down As an Arabic Qur-ān, In order that ye may Learn wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣- نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ الْقَصَصِ بِمَا أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. We do relate unto thee The most beautiful of stories, In that We reveal to thee This (portion of the) Qur-ān : Before this, thou too Was among those Who knew it not.

arabic_text: ٤- إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 4.Behold, Joseph said To his father : “ O my father ! I did see eleven stars And the sun and the moon : I saw them prostrate themselves To me ! ”

arabic_text: ٥- قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْإِنسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 5. Said (the father) : “ My (dear) little son ! Relate not thy vision To thy brothers, lest they Concoct a plot against thee : For Satan is to man An avowed enemy !

arabic_text: ٦- وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 6. “ Thus will thy Lord Choose thee and teach thee The interpretation of stories (and events) And perfect His favour To thee and to the posterity Of Jacob—even as He Perfected it to thy fathers Abraham and Isaac aforetime ! For God is full of knowledge And wisdom.”

arabic_text: ٧- لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِي يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِ آيَاتٌ لِّلسَّائِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 7.Verily in Joseph and his brethren Are Signs (or Symbols) For Seekers (after Truth).

arabic_text: ٨- إِذْ قَالُوا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 8.They said : “ Truly Joseph And his brother are loved More by our father than we : But we are a goodly body ! Really our father is obviously Wandering (in his mind) !

arabic_text: ٩- اقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا مِن بَعْدِهِ قَوْمًا صَالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 9. “ Slay ye Joseph or cast him out To some (unknown) land, That so the favour Of your father may be Given to you alone : (There will be time enough) For you to be righteous after that ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠- قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ السَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. Said one of them : “ Slay not Joseph but if ye must Do something, throw him down To the bottom of the well : He will be picked up By some caravan of travellers.”

arabic_text: ١١- قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَنَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَنَاصِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 11.They said : “ O our father ! Why dost thou not Trust us with Joseph,—Seeing we are indeed His sincere well-wishers ?

arabic_text: ١٢- أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. “ Send him with us to-morrow To enjoy himself and play, And we shall take Every care of him.”

arabic_text: ١٣- قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَن تَذْهَبُوا بِهِ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأْكُلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَأَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَافِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. (Jacob) said : “ Really It saddens me that ye Should take him away : I fear lest the wolf Should devour him While ye attend not To him.”

arabic_text: ١٤- قَالُوا لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. They said : “ If the wolf Were to devour him While we are (so large) a party, Then should we indeed (First) have perished ourselves ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا بِهِ وَأَجْمَعُوا أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 15.So they did take him away, And they all agreed To throw him down To the bottom of the well : And We put into his heart (This Message) : ‘ Of a surety Thou shalt (one day) Tell them the truth Of this their affair While they know (thee) not.’

arabic_text: ١٦- وَجَاءُوا أَبَاهُمْ عِشَاءً يَبْكُونَ◯
english_translation: 16.Then they came To their father In the early part Of the night, Weeping.

arabic_text: ١٧- قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَاعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍ لَّنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. They said : “ Oh our father ! We went racing with one another, And left Joseph with our things ; And the wolf devoured him… But thou wilt never believe us Even though we tell the truth.”

arabic_text: ١٨- وَجَاءُوا عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. They stained his shirt With false blood. He said : “ Nay, but your minds Have made up a tale (That may pass) with you. (For me) patience is most fitting : Against that which ye assert, It is God (alone) Whose help can be sought ”…

arabic_text: ١٩- وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ ۖ قَالَ يَا بُشْرَىٰ هَـٰذَا غُلَامٌ ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 19.Then there came a caravan Of travellers : they sent Their water-carrier (for water), And he let down his bucket (Into the well)…He said : “ Ah there ! Good news ! Here is a (fine) young man ! ” So they concealed him As a treasure ! But God Knoweth well all that they do !

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. The (Brethren) sold him For a miserable price,— For a few dirhams counted out : In such low estimation Did they hold him !

arabic_text: ٢١- وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ عَسَىٰ أَن يَنفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰ أَمْرِهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 21.The man in Egypt Who bought him, said To his wife : “ Make his stay (Among us) honorable : Maybe he will bring us Much good, or we shall Adopt him as a son.” Thus did We establish Joseph in the land, That We might teach him The interpretation of stories (And events). And God Hath full power and control Over His affairs ; but most Among mankind know it not.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 22. When Joseph attained His full manhood, We gave him Power and knowledge : thus do We Reward those who do right.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ ۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّـهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 23.But she in whose house He was, sought to seduce him From his (true) self : she fastened The doors, and said : “ Now come, thou (dear one) ! ” He said : “ God forbid ! Truly (thy husband) is My lord ! He made My sojourn agreeable ! Truly to no good Come those who do wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَن رَّأَىٰ بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ السُّوءَ وَالْفَحْشَاءَ ۚ إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. And (with passion) Did she Desire him, and he would Have desired her, but that He saw the evidence Of his Lord : thus (Did We order) that We Might turn away from him (All) evil and shameful deeds : For he was one of Our servants, Sincere and purified.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِن دُبُرٍ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَى الْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَاءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوءًا إِلَّا أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 25.So they both raced each other To the door and she Tore his shirt from the back : They both found her lord Near the door. She said : “ What is the (fitting) punishment For one who formed An evil design against Thy wife, but prison Or a grievous chastisement ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَن نَّفْسِي ۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا إِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 26. He said : “ It was she That sought to seduce me— From my (true) self.” And one Of her household saw (this) And bore witness, (thus) :— “ If it be that his shirt Is rent form the front, then Is her tale true, And he is a liar !

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. “ But if it be that his shirt Is torn from the back, Then is she the liar, And he is telling the truth ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ قَمِيصَهُ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مِن كَيْدِكُنَّ ۖ إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 28. So when he saw his shirt,— That it was torn at the back,— (Her husband) said : “ Behold ! It is a snare of you women ! Truly, mighty is your snare !

arabic_text: ٢٩- يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَـٰذَا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرِي لِذَنبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ الْخَاطِئِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. “ O Joseph, pass this over ! (O wife), ask forgiveness For thy sin, for truly Thou hast been at fault ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَقَالَ نِسْوَةٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتَاهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۖ قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ إِنَّا لَنَرَاهَا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 30.Ladies said in the City : “ The wife of the (great) ’Azīz Is seeking to seduce her slave From his (true) self : Truly hath he inspired her With violent love : we see She is evidently going astray.”

arabic_text: ٣١- فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِمَكْرِهِنَّ أَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَعْتَدَتْ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَأً وَآتَتْ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِّنْهُنَّ سِكِّينًا وَقَالَتِ اخْرُجْ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْنَهُ أَكْبَرْنَهُ وَقَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ وَقُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّـهِ مَا هَـٰذَا بَشَرًا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 31. When she heard Of their malicious talk, She sent for them And prepared a banquet For them : she gave Each of them a knife : And she said (to Joseph), “ Come out before them.” When they saw him, They did extol him, And (in their amazement) Cut their hands : they said, “ God preserve us ! no mortal Is this ! This is none other Than a noble angel ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ ۖ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا آمُرُهُ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِّنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. She said : “ There before you Is the man about whom Ye did blame me ! I did seek to seduce him from His (true) self but he did Firmly save himself guiltless !… And now, if he doth not My bidding, he shall certainly Be cast into prison, And (what is more) Be of the company of the vilest ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. He said : “ O my Lord ! The prison is more To my liking than that To which they invite me : Unless Thou turn away Their snare from me, I should (in my youthful folly) Feel inclined towards them And join the ranks of the ignorant.”

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ فَصَرَفَ عَنْهُ كَيْدَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 34.So his Lord hearkened to him (In his prayer), and turned Away from him their snare : Verily He heareth and knoweth (All things).

arabic_text: ٣٥- ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا الْآيَاتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 35.Then it occurred to the men, After they had seen the Signs, (That it was best) To imprison him For a time.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا ۖ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي خُبْزًا تَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ ۖ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 36.Now with him there came Into the prison two young men. Said one of them : “ I see Myself (in a dream) Pressing wine.” Said the other : “ I see myself (in a dream) Carrying bread on my head, And birds are eating thereof.” “ Tell us ” (they said) “ the truth And meaning thereof : for we See thou art one That doth good (to all).”

arabic_text: ٣٧- قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي ۚ إِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. He said : “ Before any food Comes (in due course) To feed either of you, I will surely reveal To you the truth And meaning of this Ere it befall you : That is part of the (Duty) Which my Lord hath taught me. I have (I assure you) Abandoned the ways Of a people that believe not In God and that (even) Deny the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَاتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ آبَائِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۚ مَا كَانَ لَنَا أَن نُّشْرِكَ بِاللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. “ And I follow the ways Of my fathers,—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob ; and never Could we attribute any partners Whatever to God : that (comes) Of the grace of God to us And to mankind : yet Most men are not grateful.

arabic_text: ٣٩- يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَأَرْبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ اللَّـهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ◯
english_translation: 39. “ O my two companions Of the prison ! (I ask you) : Are many lords differing Among themselves better, Or the One God, Supreme and Irresistible ?

arabic_text: ٤٠- مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِهِ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءً سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم مَّا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّـهِ ۚ أَمَرَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. “ If not Him, ye worship nothing But names which ye have named,— Ye and your fathers,— For which God hath sent down No authority : the Command Is for none but God : He Hath commanded that ye worship None but Him : that is The right religion, but Most men understand not…

arabic_text: ٤١- يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا ۖ وَأَمَّا الْآخَرُ فَيُصْلَبُ فَتَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِن رَّأْسِهِ ۚ قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ الَّذِي فِيهِ تَسْتَفْتِيَانِ◯
english_translation: 41. “ O my two companions Of the prison ! As to one Of you, he will pour out The wine for his lord to drink : As for the other, he will Hang from the cross, and the birds Will eat from off his head. (So) hath been decreed That matter whereof Ye twain do enquire ”…

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي ظَنَّ أَنَّهُ نَاجٍ مِّنْهُمَا اذْكُرْنِي عِندَ رَبِّكَ فَأَنسَاهُ الشَّيْطَانُ ذِكْرَ رَبِّهِ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ بِضْعَ سِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 42.And of the two, To that one whom he considered About to be saved, he said : “ Mention me to thy lord.” But Satan made him forget To mention him to his lord : And (Joseph) lingered in prison A few (more) years.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعَ سُنبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ ۖ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي رُؤْيَايَ إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 43.The king (of Egypt) said : “ I do see (in a vision) Seven fat kine, whom seven Lean ones devour,—and seven Green ears of corn, and seven (others) Withered. O ye chiefs ! Expound to me my vision If it be that ye can Interpret visions.”

arabic_text: ٤٤- قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ ۖ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. They said : “ A confused medley Of dreams : and we are not Skilled in the interpretation Of dreams.”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ◯
english_translation: 45.But the man who had been Released, one of the two (Who had been in prison) And who now bethought him After (so long) a space of time, Said : “ I will tell you The truth of its interpretation : Send ye me (therefor).”

arabic_text: ٤٦- يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ لَّعَلِّي أَرْجِعُ إِلَى النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. “ O Joseph ! ” (he said). “O man of truth ! Expound To us (the dream) Of seven fat kine Whom seven lean ones Devour, and of seven Green ears of corn And (seven) others withered : That I may return To the people, and that They may understand.”

arabic_text: ٤٧- قَالَ تَزْرَعُونَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ دَأَبًا فَمَا حَصَدتُّمْ فَذَرُوهُ فِي سُنبُلِهِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. (Joseph) said : “ For seven years Shall ye diligently sow As is your wont : And the harvests that ye reap, Ye shall leave them in the ear,— Except a little, of which Ye shall eat.

arabic_text: ٤٨- ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّمَّا تُحْصِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. “ Then will come After that (period) Seven dreadful (years), Which will devour What ye shall have laid by In advance for them,— (All) except a little Which ye shall have (Specially) guarded.

arabic_text: ٤٩- ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. “ Then will come After that (period) a year In which the people will have Abundant water, and in which They will press (wine and oil).”

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَاسْأَلْهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسْوَةِ اللَّاتِي قَطَّعْنَ أَيْدِيَهُنَّ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي بِكَيْدِهِنَّ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 50.So the king said : “ Bring ye him unto me.” But when the messenger Came to him, (Joseph) said : “ Go thou back to thy lord, and ask him, ‘ What is The state of mind Of the ladies Who cut their hands ’ ? For my Lord is Certainly well aware Of their snare.”

arabic_text: ٥١- قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَاوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ قُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّـهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوءٍ ۚ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ أَنَا رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 51. (The king) said (to the ladies) : “ What was your affair When ye did seek to seduce Joseph from his (true) self ? ” The ladies said : “ God Preserve us! no evil Know we against him ! ” Said the ’Aziz’s wife : “ Now is the truth manifest (To all) : it was I Who sought to seduce him From his (true) self : He is indeed of those Who are (ever) true (and virtuous).

arabic_text: ٥٢- ذَٰلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّي لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي كَيْدَ الْخَائِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 52. “ This (say I), in order that He may know that I Have never been false To him in his absence, And that God will never Guide the snare of the false ones.

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَمَا أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِي ۚ إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّي ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 53. “ Nor do I absolve my own self (Of blame) : the (human soul) Is certainly prone to evil, Unless my Lord do bestow His Mercy : but surely My Lord is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِي ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُ قَالَ إِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 54.So the king said : “ Bring him unto me ; I will take him specially To serve about my own person.” Therefore when he had spoken To him, he said : “ Be assured this day, Thou art, before our own Presence, With rank firmly established, And fidelity fully proved ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٥- قَالَ اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 55. (Joseph) said : “ Set me Over the store-houses Of the land : I will Indeed guard them, As one that knows (Their importance).”

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَتَبَوَّأُ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ يَشَاءُ ۚ نُصِيبُ بِرَحْمَتِنَا مَن نَّشَاءُ ۖ وَلَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 56.Thus did We give Established power to Joseph In the land, to take possession Therein as, when, or where He pleased. We bestow Of Our mercy on whom We please, and We suffer not, To be lost, the reward Of those who do good.

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَلَأَجْرُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 57. But verily the reward Of the Hereafter Is the best, for those Who believe, and are constant In righteousness.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَجَاءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 58.Then came Joseph’s brethren : They entered his presence, And he knew them, But they knew him not.

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ قَالَ ائْتُونِي بِأَخٍ لَّكُم مِّنْ أَبِيكُمْ ۚ أَلَا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّي أُوفِي الْكَيْلَ وَأَنَا خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 59. And when he had furnished Them forth with provisions (Suitable) for them, he said : “ Bring unto me a brother Ye have, of the same father As yourselves, (but a different mother) : See ye not that I pay out Full measure, and that I Do provide the best hospitality ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- فَإِن لَّمْ تَأْتُونِي بِهِ فَلَا كَيْلَ لَكُمْ عِندِي وَلَا تَقْرَبُونِ◯
english_translation: 60. “ Now if ye bring him not To me, ye shall have No measure (of corn) from me, Nor shall be ye (even) come Near me.”

arabic_text: ٦١- قَالُوا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنْهُ أَبَاهُ وَإِنَّا لَفَاعِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. They said : “ We shall Certainly seek to get Our wish about him From his father : Indeed we shall do it.”

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَقَالَ لِفِتْيَانِهِ اجْعَلُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَا إِذَا انقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 62.And (Joseph) told his servants To put their stock-in-trade (With which they had bartered) Into their saddle-bags, So they should know it only When they returned to their people, In order that they Might come back.

arabic_text: ٦٣- فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا إِلَىٰ أَبِيهِمْ قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْكَيْلُ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا أَخَانَا نَكْتَلْ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 63.Now when they returned To their father, they said : “ O our father ! No more Measure of grain shall we get (Unless we take our brother) : So send our brother with us, That we may get our measure ; And we will indeed Take every care of him.”

arabic_text: ٦٤- قَالَ هَلْ آمَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَا أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَاللَّـهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 64. He said : “ Shall I trust you With him with any result Other than when I trusted you With his brother aforetime ? But God is the best To take care (of him), And He is the Most Merciful Of those who show mercy ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِي ۖ هَـٰذِهِ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 65.Then when they opened Their baggage, they found Their stock in trade had been Returned to them. They said : “ O our father ! What (more) Can we desire ? This our Stock-in-trade has been returned To us : so we shall get (More) food for our family ; We shall take care of our brother ; And add (at the same time) a full camel’s load (of grain To our provisions). This is but a small quantity.”

arabic_text: ٦٦- قَالَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِي بِهِ إِلَّا أَن يُحَاطَ بِكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا آتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قَالَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ◯
english_translation: 66. (Jacob) said : “ Never will I Send him with you until Ye swear a solemn oath to me, In God’s name, that ye Will be sure to bring him back To me unless ye are yourselves Hemmed in (and made powerless).” And when they had sworn Their solemn oath, He said : “ Over all That we say, be God The Witness and Guardian ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَقَالَ يَا بَنِيَّ لَا تَدْخُلُوا مِن بَابٍ وَاحِدٍ وَادْخُلُوا مِنْ أَبْوَابٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍ ۖ وَمَا أُغْنِي عَنكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۖ إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّـهِ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. Further he said : “ O my sons ! enter not All by one gate : enter ye By different gates. Not that I can profit you aught Against God (with my advice) : None can command except God : On Him do I put my trust : And let all that trust Put their trust on Him.”

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُم مَّا كَانَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ إِلَّا حَاجَةً فِي نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَاهَا ۚ وَإِنَّهُ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِّمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 68. And when they entered In the manner their father Had enjoined, it did not Profit them in the least Against (the Plan of) God : It was but a necessity Of Jacob’s soul, which he Discharged. For he was, by Our instruction, full Of knowledge (and experience) : But most men know not.

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَخَاهُ ۖ قَالَ إِنِّي أَنَا أَخُوكَ فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 69.Now when they came Into Joseph’s presence, He received his (full) brother To stay with him. He said (To him) : “ Behold ! I am thy (own) Brother ; so grieve not At aught of their doings.”

arabic_text: ٧٠- فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا الْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. At length when he had furnished Them forth with provisions (Suitable) for them, he put The drinking cup into His brother’s saddle-bag. Then shouted out a Crier : “ O ye (in) the Caravan ! Behold ! ye are thieves, Without doubt ! ”

arabic_text: ٧١- قَالُوا وَأَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْهِم مَّاذَا تَفْقِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 71. They said, turning towards them : “ What is it that ye miss ? ”

arabic_text: ٧٢- قَالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 72. They said : “ We miss The great beaker of the king ; For him who produces it, Is (the reward of) A camel load ; I Will be bound by it.”

arabic_text: ٧٣- قَالُوا تَاللَّـهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا جِئْنَا لِنُفْسِدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سَارِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 73. (The brothers) said : “ By God ! Well ye know that we Came not to make mischief In the land, and we are No thieves ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٤- قَالُوا فَمَا جَزَاؤُهُ إِن كُنتُمْ كَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 74. (The Egyptians) said : “ What then Shall be the penalty of this, If ye are (proved) to have lied ? ”

arabic_text: ٧٥- قَالُوا جَزَاؤُهُ مَن وُجِدَ فِي رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزَاؤُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 75. They said : “ The penalty Should be that he In whose saddle-bag it is found, should be held (As bondman) to atone For the (crime). Thus it is We punish the wrong-doers ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٦- فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَّن نَّشَاءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 76.So he began (the search) With their baggage, Before (he came to) the baggage Of his brother : at length He brought it out of his Brother’s baggage. Thus did We Plan for Joseph. He could not Take his brother by the law Of the king except that God Willed it (so). We raise To degrees (of wisdom) whom We please : but over all Endued with knowledge is One, The All-Knowing.

arabic_text: ٧٧- قَالُوا إِن يَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ فَأَسَرَّهَا يُوسُفُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَلَمْ يُبْدِهَا لَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ أَنتُمْ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا ۖ وَاللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 77. They said : “ If he steals, There was a brother of his Who did steal before (him).” But these things did Joseph Keep locked in his heart, Revealing not the secrets to them. He (simply) said (to himself) : “ Ye are the worse situated ; And God knoweth best The truth of what ye assert ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٨- قَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَبًا شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا فَخُذْ أَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهُ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 78.They said : “ O exalted one ! Behold ! he has a father, Aged and venerable, (who will Grieve for him) ; so take One of us in his place ; For we see that thou art (Gracious) in doing good.”

arabic_text: ٧٩- قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللَّـهِ أَن نَّأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَن وَجَدْنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِندَهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّظَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. He said : “ God forbid That we take other than him With whom we found Our property : indeed (If we did so), we should Be acting wrongfully.”

arabic_text: ٨٠- فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْأَسُوا مِنْهُ خَلَصُوا نَجِيًّا ۖ قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَبَاكُمْ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَيْكُم مَّوْثِقًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ مَا فَرَّطتُمْ فِي يُوسُفَ ۖ فَلَنْ أَبْرَحَ الْأَرْضَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْذَنَ لِي أَبِي أَوْ يَحْكُمَ اللَّـهُ لِي ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 80.Now when they saw No hope of his (yielding), They held a conference in private. The leader among them said : “ Know ye not that your father Did take an oath from you In God’s name, and how ∫efore this, ye did fail In your duty with Joseph ? Therefore will I not leave This land until my father Permits me, or God Commands me ; and He Is the best to command.

arabic_text: ٨١- ارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ أَبِيكُمْ فَقُولُوا يَا أَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ◯
english_translation: 81. “ Turn ye back to your father, And say, ‘ O our father ! Behold ! thy son committed theft ! We bear witness only to what We know, and we could not Well guard against the unseen !

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَاسْأَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ الَّتِي كُنَّا فِيهَا وَالْعِيرَ الَّتِي أَقْبَلْنَا فِيهَا ۖ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. “ ‘Ask at the town where We have been and the caravan In which we returned, And (you will find) we are Indeed telling the truth.’ ”

arabic_text: ٨٣- قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًا ۖ فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى اللَّـهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 83.Jacob said : “ Nay, but ye Have yourselves contrived A story (good enough) for you. So patience is most fitting (For me). Maybe God will Bring them (back) all To me (in the end). For He is indeed full Of knowledge and wisdom.”

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَا أَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 84. And he turned away from them, And said : “ How great Is my grief for Joseph ! ” And his eyes became white With sorrow, and he fell Into silent melancholy.

arabic_text: ٨٥- قَالُوا تَاللَّـهِ تَفْتَأُ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْهَالِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 85. They said : “ By God ! (Never) wilt thou cease To remember Joseph Until thou reach the last Extremity of illness, Or until thou die ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٦- قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 86. He said : “ I only complain Of my distraction and anguish To God, and I know from God That which ye know not…

arabic_text: ٨٧- يَا بَنِيَّ اذْهَبُوا فَتَحَسَّسُوا مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّـهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّـهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 87. “ O my sons ! go ye And enquire about Joseph And his brother, and never Give up hope of God’s Soothing Mercy : truly No one despairs of God’s Soothing Mercy, except Those who have no faith.”

arabic_text: ٨٨- فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ قَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الْعَزِيزُ مَسَّنَا وَأَهْلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزْجَاةٍ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا الْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَجْزِي الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 88.Then, when they came (Back) into (Joseph’s) presence They said : “ O exalted one ! Distress has seized us And our family : we have (Now) brought but scanty capital : So pay us full measure, (We pray thee), and treat it As charity to us : for God Doth reward the charitable.”

arabic_text: ٨٩- قَالَ هَلْ عَلِمْتُم مَّا فَعَلْتُم بِيُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ إِذْ أَنتُمْ جَاهِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 89. He said : “ Know ye How ye dealt with Joseph And his brother, not knowing (What ye were doing) ? ”

arabic_text: ٩٠- قَالُوا أَإِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ يُوسُفُ ۖ قَالَ أَنَا يُوسُفُ وَهَـٰذَا أَخِي ۖ قَدْ مَنَّ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْنَا ۖ إِنَّهُ مَن يَتَّقِ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 90. They said : “ Art thou indeed Joseph ? ” He said : “ I am Joseph, and this is my brother : God has indeed been gracious To us (all) : behold, he that is Righteous and patient,—never Will God suffer the reward To be lost, of those Who do right.”

arabic_text: ٩١- قَالُوا تَاللَّـهِ لَقَدْ آثَرَكَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَاطِئِينَ◯
english_translation: 91. They said : “ By God! Indeed Has God preferred thee Above us, and we certainly Have been guilty of sin ! ”

arabic_text: ٩٢- قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ اللَّـهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 92. He said : “ This day Let no reproach be (cast) On you : God will forgive you, And He is the Most Merciful Of those who show mercy !

arabic_text: ٩٣- اذْهَبُوا بِقَمِيصِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقُوهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِ أَبِي يَأْتِ بَصِيرًا وَأْتُونِي بِأَهْلِكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 93. “ Go with this my shirt, And cast it over the face Of my father : he will Come to see (clearly). Then come Ye (here) to me together With all your family.”

arabic_text: ٩٤- وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَا أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ◯
english_translation: 94.When the Caravan left (Egypt), Their father said : “ I do indeed Scent the presence of Joseph : Nay, think me not a dotard.”

arabic_text: ٩٥- قَالُوا تَاللَّـهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِي ضَلَالِكَ الْقَدِيمِ◯
english_translation: 95. They said : “ By God ! Truly thou art in Thine old wandering mind.”

arabic_text: ٩٦- فَلَمَّا أَن جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّي أَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. Then when the bearer Of the good news came, He cast (the shirt) Over his face, and he Forthwith regained clear sight. He said : “ Did I not say To you, ‘ I know from God That which ye know not ? ’ ”

arabic_text: ٩٧- قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا خَاطِئِينَ◯
english_translation: 97. They said : “ O our father ! Ask for us forgiveness For our sins, for we Were truly at fault.”

arabic_text: ٩٨- قَالَ سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 98. He said : “ Soon will I Ask my Lord for forgiveness For you : for He is indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

arabic_text: ٩٩- فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوا مِصْرَ إِن شَاءَ اللَّـهُ آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 99.Then when they entered The presence of Joseph, He provided a home For his parents with himself, And said : “ Enter ye Egypt (all) in safety If it please God.”

arabic_text: ١٠٠- وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ يَا أَبَتِ هَـٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُؤْيَايَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُم مِّنَ الْبَدْوِ مِن بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 100. And he raised his parents High on the throne (of dignity), And they fell down in prostration, (All) before him. He said : “ O my father ! this is The fulfillment of my vision Of old ! God hath made it Come true ! He was indeed Good to me when He Took me out of prison And brought you (all here) Out of the desert, (Even) after Satan had sown Enmity between me and my brothers. Verily my Lord understandeth Best the mysteries of all That He planneth to do. For verily He is full Of knowledge and wisdom.

arabic_text: ١٠١- رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 101. “ O my Lord ! Thou hast Indeed bestowed on me Some power, and taught me Something of the interpretation Of dreams and events,—O Thou Creator of the heavens And the earth ! Thou art My Protector in this world And in the Hereafter. Take Thou my soul (at death) As one submitting to Thy Will (As a Muslim), and unite me With the righteous.”

arabic_text: ١٠٢- ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ أَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَمْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 102.Such is one of the stories Of what happened unseen, Which We reveal by inspiration Unto thee : nor wast thou (Present) with them when they Concerted their plans together In the process of weaving their plots.

arabic_text: ١٠٣- وَمَا أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 103. Yet no faith will The greater part of mankind Have, however ardently Thou dost desire it.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- وَمَا تَسْأَلُهُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 104. And no reward dost thou ask Of them for this : it is No less than a Message For all creatures.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 105.And how many Signs In the heavens and the earth Do they pass by ? Yet they Turn (their faces) away from them !

arabic_text: ١٠٦- وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِاللَّـهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 106. And most of them Believe not in God Without associating (others As partners) with Him !

arabic_text: ١٠٧- أَفَأَمِنُوا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ اللَّـهِ أَوْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 107. Do they then feel secure From the coming against them Of the covering veil Of the wrath of God,— Or of the coming against them Of the (final) Hour All of a sudden While they perceive not ?

arabic_text: ١٠٨- قُلْ هَـٰذِهِ سَبِيلِي أَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي ۖ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 108.Say thou : “ This is my way : I do invite unto God,— On evidence clear as The seeing with one’s eyes,— I and whoever follows me. Glory to God ! and never Will I join gods with God ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠٩- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۗ وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 109. Nor did We send before thee (As apostles) any but men, Whom We did inspire,— (Men) living in human habitations. Do they not travel Through the earth, and see What was the end Of those before them ? But the home of the Hereafter Is best, for those who do right. Will ye not then understand ?

arabic_text: ١١٠- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا فَنُجِّيَ مَن نَّشَاءُ ۖ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنَا عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 110. (Respite will be granted) Until, when the apostles Give up hope (of their people) And (come to ) think that they Were treated as liars, There reaches them Our help, And those whom We will Are delivered into safety. But never will be warded off Our punishment from those Who are in sin.

arabic_text: ١١١- لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِّأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ۗ مَا كَانَ حَدِيثًا يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَتَفْصِيلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 111. There is, in their stories, Instruction for men endued With understanding. It is not A tale invented, but a confirmation Of what went before it,— A detailed exposition Of all things, and a Guide And a Mercy to any such As believe.

arabic_text: ١- المر ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ ۗ وَالَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.A. L. M. R.These are The Signs (or Verses) Of the Book : that which Hath been revealed unto thee From thy Lord is the Truth ; But most men believe not.

arabic_text: ٢- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. God is He Who raised The heavens without any pillars That ye can see ; is firmly Established on the Throne (of Authority) ; He has subjected the sun And the moon (to His Law) ! Each one runs (its course) For a term appointed. He doth regulate all affairs, Explaining the Signs in detail, That ye may believe with certainty In the meeting with your Lord.

arabic_text: ٣- وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَدَّ الْأَرْضَ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْهَارًا ۖ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ جَعَلَ فِيهَا زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. And it is He Who spread out The earth, and set thereon Mountains standing firm, And (flowing) rivers : and fruit Of every kind He made In pairs, two and two : He draweth the Night as a veil O’er the Day. Behold, verily In these things there are Signs For those who consider !

arabic_text: ٤- وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُّتَجَاوِرَاتٌ وَجَنَّاتٌ مِّنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَزَرْعٌ وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَنُفَضِّلُ بَعْضَهَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِي الْأُكُلِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. And in the earth are tracts (Diverse though) neighbouring, And gardens of vines And fields sown with corn, And palm trees—growing Out of single roots or otherwise : Watered with the same water, Yet some of them We make More excellent than others to eat. Behold, verily in these things There are Signs for those Who understand !

arabic_text: ٥- وَإِن تَعْجَبْ فَعَجَبٌ قَوْلُهُمْ أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۗ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 5.If thou dost marvel (At their want of faith), Strange is their saying : “ When we are (actually) dust, Shall we indeed then be In a creation renewed ? ” They are Those who deny their Lord ! They Are those round whose necks Will be yokes (of servitude) : They will be Companions Of the Fire, to dwell therein (For aye) !

arabic_text: ٦- وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 6. They ask thee to hasten on The evil in preference to the good : Yet have come to pass, Before them, (many) exemplary Punishments ! But verily Thy Lord is full of forgiveness For mankind for their wrong-doing. And verily thy Lord Is (also) strict in punishment.

arabic_text: ٧- وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۗ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَلِكُلِّ قَوْمٍ هَادٍ◯
english_translation: 7.And the Unbelievers say : “ Why is not a Sign sent down To him from his Lord ? ” But thou art truly A warner, and to every people A guide.

arabic_text: ٨- اللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِندَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ◯
english_translation: 8.God doth know what Every female (womb) doth bear, By how much the wombs Fall short (of their time Or number) or do exceed. Every single thing is before His sight, in (due) proportion.

arabic_text: ٩- عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَعَالِ◯
english_translation: 9. He knoweth the Unseen And that which is open : He is the Great, the most High.

arabic_text: ١٠- سَوَاءٌ مِّنكُم مَّنْ أَسَرَّ الْقَوْلَ وَمَن جَهَرَ بِهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ مُسْتَخْفٍ بِاللَّيْلِ وَسَارِبٌ بِالنَّهَارِ◯
english_translation: 10. It is the same (to Him) Whether any of you Conceal his speech or Declare it openly ; Whether he lie hid by night Or walk freely by day.

arabic_text: ١١- لَهُ مُعَقِّبَاتٌ مِّن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّـهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّـهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَالٍ◯
english_translation: 11. For each (such person) There are (angels) in succession, Before and behind him : They guard him by command Of God. Verily never Will God change the condition Of a people until they Change it themselves (With their own souls). But when (once) God willeth A people’s punishment, There can be no Turning it back, nor Will they find, besides Him, Any to protect.
