arabic_text: ١٢- هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ◯
english_translation: 12. It is He Who doth show you The lightning, by way Both of fear and of hope : It is He Who doth raise up The clouds, heavy With (fertilising) rain !

arabic_text: ١٣- وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّـهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ◯
english_translation: 13. Nay, thunder repeateth His praises, And so do the angels, with awe : He flingeth the loud-voiced Thunder-bolts, and therewith He striketh whomsoever He will…Yet these (are the men) Who (dare to) dispute About God, with the strength Of His power (supreme) !

arabic_text: ١٤- لَهُ دَعْوَةُ الْحَقِّ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُم بِشَيْءٍ إِلَّا كَبَاسِطِ كَفَّيْهِ إِلَى الْمَاءِ لِيَبْلُغَ فَاهُ وَمَا هُوَ بِبَالِغِهِ ۚ وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ◯
english_translation: 14.For Him (alone) is prayer In Truth : any others that they Call upon besides Him hear them No more than if they were To stretch forth their hands For water to reach their mouths But it reaches them not : For the prayer of those Without Faith is nothing But (futile) wandering (in the mind).

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلِلَّـهِ يَسْجُدُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَظِلَالُهُم بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِالسجدة◯
english_translation: 15. Whatever beings there are In the heavens and the earth Do prostrate themselves to God (Acknowledging subjection),—with good-will Or in spite of themselves : So do their shadows In the mornings and evenings.

arabic_text: ١٦- قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قُلِ اللَّـهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَاتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِي الظُّلُمَاتُ وَالنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا لِلَّـهِ شُرَكَاءَ خَلَقُوا كَخَلْقِهِ فَتَشَابَهَ الْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ اللَّـهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ◯
english_translation: 16.Say: “ Who is the Lord and Sustainer Of the heavens and the earth ? ” Say : “ (It is) God.” Say : “ Do ye then take (For worship) protectors other Than Him, such as have No power either for good Or for harm to themselves ? ” Say : “ Are the blind equal With those who see ? Or the depths of darkness Equal with Light ? ” Or do they assign to God Partners who have created (Anything) as He has created, So that the creation seemed To them similar ? Say : “ God is the Creator Of all things : He is The One, the Supreme and Irresistible.”

arabic_text: ١٧- أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَّابِيًا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ ابْتِغَاءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ مِّثْلُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّـهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَاطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّـهُ الْأَمْثَالَ◯
english_translation: 17. He sends down water From the skies, and the channels Flow, each according to its measure : But the torrent bears away The foam that mounts up To the surface. Even so, From that (ore) which they heat In the fire, to make ornaments Or utensils therewith, There is a scum likewise. Thus doth God (by parables) Show forth Truth and Vanity. For the scum disappears Like froth cast out ; While that which is for the good Of mankind remains On the earth. Thus doth God Set forth parables.

arabic_text: ١٨- لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُ لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْحِسَابِ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ◯
english_translation: 18. For those who respond To their Lord, are (all) Good things. But those Who respond not to Him,— Even if they had all That is in the heavens And on earth, and as much more, (In vain) would they offer it For ransom. For them Will the reckoning be terrible : Their abode will be Hell,— What a bed of misery !

arabic_text: ١٩- أَفَمَن يَعْلَمُ أَنَّمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ الْحَقُّ كَمَنْ هُوَ أَعْمَىٰ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 19.Is then one who doth know That that which hath been Revealed unto thee From thy Lord is the Truth, Like one who is blind ? It is those who are Endued with understanding That receive admonition ;—

arabic_text: ٢٠- الَّذِينَ يُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِ اللَّـهِ وَلَا يَنقُضُونَ الْمِيثَاقَ◯
english_translation: 20. Those who fulfil the Covenant Of God and fail not In their plighted word ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَالَّذِينَ يَصِلُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّـهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ وَيَخَافُونَ سُوءَ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 21. Those who join together Those things which God Hath commanded to be joined, Hold their Lord in awe, And fear the terrible reckoning ;

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَالَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 22. Those who patiently persevere, Seeking the countenance their Lord ; Establish regular prayers ; spend, Out of (the gifts) We have bestowed For their sustenance, secretly And openly ; and turn off Evil With good : for such there is The final attainment Of the (Eternal) Home,—

arabic_text: ٢٣- جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن كُلِّ بَابٍ◯
english_translation: 23. Gardens of perpetual bliss : They shall enter there, As well as the righteous Among their fathers, their spouses, And their offspring : And angels shall enter unto them From every gate (with the salutation) :

arabic_text: ٢٤- سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُم بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ ۚ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 24. “ Peace unto you for that ye Persevered in patience ! Now How excellent is the final Home ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَالَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّـهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّـهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۙ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 25.But those who break The Covenant of God, after Having plighted their word thereto, And cut asunder those things Which God has commanded To be joined, and work mischief In the land ;—on them Is the Curse ; for them Is the terrible Home !

arabic_text: ٢٦- اللَّـهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ◯
english_translation: 26.God doth enlarge, or grant By (strict) measure, the Sustenance (Which He giveth) to whomso He pleaseth. (The worldly) rejoice In the life of this world : But the life of this world Is but little comfort In the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ◯
english_translation: 27.The Unbelievers say : “ Why Is not a Sign sent down To him from his Lord ? ” Say : “ Truly God leaveth, To stray, whom He will ; But He guideth to Himself Those who turn to Him In penitence,—

arabic_text: ٢٨- الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ◯
english_translation: 28. “ Those who believe, and whose hearts Find satisfaction in the remembrance Of God : for without doubt In the remembrance of God Do hearts find satisfaction.

arabic_text: ٢٩- الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ◯
english_translation: 29. “ For those who believe And work righteousness, Is (every) blessedness, And a beautiful place Of (final) return.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- كَذَٰلِكَ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ فِي أُمَّةٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهَا أُمَمٌ لِّتَتْلُوَ عَلَيْهِمُ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَهُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ قُلْ هُوَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ مَتَابِ◯
english_translation: 30.Thus have We sent thee Amongst a People before whom (Long since) have (other) Peoples (Gone and) passed away ; In order that thou mightest Rehearse unto them what We Send down unto thee by inspiration ; Yet do they reject (Him), the Most Gracious ! Say : “ He is my Lord ! There is no god but He ! On Him is my trust, And to Him do I turn ! ”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّـهِ الْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّـهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ◯
english_translation: 31. If there were a Qur-ān With which mountains were moved, Or the earth were cloven asunder, Or the dead were made to speak, (This would be the one !) But truly, the Command is With God in all things ! Do not the Believers know, That, had God (so) willed, He could have guided All mankind (to the Right) ?But the Unbelievers,—never Will disaster cease to seize Them for their (ill) deeds, Or to settle close to their homes, Until the Promise of God Come to pass, for, verily, God will not fail In His promise.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 32.Mocked were (many) apostles Before thee : but I granted Respite to the Unbelievers, And finally I punished them : Then how (terrible) was My requital !

arabic_text: ٣٣- أَفَمَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۗ وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّـهِ شُرَكَاءَ قُلْ سَمُّوهُمْ ۚ أَمْ تُنَبِّئُونَهُ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَم بِظَاهِرٍ مِّنَ الْقَوْلِ ۗ بَلْ زُيِّنَ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مَكْرُهُمْ وَصُدُّوا عَنِ السَّبِيلِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ◯
english_translation: 33. Is then He Who standeth Over every soul (and knoweth) All that it doth, (Like any others) ? And yet They ascribe partners to God. Say : “ But name them ! Is it that ye will Inform Him of something He knoweth not on earth, Or is it (just) a show Of words ? ” Nay ! to those Who believe not, their pretence Seems pleasing, but they are Kept back (thereby) from the Path. And those whom God leaves To stray, no one can guide.

arabic_text: ٣٤- لَّهُمْ عَذَابٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مِن وَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 34. For them is a Penalty In the life of this world, But harder, truly, is the Penalty Of the Hereafter : and defender Have they none against God.

arabic_text: ٣٥- مَّثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَائِمٌ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا ۖ وَّعُقْبَى الْكَافِرِينَ النَّارُ◯
english_translation: 35. The parable of the Garden Which the righteous are promised !— Beneath if flow rivers : Perpetual is the enjoyment thereof And the shade therein : Such is the End Of the Righteous ; and the End Of Unbelievers is the Fire.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَفْرَحُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَمِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ مَن يُنكِرُ بَعْضَهُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّـهَ وَلَا أُشْرِكَ بِهِ ۚ إِلَيْهِ أَدْعُو وَإِلَيْهِ مَآبِ◯
english_translation: 36.Those to whom We have Given the Book rejoice At what hath been revealed Unto thee : but there are Among the clans those who reject A part thereof. Say : “ I am commanded to worship God, and not to join partners With Him. Unto Him Do I call, and Unto Him is my return.”

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ حُكْمًا عَرَبِيًّا ۚ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعْتَ أَهْوَاءَهُم بَعْدَ مَا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللَّـهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا وَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 37. Thus have We revealed it To be a judgment of authority In Arabic. Wert thou to follow Their (vain) desires after the knowledge Which hath reached thee, Then wouldst thou find Neither protector nor defender Against God.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَذُرِّيَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۗ لِكُلِّ أَجَلٍ كِتَابٌ◯
english_translation: 38.We did send apostles Before thee, and appointed For them wives and children : And it was never the part Of an apostle to bring a Sign Except as God permitted (Or commanded). For each period Is a Book (revealed).

arabic_text: ٣٩- يَمْحُو اللَّـهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ ۖ وَعِندَهُ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ◯
english_translation: 39. God doth blot out Or confirm what He pleaseth : With Him is The Mother of the Book.

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَإِن مَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ◯
english_translation: 40.Whether We shall show thee (Within thy life-time) Part of what We promised them Or take to ourselves thy soul (Before it is all accomplished). Thy duty is to make (The Message) reach them : It is Our part To call them to account.

arabic_text: ٤١- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا ۚ وَاللَّـهُ يَحْكُمُ لَا مُعَقِّبَ لِحُكْمِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 41. See they not that We Gradually reduce the land (In their control) from its Outlying borders ? (Where) God Commands, there is none To put back His command : And He is Swift In calling to account.

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَقَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَلِلَّـهِ الْمَكْرُ جَمِيعًا ۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْسِبُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الْكُفَّارُ لِمَنْ عُقْبَى الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 42. Those before them did (also) Devise plots ; but in all things The master-planning is God’s. He knoweth the doings Of every soul : and soon Will the Unbelievers know Who gets home in the End.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَسْتَ مُرْسَلًا ۚ قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْكِتَابِ◯
english_translation: 43. The Unbelievers say : “ No apostle Art thou.” Say : “ Enough For a witness between me And you is God, and such As have knowledge of the Book.”

arabic_text: ١- الر ۚ كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ لِتُخْرِجَ النَّاسَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ◯
english_translation: 1.A. L. R.A Book Which We have revealed Unto thee, in order that Thou mightest lead mankind Out of the depths of darkness Into light—by the leave Of their Lord—to the Way Of (Him) Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise !—

arabic_text: ٢- اللَّـهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 2. Of God, to Whom do belong All things in the heavens And on earth ! But alas for the Unbelievers For a terrible Penalty (Their Unfaith will bring them) !—

arabic_text: ٣- الَّذِينَ يَسْتَحِبُّونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْآخِرَةِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ وَيَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 3. Those who love the life Of this world more than The Hereafter, who hinder (men) From the Path of God And seek therein something crooked : They are astray By a long distance.

arabic_text: ٤- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ اللَّـهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 4.We sent not an apostle Except (to teach) in the language Of his (own) people, in order To make (things) clear to them. Now God leaves straying Those whom He pleases And guides whom He pleases : And He is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٥- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّامِ اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ◯
english_translation: 5. We sent Moses with Our Signs (And the command). “ Bring out Thy people from the depths Of darkness into light, And teach them to remember The Days of God.” Verily In this there are Signs For such as are firmly patient And constant,—grateful and appreciative.

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ أَنجَاكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَاءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 6. Remember ! Moses said To his people : “ Call to mind The favor of God to you When He delivered you From the people of Pharaoh : They set you hard tasks And punishments, slaughtered Your sons, and let your women-folk Live : therein was A tremendous trial from your Lord.”

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِي لَشَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 7.And remember ! your Lord Caused to be declared (publicly) : “ If ye are grateful, I will Add more (favours) unto you ; But if ye show ingratitude, Truly My punishment Is terrible indeed.”

arabic_text: ٨- وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ إِن تَكْفُرُوا أَنتُمْ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَغَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 8. And Moses said : “ If ye Show ingratitude, ye and all On earth together,—yet Is God Free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ٩- أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ ۛ وَالَّذِينَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۛ لَا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ ۚ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَرَدُّوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَقَالُوا إِنَّا كَفَرْنَا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ وَإِنَّا لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَنَا إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 9.Has not the story Reached you, (O people !), of those Who (went) before you ?— Of the People of Noah And ‘Ād andThamūd ?— And of those who (came) After them ? None knows them But God. To them came Apostles with Clear (Signs) ; But they put their hands Up to their mouths, and said : “ We do deny (the mission) On which ye have been sent, And we are really In suspicious (disquieting) doubt As to that to which Ye invite us.”

arabic_text: ١٠- قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِي اللَّـهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ قَالُوا إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 10. Their apostles said : “ Is there A doubt about God, The Creator of the heavens And the earth ? It is He Who invites you, in order That He may forgive you Your sins and give you Respite for a term appointed ! ” They said : “ Ah ! ye are No more than human, Like ourselves ! Ye wish To turn us away from The (gods) our fathers Used to worship : then Bring us some clear authority.”

arabic_text: ١١- قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. Their apostles said to them : “ True, we are human Like yourselves, but God Doth grant His grace To such of His servants As He pleases. It is not For us to bring you An authority except as God Permits. And on God Let all men of faith Put their trust.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمَا لَنَا أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ وَقَدْ هَدَانَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَا آذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. “ No reason have we why We should not put our trust On God. Indeed He Has guided us to the Ways We (follow). We shall certainly Bear with patience all The hurt you may cause us. For those who put their trust Should put their trust on God.”

arabic_text: ١٣- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَا أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِي مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 13.And the Unbelievers said To their apostles : “ Be sure We shall drive you out Of our land, or ye shall Return to our religion.” But their Lord inspired (This Message) to them : “ Verily We shall cause The wrong-doers to perish !

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِي وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 14. “ And verily We shall Cause you to abide In the land, and succeed them. This for such as fear The Time when they shall stand Before My tribunal,—such As fear the Punishment denounced.”

arabic_text: ١٥- وَاسْتَفْتَحُوا وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 15. But they sought victory and decision (There and then), and frustration Was the lot of every Powerful obstinate transgressor.

arabic_text: ١٦- مِّن وَرَائِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّاءٍ صَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 16. In front of such a one Is Hell, and he is given, For drink, boiling fetid water.

arabic_text: ١٧- يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُ وَيَأْتِيهِ الْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ ۖ وَمِن وَرَائِهِ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌ◯
english_translation: 17. In gulps will he sip it, But never well he be near Swallowing it down his throat : Death will come to him From every quarter, yet Will he not die : and In front of him will be A chastisement unrelenting.

arabic_text: ١٨- مَّثَلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ اشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَالُ الْبَعِيدُ◯
english_translation: 18.The parable of those who Reject their Lord is that Their works are as ashes, On which the wind blows Furiously on a tempestuous day : No power have they over Aught that they have earned : That is the straying Far, far (from the goal).

arabic_text: ١٩- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 19. Seest thou not that God Created the heavens and the earth In Truth ? If He so will, He can remove you And put (in your place) A new Creation ?

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ بِعَزِيزٍ◯
english_translation: 20. Nor is that for God Any great matter.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَبَرَزُوا لِلَّـهِ جَمِيعًا فَقَالَ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ قَالُوا لَوْ هَدَانَا اللَّـهُ لَهَدَيْنَاكُمْ ۖ سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَجَزِعْنَا أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍ◯
english_translation: 21. They will all be marshalled Before God together : then Will the weak say to those Who were arrogant, “ For us, We but followed you ; can ye Then avail us at all Against the Wrath of God ? ” They will reply, “ If we Had received the guidance Of God, we should have Given it to you : to us It makes no difference (now) Whether we rage, or bear (These torments) with patience : For ourselves there is no way Of escape.”

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِيَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَاسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِي ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِي وَلُومُوا أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّا أَنَا بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِيَّ ۖ إِنِّي كَفَرْتُ بِمَا أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 22.And Satan will say When the matter is decided : “ It was God Who gave you A promise of Truth : I too Promised, but I failed In my promise to you. I had no authority over you Except to call you, but ye Listened to me : then Reproach not me, but reproach Your own souls. I cannot listen To your cries, nor can ye Listen to mine. I reject Your former act in associating Me with God. For wrong-doers there must be A grievous Penalty.”

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَأُدْخِلَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَامٌ◯
english_translation: 23.But those who believe And work righteousness Will be admitted to Gardens Beneath which rivers flow,— To dwell therein for aye With the leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein Will be : “ Peace ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ◯
english_translation: 24.Seest thou not how God sets forth a parable ?— A goodly Word Like a goodly tree, Whose root is firmly fixed, And its branches (reach) To the heavens,—

arabic_text: ٢٥- تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّـهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. It brings forth its fruit At all times, by the leave Of its Lord. So God sets forth parables For men, in order that They may receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ اجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ الْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍ◯
english_translation: 26. And the parable Of an evil Word Is that of an evil tree : It is torn up by the root From the surface of the earth : It has no stability.

arabic_text: ٢٧- يُثَبِّتُ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ اللَّـهُ الظَّالِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ اللَّـهُ مَا يَشَاءُ◯
english_translation: 27. God will establish in strength Those who believe, with the Word That stands firm, in this world And in the Hereafter ; but God Will leave, to stray, those Who do wrong : God doeth What He willeth.

arabic_text: ٢٨- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّـهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِ◯
english_translation: 28.Hast thou not turned Thy vision to those who Have changed the favour of God Into blasphemy and caused Their people to descend To the House of Perdition ?—

arabic_text: ٢٩- جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ◯
english_translation: 29. Into Hell ? They will burn Therein,—an evil place To stay in !

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَجَعَلُوا لِلَّـهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلُّوا عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 30. And they set up (idols) As equal to God, to mislead (Men) from the Path ! Say : “ Enjoy (your brief power) ! But verily ye are making Straightway for Hell ! ”

arabic_text: ٣١- قُل لِّعِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَالٌ◯
english_translation: 31.Speak to My servants Who have believed, That they may establish Regular prayers, and spend (In charity) out of the Sustenance We have given them, Secretly and openly, before The coming of a Day In which there will be Neither mutual bargaining Nor befriending.

arabic_text: ٣٢- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِيَ فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْهَارَ◯
english_translation: 32.It is God Who hath created The heavens and the earth And sendeth down rain From the skies, and with it Bringeth out fruits wherewith To feed you ; it is He Who hath made the ships subject To you, that they may sail Through the sea by His Command ; And the rivers (also) Hath He made subject to you.

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ دَائِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ◯
english_translation: 33. And He hath made subject To you the sun and the moon, Both diligently pursuing Their courses ; and the Night And the Day hath He (also) Made subject you.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَآتَاكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّـهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا ۗ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَظَلُومٌ كَفَّارٌ◯
english_translation: 34. And He giveth you Of all that ye ask for. But if ye count the favours Of God, never will ye Be able to number them. Verily, man is given up To injustice and ingratitude.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَـٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ◯
english_translation: 35.Remember Abraham said : “ O my Lord ! make this city One of peace and security : And preserve me and my sons From worshipping idols.

arabic_text: ٣٦- رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 36. “ O my Lord ! they have indeed Led astray many among mankind ; He then who follows my (ways) Is of me, and he that Disobeys me,—but Thou Art indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٣٧- رَّبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُم مِّنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. “ O our Lord ! I have made Some of my offspring to dwell In a valley without cultivation, By Thy Sacred House ; In order, O our Lord, that they May establish regular Prayer : So fill the hearts of some Among men with love towards them, And feed them with Fruits : So that they may give thanks.

arabic_text: ٣٨- رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ◯
english_translation: 38. “ O our Lord ! truly Thou Dost know what we conceal And what we reveal : For nothing whatever is hidden From God, whether on earth Or in heaven.

arabic_text: ٣٩- الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ◯
english_translation: 39. “ Praise be to God, Who hath Granted unto me in old age Ismā‘īl and Isaac : for truly My Lord is He, the Hearer Of Prayer !

arabic_text: ٤٠- رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ◯
english_translation: 40. “ O my Lord ! make me One who establishes regular Prayer, And also (raise such) Among my offspring O our Lord ! And accept Thou my Prayer.

arabic_text: ٤١- رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ◯
english_translation: 41. “ O our Lord ! cover (us) With Thy Forgiveness—me, My parents, and (all) Believers, On the Day that the Reckoning Will be established ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّـهَ غَافِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ الْأَبْصَارُ◯
english_translation: 42.Think not that God Doth not heed the deeds Of those who do wrong. He but giveth them respite Against a Day when The eyes will fixedly stare In horror,—

arabic_text: ٤٣- مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَاءٌ◯
english_translation: 43. They running forward With necks outstretched, Their heads uplifted, their gaze Returning not towards them, And their hearts a (gaping) void !

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَأَنذِرِ النَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ الْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا رَبَّنَا أَخِّرْنَا إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوا أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍ◯
english_translation: 44.So warn mankind Of the Day when the Wrath Will reach them : then will The wrong-doers say : “ Our Lord ! Respite us (if only) For a short Term : we will Answer Thy Call, and follow The apostles ! ” “ What ! were ye not wont To swear aforetime that ye Should suffer no decline ?

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَسَكَنتُمْ فِي مَسَاكِنِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ الْأَمْثَالَ◯
english_translation: 45. “ And ye dwelt in the dwellings Of men who wronged their own Souls ; ye were clearly shown How We dealt with them ; And We put forth many Parables In your behoof ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ اللَّـهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ الْجِبَالُ◯
english_translation: 46. Mighty indeed were the plots Which they made, but their plots Were (well) within the sight Of God, even though they were Such as to shake the hills !

arabic_text: ٤٧- فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّـهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو انتِقَامٍ◯
english_translation: 47. Never think that God would fail His apostles in His promise : For God is Exalted in Power,— The Lord of Retribution.

arabic_text: ٤٨- يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا لِلَّـهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ◯
english_translation: 48.One day the Earth will be Changed to a different Earth, And so will be the Heavens, And (men) will be marshalled Forth, before God, the One, The Irresistible ;

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ◯
english_translation: 49. And thou wilt see The Sinners that day Bound together in fetters ;—

arabic_text: ٥٠- سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ◯
english_translation: 50. Their garments of liquid pitch, And their faces covered with Fire ;

arabic_text: ٥١- لِيَجْزِيَ اللَّـهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 51. That God may requite Each soul according To its deserts ; And verily God is Swift In calling to account.

arabic_text: ٥٢- هَـٰذَا بَلَاغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 52.Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, And let them know that He Is (no other than) One God : Let men of understanding Take heed.

arabic_text: ١- الر ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ وَقُرْآنٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 1.A. L. R.These are The Āyats of Revelation,— Of a Qur-ān That makes things clear.

arabic_text: ٢- رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 2.Again and again will those Who disbelieve, wish that they Had bowed (to God’s Will) In Islām.

arabic_text: ٣- ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. Leave them alone, to enjoy (The good things of this life) And to please themselves : Let (false) Hope amuse them : soon Will knowledge (undeceive them).

arabic_text: ٤- وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ◯
english_translation: 4.Never did We destroy A population that had not A term decreed and assigned Beforehand.

arabic_text: ٥- مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Neither can a people anticipate Its Term, nor delay it.

arabic_text: ٦- وَقَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 6. They say : “ O thou to whom The Message is being revealed ! Truly thou art mad (or possessed) !

arabic_text: ٧- لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 7. “ Why bringest thou not Angels to us if it be That thou hast the Truth ? ”

arabic_text: ٨- مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوا إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. We send not the angels Down except for just cause : If they came (to the ungodly), Behold ! no respite would they have !

arabic_text: ٩- إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.We have, without doubt, Sent down the Message ; And We will assuredly Guard it (from corruption).

arabic_text: ١٠- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 10.We did send apostles before thee Amongst the religious sects Of old :

arabic_text: ١١- وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. But never came an apostle To them but they mocked him.

arabic_text: ١٢- كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 12. Even so do We let it creep Into the hearts of the sinners—

arabic_text: ١٣- لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. That they should not believe In the (Message) ; but the ways Of the ancients have passed away.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّوا فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ◯
english_translation: 14.Even if We opened out to them A gate from heaven, And they were to continue (All day) ascending therein,

arabic_text: ١٥- لَقَالُوا إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. They would only say : “ Our eyes have been intoxicated : Nay, we have been bewitched By sorcery.”

arabic_text: ١٦- وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 16.It is We Who have set out The Zodiacal Signs in the heavens, And made them fair-seeming To (all) beholders ;

arabic_text: ١٧- وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 17. And (moreover) We have guarded them From every evil spirit accursed :

arabic_text: ١٨- إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 18. But any that gains a hearing By stealth, is pursued By a flaming fire, bright (to see).

arabic_text: ١٩- وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ◯
english_translation: 19.And the earth We have spread out (Like a carpet) ; set thereon Mountains firm and immovable ; And produced therein all kinds Of things in due balance.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. And We have provided therein Means of subsistence,—for you And for those for whose sustenance Ye are not responsible.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِن مِّن شَيْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 21.And there is not a thing But its (sources and) treasures (Inexhaustible) are with Us ; But We only send down Thereof in due and ascertainable measures.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَا أَنتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 22. And We send the fecundating winds, Then cause the rain to descend From the sky, therewith providing You with water (in abundance), Though ye are not the guardians Of its stores.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوَارِثُونَ◯
english_translation: 23.And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give Death : it is We Who remain Inheritors (After all else passes away).

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 24.To Us are known those of you Who hasten forward, and those Who lag behind.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 25. Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together : For He is Perfect in Wisdom And Knowledge.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 26.We created man from sounding clay, From mud moulded into shape ;

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَالْجَانَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ السَّمُومِ◯
english_translation: 27. And the Jinn race, We had Created before, from the fire Of a scorching wind.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 28.Behold ! thy Lord said To the angels : “ I am about To create man, from sounding clay, From mud moulded into shape ;

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. “ When I have fashioned him (In due proportion) and breathed Into him of My spirit, Fall ye down in obeisance Unto him.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. So the angels prostrated themselves, All of them together :

arabic_text: ٣١- إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. Not so Iblīs : he refused to be Among those who prostrated themselves.

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ السَّاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. (God) said : “ O Iblīs ! What is your reason For not being among those Who prostrated themselves ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 33. (Iblīs) said : “ I am not one To prostrate myself to man, Whom Thou didst create From sounding clay, from mud Moulded into shape.”

arabic_text: ٣٤- قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 34. (God) said : “ Then get thee out From here ; for thou art Rejected, accursed.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 35. “ And the Curse shall be On thee till the Day of Judgment.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. (Iblīs) said : “ O my Lord ! Give me then respite Till the Day The (dead) are raised.”

arabic_text: ٣٧- قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. (God) said : “ Respite Is granted thee—

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ◯
english_translation: 38. “ Till the Day Of the Time Appointed.”

arabic_text: ٣٩- قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَغْوَيْتَنِي لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 39. (Iblīs) said : “ O my Lord ! Because Thou hast put me In the wrong, I will Make (wrong) fair-seeming To them on the earth, And I will put them All in the wrong,—

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. “ Except Thy servants among them, Sincere and purified (By Thy grace).”

arabic_text: ٤١- قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 41. (God) said : “ This (Way Of My sincere servants) is Indeed a Way that leads Straight to Me.

arabic_text: ٤٢- إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغَاوِينَ◯
english_translation: 42. “ For over My servants No authority shalt thou Have, except such as Put themselves in the wrong And follow thee.”

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 43.And verily, Hell Is the promised abode For them all !

arabic_text: ٤٤- لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ◯
english_translation: 44. To it are seven Gates : For each of those Gates Is a (special) class (Of sinners) assigned.

arabic_text: ٤٥- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 45.The righteous (will be) Amid Gardens And fountains (Of clear-flowing water).

arabic_text: ٤٦- ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. (Their greeting will be) : “ Enter ye here In Peace and Security.”

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَانًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. And We shall remove From their hearts any Lurking sense of injury : (They will be) brothers (Joyfully) facing each other On thrones (of dignity).

arabic_text: ٤٨- لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ◯
english_translation: 48. There no sense of fatigue Shall touch them, Nor shall they (ever) Be asked to leave.

arabic_text: ٤٩- نَبِّئْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 49.Tell My servants That I am indeed The Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful ;

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْأَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 50. And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ◯
english_translation: 51.Tell them about The guests of Abraham.

arabic_text: ٥٢- إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. When they entered his presence And said, “ Peace ! ” He said, “ We feel Afraid of you ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٣- قَالُوا لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 53. They said : “ Fear not ! We give thee glad tidings Of a son endowed With wisdom.”

arabic_text: ٥٤- قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَىٰ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. He said : “ Do ye give me Glad tidings that old age Has seized me ? Of what, Then, is your good news ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٥- قَالُوا بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ الْقَانِطِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. They said : “ We give thee Glad tidings in truth : Be not then in despair ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٦- قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضَّالُّونَ◯
english_translation: 56. He said : “ And who Despairs of the mercy Of his Lord, but such As go astray ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٧- قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.Abraham said : “ What then Is the business on which Ye (have come), O ye Messengers (of God) ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٨- قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. They said : “ We have been Sent to a people (Deep) in sin,

arabic_text: ٥٩- إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 59. “ Excepting the adherents Of Lūṭ : them we are certainly (Charged) to save (from harm),— All—

arabic_text: ٦٠- إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَا ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 60. “ Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, Will be among those Who will lag behind.”

arabic_text: ٦١- فَلَمَّا جَاءَ آلَ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 61.At length when the messengers Arrived among the adherents Of Lūṭ,

arabic_text: ٦٢- قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. He said : “ Ye appear To be uncommon folk.”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالُوا بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. They said : “ Yea, We have come to thee To accomplish that Of which they doubt.

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَأَتَيْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. “ We have brought to thee That which is inevitably Due, and assuredly We tell the truth.

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَامْضُوا حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. “ Then travel by night With thy household, When a portion of the night (Yet remains), and do thou Bring up the rear : Let no one amongst you Look back, but pass on Whither ye are ordered.”

arabic_text: ٦٦- وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ الْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 66. And We made known This decree to him, That the last remnants Of those (sinners) should be Cut off by the morning.

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَجَاءَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 67.The inhabitants of the City Came in (mad) joy (At news of the young men).

arabic_text: ٦٨- قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ ضَيْفِي فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ◯
english_translation: 68. Lūṭ said : “ These are My guests : disgrace me not :

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ◯
english_translation: 69. “ But fear God, And shame me not.”

arabic_text: ٧٠- قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 70. They said : “ Did we not Forbid thee (to speak) For all and sundry ? ”

arabic_text: ٧١- قَالَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي إِن كُنتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 71. He said : “ There are My daughters (to marry), If ye must act (so).”

arabic_text: ٧٢- لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), In their wild intoxication, They wander in distraction, To and fro.

arabic_text: ٧٣- فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 73. But the (mighty) Blast Overtook them before morning,

arabic_text: ٧٤- فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ◯
english_translation: 74. And We turned (the Cities) Upside down, and rained down On them brimstones Hard as baked clay.

arabic_text: ٧٥- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ◯
english_translation: 75. Behold ! in this are Signs For those who by tokens Do understand.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 76. And the (Cities were) Right on the high-road.

arabic_text: ٧٧- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. Behold ! in this Is a Sign For those who believe !

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 78.And the Companions of the Wood Were also wrong-doers ;

arabic_text: ٧٩- فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 79. So We exacted retribution From them. They were both On an open highway, Plain to see.

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 80.The Companions of the Rocky Tract Also rejected the apostles :

arabic_text: ٨١- وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا فَكَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 81. We sent them Our Signs, But they persisted In turning away from them.

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَكَانُوا يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 82. Out of the mountains Did they hew (their) edifices, (Feeling themselves) secure.

arabic_text: ٨٣- فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 83. But the (mighty) Blast Seized them of a morning,

arabic_text: ٨٤- فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 84. And of no avail to them Was all that they did (With such art and care) !

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ ۖ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيلَ◯
english_translation: 85.We created not the heavens, The earth, and all between them, But for just ends. And the Hour is surely Coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) With gracious forgiveness.

arabic_text: ٨٦- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 86. For verily it is thy Lord Who is the Master-Creator, Knowing all things.

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ◯
english_translation: 87. And We have bestowed Upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (Verses) And the Grand Qur-ān.

arabic_text: ٨٨- لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 88. Strain not thine eyes (Wistfully) at what We Have bestowed on certain classes Of them, nor grieve over them : But lower thy wing (in gentleness) To the Believers.

arabic_text: ٨٩- وَقُلْ إِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 89.And say : “ I am indeed he That warneth openly And without ambiguity,”—

arabic_text: ٩٠- كَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الْمُقْتَسِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 90. (Of just such wrath) As We sent down On those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),—

arabic_text: ٩١- الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 91. (So also on such) As have made the Qur-ān Into shreds (as they please).

arabic_text: ٩٢- فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 92. Therefore, by thy Lord, We will, of a surety, Call them to account,

arabic_text: ٩٣- عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 93. For all their deeds.

arabic_text: ٩٤- فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 94. Therefore expound openly What thou art commanded, And turn away from those Who join false gods with God.

arabic_text: ٩٥- إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ◯
english_translation: 95. For sufficient are We Unto thee against those Who scoff,—

arabic_text: ٩٦- الَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. Those who adopt, with God, Another god:  but soon Will they come to know.

arabic_text: ٩٧- وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 97. We do indeed know How thy heart is distressed At what they say.

arabic_text: ٩٨- فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ السَّاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 98. But celebrate the praises Of thy Lord, and be of those Who prostrate themselves In adoration.

arabic_text: ٩٩- وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ◯
english_translation: 99. And serve thy Lord Until there come unto thee The Hour that is Certain.

arabic_text: ١- أَتَىٰ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 1. (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) The Command of God : Seek ye not then To hasten it : glory to Him, And far is He above Having the partners They ascribe unto Him !

arabic_text: ٢- يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةَ بِالرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرُوا أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاتَّقُونِ◯
english_translation: 2. He doth send down His angels With inspiration of His Command, To such of His servants As He pleaseth, (saying) : “ Warn (Man) that there is No god but I : so do Your duty unto Me.”

arabic_text: ٣- خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. He has created the heavens And the earth for just ends : Far is He above having The partners they ascribe to Him !

arabic_text: ٤- خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 4.He has created man From a sperm-drop ; And behold this same (man) Becomes an open disputer !

arabic_text: ٥- وَالْأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 5.And cattle He has created For you (men) : from them Ye derive warmth, And numerous benefits, And of their (meat) ye eat.

arabic_text: ٦- وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. And ye have a sense Of pride and beauty in them As ye drive them home In the evening, and as ye Lead them forth to pasture In the morning.

arabic_text: ٧- وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا بَالِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 7. And they carry your heavy loads To lands that ye could not (Otherwise) reach except with Souls distressed : for your Lord Is indeed Most Kind, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٨- وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. And (He has created) horses, Mules, and donkeys, for you To ride and use for show ; And He has created (other) things Of what ye have no knowledge.

arabic_text: ٩- وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 9.And unto God leads straight The Way, but there are ways That turn aside : if God Had willed, He could have Guided all of you.

arabic_text: ١٠- هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ◯
english_translation: 10.It is He Who sends down Rain from the sky : From it ye drink, And out of it (grows) The vegetation on which Ye feed your cattle.

arabic_text: ١١- يُنبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُونَ وَالنَّخِيلَ وَالْأَعْنَابَ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. With it He produces For you corn, olives, Date-palms, grapes, And every kind of fruit : Verily in this is a Sign For those who give thought.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ وَالنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 12.He has made subject to you The Night and the Day ; The Sun and the Moon ; And the Stars are in subjection By His Command : verily In this are Signs For men who are wise.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. And the things on this earth Which He has multiplied In varying colours (and qualities) : Verily in this is a Sign For men who celebrate The praises of God (in gratitude).

arabic_text: ١٤- وَهُوَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 14.It is He Who has made The sea subject, that ye May eat thereof flesh That is fresh and tender, And that ye may extract Therefrom ornaments to wear ; And thou seest the ships Therein that plough the waves, That ye may seek (thus) Of the bounty of God And that ye may be grateful.

arabic_text: ١٥- وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَارًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 15.And He has set up On the earth mountains Standing firm, lest it should Shake with you ; and rivers And roads ; that ye May guide yourselves ;

arabic_text: ١٦- وَعَلَامَاتٍ ۚ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. And marks and sign-posts ; And by the stars (Men) guide themselves.

arabic_text: ١٧- أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 17.Is then He Who creates Like one that creates not ? Will ye not receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ١٨- وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّـهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 18. If ye would count up The favours of God, Never would ye be able To number them : for God Is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. And God doth know What ye conceal, And what ye reveal.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. Those whom they invoke Besides God create nothing And are themselves created.

arabic_text: ٢١- أَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَاءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. (They are things) dead, Lifeless : nor do they know When they will be raised up.

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 22.Your God is One God : As to those who believe not In the Hereafter, their hearts Refuse to know, and they Are arrogant.

arabic_text: ٢٣- لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 23. Undoubtedly God doth know What they conceal, And what they reveal : Verily He loveth not the arrogant.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. When it is said to them, “ What is it that your Lord Has revealed ? ” they say, “ Tales of the ancients ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- لِيَحْمِلُوا أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ الَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. Let them bear, on the Day Of Judgment, their own burdens In full, and also (something) Of the burdens of those Without knowledge, whom they Misled. Alas, how grievous The burdens they will bear !

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى اللَّـهُ بُنْيَانَهُم مِّنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.Those before them did also Plot (against God’s Way) : But God took their structures From their foundations, and the roof Fell down on them from above ; And the Wrath seized them From directions they did not perceive.

arabic_text: ٢٧- ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ إِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوءَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will cover them With shame, and say : “ Where are My ‘ partners ’ Concerning whom ye used To dispute (with the godly) ? ” Those endued with knowledge Will say : “ This Day, indeed, Are the Unbelievers covered With Shame and Misery,—

arabic_text: ٢٨- الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوءٍ ۚ بَلَىٰ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. “ (Namely) those whose lives the angels Take in a state of wrong-doing To their own souls.” Then would they offer submission (With the pretence), “ We did No evil (knowingly).” (The angels Will reply), “ Nay, but verily God knoweth all that ye did ;

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَاۖفَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. “ So enter the gates of Hell, To dwell therein. Thus evil indeed Is the abode of the arrogant.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْۚقَالُوا خَيْرًاۗلِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۚوَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۚوَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 30.To the righteous (When) it is said, “ What Is it that your Lord Has revealed ? ” they say, “ All that is good.” To those Who do good, there is good In this world, and the Home Of the Hereafter is even better And excellent indeed is the Home Of the righteous,—

arabic_text: ٣١- جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللَّـهُ الْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. Gardens of Eternity which they Will enter : beneath them Flow (pleasant) rivers : they Will have therein all That they wish : thus doth God reward the righteous,—

arabic_text: ٣٢- الَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. (Namely) those whose lives The angels take in a state Of purity, saying (to them), “ Peace be on you ; enter ye The Garden, because of (the good) Which ye did (in the world).”

arabic_text: ٣٣- هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّـهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 33.Do the (ungodly) wait until The angels come to them, Or there comes the Command Of thy Lord (for their doom) ? So did those who went Before them. But God Wronged them not : nay, They wronged their own souls.

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. But the evil results Of their deeds overtook them, And that very (Wrath) At which they had scoffed Hemmed them in.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَا آبَاؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 35.The worshippers of false gods Say : “ If God had so willed, We should not have worshipped Aught but Him—neither we Nor our fathers,—nor should We have prescribed prohibitions Other than His.” So did those Who went before them. But what is the mission Of apostles but to preach The Clear Message ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى اللَّـهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلَالَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 36. For We assuredly sent Amongst every People an apostle, (With the Command), “ Serve God, and eschew Evil ” : Of the people were some whom God guided, and some On whom Error became Inevitably (established). So travel Through the earth, and see What was the end of those Who denied (the Truth).

arabic_text: ٣٧- إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. If thou art anxious For their guidance, yet God guideth not such As He leaves to stray, And there is none To help them.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّـهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللَّـهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 38.They swear their strongest oaths By God, that God will not Raise up those who die : Nay, but it is a promise (Binding) on Him in truth : But most among mankind Realise it not.

arabic_text: ٣٩- لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 39. (They must be raised up), In order that He may manifest To them the truth of that Wherein they differ, and that The rejecters of Truth May realise that they had Indeed (surrendered to) Falsehood.

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ إِذَا أَرَدْنَاهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ◯
english_translation: 40. For to anything which We Have willed, We but say The Word, “ Be ”, and it is.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا فِي اللَّـهِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 41.To those who leave Their homes in the cause Of God, after suffering oppression,— We will assuredly give A goodly home in this world ; But truly the reward Of the Hereafter will be greater. If they only realise (this) !

arabic_text: ٤٢- الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. (They are) those who persevere In patience, and put Their trust on their Lord.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 43.And before thee also The apostles We sent Were but men, to whom We granted inspiration : if ye Realise this not, ask of those Who possess the Message.

arabic_text: ٤٤- بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. (We sent them) with Clear Signs And Books of dark prophecies ; And We have sent down Unto thee (also) the Message ; That thou mayest explain clearly To men what is sent For them, and that they May give thought.

arabic_text: ٤٥- أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ اللَّـهُ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 45.Do then those who devise Evil (plots) feel secure That God will not cause The earth to swallow them up, Or that the Wrath will not Seize them from directions They little perceive ?—

arabic_text: ٤٦- أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِي تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. Or that He may not Call them to account In the midst of their goings To and fro, without a chance Of their frustrating Him ?

arabic_text: ٤٧- أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 47. Or that He may not Call them to account By a process of slow wastage— For thy Lord is indeed Full of kindness and mercy.

arabic_text: ٤٨- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّـهُ مِن شَيْءٍ يَتَفَيَّأُ ظِلَالُهُ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَالشَّمَائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّـهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 48.Do they not look At God’s creation, (even) Among (inanimate) things,— How their (very) shadows Turn round, from the right And the left, prostrating Themselves to God, and that In the humblest manner ?

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَلِلَّـهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِن دَابَّةٍ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. And to God doth obeisance All that is in the heavens And on earth, whether Moving (living) creatures Or the angels : for none Are arrogant (before their Lord).

arabic_text: ٥٠- يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 50. They all revere their Lord, High above them, and they do All that they are commanded.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَقَالَ اللَّـهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَـٰهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ فَإِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُونِ◯
english_translation: 51.God has said : “ Take not (For worship) two gods : For He is just One God : Then fear Me (and Me alone).”

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَلَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّـهِ تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. To Him belongs whatever Is in the heavens and on earth, And to Him is duty due always : Then will ye fear other Than God ?

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّـهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْأَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. And ye have no good thing But is from God : and moreover, When ye are touched by distress, Unto Him ye cry with groans ;

arabic_text: ٥٤- ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. Yet, when He removes The distress from you, behold ! Some of you turn to other gods To join with their Lord—

arabic_text: ٥٥- لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. (As if) to show their ingratitude For the favours We have Bestowed on them ! Then enjoy (Your brief day) ; but soon Will ye know (your folly) !

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ ۗ تَاللَّـهِ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. And they (even) assign, To things they do not know, A portion out of that Which we have bestowed For their sustenance ! By God, ye shall certainly Be called to account For your false inventions.

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّـهِ الْبَنَاتِ سُبْحَانَهُ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.And they assign daughters For God !—Glory be to Him !— And for themselves (sons,— The issue) they desire !

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِالْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 58. When news is brought To one of them, of (the birth Of) a female (child), his face Darkens, and he is filled With inward grief !

arabic_text: ٥٩- يَتَوَارَىٰ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِن سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُ فِي التُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. With shame does he hide Himself from his people, Because of the bad news He has had ! Shall he retain it On (sufferance and) contempt, Or bury it in the dust ? Ah ! what an evil (choice) They decide on ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّـهِ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 60. To those who believe not In the Hereafter, applies The similitude of evil : To God applies the highest Similitude : for He is The Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٦١- وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّـهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 61.If God were to punish Men for their wrong-doing, He would not leave, on the (earth), A single living creature : But He gives them respite For a stated Term : When their Term expires, They would not be able To delay (the punishment) For a single hour, just as They would not be able To anticipate it (for a single hour).

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّـهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. They attribute to God What they hate (for themselves), And their tongues assert The falsehood that all good things Are for themselves : without doubt For them is the Fire, and they Will be the first to be Hastened on into it !

arabic_text: ٦٣- تَاللَّـهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 63.By God, We (also) sent (Our apostles) to Peoples Before thee ; but Satan Made, (to the wicked), Their own acts seem alluring : He is also their patron to-day, But they shall have A most grievous penalty.

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. And We sent down the Book To thee for the express purpose, That thou shouldst make clear To them those things in which They differ, and that it should be A guide and a mercy To those who believe.

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَاللَّـهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. And God sends down rain From the skies, and gives therewith Life to the earth after its death : Verily in this is a Sign For those who listen.

arabic_text: ٦٦- وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِي بُطُونِهِ مِن بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَائِغًا لِّلشَّارِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 66.And verily in cattle (too) Will ye find an instructive Sign. From what is within their bodies, Between excretions and blood, We produce, for your drink, Milk, pure and agreeable To those who drink it.

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَمِن ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. And from the fruit Of the date-palm and the vine, Ye get out wholesome drink And food : behold, in this Also is a Sign For those who are wise.

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ◯
english_translation: 68. And thy Lord taught the Bee To build its cells in hills, On trees, and in (men’s) habitations ;

arabic_text: ٦٩- ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. Then to eat of all The produce (of the earth), And find with skill the spacious Paths of its Lord : there issues From within their bodies A drink of varying colours, Wherein is healing for men : Verily in this is a Sign For those who give thought.

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَاللَّـهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّاكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 70. It is God Who creates you And takes your souls at death ; And of you there are Some who are sent back To a feeble age, so that They know nothing after Having known (much) : For God is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

arabic_text: ٧١- وَاللَّـهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا الَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا بِرَادِّي رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّـهِ يَجْحَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 71.God has bestowed His gifts Of sustenance more freely on some Of you than on others : those More favoured are not going To throw back their gifts To those whom their right hands Possess, so as to be equal In that respect. Will they then Deny the favours of God ?

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَاللَّـهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللَّـهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. And God has made for you Mates (and companions) of your own nature, And made for you, out of them, Sons and daughters and grandchildren, And provided for you sustenance Of the best : will they Then believe in vain things, And be ungrateful for God’s favours ?—

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. And worship others than God,— Such as have no power Of providing them, for sustenance, With anything in heavens or earth, And cannot possibly have Such power ?

arabic_text: ٧٤- فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا لِلَّـهِ الْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 74.Invent not similitudes For God : for God knoweth, And ye know not.

arabic_text: ٧٥- ضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَاهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُونَ ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. God sets forth the Parable (Of two men : one) a slave Under the dominion of another ; He has no power of any sort ; And (the other) a man On whom We have bestowed Goodly favours from Ourselves, And he spends thereof (freely), Privately and publicly : Are the two equal ? (By no means ;) Praise be to God. But Most of them understand not.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَاهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 76. God sets forth (another) Parable Of two men : one of them Dumb, with no power Of any sort ; a wearisome burden Is he to his master ; Whichever way he directs him, He brings no good : Is such a man equal With one who commands Justice, and is on A Straight Way ?

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَلِلَّـهِ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَا أَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 77.To God belongeth the Mystery Of the heavens and the earth. And the Decision of the Hour (Of Judgment) is as The twinkling of an eye, Or even quicker : For God hath power Over all things.

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَاللَّـهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّن بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 78. It is He Who brought you Forth from the wombs Of your mothers when Ye knew nothing ; and He Gave you hearing and sight And intelligence and affections : That ye may give thanks (To God).

arabic_text: ٧٩- أَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ فِي جَوِّ السَّمَاءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. Do they not look at The birds, held poised In the midst of (the air And) the sky ? Nothing Holds them up but (the power Of) God. Verily in this Are Signs for those who believe.

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَاللَّـهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ الْأَنْعَامِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَا أَثَاثًا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 80.
