It is God Who made your habitations Homes of rest and quiet For you; and made for you, Out of the skins of animals, (Tents for) dwellings, which Ye find so light (and handy) When ye travel and when Ye stop (in your travels) ; And out of their wool, And their soft fibres (Between wool and hair), And their hair, rich stuff And articles of convenience (To serve you) for a time.

arabic_text: ٨١- وَاللَّـهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَالًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ أَكْنَانًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 81. It is God Who made, Out of the things He created, Some things to give you shade ; Of the hills He made some For your shelter ; He made you Garments to protect you From heat, and coats of mail To protect you from Your (mutual) violence. Thus does He complete His favours on you, that Ye may bow to His Will (in Islām).

arabic_text: ٨٢- فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 82. But if they turn away, Thy duty is only to preach The Clear Message.

arabic_text: ٨٣- يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ اللَّـهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 83. They recognise the favours Of God ; then they deny them ; And most of them Are (creatures) ungrateful.

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 84.One day We shall raise From all Peoples a Witness : Then will no excuse be accepted From Unbelievers, nor will they Receive any favours.

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. When the wrong-doers (Actually) see the Penalty, Then will it in no way Be mitigated, nor will they Then receive respite.

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَإِذَا رَأَى الَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا شُرَكَاءَهُمْ قَالُوا رَبَّنَا هَـٰؤُلَاءِ شُرَكَاؤُنَا الَّذِينَ كُنَّا نَدْعُو مِن دُونِكَ ۖ فَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ إِنَّكُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 86. When those who gave partners To God will see their “ partners ”, They will say : “ Our Lord ! These are our ‘ partners,’ those Whom we used to invoke Besides Thee.” But they will Throw back their word at them (And say) : “ Indeed ye are liars ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَى اللَّـهِ يَوْمَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 87. That day shall they (openly) show (Their) submission to God ; and all Their inventions shall leave Them in the lurch.

arabic_text: ٨٨- الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ زِدْنَاهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا يُفْسِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. Those who reject God And hinder (men) from the Path Of God—for them Will We add Penalty To Penalty ; for that they Used to spread mischief.

arabic_text: ٨٩- وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِي كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيدًا عَلَىٰ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ ۚ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ تِبْيَانًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 89.One day We shall raise From all Peoples a witness Against them, from amongst themselves : And We shall bring thee As a witness against these (Thy people) : and We have sent down To thee the Book explaining All things, a Guide, a Mercy, And Glad Tidings to Muslims.

arabic_text: ٩٠- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 90.God commands justice, the doing Of good, and liberality to kith And kin, and He forbids All shameful deeds, and injustice And rebellion : He instructs you, That ye may receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٩١- وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّـهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمْ وَلَا تَنقُضُوا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللَّـهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيلًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 91. Fulfil the Covenant of God When ye have entered into it, And break not your oaths 3 ye have confirmed them ; Indeed ye have made God your surety ; for God Knoweth all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٩٢- وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّـهُ بِهِ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 92. And be not like a woman Who breaks into untwisted strands The yarn which she has spun, After it has become strong. Nor take your oaths to practise Deception between yourselves, Lest one party should be More numerous than another : For God will test you by this ; And on the Day of Judgment He will certainly make clear To you (the truth of) that Wherein ye disagree.

arabic_text: ٩٣- وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَلَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 93. If God so willed, He Could make you all one People : But He leaves straying Whom He pleases, and He guides Whom He pleases : but ye Shall certainly be called to account For all your actions.

arabic_text: ٩٤- وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوا أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا وَتَذُوقُوا السُّوءَ بِمَا صَدَدتُّمْ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 94. And take not your oaths, To practice deception between yourselves, With the result that someone’s foot May slip after it was Firmly planted, and ye may Have to taste the evil (consequences) Of having hindered (men) From the Path of God, And a mighty Wrath Descend on you.

arabic_text: ٩٥- وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا۟ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًۭا قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 95.Nor sell the Covenant of God For a miserable price : For with God is (a prize) Far better for you, If ye only knew.

arabic_text: ٩٦- مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّـهِ بَاقٍ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. What is with you must vanish : What is with God will endure. And We will certainly bestow, On those who patiently persevere, Their reward according to The best of their actions.

arabic_text: ٩٧- مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُ حَيَاةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 97. Whoever works righteousness, Man or woman, and has Faith, Verily, to him will We give A new Life, a life That is good and pure, and We Will bestow on such their reward According to the best Of their actions.

arabic_text: ٩٨- فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّـهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ◯
english_translation: 98.When thou dost read The Qur-ān, seek God’s protection From Satan the Rejected One.

arabic_text: ٩٩- إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ سُلْطَانٌ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 99. No authority has he over those Who believe and put their trust In their Lord.

arabic_text: ١٠٠- إِنَّمَا سُلْطَانُهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُ وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِهِ مُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 100. His authority is over those Only, who take him as patron And who join partners with God.

arabic_text: ١٠١- وَإِذَا بَدَّلْنَا آيَةً مَّكَانَ آيَةٍ ۙ وَاللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُفْتَرٍ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 101.When We substitute one revelation For another,—and God knows best What He reveals (in stages),— They say, “ Thou art but a forger ” : But most of them understand not.

arabic_text: ١٠٢- قُلْ نَزَّلَهُ رُوحُ الْقُدُسِ مِن رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 102. Say, the Holy Spirit has brought The revelation from thy Lord In Truth, in order to strengthen Those who believe, and as a Guide And Glad Tidings to Muslims.

arabic_text: ١٠٣- وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهُ بَشَرٌ ۗ لِّسَانُ الَّذِي يُلْحِدُونَ إِلَيْهِ أَعْجَمِيٌّ وَهَـٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 103. We know indeed that they Say, “ It is a man that Teaches him.” The tongue Of him they wickedly point to Is notable foreign, while this Is Arabic, pure and clear.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ لَا يَهْدِيهِمُ اللَّـهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 104. Those who believe not In the Signs of God,— God will not guide them, And theirs will be A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- إِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِي الْكَذِبَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 105. It is those who believe not In the Signs of God, That forge falsehood : It is they who lie !

arabic_text: ١٠٦- مَن كَفَرَ بِاللَّـهِ مِن بَعْدِ إِيمَانِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّن شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 106.Any one who, after accepting Faith in God, utters Unbelief,— Except under compulsion, His heart remaining firm In Faith—but such as Open their breast to Unbelief,— On them is Wrath from God, And theirs will be A dreadful Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٠٧- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْآخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 107. This because they love The life of this world Better than the Hereafter : And God will not guide Those who reject Faith.

arabic_text: ١٠٨- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْغَافِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 108. Those are they whose hearts, Ears, and eyes God has sealed up, And they take no heed.

arabic_text: ١٠٩- لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 109. Without doubt, in the Hereafter They will perish.

arabic_text: ١١٠- ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوا وَصَبَرُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِن بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 110. But verily thy Lord,— To those who leave their homes After trials and persecutions,— And who thereafter strive And fight for the Faith And patiently persevere,— Thy Lord, after all this Is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١١١- يَوْمَ تَأْتِي كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَن نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 111.One Day every soul Will come up struggling For itself, and every soul Will be recompensed (fully) For all its actions, and none Will be unjustly dealt with.

arabic_text: ١١٢- وَضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ آمِنَةً مُّطْمَئِنَّةً يَأْتِيهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِأَنْعُمِ اللَّـهِ فَأَذَاقَهَا اللَّـهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 112. God sets forth a Parable : A city enjoying security And quiet, abundantly supplied With sustenance from every place : Yet was it ungrateful For the favours of God : So God made it taste Of hunger and terror (in extremes) (Closing in on it) like a garment (From every side), because Of the (evil) which (Its people) wrought.

arabic_text: ١١٣- وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 113. And there came to them An Apostle from among themselves, But they falsely rejected him ; So the Wrath seized them Even in the midst Of their iniquities.

arabic_text: ١١٤- فَكُلُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّـهُ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاشْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّـهِ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 114.So eat of the sustenance Which God has provided For you, lawful and good ; And be grateful for the favours Of God, if it is He Whom ye serve.

arabic_text: ١١٥- إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّـهِ بِهِ ۖ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 115. He has only forbidden you Dead meat, and blood, And the flesh of swine, And any (food) over which The name of other than God Has been invoked. But if one is forced by necessity, Without wilful disobedience, Nor transgressing due limits,— Then God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١١٦- وَلَا تَقُولُوا لِمَا تَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هَـٰذَا حَلَالٌ وَهَـٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّـهِ الْكَذِبَ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 116. But say not—for any false thing That your tongues may put forth,— “ This is lawful, and this Is forbidden,” so as to ascribe False things to God. For those Who ascribe false things To God, will never prosper.

arabic_text: ١١٧- مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 117. (In such falsehood) Is but a paltry profit ; But they will have A most grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ١١٨- وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ هَادُوا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 118.To the Jews We prohibited Such things as We have Mentioned to thee before : We did them no wrong, But they were used to Doing wrong to themselves.

arabic_text: ١١٩- ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِن بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 119. But verily thy Lord,— To those who do wrong In ignorance, but who Thereafter repent and make amends,— Thy Lord, after all this, Is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٢٠- إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كَانَ أُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلَّـهِ حَنِيفًا وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 120.Abraham was indeed a model, Devoutly obedient to God, (And) true in faith, and he Joined not gods with God :

arabic_text: ١٢١- شَاكِرًا لِّأَنْعُمِهِ ۚ اجْتَبَاهُ وَهَدَاهُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 121. He showed his gratitude For the favours of God, Who chose him, and guided him To a Straight Way.

arabic_text: ١٢٢- وَآتَيْنَاهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 122. And We gave him Good In this world, and he will be, In the Hereafter, in the ranks Of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ١٢٣- ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 123. So We have taught thee The inspired (message), “ Follow the ways of Abraham The True in Faith, and he Joined not gods with God.”

arabic_text: ١٢٤- إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ ۚ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 124. The Sabbath was only made (Strict) to those who disagreed (As to its observance) ; But God will judge between them On the Day of Judgment, As to their differences.

arabic_text: ١٢٥- ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ ۖ وَجَادِلْهُم بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ◯
english_translation: 125.Invite (all) to the Way Of thy Lord with wisdom And beautiful preaching ; And argue with them In ways that are best And most gracious : For thy Lord knoweth best, Who have strayed from His Path, And who receive guidance.

arabic_text: ١٢٦- وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِ ۖ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 126. And if ye do catch them out, Catch them out no worse Than they catch you out : But if ye show patience, That is indeed the best (course) For those who are patient.

arabic_text: ١٢٧- وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّـهِ ۚ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 127. And do thou be patient, For thy patience is but From God ; nor grieve over them : And distress not thyself Because of their plots.

arabic_text: ١٢٨- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 128. For God is with those Who restrain themselves, And those who do good.

arabic_text: ١- سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى الَّذِي بَارَكْنَا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِيَهُ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 1.Glory to (God) Who did take His Servant For a Journey by night From the Sacred Mosque To the Farthest Mosque, Whose precincts We did Bless,—in order that We Might show him some Of Our Signs : for He Is the One Who heareth And seeth (all things).

arabic_text: ٢- وَآتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا مِن دُونِي وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 2. We gave Moses the Book, And made it a Guide To the Children of Israel, (Commanding) : “ Take not Other than Me As Disposer of (your) affairs.”

arabic_text: ٣- ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا◯
english_translation: 3. O ye that are sprung From those whom We carried (In the Ark) with Noah ! Verily he was a devotee Most grateful.

arabic_text: ٤- وَقَضَيْنَا إِلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فِي الْكِتَابِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 4. And We gave (clear) warning To the Children of Israel In the Book, that twice Would they do mischief On the earth and be elated With mighty arrogance (And twice would they be punished) !

arabic_text: ٥- فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ أُولَاهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًا لَّنَا أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ فَجَاسُوا خِلَالَ الدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًا مَّفْعُولًا◯
english_translation: 5. When the first of the warnings Came to pass, We sent Against you Our servants Given to terrible warfare : They entered the very inmost Parts of your homes ; And it was a warning (Completely) fulfilled.

arabic_text: ٦- ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ الْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَاكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا◯
english_translation: 6. Then did We grant you The Return as against them : We gave you increase In resources and sons, And made you The more numerous In man-power.

arabic_text: ٧- إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا ۚ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ لِيَسُوءُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا الْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا مَا عَلَوْا تَتْبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 7. If ye did well, Ye did well for yourselves ; If ye did evil, (Ye did it) against yourselves. So when the second Of the warnings came to pass, (We permitted your enemies) To disfigure your faces, And to enter your Temple As they had entered it before, And to visit with destruction All that fell into their power.

arabic_text: ٨- عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ حَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 8. It may be that your Lord May (yet) show Mercy Unto you ; but if ye Revert (to your sins), We shall revert (To Our punishments) : And We have made Hell A prison for those who Reject (all Faith).

arabic_text: ٩- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَهْدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 9. Verily this Qur-ān Doth guide to that Which is most right (or stable), And giveth the glad tidings To the Believers who work Deeds of righteousness, That they shall have A magnificent reward ;

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 10. And to those who believe not In the Hereafter, (it announceth) That We have prepared For them a Penalty Grievous (indeed).

arabic_text: ١١- وَيَدْعُ الْإِنسَانُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَاءَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ عَجُولًا◯
english_translation: 11.The prayer that man Should make for good, He maketh for evil ; For man is given to Hasty (deeds).

arabic_text: ١٢- وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ آيَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَا آيَةَ اللَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَا آيَةَ النَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةً لِّتَبْتَغُوا فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا عَدَدَ السِّنِينَ وَالْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَصَّلْنَاهُ تَفْصِيلًا◯
english_translation: 12. We have made the Night And the Day as two (Of Our) Signs : the Sign Of the Night have We obscured, While the Sign of the Day We have made to enlighten You ; that ye may seek Bounty from your Lord, And that ye may know The number and count Of the years : all things Have We explained in detail.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَكُلَّ إِنسَانٍ أَلْزَمْنَاهُ طَائِرَهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كِتَابًا يَلْقَاهُ مَنشُورًا◯
english_translation: 13. Every man’s fate We have fastened On his own neck : On the Day of Judgment We shall bring out For him a scroll, Which he will see Spread open.

arabic_text: ١٤- اقْرَأْ كِتَابَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًا◯
english_translation: 14. (It will be said to him :) “ Read thine (own) record : Sufficient is thy soul This day to make out An account against thee.”

arabic_text: ١٥- مَّنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًا◯
english_translation: 15.Who receiveth guidance, Receiveth it for his own Benefit : who goeth astray Doth so to his own loss : No bearer of burdens Can bear the burden Of another : nor would We Visit with Our Wrath Until We had sent An apostle (to give warning).

arabic_text: ١٦- وَإِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا الْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا◯
english_translation: 16. When We decide to destroy A population, We (first) send A definite order to those Among them who are given The good things of this life And yet transgress ; so that The word is proved true Against them : then (it is) We destroy them utterly.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مِن بَعْدِ نُوحٍ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 17. How many generations Have We destroyed after Noah ? And enough is thy Lord To note and see The sins of His servants.

arabic_text: ١٨- مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُ فِيهَا مَا نَشَاءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَاهَا مَذْمُومًا مَّدْحُورًا◯
english_translation: 18.If any do wish For the transitory things (Of this life), We readily Grant them—such things As We will, to such persons As We will : in the end Have We provided Hell For them : they will burn Therein, disgraced and rejected.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَمَنْ أَرَادَ الْآخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا◯
english_translation: 19. Those who do wish For the (things of) the Hereafter, And strive therefor With all due striving, And have Faith,— They are the ones Whose striving is acceptable (To God).

arabic_text: ٢٠- كُلًّا نُّمِدُّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ وَهَـٰؤُلَاءِ مِنْ عَطَاءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَاءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا◯
english_translation: 20. Of the bounties of thy Lord We bestow freely on all— These as well as those : The bounties of thy Lord Are not closed (to anyone).

arabic_text: ٢١- انظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَلَلْآخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَاتٍ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًا◯
english_translation: 21. See how We have bestowed More on some than on others ; But verily the Hereafter Is more in rank and gradation And more in excellence.

arabic_text: ٢٢- لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًا مَّخْذُولًا◯
english_translation: 22. Take not with God Another object of worship ; Or thou (O man !) wilt sit In disgrace and destitution.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَا أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَا أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا◯
english_translation: 23.Thy Lord hath decreed That ye worship none but Him, And that ye be kind To parents. Whether one Or both of them attain Old age in thy life, Say not to them a word Of contempt, nor repel them, But address them In terms of honour.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا◯
english_translation: 24. And, out of kindness, Lower to them the wing Of humility, and say : “ My Lord ! bestow on them Thy Mercy even as they Cherished me in childhood.”

arabic_text: ٢٥- رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا صَالِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّابِينَ غَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 25. Your Lord knoweth best What is in your hearts : If ye do deeds of righteousness, Verily He is Most Forgiving To those who turn to Him Again and again (in true penitence).

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 26.And render to the kindred Their due rights, as (also) To those in want, And to the wayfarer : But squander not (your wealth) In the manner of a spendthrift.

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّ الْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوا إِخْوَانَ الشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِرَبِّهِ كَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 27. Verily spendthrifts are brothers Of the Evil Ones ; And the Evil One Is to his Lord (Himself) Ungrateful.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ رَحْمَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّيْسُورًا◯
english_translation: 28. And even if thou hast To turn away from them In pursuit of the Mercy From thy Lord which thou Dost expect, yet speak To them a word Of easy kindness.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا مَّحْسُورًا◯
english_translation: 29. Make not thy hand tied (Like a niggard’s) to thy neck, Nor stretch it forth To its utmost reach, So that thou become Blameworthy and destitute.

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 30. Verily thy Lord doth provide Sustenance in abundance For whom He pleaseth, and He Provideth in a just measure. For He doth know And regard all His servants.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَاقٍ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْئًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 31.Kill not your children For fear of want : We shall Provide sustenance for them As well as for you. Verily the killing of them Is a great sin.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا الزِّنَىٰ ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَاحِشَةً وَسَاءَ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 32. Nor come nigh to adultery : For it is a shameful (deed) And an evil, opening the road (To other evils).

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّـهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِ سُلْطَانًا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّي الْقَتْلِ ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مَنصُورًا◯
english_translation: 33. Nor take life—which God Has made sacred—except For just cause. And if Anyone is slain wrongfully, We have given his heir Authority (to demand Qiṣāṣ Or to forgive) : but let him Not exceed bounds in the matter Of taking life ; for he Is helped (by the Law).

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُ ۚ وَأَوْفُوا بِالْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْئُولًا◯
english_translation: 34.Come not nigh To the orphan’s property Except to improve it, Until he attains the age Of full strength ; and fulfil (Every) engagement, For (every) engagement Will be enquired into (On the Day of Reckoning).

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَأَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 35. Give full measure when ye Measure, and weigh With a balance that is straight : That is the most fitting And the most advantageous In the final determination.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَـٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا◯
english_translation: 36. And pursue not that Of which thou hast No knowledge ; for Every act of hearing, Or of seeing Or of (feeling in) the heart Will be enquired into (On the Day of Reckoning).

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ الْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ الْجِبَالَ طُولًا◯
english_translation: 37. Nor walk on the earth With insolence : for thou Canst not rend the earth Asunder, nor reach The mountains in height.

arabic_text: ٣٨- كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًا◯
english_translation: 38. Of all such things The evil is hateful In the sight of thy Lord.

arabic_text: ٣٩- ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّا أَوْحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا◯
english_translation: 39. These are among the (precepts Of) wisdom, which thy Lord Has revealed to thee. Take not, with God, Another object of worship, Lest thou shouldst be thrown Into Hell, blameworthy and rejected.

arabic_text: ٤٠- أَفَأَصْفَاكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِالْبَنِينَ وَاتَّخَذَ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنَاثًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 40.Has then your Lord, (O Pagans !) preferred for you Sons, and taken for Himself Daughters among the angels ? Truly ye utter A most dreadful saying !

arabic_text: ٤١- وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 41.We have explained (things) In various (ways) in this Qur-ān, In order that they may receive Admonition, but it only increases Their flight (from the Truth) !

arabic_text: ٤٢- قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُ آلِهَةٌ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًا لَّابْتَغَوْا إِلَىٰ ذِي الْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 42. Say : if there had been (Other) gods with Him,— As they say,—behold, They would certainly have Sought out a way To the Lord of the Throne !

arabic_text: ٤٣- سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 43. Glory to Him ! He is high Above all that they say !— Exalted and Great (beyond measure) !

arabic_text: ٤٤- تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ السَّبْعُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن مِّن شَيْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 44. The seven heavens and the earth, And all beings therein, Declare His glory : There not a thing But celebrates His praise ; And yet ye understand not How they declare His glory ! Verily He is Oft-Forbearing, Most Forgiving !

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا◯
english_translation: 45.When thou dost recite The Qur-ān, We put, Between thee and those who Believe not in the Hereafter, A veil invisible :

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَحْدَهُ وَلَّوْا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِهِمْ نُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 46. And We put coverings Over their hearts (and minds) Lest they should understand The Qur-ān, and deafness Into their ears : when thou Dost commemorate thy Lord— And Him alone—in the Qur-ān, They turn on their backs, Fleeing (from the Truth).

arabic_text: ٤٧- نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰ إِذْ يَقُولُ الظَّالِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا◯
english_translation: 47. We know best why it is They listen, when they listen To thee ; and when they Meet in private conference, Behold, the wicked say, “ Ye follow none other than A man bewitched ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- انظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 48. See what similes thy strike For thee : but they have gone Astray, and never can they Find a way.

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا◯
english_translation: 49.They say : “ What ! When we are reduced To bones and dust, Should we really be raised up (To be) a new creation ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٠- قُلْ كُونُوا حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا◯
english_translation: 50. Say : “ (Nay !) be ye Stones or iron,

arabic_text: ٥١- أَوْ خَلْقًا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِي صُدُورِكُمْ ۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا ۖ قُلِ الَّذِي فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًا◯
english_translation: 51. “ Or created matter Which, in your minds, Is hardest (to be raised up),— (Yet shall ye be raised up) ! ” Then will they say : “ Who will cause us To return ? ” Say : “ He Who created you first ! ” Then will they wag Their heads towards thee, And say, “ When will That be ? ” Say, “ May be It will be quite soon !

arabic_text: ٥٢- يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 52. “ It will be on a Day When He will call you, And ye will answer (His call) with (words Of) His praise, and ye Will think that ye tarried But a little while ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَقُل لِّعِبَادِي يَقُولُوا الَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَانِ عَدُوًّا مُّبِينًا◯
english_translation: 53.Say to My servants That they should (only) say Those things that are best : For Satan doth sow Dissensions among them : For Satan is to man An avowed enemy.

arabic_text: ٥٤- رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ۖ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ ۚ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 54. It is your Lord That knoweth you best : If He please, He granteth You mercy, or if He please, Punishment : We have not sent Thee to be a disposer Of their affairs for them.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ النَّبِيِّينَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَآتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا◯
english_translation: 55. And it is your Lord That knoweth best all beings That are in the heavens And on earth : We Did bestow on some Prophets More (and other) gifts Than on others : and We gave To David (the gift Of) the Psalms.

arabic_text: ٥٦- قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 56.Say : “ Call on those— Besides Him—whom ye fancy : They have neither the power To remove your troubles From you nor to change them.”

arabic_text: ٥٧- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًا◯
english_translation: 57. Those whom they call upon Do desire (for themselves) means Of access to their Lord,— Even those who are nearest : They hope for His Mercy And fear His Wrath : For the Wrath of thy Lord Is something to take heed of.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا◯
english_translation: 58. There is not a population But We shall destroy it Before the Day of Judgment Or punish it with A dreadful Penalty : That is written In the (eternal) Record.

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَمَا مَنَعَنَا أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِالْآيَاتِ إِلَّا أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا الْأَوَّلُونَ ۚ وَآتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ النَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةً فَظَلَمُوا بِهَا ۚ وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِالْآيَاتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًا◯
english_translation: 59. And We refrain from sending The Signs, only because The men of former generations Treated them as false : We sent the She-camel To theThamūd to open Their eyes, but they Treated her wrongfully : We only send the Signs By way of terror (And warning from evil).

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّؤْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُونَةَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 60. Behold ! We told thee That thy Lord doth encompass Mankind round about : We granted the Vision Which We showed thee, But as a trial for men,— As also the Cursed Tree (Mentioned) in the Qur-ān : We put terror (and warning) Into them, but it only Increases their inordinate transgression !

arabic_text: ٦١- وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ أَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًا◯
english_translation: 61.Behold ! We said to the angels : “ Bow down unto Adam ” : They bowed down except Iblīs : He said, “ Shall I bow down To one whom Thou didst create From clay ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٢- قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 62. He said, “ Seest Thou ? This is The one whom Thou hast honoured Above me ! If Thou wilt but Respite me to the Day Of Judgment, I will surely Bring his descendants Under my sway— All but a few ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَاؤُكُمْ جَزَاءً مَّوْفُورًا◯
english_translation: 63. (God) said : “ Go thy way ; If any of them follow thee, Verily Hell will be The recompense of you (all)— An ample recompense.

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَاسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا◯
english_translation: 64. “ Lead to destruction those Whom thou canst among them, With thy (seductive) voice ; Make assaults on them With thy cavalry and thy Infantry ; mutually share With them wealth and children ; And make promises to them.” But Satan promises them Nothing but deceit.

arabic_text: ٦٥- إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 65. “ As for My servants, No authority shalt thou Have over them : ” Enough is thy Lord For a Disposer of affairs.

arabic_text: ٦٦- رَّبُّكُمُ الَّذِي يُزْجِي لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِي الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 66.Your Lord is He That maketh the Ship Go smoothly for you Through the sea, in order that Ye may seek of His Bounty. For He is unto you Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاكُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ كَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 67. When distress seizes you At sea, those that ye Call upon—besides Himself— Leave you in the lurch ! But when He brings you back Safe to land, ye turn Away (from Him). Most ungrateful Is man !

arabic_text: ٦٨- أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ الْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 68. Do ye then feel secure That He will not cause you To be swallowed up Beneath the earth When ye are on land, Or that He will not send Against you a violent tornado (With showers of stones) So that ye shall find No one to carry out Your affairs for you ?

arabic_text: ٦٩- أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًا مِّنَ الرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ تَبِيعًا◯
english_translation: 69. Or do ye feel secure That He will not send you Back a second time To sea and send against you A heavy gale to drown you Because of your ingratitude, So that ye find no helper Therein against Us ?

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِي آدَمَ وَحَمَلْنَاهُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَاهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا◯
english_translation: 70. We have honoured the sons Of Adam ; provided them With transport on land and sea ; Given them for sustenance things Good and pure ; and conferred On them special favours, Above a great part Of Our Creation.

arabic_text: ٧١- يَوْمَ نَدْعُو كُلَّ أُنَاسٍ بِإِمَامِهِمْ ۖ فَمَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَابَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا◯
english_translation: 71.One day We shall call Together all human beings With their (respective) Imāms : Those who are given their record In their right hand Will read it (with pleasure), And they will not be Dealt with unjustly In the least.

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَمَن كَانَ فِي هَـٰذِهِ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 72. But those who were blind In this world, will be Blind in the Hereafter, And most astray From the Path.

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَإِن كَادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِيَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُ ۖ وَإِذًا لَّاتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 73.And their purpose was To tempt thee away From that which We Had revealed unto thee, To substitute in Our name Something quite different : (In that case), behold ! They would certainly have Made thee (their) friend !

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَلَوْلَا أَن ثَبَّتْنَاكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 74. And had We not Given thee strength, Thou wouldst nearly Have inclined to them A little.

arabic_text: ٧٥- إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَاكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيَاةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 75. In that case We should Have made thee taste An equal portion (of punishment) In this life, and an equal portion In death : and moreover Thou wouldst have found None to help thee against Us !

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَإِن كَادُوا لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَإِذًا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَافَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 76. Their purpose was to scare Thee off the land, In order to expel thee ; But in that case they Would not have stayed (Therein) after thee, Except for a little while.

arabic_text: ٧٧- سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 77. (This was Our) way With the apostles We sent Before thee : thou wilt find No change in Our ways.

arabic_text: ٧٨- أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِدُلُوكِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ اللَّيْلِ وَقُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ إِنَّ قُرْآنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا◯
english_translation: 78.Establish regular prayers— At the sun’s decline Till the darkness of the night, And the morning prayer And reading:  for the prayer And reading in the morning Carry their testimony.

arabic_text: ٧٩- وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِ نَافِلَةً لَّكَ عَسَىٰ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا◯
english_translation: 79. And pray in the small watches Of the morning : (it would be) An additional prayer (Or spiritual profit) For thee : soon will thy Lord Raise thee to a station Of Praise and Glory !

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 80. Say : “ O my Lord ! Let my entry be By the Gate of Truth And Honour, and likewise My exit by the Gate Of Truth and Honour ; And grant me From Thy Presence An authority to aid (me).”

arabic_text: ٨١- وَقُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ الْبَاطِلُ ۚ إِنَّ الْبَاطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًا◯
english_translation: 81. And say : “ Truth has (now) Arrived, and Falsehood perished : For Falsehood is (by its nature) Bound to perish.”

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا◯
english_translation: 82. We send down (stage by stage) In the Qur-ān that which Is a healing and a mercy To those who believe : To the unjust it causes Nothing but loss after loss.

arabic_text: ٨٣- وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَأَىٰ بِجَانِبِهِ ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ كَانَ يَئُوسًا◯
english_translation: 83.Yet when We bestow Our favours on man, He turns away and becomes Remote on his side (instead Of coming to Us), and when Evil seizes him he Gives himself up to despair !

arabic_text: ٨٤- قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 84. Say : “ Everyone acts According to his own disposition : But your Lord knows best Who it is that is Best guided on the Way.”

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 85.They ask thee concerning The Spirit (of inspiration). Say : “ The Spirit (cometh) By command of my Lord : Of knowledge it is only A little that is communicated To you, (O men !) ”

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 86. If it were Our Will, We could take away That which We have Sent thee by inspiration : Then would thou find None to plead thy affair In that matter as against Us,—

arabic_text: ٨٧- إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 87. Except for Mercy from thy Lord : For His Bounty is To thee (indeed) great.

arabic_text: ٨٨- قُل لَّئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَىٰ أَن يَأْتُوا بِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا◯
english_translation: 88.Say : “ If the whole Of mankind and Jinns were to gather together To produce the like Of this Qur-ān, they Could not produce The like thereof, even if They backed up each other With help and support.

arabic_text: ٨٩- وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 89. And We have explained To man, in this Qur-ān, Every kind of similitude : Yet the grater part of men Refuse (to receive it) Except with ingratitude !

arabic_text: ٩٠- وَقَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ يَنبُوعًا◯
english_translation: 90. They say : “ We shall not Believe in thee, until thou Cause a spring to gush Forth for us from the earth,

arabic_text: ٩١- أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَعِنَبٍ فَتُفَجِّرَ الْأَنْهَارَ خِلَالَهَا تَفْجِيرًا◯
english_translation: 91. “ Or (until) thou have A garden of date trees And vines, and cause rivers To gush forth in their midst, Carrying abundant water ;

arabic_text: ٩٢- أَوْ تُسْقِطَ السَّمَاءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِيَ بِاللَّـهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ قَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 92. “ Or thou cause the sky To fall in pieces, as thou Sayest (will happen), against us ; Or thou bring God And the angels before (us) Face to face ;

arabic_text: ٩٣- أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابًا نَّقْرَؤُهُ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا◯
english_translation: 93. “ Or thou have a house Adorned with gold, Or thou mount a ladder Right into the skies. No, we shall not even believe In thy mounting until thou Send down to us a book That we could read.” Say : “ Glory to my Lord ! Am I aught but a man,— An apostle ? ”

arabic_text: ٩٤- وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا أَبَعَثَ اللَّـهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا◯
english_translation: 94.What kept men back From Belief when Guidance Came to them, was nothing But this : they said, “ Has God sent a man (Like us) to be (His) Apostle ? ”

arabic_text: ٩٥- قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا◯
english_translation: 95. Say, “ If there were settled, On earth, angels walking about In peace and quiet, We should Certainly have sent them Down from the heavens An angel for an apostle.”

arabic_text: ٩٦- قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 96. Say : “ Enough is God For a witness between me And you : for He is Well acquainted with His servants, And He sees (all things).”

arabic_text: ٩٧- وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّـهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِهِ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًا وَبُكْمًا وَصُمًّا ۖ مَّأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَاهُمْ سَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 97.It is he whom God guides, That is on true guidance ; But he whom He leaves Astray—for such wilt thou Find no protector besides Him. On the Day of Judgment We shall gather them together, Prone on their faces, Blind, dumb, and deaf : Their abode will be Hell : Every time it shows abatement, We shall increase for them The fierceness of the Fire.

arabic_text: ٩٨- ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا◯
english_translation: 98. That is their recompense, Because they rejected Our Signs, And said, “ When we are reduced To bones and broken dust, Should we really be raised up (To be) a new Creation ? ”

arabic_text: ٩٩- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى الظَّالِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 99. See they not that God, Who created the heavens And the earth, has power To create the like of them (Anew) ? Only He has Decreed a term appointed, Of which there is no doubt. But the unjust refuse (To receive it) except With ingratitude.

arabic_text: ١٠٠- قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَائِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّي إِذًا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ الْإِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ قَتُورًا◯
english_translation: 100. Say : “ If ye had Control of the Treasures Of the Mercy of my Lord, Behold, ye would keep them Back, for fear of spending Them : for man Is (ever) niggardly ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠١- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ ۖ فَاسْأَلْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِذْ جَاءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًا◯
english_translation: 101.To Moses We did give Nine Clear Signs : Ask the Children of Israel : When he came to them, Pharaoh said to him : “ O Moses ! I consider thee, Indeed, to have been Worked upon by sorcery ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠٢- قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا أَنزَلَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ بَصَائِرَ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّكَ يَا فِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًا◯
english_translation: 102. Moses said, “ Thou knowest Well that these things Have been sent down by none But the Lord of the heavens And the earth as eye-opening Evidence : and I consider thee Indeed, O Pharaoh, to be One doomed to destruction ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠٣- فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ جَمِيعًا◯
english_translation: 103. So he resolved to remove them From the face of the earth : But We did drown him And all who were with him.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- وَقُلْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ اسْكُنُوا الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ الْآخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًا◯
english_translation: 104. And We said thereafter To the Children of Israel, “ Dwell securely in the land (Of promise) ” : but when The second of the warnings came To pass, We gathered you Together in a mingled crowd.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- وَبِالْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَاهُ وَبِالْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 105.We sent down the (Qur-ān) In Truth, and in Truth Has it descended : and We sent Thee but to give Glad Tidings and to warn (sinners).

arabic_text: ١٠٦- وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنزِيلًا◯
english_translation: 106. (It is) a Qur-ān Which We have divided (Into parts from time to time), In order that thou mightest Recite it to men At intervals : We have Revealed it by stages.

arabic_text: ١٠٧- قُلْ آمِنُوا بِهِ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوا ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًا◯
english_translation: 107. Say : “ Whether ye believe In it or not, it is true That those who were given Knowledge beforehand, when It is recited to them, Fall down on their faces In humble prostration,

arabic_text: ١٠٨- وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا◯
english_translation: 108. “ And they say : ‘ Glory To our Lord ! Truly Has the promise of our Lord Been fulfilled ! ’ ”

arabic_text: ١٠٩- وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًاالسجدة◯
english_translation: 109. They fall down on their faces In tears, and it increases Their (earnest) humility.

arabic_text: ١١٠- قُلِ ادْعُوا اللَّـهَ أَوِ ادْعُوا الرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا فَلَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 110. Say : “ Call upon God, or Call upon Raḥmān : By whatever name ye call Upon Him, (it is well) : For to Him belong The Most Beautiful Names. Neither speak thy Prayer aloud, Nor speak it in a low tone, But seek a middle course Between.”

arabic_text: ١١١- وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 111. Say : “ Praise be to God, Who begets no son, And has no partner In (His) dominion : Nor (needs) He any To protect Him from humiliation : Yea, magnify Him For His greatness and glory ! ”

arabic_text: ١- الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ الْكِتَابَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُ عِوَجًا◯
english_translation: 1.Praise be to God, Who hath sent to His Servant The Book, and hath allowed Therein no Crookedness :

arabic_text: ٢- قَيِّمًا لِّيُنذِرَ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا مِّن لَّدُنْهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ الصَّالِحَاتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا◯
english_translation: 2. (He hath made it) Straight (And Clear) in order that He may warn (the godless) Of a terrible Punishment From Him, and that He May give Glad Tidings To the Believers who work Righteous deeds, that they Shall have a goodly Reward,

arabic_text: ٣- مَّاكِثِينَ فِيهِ أَبَدًا◯
english_translation: 3. Wherein they shall Remain for ever :

arabic_text: ٤- وَيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللَّـهُ وَلَدًا◯
english_translation: 4. Further, that He may warn Those (also) who say, “ God hath begotten a son ” :

arabic_text: ٥- مَّا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ وَلَا لِآبَائِهِمْ ۚ كَبُرَتْ كَلِمَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ ۚ إِن يَقُولُونَ إِلَّا كَذِبًا◯
english_translation: 5. No knowledge have they Of such a thing, nor Had their fathers. It is A grievous thing that issues From their mouths as a saying. What they say is nothing But falsehood !

arabic_text: ٦- فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا◯
english_translation: 6.Thou wouldst only, perchance, Fret thyself to death, Following after them, in grief, If they believe not In this Message.

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ زِينَةً لَّهَا لِنَبْلُوَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا◯
english_translation: 7. That which is on earth We have made but as A glittering show for the earth, In order that We may test Them—as to which of them Are best in conduct.

arabic_text: ٨- وَإِنَّا لَجَاعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا◯
english_translation: 8. Verily what is on earth We shall make but as Dust and dry soil (Without growth or herbage).

arabic_text: ٩- أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا مِنْ آيَاتِنَا عَجَبًا◯
english_translation: 9.Or dost thou reflect That the Companions of the Cave And of the Inscription Were wonders among Our Signs ?

arabic_text: ١٠- إِذْ أَوَى الْفِتْيَةُ إِلَى الْكَهْفِ فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا◯
english_translation: 10. Behold, the youths betook themselves To the Cave : they said, “ Our Lord ! bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, And dispose of our affair For us in the right way ! ”

arabic_text: ١١- فَضَرَبْنَا عَلَىٰ آذَانِهِمْ فِي الْكَهْفِ سِنِينَ عَدَدًا◯
english_translation: 11. Then We drew (a veil) Over their ears, for a number Of years, in the Cave, (So that they heard not) :

arabic_text: ١٢- ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِنَعْلَمَ أَيُّ الْحِزْبَيْنِ أَحْصَىٰ لِمَا لَبِثُوا أَمَدًا◯
english_translation: 12. Then We roused them, In order to test which Of the two parties was best At calculating the term Of years they had tarried !

arabic_text: ١٣- نَّحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ نَبَأَهُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْيَةٌ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَزِدْنَاهُمْ هُدًى◯
english_translation: 13. We relate to thee their story In truth : they were youths Who believed in their Lord, And We advanced them In guidance :

arabic_text: ١٤- وَرَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ إِذْ قَامُوا فَقَالُوا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَن نَّدْعُوَ مِن دُونِهِ إِلَـٰهًا ۖ لَّقَدْ قُلْنَا إِذًا شَطَطًا◯
english_translation: 14. We gave strength to their hearts : Behold, they stood up And said : “ Our Lord is The Lord of the heavens And of the earth : never Shall we call upon any god Other than Him : if we Did, we should indeed Have uttered an enormity !

arabic_text: ١٥- هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمُنَا اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً ۖ لَّوْلَا يَأْتُونَ عَلَيْهِم بِسُلْطَانٍ بَيِّنٍ ۖ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا◯
english_translation: 15. “ These our people have taken For worship gods other Than Him : why do they Not bring forward an authority Clear (and convincing) For what they do ? Who doth more wrong Than such as invent A falsehood against God ?

arabic_text: ١٦- وَإِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّـهَ فَأْوُوا إِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًا◯
english_translation: 16. “ When ye turn away From them and the things They worship other than God, Betake yourselves to the Cave : Your Lord will shower His mercies on you And dispose of your affair Towards comfort and ease.”

arabic_text: ١٧- وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَاوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِي فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ اللَّـهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا◯
english_translation: 17.Thou wouldst have seen The sun, when it rose, Declining to the right From their Cave, and when It set, turning away From them to the left, While they lay in the open Space in the midst Of the Cave. Such are Among the Signs of God : He whom God guides Is right guided ; but he Whom God leaves to stray,— For him wilt thou find No protector to lead him To the Right Way.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ ۖ وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ ۚ لَوِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا◯
english_translation: 18.Thou wouldst have deemed them Awake, whilst they were asleep, And We turned them On their right and on Their left sides : their dog Stretching forth his two fore-legs On the threshold : if thou Hadst come up on to them, Thou wouldst have certainly Turned back from them in flight, And wouldst certainly have been Filled with terror of them.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِيَتَسَاءَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۚ قَالُوا رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَابْعَثُوا أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَا أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 19. Such (being their state), We raised them up (from sleep), That they might question Each other. Said one of them, “ How long have ye stayed (here) ? ” They said, “ We have stayed (Perhaps) a day, or part Of a day.” (At length) They (all) said, “ God (alone) Knows best how long Ye have stayed here… Now send ye then one of you With this money of yours To the town : let him Find out which is the best Food (to be had) and bring some To you, that (ye may) Satisfy your hunger therewith : And let him behave With care and courtesy, And let him not inform Any one about you.

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِي مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوا إِذًا أَبَدًا◯
english_translation: 20. “ For if thy should Come upon you, they would Stone you or force you To return to their cult, And in that case ye would Never attain prosperity.”

arabic_text: ٢١- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا إِذْ يَتَنَازَعُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَمْرَهُمْ ۖ فَقَالُوا ابْنُوا عَلَيْهِم بُنْيَانًا ۖ رَّبُّهُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِهِمْ ۚ قَالَ الَّذِينَ غَلَبُوا عَلَىٰ أَمْرِهِمْ لَنَتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيْهِم مَّسْجِدًا◯
english_translation: 21.Thus did We make Their case known to the people, That they might know That the promise of God Is true, and that there can Be no doubt about the Hour Of Judgment. Behold, They dispute among themselves As to their affair. (Some) said, “ Construct a building over them ” : Their Lord knows best About them : those who prevailed Over their affair said, “ Let us surely build a place Of worship over them.”

arabic_text: ٢٢- سَيَقُولُونَ ثَلَاثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ خَمْسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ رَجْمًا بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ وَيَقُولُونَ سَبْعَةٌ وَثَامِنُهُمْ كَلْبُهُمْ ۚ قُل رَّبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِم مَّا يَعْلَمُهُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌ ۗ فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيهِمْ إِلَّا مِرَاءً ظَاهِرًا وَلَا تَسْتَفْتِ فِيهِم مِّنْهُمْ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 22. (Some) say they were three, The dog being the fourth Among them ; (others) say They were five, the dog Being the sixth,—doubtfully Guessing at the unknown ; (Yet others) say they were Seven, the dog being the eighth. Say thou : “ My Lord Knoweth best their number ; It is but few that know Their (real case).” Enter not, Therefore, into controversies Concerning them, except On a matter that is clear, Nor consult any of them About (the affair of) the Sleepers.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّي فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا◯
english_translation: 23.Nor say of anything, “ I shall be sure to do So and so to-morrow ”—

arabic_text: ٢٤- إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۚ وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّي لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًا◯
english_translation: 24. Without adding, “ So please God ! ” And call thy Lord to mind When thou forgettest, and say, “ I hope that my Lord Will guide me ever closer (Even) than this To the right road.”

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا◯
english_translation: 25.So they stayed in their Cave Three hundred years, and (some) Add nine (more).

arabic_text: ٢٦- قُلِ اللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوا ۖ لَهُ غَيْبُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ أَبْصِرْ بِهِ وَأَسْمِعْ ۚ مَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا يُشْرِكُ فِي حُكْمِهِ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 26. Say : “ God knows best How long they stayed : With Him is (the knowledge Of) the secrets of the heavens And the earth : how clearly He sees, how finely He hears (Everything) ! They have no protector Other than Him ; nor does He share His Command With any person whatsoever.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَاتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِن كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَلَن تَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 27.And recite (and teach) What has been revealed To thee of the Book Of thy Lord : none Can change His Words, And none wilt thou find As a refuge other than Him.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَاصْبِرْ نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ ۖ وَلَا تَعْدُ عَيْنَاكَ عَنْهُمْ تُرِيدُ زِينَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ وَكَانَ أَمْرُهُ فُرُطًا◯
english_translation: 28. And keep thy soul content With those who call On their Lord morning And evening, seeking His Face;  and let not Thine eyes pass beyond them, Seeking the pomp and glitter Of this Life ; nor obey Any whose heart We Have permitted to neglect The remembrance of Us, One who follows his own Desires, whose case has Gone beyond all bounds.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَقُلِ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ فَلْيُؤْمِن وَمَن شَاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ ۚ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا ۚ وَإِن يَسْتَغِيثُوا يُغَاثُوا بِمَاءٍ كَالْمُهْلِ يَشْوِي الْوُجُوهَ ۚ بِئْسَ الشَّرَابُ وَسَاءَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا◯
english_translation: 29.Say, “ The Truth is From your Lord ” : Let him who will, Believe, and let him Who will, reject (it) : For the wrong-doers We Have prepared a Fire Whose (smoke and flames), Like the wall and roof Of a tent, will hem Them in : if they implore Relief they will be granted Water like melted brass, That will scald their faces. How dreadful the drink ! How uncomfortable a couch To recline on !

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا◯
english_translation: 30. As to those who believe And work righteousness, Verily We shall not suffer To perish the reward Of any who do A (single) righteous deed.

arabic_text: ٣١- أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا◯
english_translation: 31. For them will be Gardens Of Eternity ; beneath them Rivers will flow : they will Be adorned therein With bracelets of gold, And they will wear Green garments of fine silk And heavy brocade ; They will recline therein On raised thrones. How good the recompense ! How beautiful a couch To recline on !

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ جَعَلْنَا لِأَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيْنِ مِنْ أَعْنَابٍ وَحَفَفْنَاهُمَا بِنَخْلٍ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمَا زَرْعًا◯
english_translation: 32.Set forth to them The parable of two men : For one of them We provided Two gardens of grape-vines And surrounded them With date-palms ; In between the two We placed corn-fields.

arabic_text: ٣٣- كِلْتَا الْجَنَّتَيْنِ آتَتْ أُكُلَهَا وَلَمْ تَظْلِم مِّنْهُ شَيْئًا ۚ وَفَجَّرْنَا خِلَالَهُمَا نَهَرًا◯
english_translation: 33. Each of those gardens Brought forth its produce, And failed not in the least Therein : in the midst Of them We caused A river to flow.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَكَانَ لَهُ ثَمَرٌ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَنَا أَكْثَرُ مِنكَ مَالًا وَأَعَزُّ نَفَرًا◯
english_translation: 34. (Abundant) was the produce This man had : he said To his companion, in the course Of a mutual argument : “ More wealth have I Than you, and more honour And power in (my following Of) men.”

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ قَالَ مَا أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَـٰذِهِ أَبَدًا◯
english_translation: 35. He went into his garden In a state (of mind) Unjust to his soul : He said, “ I deem not That this will ever perish,

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّدِدتُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي لَأَجِدَنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا مُنقَلَبًا◯
english_translation: 36. “ Nor do I deem That the Hour (of Judgment) Will (ever) come : Even if I am brought back To my Lord, I shall Surely find (there) Something better in exchange.”

arabic_text: ٣٧- قَالَ لَهُ صَاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرْتَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلًا◯
english_translation: 37. His companion said to him, In the course of the argument With him : “ Dost thou deny Him Who created thee Out of dust, then out of A sperm-drop, then fashioned Thee into a man ?

arabic_text: ٣٨- لَّـٰكِنَّا هُوَ اللَّـهُ رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 38. “ But (I think) for my part That He is God, My Lord, and none shall I Associate with my Lord.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَلَوْلَا إِذْ دَخَلْتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلْتَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّـهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّـهِ ۚ إِن تَرَنِ أَنَا أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا◯
english_translation: 39. “ Why didst thou not, As thou wentest into Thy garden, say : ‘ God’s Will (Be done) ! There is no power But with God ! ’ If thou Dost see me less than Thee in wealth and sons,

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَعَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يُؤْتِيَنِ خَيْرًا مِّن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهَا حُسْبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتُصْبِحَ صَعِيدًا زَلَقًا◯
english_translation: 40. “ It may be that my Lord Will give me something Better than thy garden, And that He will send On thy garden thunderbolts (By way of reckoning) From heaven, making it (But) slippery sand !—

arabic_text: ٤١- أَوْ يُصْبِحَ مَاؤُهَا غَوْرًا فَلَن تَسْتَطِيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا◯
english_translation: 41. “ Or the water of the garden Will run off underground So that thou wilt never Be able to find it.”

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَأُحِيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَىٰ مَا أَنفَقَ فِيهَا وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِرَبِّي أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 42. So his fruits (and enjoyment) Were encompassed (with ruin), And he remained twisting And turning his hands Over what he had spent On his property, which had (Now) tumbled to pieces To its very foundations, And he could only say, “ Woe is me ! Would I had Never ascribed partners To my Lord and Cherisher ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَلَمْ تَكُن لَّهُ فِئَةٌ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا◯
english_translation: 43. Nor had he numbers To help him against God, Nor was he able To deliver himself.

arabic_text: ٤٤- هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّـهِ الْحَقِّ ۚ هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا◯
english_translation: 44. There, the (only) protection comes From God, the True One. He is the Best to reward, And the Best to give success.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا كَمَاءٍ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًا تَذْرُوهُ الرِّيَاحُ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّقْتَدِرًا◯
english_translation: 45.Set forth to them The similitude of the life Of this world : it is like The rain which We send Down from the skies : The earth’s vegetation absorbs it, But soon it becomes Dry stubble, which the winds Do scatter : it is (only) God Who prevails over all things.

arabic_text: ٤٦- الْمَالُ وَالْبَنُونَ زِينَةُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ أَمَلًا◯
english_translation: 46. Wealth and sons are allurements Of the life of this world : But the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best In the sight of thy Lord, As rewards, and best As (the foundation for) hopes.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَيَوْمَ نُسَيِّرُ الْجِبَالَ وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ بَارِزَةً وَحَشَرْنَاهُمْ فَلَمْ نُغَادِرْ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 47. One Day We shall Remove the mountains, and thou Wilt see the earth As a level stretch, And We shall gather them, All together, nor shall We Leave out any one of them.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَعُرِضُوا عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمُونَا كَمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۚ بَلْ زَعَمْتُمْ أَلَّن نَّجْعَلَ لَكُم مَّوْعِدًا◯
english_translation: 48. And they will be marshalled Before thy Lord in ranks, (With the announcement), “ Now have ye come to Us (Bare) as We created you First : aye, ye thought We shall not fulfil The appointment made to you To meet (Us) ! ” :

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ فَتَرَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَا وَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَـٰذَا الْكِتَابِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا مَا عَمِلُوا حَاضِرًا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 49. And the Book (of Deeds) Will be placed (before you) ; And thou wilt see The sinful in great terror Because of what is (recorded) Therein ; they will say, “ Ah ! woe to us ! What a book is this ! It leaves out nothing Small or great, but Takes account thereof ! ” They will find all that they Did, placed before them : And not one will thy Lord Treat with injustice.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِي وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ بَدَلًا◯
english_translation: 50.Behold ! We said To the angels, “ Bow down To Adam ” : they bowed down Except Iblīs. He was One of the Jinns, and he Broke the Command Of his Lord. Will ye then take him And his progeny as protectors Rather than Me ? And they Are enemies to you ! Evil would be the exchange For the wrong-doers !

arabic_text: ٥١- مَّا أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا◯
english_translation: 51. I called them not To witness the creation Of the heavens and the earth, Nor (even) their own creation : Nor is it for Me To take as helpers Such as lead (men) astray !

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًا◯
english_translation: 52. One Day He will say, “ Call on those whom ye Thought to be My partners,” And they will call on them, But they will not listen To them ; and We shall Make for them a place Of common perdition.

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَرَأَى الْمُجْرِمُونَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا◯
english_translation: 53. And the Sinful shall see The Fire and apprehend That they have to fall Therein : no means will they Find to turn away therefrom.

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلًا◯
english_translation: 54.We have explained In detail in this Qur-ān, For the benefit of mankind, Every kind of similitude : But man is, in most things, Contentious.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّا أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ الْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ قُبُلًا◯
english_translation: 55. And what is there To keep back men From believing, now that Guidance has come to them, Nor from praying for forgiveness From their Lord, but that (They ask that) the ways Of the ancients be repeated With them, or the Wrath Be brought to them Face to face ?

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَمَا نُرْسِلُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ ۖ وَاتَّخَذُوا آيَاتِي وَمَا أُنذِرُوا هُزُوًا◯
english_translation: 56. We only send the apostles To give glad tidings And to give warnings : But the Unbelievers dispute With vain argument, in order Therewith to weaken the truth, And they treat My Signs As a jest, as also the fact That they are warned !

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِيَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوا إِذًا أَبَدًا◯
english_translation: 57. And who doth more wrong Than one who is reminded Of the Signs of his Lord, But turns away from them, Forgetting the (deeds) which his hands Have sent forth ? Verily We Have set veils over their hearts Lest they should understand this, And over their ears, deafness. If thou callest them To guidance, even then Will they never accept guidance.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَرَبُّكَ الْغَفُورُ ذُو الرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌ لَّن يَجِدُوا مِن دُونِهِ مَوْئِلًا◯
english_translation: 58. But your Lord is Most Forgiving, Full of Mercy. If He were To call them (at once) to account For what they have earned, Then surely He would Have hastened their Punishment : But they have their appointed Time, beyond which they Will find no refuge.

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَتِلْكَ الْقُرَىٰ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًا◯
english_translation: 59. Such were the populations We destroyed when they Committed iniquities ; but We fixed an appointed time For their destruction.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا◯
english_translation: 60.Behold, Moses said To his attendant, “ I will not Give up until I reach The junction of the two Seas or (until) I spend Years and years in travel.”

arabic_text: ٦١- فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ سَرَبًا◯
english_translation: 61. But when they reached The Junction, they forgot (About) their Fish, which took Its course through the sea (Straight) as in a tunnel.

arabic_text: ٦٢- فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَاهُ آتِنَا غَدَاءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَـٰذَا نَصَبًا◯
english_translation: 62. When they had passed on (Some distance), Moses said To his attendant : “ Bring us Our early meal ; truly We have suffered much fatigue At this (stage of) our journey.”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنسَانِيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ ۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِي الْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا◯
english_translation: 63. He replied : “ Sawest thou (What happened) when we Betook ourselves to the rock ? I did indeed forget (About) the Fish : none but Satan made me forget To tell (you) about it : It took its course through The sea in a marvellous way ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٤- قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا◯
english_translation: 64. Moses said : “ That was what We were seeking after : ” So they went back On their footsteps, following (The path they had come).

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَا آتَيْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًا◯
english_translation: 65.So they found one Of Our servants, On whom We had bestowed Mercy from Ourselves And whom We had taught Knowledge from Our own Presence.

arabic_text: ٦٦- قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًا◯
english_translation: 66. Moses said to him : “ May I follow thee, On the footing that Thou teach me something Of the (Higher) Truth Which thou hast been taught ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٧- قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبْرًا◯
english_translation: 67. (The other) said : “ Verily Thou wilt not be able To have patience with me !

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا◯
english_translation: 68. “ And how canst thou Have patience about things About which thy understanding Is not complete ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٩- قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّـهُ صَابِرًا وَلَا أَعْصِي لَكَ أَمْرًا◯
english_translation: 69. Moses said : “ Thou wilt Find me, if God so will, (Truly) patient : nor shall I Disobey thee in aught.”

arabic_text: ٧٠- قَالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعْتَنِي فَلَا تَسْأَلْنِي عَن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًا◯
