arabic_text: ٣٧- خُلِقَ الْإِنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِي فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ◯
english_translation: 37. Man is a creature of haste : Soon (enough) will I show You My Signs ; then Ye will not ask Me To hasten them !

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 38. They say : “ When will this Promise come to pass, If ye are telling the truth ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٩- لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَنْ وُجُوهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنْ ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. If only the Unbelievers Knew (the time) when they Will not be able To ward off the Fire From their faces, nor yet From their backs, and (when) No help can reach them !

arabic_text: ٤٠- بَلْ تَأْتِيهِمْ بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. Nay, it may come to them All of a sudden and confound Them : no power will they Have then to avert it, Nor will they (then) Get respite.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. Mocked were (many) Apostles before thee ; But their scoffers Were hemmed in By the thing that they mocked.

arabic_text: ٤٢- قُلْ مَنْ يَكْلَؤُكُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 42.Say, “ Who can keep You safe by night and by day From (the Wrath of) (God) Most Gracious ? ” Yet they Turn away from the mention Of their Lord.

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَمْ لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِنْ دُونِنَا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ مِنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. Or have they gods that Can guard them from Us ? They have no power to aid Themselves, nor can they Be defended from Us.

arabic_text: ٤٤- بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِي الْأَرْضَ نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا أَفَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Nay, We gave the good things Of this life to these men And their fathers until The period grew long for them ; See they not that We Gradually reduce the land (In their control) from Its outlying borders ? Is it Then they who will win ?

arabic_text: ٤٥- قُلْ إِنَّمَا أُنْذِرُكُمْ بِالْوَحْيِ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا مَا يُنْذَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 45. Say, “ I do but warn you According to revelation ” : But the deaf will not hear The call, (even) when They are warned !

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَلَئِنْ مَسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. If but a breath of the Wrath Of thy Lord do touch them, They will then say, “ Woe To us ! we did wrong indeed ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِينَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَإِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَاسِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 47.We shall set up scales Of justice for the Day Of Judgment, so that Not a soul will be dealt with Unjustly in the least. And if there be (No more than) the weight Of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account) : And enough are We To take account.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَاءً وَذِكْرًا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 48.In the past We granted To Moses and Aaron The Criterion (for judgment), And a Light and a Message For those who would do right,—

arabic_text: ٤٩- الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. Those who fear their Lord In their most secret thoughts, And who hold the Hour (Of Judgment) in awe.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُبَارَكٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ أَفَأَنْتُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. And this is a blessed Message which We have Sent down : will ye then Reject it ?

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 51.We bestowed aforetime On Abraham his rectitude Of conduct, and well were We Acquainted with him.

arabic_text: ٥٢- إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنْتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. Behold ! he said To his father and his people, “ What are these images, To which ye are (So assiduously) devoted ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٣- قَالُوا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. They said, “ We found Our fathers worshipping them.”

arabic_text: ٥٤- قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 54. He said, “ Indeed ye Have been in manifest Error—ye and your fathers.”

arabic_text: ٥٥- قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنْتَ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. They said, “ Have you Brought us the Truth, Or are you one Of those who jest ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٦- قَالَ بَلْ رَبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الَّذِي فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 56. He said, “ Nay, your Lord Is the Lord of the heavens And the earth, He Who Created them (from nothing) : And I am a witness To this (truth).

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَتَاللَّـهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ أَنْ تُوَلُّوا مُدْبِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 57. “ And by God, I have A plan for your idols— After ye go away And turn your backs ”…

arabic_text: ٥٨- فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 58.So he broke them to pieces, (All) but the biggest of them, That they might turn (And address themselves) to it.

arabic_text: ٥٩- قَالُوا مَنْ فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 59. They said, “ Who has Done this to our gods ? He must indeed be Some man of impiety ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٠- قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ◯
english_translation: 60. They said, “ We heard A youth talk of them : He is called Abraham.”

arabic_text: ٦١- قَالُوا فَأْتُوا بِهِ عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. They said, “ Then bring him Before the eyes of the people, That they may bear witness : ”

arabic_text: ٦٢- قَالُوا أَأَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ◯
english_translation: 62. They said, “ Art thou The one that did this With our gods, O Abraham ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ إِنْ كَانُوا يَنْطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. He said : “ Nay, this Was done by— This is their is their biggest one ! Ask them, if they Can speak intelligently ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٤- فَرَجَعُوا إِلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ أَنْتُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. So they turned to themselves And said, “ Surely ye Are the ones in the wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰؤُلَاءِ يَنْطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. Then were they confounded With shame : (they said), “ Thou knowest full well that These (idols) do not speak ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٦- قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ◯
english_translation: 66. (Abraham) said, “ Do ye then Worship, besides God, Things that can neither Be of any good to you Nor do you harm ?

arabic_text: ٦٧- أُفٍّ لَكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. “ Fie upon you, and upon The things that ye worship Besides God ! Have ye No sense ? ”…

arabic_text: ٦٨- قَالُوا حَرِّقُوهُ وَانْصُرُوا آلِهَتَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 68.They said, “ Burn him And protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all) ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٩- قُلْنَا يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ◯
english_translation: 69. We said, “ O Fire ! Be thou cool, And (a means of) safety For Abraham ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَخْسَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 70. Then they sought a stratagem Against him : but We Made them the ones That lost most !

arabic_text: ٧١- وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 71. But We delivered him And (his nephew) Lūṭ (And directed them) to the land Which We have blessed For the nations.

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 72.And We bestowed on him Isaac And, as an additional gift, (A grandson), Jacob, and We Made righteous men of every one (Of them).

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ وَإِقَامَ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءَ الزَّكَاةِ وَكَانُوا لَنَا عَابِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 73. And We made them Leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We Sent them inspiration To do good deeds, To establish regular prayers, And to practice regular charity ; And they constantly served Us (and Us only).

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَلُوطًا آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ الْخَبَائِثَ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 74.And to Lūṭ, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, And We saved him From the town which practiced Abominations : truly they were A people given to Evil, A rebellious people.

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 75. And We admitted him To Our Mercy : for he Was one of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 76. (Remember) Noah, when He cried (to Us) aforetime : We listened to his (prayer) And delivered him and his Family from great distress.

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَنَصَرْنَاهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. We helped him against People who rejected Our Signs : Truly they were a people Given to Evil : so We Drowned them (in the Flood) All together.

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَدَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 78.And remember David And Solomon, when they Gave judgment in the matter Of the field into which The sheep of certain people Had strayed by night : We did witness their judgment.

arabic_text: ٧٩- فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا آتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُودَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَ وَكُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 79. To Solomon We inspired The (right) understanding Of the matter : to each (Of them) We gave Judgment And Knowledge ; it was Our power that made The hills and the birds Celebrate Our praises, With David : it was We Who did (all these things).

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَعَلَّمْنَاهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِنْ بَأْسِكُمْ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ شَاكِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. It was We Who taught him The making of coats of mail For your benefit, to guard You from each other’s violence : Will ye then be grateful ?

arabic_text: ٨١- وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 81. (It was Our power that Made) the violent (unruly) Wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, To his order, to the land Which We had blessed : For We do know all things.

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَمِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ مَنْ يَغُوصُونَ لَهُ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَافِظِينَ◯
english_translation: 82. And of the evil ones, Were some who dived For him, and did other work Besides ; and lit was We Who guarded them.

arabic_text: ٨٣- وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 83.And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, “ Truly distress has seized me, But Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are Merciful.”

arabic_text: ٨٤- فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَابِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 84. So We listened to him : We removed the distress That was on him, And We restored his people To him, and doubled Their number,—as a Grace From Ourselves, and a thing For commemoration, for all Who serve Us.

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 85.And (remember) Ismā‘īl, Idrīs, and Ẓul-kifl, all (Men) of constancy and patience ;

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُمْ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 86. We admitted them to Our Mercy : for they Were of the Righteous ones.

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ نَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 87.And remember Ẓun-nūn, When he departed in wrath : He imagined that We Had no power over him ! But he cried through the depths Of darkness, “ There is No god but Thou : Glory to Thee : I was Indeed wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٨- فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُنْجِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 88. So We listened to him : And delivered him from Distress : and thus do We Deliver those who have faith.

arabic_text: ٨٩- وَزَكَرِيَّا إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ◯
english_translation: 89.And (remember) Zakarīyā, When he cried to his Lord : “ O my Lord ! leave me not Without offspring, though Thou Art the best of inheritors.”

arabic_text: ٩٠- فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُ زَوْجَهُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكَانُوا لَنَا خَاشِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 90. So We listened to him : And We granted him Yaḥyā : We cured his wife’s (Barrenness) for him. These (three) Were ever quick in emulation In good works : they used To call on Us with love And reverence, and humble themselves Before Us.

arabic_text: ٩١- وَالَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ رُوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَاهَا وَابْنَهَا آيَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 91.And (remember) her who Guarded her chastity : We breathed into her Of Our Spirit, and We Made her and her son A Sign for all peoples.

arabic_text: ٩٢- إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ◯
english_translation: 92.Verily, this Brotherhood Of yours is a single Brotherhood, And I am your Lord And Cherisher : therefore Serve Me (and no other).

arabic_text: ٩٣- وَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَاجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 93. But (later generations) cut off Their affair (of unity), One from another : (yet) Will they all return to Us.

arabic_text: ٩٤- فَمَنْ يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِ وَإِنَّا لَهُ كَاتِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 94.Whoever works any act Of Righteousness and has Faith,— His endeavour will not Be rejected : We shall Record it in his favour.

arabic_text: ٩٥- وَحَرَامٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 95. But there is a ban On any population which We have destroyed : that they Shall not return,

arabic_text: ٩٦- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. Until the Gog and Magog (people) Are let through (their barrier), And they swiftly swarm From every hill.

arabic_text: ٩٧- وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ أَبْصَارُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 97. Then will the True Promise Draw nigh (of fulfilment) : Then behold ! the eyes Of the Unbelievers will Fixedly stare in horror : “ Ah ! Woe to us ! we were indeed Heedless of this ; nay ; we Truly did wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٩٨- إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنْتُمْ لَهَا وَارِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 98. Verily ye, (Unbelievers), And the (false) gods that Ye worship besides God, Are (but) fuel for Hell ! To it will ye (surely) come !

arabic_text: ٩٩- لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ آلِهَةً مَا وَرَدُوهَا وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 99. If these had been gods, They would not have got there ! But each one will abide Therein.

arabic_text: ١٠٠- لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 100. There, sobbing will be Their lot, nor will they There hear (aught else).

arabic_text: ١٠١- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِنَّا الْحُسْنَىٰ أُولَـٰئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 101.Those for whom The Good (Record) from Us Has gone before, will be Removed far therefrom.

arabic_text: ١٠٢- لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِي مَا اشْتَهَتْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 102. Not the slightest sound Will they hear of Hell : What their souls desired, In that will they dwell.

arabic_text: ١٠٣- لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 103. The Great Terror will Bring them no grief : But the angels will meet them (With mutual greetings) : “ This is your Day,— (The Day) that ye were promised.”

arabic_text: ١٠٤- يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 104. The Day that We roll up The heavens like a scroll Rolled up for books (completed),— Even as We produced The first Creation, so Shall We produce A new one : a promise We have undertaken : Truly shall We fulfil it.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُورِ مِنْ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 105.Before this We wrote In the Psalms, after the Message (Given to Moses) : “ My servants, The righteous, shall inherit The earth.”

arabic_text: ١٠٦- إِنَّ فِي هَـٰذَا لَبَلَاغًا لِقَوْمٍ عَابِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 106. Verily in the (Qur-ān) Is a Message for people Who would (truly) worship God.

arabic_text: ١٠٧- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 107. We sent thee not, but As a mercy for all creatures.

arabic_text: ١٠٨- قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 108. Say : “ What has come to me By inspiration is that Your God is One God : Will ye therefore bow To His Will (in Islām) ? ”

arabic_text: ١٠٩- فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ آذَنْتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَاءٍ وَإِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ أَمْ بَعِيدٌ مَا تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 109. But if they turn back, Say : “ I have proclaimed The Message to you all alike And in truth ; but I Know not whether that Which ye are promised Is near or far.

arabic_text: ١١٠- إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 110. “ It is He Who knows What is open in speech And what ye hide (In your hearts).

arabic_text: ١١١- وَإِنْ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ فِتْنَةٌ لَكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 111. “ I know not but that It may be a trial For you, and a grant Of (worldly) livelihood (To you) for a time.”

arabic_text: ١١٢- قَالَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 112. Say : “ O my Lord ! Judge Thou in truth ! ” “ Our Lord Most Gracious Is the One Whose assistance Should be sought against The blasphemies ye utter ! ”

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 1.Omankind ! Fear your Lord ! For the convulsion of the Hour (Of Judgment) will be A thing terrible !

arabic_text: ٢- يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّا أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَى النَّاسَ سُكَارَىٰ وَمَا هُمْ بِسُكَارَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اللَّـهِ شَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 2. The Day ye shall see it, Every mother giving suck Shall forget her suckling-babe, And every pregnant female Shall drop her load (unformed) : Thou shalt see mankind As in a drunken riot, Yet not drunk : but dreadful Will be the Wrath of God.

arabic_text: ٣- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَانٍ مَرِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 3. And yet among men There are such as dispute About God, without knowledge, And follow every evil one Obstinate in rebellion !

arabic_text: ٤- كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ مَنْ تَوَلَّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 4. About the (Evil One) It is decreed that whoever Turns to him for friendship, Him will he lead astray, And he will guide him To the Penalty of the Fire.

arabic_text: ٥- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنْبَتَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ◯
english_translation: 5.Omankind ! if ye have A doubt about the Resurrection, (Consider) that We created you Out of dust, then out of Sperm, then out of a leech-like Clot, then out a morsel Of flesh, partly formed And partly unformed, in order That We may manifest (Our power) to you ; And We cause whom We will To rest in the wombs For an appointed term, Then do We bring you out As babes, then (foster you) That ye may reach your age Of full strength ; and some Of you are called to die, And some are sent back To the feeblest old age, So that they know nothing After having known (much). And (further), thou seest The earth barren and lifeless, But when We pour down Rain on it, it is stirred (To life), it swells, And it puts forth every kind Of beautiful growth (in pairs).

arabic_text: ٦- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَأَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 6. This is so, because God Is the Reality : it is He Who gives life to the dead, And it is He Who has Power over all things.

arabic_text: ٧- وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ◯
english_translation: 7. And verily the Hour will come : There can be no doubt About it, or about (the fact) That God will raise up All who are in the graves.

arabic_text: ٨- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُنِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 8. Yet there is among men Such a one as disputes About God, without knowledge, Without guidance, and without A Book of Enlightenment,—

arabic_text: ٩- ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ لَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَنُذِيقُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ◯
english_translation: 9. (Disdainfully) bending his side, In order to lead (men) astray From the Path of God : For him there is disgrace In this life, and on the Day Of Judgment We shall Make him taste the Penalty Of burning (Fire).

arabic_text: ١٠- ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ◯
english_translation: 10. (It will be said) : “ This is Because of the deeds which Thy hands sent forth, For verily God is not Unjust to His servants.”

arabic_text: ١١- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ انْقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 11.There are among men Some who serve God, As it were, on the verge : If good befalls them, they are, Therewith, well content ; but If a trial comes to them, They turn on their faces : They lose both this world And the Hereafter : that Is loss for all to see !

arabic_text: ١٢- يَدْعُو مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُ وَمَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلَالُ الْبَعِيدُ◯
english_translation: 12. They call on such deities, Besides God, as can neither Hurt nor profit them : That is straying far indeed (From the Way) !

arabic_text: ١٣- يَدْعُو لَمَنْ ضَرُّهُ أَقْرَبُ مِنْ نَفْعِهِ لَبِئْسَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ◯
english_translation: 13. (Perhaps) they call on one Whose hurt is nearer Than his profit : evil, indeed, Is the patron, and evil The companion (for help) !

arabic_text: ١٤- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ◯
english_translation: 14.Verily God will admit Those who believe and work Righteous deeds, to Gardens, Beneath which rivers flow : For God carries out All that He plans.

arabic_text: ١٥- مَنْ كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَنْ لَنْ يَنْصُرَهُ اللَّـهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنْظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُ مَا يَغِيظُ◯
english_translation: 15. If any think that God Will not help him (His Apostle) in this world And the Hereafter, let him Stretch out a rope To the ceiling and cut (himself) Off : then let him see Whether his plan will remove That which enrages (him) !

arabic_text: ١٦- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يُرِيدُ◯
english_translation: 16. Thus have We sent down Clear Signs ; and verily God doth guide whom He will !

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 17. Those who believe (in the Qur-ān), Those who follow the Jewish (scriptures), And the Sabians, Christians, Magians, and Polytheists,— God will judge between them On the Day of Judgment : For God is witness Of all things.

arabic_text: ١٨- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَابُّ وَكَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ الْعَذَابُ وَمَنْ يُهِنِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ مُكْرِمٍ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُالسجدة◯
english_translation: 18.Seest thou not that To God bow down in worship All things that are In the heavens and on earth,— The sun, the moon, the stars ; The hills, the trees, the animals ; And a great number among Mankind ? But a great number Are (also) such as are Fit for Punishment : and such As God shall disgrace,— None can raise to honour : For God carries out All that He wills.

arabic_text: ١٩- هَـٰذَانِ خَصْمَانِ اخْتَصَمُوا فِي رَبِّهِمْ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابٌ مِنْ نَارٍ يُصَبُّ مِنْ فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ الْحَمِيمُ◯
english_translation: 19. These two antagonists dispute With each other about their Lord : But those who deny (their Lord),— For them will be cut out A garment of Fire : Over their heads will be Poured out boiling water.

arabic_text: ٢٠- يُصْهَرُ بِهِ مَا فِي بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُ◯
english_translation: 20. With it will be scalded What is within their bodies, As well as (their) skins.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَلَهُمْ مَقَامِعُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 21. In addition there will be Maces of iron (to punish) them.

arabic_text: ٢٢- كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيقِ◯
english_translation: 22. Every time they wish To get away therefrom, From anguish, they will be Forced back therein, and (It will be said), “ Taste ye The Penalty of Burning ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 23.God will admit those Who believe and work righteous deeds, To Gardens beneath which Rivers flow : they shall be Adorned therein with bracelets Of gold and pearls ; and Their garments there Will be of silk.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَهُدُوا إِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوا إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْحَمِيدِ◯
english_translation: 24. For they have been guided (In this life) to the purest Of speeches ; they have been Guided to the Path of Him Who is Worthy of (all) Praise.

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَاءً الْعَاكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِ وَمَنْ يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍ بِظُلْمٍ نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 25. As to those who have rejected (God), and would keep back (men) From the Way of God, and From the Sacred Mosque, which We have made (open) to (all) men— Equal is the dweller there And the visitor from the country— And any whose purpose therein Is profanity or wrong-doing— Them will We cause to taste Of a most grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ مَكَانَ الْبَيْتِ أَنْ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِي شَيْئًا وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْقَائِمِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ◯
english_translation: 26.Behold ! We gave the site, To Abraham, of the (Sacred) House, (Saying) : “ Associate not anything (In worship) with Me ; And sanctify My House For those who compass it round, Or stand up, Or bow, or prostrate themselves (Therein in prayer).

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَأَذِّنْ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ◯
english_translation: 27. “ And proclaim the Pilgrimage Among men : they will come To thee on foot and (mounted) On every kind of camel, Lean on account of journeys Through deep and distant Mountain highways ;

arabic_text: ٢٨- لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّـهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ فَكُلُوا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْبَائِسَ الْفَقِيرَ◯
english_translation: 28. “ That they may witness The benefits (provided) for them, And celebrate the name Of God, through the Days Appointed, over the cattle Which He has provided for them (For sacrifice) : then eat ye Thereof and feed the distressed Ones in want.

arabic_text: ٢٩- ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ◯
english_translation: 29. “ Then let them complete The rites prescribed For them, perform their vows, And (again) circumambulate The Ancient House.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ حُرُمَاتِ اللَّـهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الرِّجْسَ مِنَ الْأَوْثَانِ وَاجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ الزُّورِ◯
english_translation: 30.Such (is the Pilgrimage) : Whoever honours the sacred Rites of God, for him It is good in the sight Of his Lord. Lawful to you (For food in pilgrimage) are cattle, Except those mentioned to you (As exceptions) : but shun The abomination of idols, And shun the word That is false,—

arabic_text: ٣١- حُنَفَاءَ لِلَّـهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِ وَمَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّـهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَتَخْطَفُهُ الطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِي بِهِ الرِّيحُ فِي مَكَانٍ سَحِيقٍ◯
english_translation: 31. Being true in faith to God, And never assigning partners To Him : if anyone assigns Partners to God, he is As if he had fallen From heaven and been snatched up By birds, or the wind Had swooped (like a bird On its prey) and thrown him Into a far-distant place.

arabic_text: ٣٢- ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّـهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ◯
english_translation: 32. Such (is his state) : and Whoever holds in honour The Symbols of God, (In the sacrifice of animals), Such (honour) should come truly From piety of heart.

arabic_text: ٣٣- لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَا إِلَى الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ◯
english_translation: 33. In them ye have benefits For a term appointed : In the end their place Of sacrifice is near The Ancient House.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا لِيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّـهِ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُمْ مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ فَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَلَهُ أَسْلِمُوا وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ◯
english_translation: 34.To every people did We Appoint rites (of sacrifice), That they might celebrate The name of God over The sustenance He gave them From animals (fit for food). But your God is One God : Submit then your wills to Him (In Islam) : and give thou The good news to those Who humble themselves,—

arabic_text: ٣٥- الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّـهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِي الصَّلَاةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. To those whose hearts, When God is mentioned, Are filled with fear, Who show patient perseverance Over their afflictions, keep up Regular prayer, and spend (In charity) out of what We have bestowed upon them.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَاهَا لَكُمْ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّـهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَافَّ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُوا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَاهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 36.The sacrificial camels We have made for you As among the Symbols from God : in them is (much) Good for you : then pronounce The name of God over them As they line up (for sacrifice) : When they are down On their sides (after slaughter), Eat ye thereof, and feed Such as (beg not but) Live in contentment, And such as beg With due humility : thus have We made animals subject To you, that ye May be grateful.

arabic_text: ٣٧- لَنْ يَنَالَ اللَّـهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَىٰ مِنْكُمْ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَاكُمْ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. It is not their meat Nor their blood, that reaches God : it is your piety That reaches Him : He Has thus made them subject To you, that ye may glorify God for His guidance to you : And proclaim the Good News To all who do right.

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُدَافِعُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ◯
english_translation: 38. Verily God will defend (From ill) those who believe : Verily, God loveth not Any that is a traitor To faith, or shows ingratitude.

arabic_text: ٣٩- أُذِنَ لِلَّذِينَ يُقَاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 39.To those against whom War is made, permission Is given (to fight), because They are wronged ;—and verily, God is Most Powerful For their aid ;—

arabic_text: ٤٠- الَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّا أَنْ يَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّـهُ وَلَوْلَا دَفْعُ اللَّـهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوَامِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوَاتٌ وَمَسَاجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا اسْمُ اللَّـهِ كَثِيرًا وَلَيَنْصُرَنَّ اللَّـهُ مَنْ يَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ◯
english_translation: 40. (They are) those who have Been expelled from their homes In defiance of right,— (For no cause) except That they say, “ Our Lord Is God ”. Did not God Check one set of people By means of another, There would surely have been Pulled down monasteries, churches, Synagogues, and mosques, in which The name of God is commemorated In abundant measure. God will Certainly aid those who Aid His (cause) ;—for verily God is Full of Strength, Exalted in Might, (Able to enforce His Will).

arabic_text: ٤١- الَّذِينَ إِنْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَلِلَّـهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ◯
english_translation: 41. (They are) those who, If We establish them In the land, establish Regular prayer and give Regular charity, enjoin The right and forbid wrong : With God rests the end (And decision) of (all) affairs.

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَإِنْ يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَثَمُودُ◯
english_translation: 42.If they treat thy (mission) As false, so did the Peoples Before them (with their Prophets),— The People of Noah, And ‘Ād andThamūd ;

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَقَوْمُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ◯
english_translation: 43. Those of Abraham and Lūṭ ;

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَأَصْحَابُ مَدْيَنَ وَكُذِّبَ مُوسَىٰ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكَافِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ◯
english_translation: 44. And the Companions Of the Madyan people ; And Moses was rejected (In the same way). But I Granted respite to the Unbelievers, And (only) after that Did I punish them : But how (terrible) was My rejection (of them) !

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَشِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 45. How many populations have We Destroyed, which were given To wrong-doing ? They tumbled down On their roofs. And how many Wells are lying idle and neglected, And castles lofty and well-built ?

arabic_text: ٤٦- أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَا أَوْ آذَانٌ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصَارُ وَلَـٰكِنْ تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 46. Do they not travel Through the land, so that Their hearts (and mind) May thus learn wisdom And their ears may Thus learn to hear ? Truly it is not their eyes That are blind, but their Hearts which are In their breasts.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَنْ يُخْلِفَ اللَّـهُ وَعْدَهُ وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ◯
english_translation: 47. Yet they ask thee To hasten on the Punishment ! But God will not fail In His promise. Verily A Day in the sight of thy Lord Is like a thousand years Of your reckoning.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 48. And to how many populations Did I give respite, which Were given to wrong-doing ? In the end I punished them. To Me is the destination (of all).

arabic_text: ٤٩- قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 49.Say : “ O men ! I am (Sent) to you only to give A clear warning :

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 50. “ Those who believe and work Righteousness, for them Is forgiveness and a sustenance Most generous.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي آيَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 51. “ But those who strive Against Our Signs, to frustrate Them,—they will be Companions of the Fire.“

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰ أَلْقَى الشَّيْطَانُ فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنْسَخُ اللَّـهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّـهُ آيَاتِهِ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 52.Never did We send An apostle or a prophet Before thee, but, when he Framed a desire, Satan Threw some (vanity) Into his desire : but God Will cancel anything (vain) That Satan throws in, And God will confirm (And establish) His Signs : For God is full of knowledge And wisdom :

arabic_text: ٥٣- لِيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ وَالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَفِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 53. That He may make The suggestions thrown in By Satan, but a trial For those in whose hearts Is a disease and who are Hardened of heart : verily The wrong-doers are in a schism Far (from the Truth) :

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَهَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 54. And that those on whom Knowledge has been bestowed may learn That the (Qur-ān) is the Truth From thy Lord, and that they May believe therein, and their hearts May be made humbly (open) To it : for verily God is The Guide of those who believe, To the Straight Way.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 55. Those who reject Faith Will not cease to be In doubt concerning (Revelation) Until the Hour (of Judgment) Comes suddenly upon them, Or there comes to them The Penalty of a Day of Disaster.

arabic_text: ٥٦- الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّـهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 56. On that Day the Dominion Will be that of God : He will judge between them : So those who believe And work righteous deeds will be In Gardens of Delight.

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 57. And for those who reject Faith And deny Our Signs, There will be a humiliating Punishment.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا أَوْ مَاتُوا لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّـهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 58.Those who leave their homes In the cause of God, And are then slain or die,— On them will God bestow verily A goodly Provision : 3 God is He Who Bestows the best Provision.

arabic_text: ٥٩- لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ مُدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 59. Verily He will admit them To a place with which They shall be well pleased : For God is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

arabic_text: ٦٠- ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنْصُرَنَّهُ اللَّـهُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 60. That (is so). And if one Has retaliated to no greater Extent than the injury he received, And is again set upon Inordinately, God will help Him : for God is One That blots out (sins) And forgives (again and again).

arabic_text: ٦١- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 61.That is because God merges Night into Day, and He Merges Day into Night, and Verily it is God Who hears And sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٦٢- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِهِ هُوَ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 62. That is because God—He Is the Reality ; and those Besides Him whom they invoke,— They are but vain Falsehood : Verily God is He, Most High, Most Great.

arabic_text: ٦٣- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ أَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 63. Seest thou not that God Sends down rain from the sky, And forthwith the earth Becomes clothed with green ? For God is He Who understands The finest mysteries, and Is well-acquainted (with them).

arabic_text: ٦٤- لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 64. To Him belongs all that is In the heavens and on earth : For verily God,—He is Free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ٦٥- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَيُمْسِكُ السَّمَاءَ أَنْ تَقَعَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 65.Seest thou not that God Has made subject to you (men) All that is on the earth, And the ships that sail Through the sea by His command ? He withholds the sky (rain) From falling on the earth Except by His leave : For God is Most Kind And Most Merciful to man.

arabic_text: ٦٦- وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 66. It is He Who gave you life, Will cause you to die, And will again give you Life : truly man is A most ungrateful creature !

arabic_text: ٦٧- لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنْسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ فَلَا يُنَازِعُنَّكَ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 67.To every People have We Appointed rites and ceremonies Which they must follow : Let them not then dispute With thee on the matter, But do thou invite (them) To thy Lord : for thou art Assuredly on the Right Way.

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَإِنْ جَادَلُوكَ فَقُلِ اللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 68. If they do wrangle with thee, Say, “ God knows best What it is ye are doing.”

arabic_text: ٦٩- اللَّـهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كُنْتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. “ God will judge between you On the Day of Judgment Concerning the matters in which Ye differ.”

arabic_text: ٧٠- أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 70. Knowest thou not that God knows all that is In heaven and on earth ? Indeed it is all In a record, and that Is easy for God.

arabic_text: ٧١- وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ نَصِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 71. Yet they worship, besides God, Things for which no authority Has been sent down to them, And of which they have (Really) no knowledge : For those that do wrong There is no helper.

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الْمُنْكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِالَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِنَا قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِشَرٍّ مِنْ ذَٰلِكُمُ النَّارُ وَعَدَهَا اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 72. When Our Clear Signs Are rehearsed to them, Thou wilt notice a denial On the faces of the Unbelievers ! They nearly attack with violence Those who rehearse Our Signs To them. Say, “ Shall I Tell you of something (Far) worse than these Signs ? It is the Fire (of Hell) ! God has promised it To the Unbelievers ! And evil is that destination ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٣- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ لَنْ يَخْلُقُوا ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ وَإِنْ يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْئًا لَا يَسْتَنْقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ◯
english_translation: 73.Omen ! Here is A parable set forth ! Listen to it ! Those On whom, besides God, Ye call, cannot create (Even) a fly, if they all Met together for the purpose ! And if the fly should snatch Away anything from them, They would have no power To release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition And those whom they petition !

arabic_text: ٧٤- مَا قَدَرُوا اللَّـهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ◯
english_translation: 74. No just estimate have they Made of God : for God Is He Who is strong And able to carry out His Will.

arabic_text: ٧٥- اللَّـهُ يَصْطَفِي مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 75. God chooses Messengers From angels and from men For God is He Who hears And sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٧٦- يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ◯
english_translation: 76. He knows what is before them And what is behind them : And to God go back All questions (for decision).

arabic_text: ٧٧- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ارْكَعُوا وَاسْجُدُوا وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 77.Oye who believe ! Bow down, prostrate yourselves, And adore your Lord ; And do good ; That ye may prosper.

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّـهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ مِلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَفِي هَـٰذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّـهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 78. And strive in His cause As ye ought to strive, (With sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has Imposed no difficulties on you In religion ; it is the cult Of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named You Muslims, both before And in this (Revelation) ; That the Apostle may be A witness for you, and ye Be witnesses for mankind ! So establish regular Prayer, Give regular Charity, And hold fast to God ! He is your Protector— The Best to protect And the Best to help !

arabic_text: ١- قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.The Believers must (Eventually) win through,—

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. Those who humble themselves In their prayers ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. Who avoid vain talk ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَاةِ فَاعِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Who are active in deeds Of charity ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Who abstain from sex,

arabic_text: ٦- إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. Except with those joined To them in the marriage bond, Or (the captives) whom Their right hands possess,— For (in their case) they are Free from blame,

arabic_text: ٧- فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. But those whose desires exceed Those limits are transgressors ;—

arabic_text: ٨- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. Those who faithfully observe Their trusts and their covenants ;

arabic_text: ٩- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. And who (strictly) guard Their prayers ;—

arabic_text: ١٠- أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْوَارِثُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. Those will be the heirs,

arabic_text: ١١- الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. Who will inherit Paradise : They will dwell therein (For ever).

arabic_text: ١٢- وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلَالَةٍ مِنْ طِينٍ◯
english_translation: 12.Man We did create From a quintessence (of clay) ;

arabic_text: ١٣- ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاهُ نُطْفَةً فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ◯
english_translation: 13. Then We placed him As (a drop of) sperm In a place of rest, Firmly fixed ;

arabic_text: ١٤- ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظَامًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظَامَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَاهُ خَلْقًا آخَرَ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّـهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 14. Then We made the sperm Into a clot of congealed blood ; Then of that clot We made A (fœtus) lump ; then We Made out of that lump Bones and clothed the bones With flesh ; then We developed Out of it another creature. So blessed be God, The Best to create !

arabic_text: ١٥- ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. After that, at length Ye will die.

arabic_text: ١٦- ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. Again, on the Day Of Judgment, will ye be Raised up.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَائِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غَافِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. And We have made, above you, Seven tracts ; and We Are never unmindful Of (Our) Creation.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّاهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 18.And We send down water From the sky according to (Due) measure, and We cause it To soak in the soil ; And We certainly are able To drain it off (with ease).

arabic_text: ١٩- فَأَنْشَأْنَا لَكُمْ بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ مِنْ نَخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. With it We grow for you Gardens of date-palms And vines : in them have ye Abundant fruits : and of them Ye eat (and have enjoyment),—

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنْبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِلْآكِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. Also a tree springing Out of Mount Sinai, Which produces oil, And relish for those Who use it for food.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْأَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً نُسْقِيكُمْ مِمَّا فِي بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. And in cattle (too) ye Have an instructive example : From within their bodies We produce (milk) for you To drink ; there are, in them, (Besides), numerous (other) Benefits for you ; And of their (meat) ye eat ;

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. And on them, as well as In ships, ye ride.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. (Further, We sent a long line Of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people : He said, “ O my people ! Worship God ! Ye have No other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him) ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ لَأَنْزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. The chiefs of the Unbelievers Among his people said : “ He is no more than a man Like yourselves : his wish is To assert his superiority Over you : if God had wished (To send messengers), He could have sent down Angels : never did we hear Such a thing (as he says), Among our ancestors of old.”

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا بِهِ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 25. (And some said) : “ He is Only a man possessed : Wait (and have patience) With him for a time.”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ◯
english_translation: 26. (Noah) said : “ O my Lord ! Help me : for that they Accuse me of falsehood ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. So We inspired him (With this message) : “ Construct The Ark within Our sight And under Our guidance : then When comes Our command, And the fountains of the earth Gush forth, take thou on board Pairs of every species, male And female, and thy family— Except those of them Against whom the Word Has already gone forth : And address Me not In favour of the wrong-doers ; For they shall be drowned (In the Flood).

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَإِذَا اسْتَوَيْتَ أَنْتَ وَمَنْ مَعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 28. And when thou hast embarked On the Ark—thou and those With thee,—say : “ Praise be To God, Who has saved us From the people who do wrong.”

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. And say : “ O my Lord ! Enable me to disembark With Thy blessing : for Thou Art the Best to enable (us) To disembark.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ وَإِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 30. Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand) ; (Thus) do We try (men).

arabic_text: ٣١- ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا آخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 31.Then We raised after them Another generation.

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِنْهُمْ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. And We sent to them An apostle from among themselves, (Saying), “ Worship God ! Ye have no other god But Him. Will ye not Fear (Him) ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 33.And the chiefs Of his people, who disbelieved And denied the Meeting In the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things Of this life, said : “ He is No more than a man Like yourselves : he eats Of that of which ye eat, And drinks of what ye drink.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. “ If ye obey a man Like yourselves, behold, It is certain ye will be lost.

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَنَّكُمْ مُخْرَجُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. “ Does he promise that When ye die and become dust And bones, ye shall be Brought forth (again) ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. “ Far, very far is that Which ye are promised !

arabic_text: ٣٧- إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. “ There is nothing but Our life in this world ! We shall die and we live ! But we shall never Be raised up again !

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 38. “ He is only a man Who invents a lie Against God, but we Are not the ones To believe in him ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٩- قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ◯
english_translation: 39. (The prophet) said : “ O my Lord ! help me : For that they accuse me Of falsehood.”

arabic_text: ٤٠- قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. (God) said : “ In but A little while, they Are sure to be sorry ! ”

arabic_text: ٤١- فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَاءً فَبُعْدًا لِلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 41. Then the Blast overtook them With justice, and We made them As rubbish of dead leaves (Floating on the stream of Time) ! So away with the people Who do wrong !

arabic_text: ٤٢- ثُمَّ أَنْشَأْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا آخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 42.Then We raised after them Other generations.

arabic_text: ٤٣- مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. No people can hasten Their term, nor can they Delay (it).

arabic_text: ٤٤- ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَىٰ كُلَّ مَا جَاءَ أُمَّةً رَسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْدًا لِقَوْمٍ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Then sent We Our apostles In succession : every time There came to a people Their apostle, they accused him Of falsehood : so We made Them follow each other (In punishment) : We made them As a tale (that is told) : So away with a people That will not believe !

arabic_text: ٤٥- ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 45.Then We sent Moses And his brother Aaron, With Our Signs and Authority manifest,

arabic_text: ٤٦- إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا عَالِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. To Pharaoh and his Chiefs : But these behaved insolently : They were an arrogant people.

arabic_text: ٤٧- فَقَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. They said : “ Shall we believe In two men like ourselves ? And their people are subject To us ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِينَ◯
english_translation: 48. So they accused them Of falsehood, and they became Of those who were destroyed.

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. And We gave Moses The Book, in order that They might receive guidance.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَجَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَا إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ◯
english_translation: 50.And We made The son of Mary And his mother As a Sign : We gave them both Shelter on high ground, Affording rest and security And furnished with springs.

arabic_text: ٥١- يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 51.Oye apostles ! enjoy (All) things good and pure, And work righteousness : For I am well-acquainted With (all) that ye do.

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِ◯
english_translation: 52. And verily this Brotherhood Of yours is a single Brotherhood, And I am your Lord And Cherisher : therefore Fear Me (and no other).

arabic_text: ٥٣- فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. But people have cut off Their affair (of unity), Between them, into sects : Each party rejoices in that Which is with itself.

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 54. But leave them In their confused ignorance For a time.

arabic_text: ٥٥- أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ◯
english_translation: 55.Do they think that because We have granted them abundance Of wealth and sons,

arabic_text: ٥٦- نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ بَلْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. We would hasten them On in every good ? Nay, They do not understand.

arabic_text: ٥٧- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ هُمْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُشْفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.Verily those who live In awe for fear of their Lord ;

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 58. Those who believe In the Signs of their Lord ;

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Those who join not (in worship) Partners with their Lord ;

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا آتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. And those who dispense Their charity with their hearts Full of fear, because They will return to their Lord ;—

arabic_text: ٦١- أُولَـٰئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. It is these who hasten In every good work, And these who are Foremost in them.

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 62.On no soul do We Place a burden greater Than it can bear : Before Us is a record Which clearly shows the truth : They will never be wronged.

arabic_text: ٦٣- بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِنْ دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. But their hearts are In confused ignorance Of this ; and there are, Besides that, deeds of theirs, Which they will (continue) To do,—

arabic_text: ٦٤- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. Until, when We seize In Punishment those of them Who received the good things Of this world, behold, They will groan in supplication !

arabic_text: ٦٥- لَا تَجْأَرُوا الْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. (It will be said) : “ Groan not in supplication This day ; for ye shall Certainly not be helped by Us.

arabic_text: ٦٦- قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. “ My Signs used to be Rehearsed to you, but ye Used to turn back On your heels—

arabic_text: ٦٧- مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. “ In arrogance : talking nonsense About the (Qur-ān), like one Telling fables by night.”

arabic_text: ٦٨- أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَاءَهُمْ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَاءَهُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 68.Do they not ponder over The Word (of God), or Has anything (new) come To them that did not Come to their fathers of old ?

arabic_text: ٦٩- أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنْكِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. Or do they not recognise Their Apostle, that they Deny him ?

arabic_text: ٧٠- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَاءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. Or do they say, “ he is Possessed ” ? Nay, he has Brought them the Truth, But most of them Hate the Truth.

arabic_text: ٧١- وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 71. If the Truth had been In accord with their desires, Truly the heavens and the earth, And all beings therein Would have been in confusion And corruption ! Nay, We Have sent them their admonition, But they turn away From their admonition.

arabic_text: ٧٢- أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 72. Or is it that thou Askest them for some Recompense ? But the recompense Of thy Lord is best : He is the Best of those Who give sustenance.

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 73. But verily thou callest them To the Straight Way ;

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 74. And verily those who Believe not in the Hereafter Are deviating from that Way.

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِنْ ضُرٍّ لَلَجُّوا فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 75.If We had mercy on them And removed the distress Which is on them, they Would obstinately persist In their transgression, Wandering in distraction To and fro.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 76. We inflicted Punishment On them, but they Humbled not themselves To their Lord, nor do they Submissively entreat (Him) !—

arabic_text: ٧٧- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ◯
english_translation: 77. Until We open on them A gate leading to A severe Punishment : then Lo ! they will be plunged In despair therein !

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلًا مَا تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 78.It is He Who has created For you (the faculties of) Hearing, sight, feeling And understanding : little thanks It is ye give !

arabic_text: ٧٩- وَهُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. And He Has multiplied you Through the earth, and to Him Shall ye be gathered back.

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ اخْتِلَافُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. It is He Who gives Life and death, and to Him (Is due) the alternation Of Night and Day : Will ye not then understand ?

arabic_text: ٨١- بَلْ قَالُوا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْأَوَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 81. On the contrary they say Things similar to what The ancients said.

arabic_text: ٨٢- قَالُوا أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. They say : “ What ! When we Die and become dust and bones, Could we really be Raised up again ?

arabic_text: ٨٣- لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 83. “ Such things have been promised To us and to our fathers Before ! They are nothing But tales of the ancients ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٤- قُلْ لِمَنِ الْأَرْضُ وَمَنْ فِيهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 84. Say : “ To whom belong The earth and all beings therein ? (Say) if ye know ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٥- سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّـهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. They will say, “ To God ! ” Say : “ Yet will ye not Receive admonition ? ”

arabic_text: ٨٦- قُلْ مَنْ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 86. Say : “ Who is the Lord Of the seven heavens, And the Lord of the Throne (Of Glory) Supreme ? ”

arabic_text: ٨٧- سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّـهِ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 87. They will say, “ (They belong) To God.” Say : “ Will ye not Then be filled with awe ? ”

arabic_text: ٨٨- قُلْ مَنْ بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. Say : “ Who is it in whose Hands is the governance Of all things,—who protects (All), but is not protected (Of any) ? (Say) if ye know.”

arabic_text: ٨٩- سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّـهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 89. They will say, “ (It belongs) To God.” Say : “ Then how Are ye deluded ? ”

arabic_text: ٩٠- بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 90.We have sent them the Truth : But they indeed practice Falsehood !

arabic_text: ٩١- مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّـهُ مِنْ وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 91. No son did God beget, Nor is there any god Along with Him : (if there were Many gods), behold, each god Would have taken away What he had created, And some would have Lorded it over others ! Glory to God ! (He is free) From the (sort of) things They attribute to Him !

arabic_text: ٩٢- عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 92. He knows what is hidden And what is open : too high Is He for the partners They attribute to Him !

arabic_text: ٩٣- قُلْ رَبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّي مَا يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 93.Say : “ O my Lord ! If Thou wilt show me (In my lifetime) that which They are warned against,—

arabic_text: ٩٤- رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 94. “ Then, O my Lord ! put me not Amongst the people Who do wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٩٥- وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 95. And We are certainly able To show thee (in fulfilment) That against which they are warned.

arabic_text: ٩٦- ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. Repel evil with that Which is best : We are Well acquainted with The things they say.

arabic_text: ٩٧- وَقُلْ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ◯
english_translation: 97. And say “ O my Lord ! I seek refuge with Thee From the suggestions Of the Evil Ones.

arabic_text: ٩٨- وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ◯
english_translation: 98. “ And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord ! lest they Should come near me.”

arabic_text: ٩٩- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُونِ◯
english_translation: 99. (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes To one of them, he says : “ O my Lord ! send me back (To life),—

arabic_text: ١٠٠- لَعَلِّي أَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَائِلُهَا وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 100. “ In order that I may Work righteousness in the things I neglected.”—“ By no means ! It is but a word he says.”— Before them is a Partition Till the Day they are Raised up.

arabic_text: ١٠١- فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَلَا أَنْسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 101.Then when the Trumpet Is blown, there will be No more relationships Between them that day, Nor will one ask after another !

arabic_text: ١٠٢- فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 102. Then those whose balance (Of good deeds) is heavy,— They will attain salvation :

arabic_text: ١٠٣- وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ فِي جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 103. But those whose balance Is light, will be those Who have lost their souls ; In Hell will they abide.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 104. The Fire will burn their faces, And they will therein Grin, with their lips displaced.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 105. “ Were not My Signs rehearsed To you, and ye did but Treat them as falsehoods ? ”

arabic_text: ١٠٦- قَالُوا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَالِّينَ◯
english_translation: 106. They will say : “ Our Lord ! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, And we became a people Astray !

arabic_text: ١٠٧- رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 107. “ Our Lord ! Bring us out Of this : if ever we return (To evil), then shall we be Wrong-doers indeed ! ”

arabic_text: ١٠٨- قَالَ اخْسَئُوا فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ◯
english_translation: 108. He will say : “ Be ye Driven into it (with ignominy) ! And speak ye not to Me !

arabic_text: ١٠٩- إِنَّهُ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 109. “ A part of My servants There was, who used to pray, ‘ Our Lord ! we believe ; Then do Thou forgive us, And have mercy upon us : For Thou art the Best Of those who show mercy ! ’

arabic_text: ١١٠- فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰ أَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِي وَكُنْتُمْ مِنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 110. “ But ye treated them With ridicule, so much so That (ridicule of) them made you Forget My Message while Ye were laughing at them !

arabic_text: ١١١- إِنِّي جَزَيْتُهُمُ الْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ◯
english_translation: 111. “ I have rewarded them This day for their patience And constancy : they are indeed The ones that have achieved Bliss…”

arabic_text: ١١٢- قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 112. He will say : “ What number Of years did ye stay On earth ? ”

arabic_text: ١١٣- قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَاسْأَلِ الْعَادِّينَ◯
english_translation: 113. They will say : “ We stayed A day or part of a day : But ask those who Keep account.”

arabic_text: ١١٤- قَالَ إِنْ لَبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا لَوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 114. He will say : “ Ye stayed Not but a little,— If ye had only known !

arabic_text: ١١٥- أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 115. “ Did ye then think That We had created you In jest, and that ye Would not be brought back To Us (for account) ? ”

arabic_text: ١١٦- فَتَعَالَى اللَّـهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ◯
english_translation: 116.Therefore exalted be God, The King, the Reality : There is no god but He, The Lord of the Throne Of Honour !

arabic_text: ١١٧- وَمَنْ يَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 117. If anyone invokes, besides God, Any other god, he has No authority therefor ; And his reckoning will be Only with his Lord ! And verily the Unbelievers Will fail to win through !

arabic_text: ١١٨- وَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 118. So say : “ O my Lord ! Grant Thou forgiveness and mercy ! For Thou art the Best Of those who show mercy ! ”

arabic_text: ١- سُورَةٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهَا وَفَرَضْنَاهَا وَأَنْزَلْنَا فِيهَا آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.ASūra which We Have sent down and Which We have ordained : In it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that Ye may receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٢- الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ اللَّـهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 2.The woman and the man Guilty of adultery or fornication,— Flog each of them With a hundred stripes : Let not compassion move you In their case, in a matter Prescribed by God, if ye believe In God and the Last Day : And let a party Of the Believers Witness their punishment.

arabic_text: ٣- الزَّانِي لَا يَنْكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنْكِحُهَا إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 3.  Let no man guilty of Adultery or fornication marry Any but a woman Similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever : Nor let any but such a man Or an Unbeliever Marry such a woman : To the Believers such a thing Is forbidden.

arabic_text: ٤- وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 4.And those who launch A charge against chaste women, And produce not four witnesses (To support their allegation),— Flog them with eighty stripes ; And reject their evidence Ever after : for such men Are wicked transgressors ;—

arabic_text: ٥- إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 5.  Unless they repent thereafter And mend (their conduct) ; For God is Oft-Forgiving Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦- وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّـهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 6.And for those who launch A charge against their spouses, And have (in support) No evidence but their own,— Their solitary evidence (Can be received) if they Bear witness four times (With an oath) by God That they are solemnly Telling the truth ;

arabic_text: ٧- وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 7.  And the fifth (oath) (Should be) that they solemnly Invoke the curse of God On themselves if they Tell a lie.

arabic_text: ٨- وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّـهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 8.  But it would avert The punishment from the wife, If she bears witness Four times (with an oath) By God, that (her husband) Is telling a lie ;

arabic_text: ٩- وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 9.  And the fifth (oath) Should be that she solemnly Invokes the wrath of God On herself if (her accuser) Is telling the truth.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 10. If it were not For God’s grace and mercy On you, and that God Is Oft-Returning, Full of wisdom,— (Ye would be ruined indeed).

arabic_text: ١١- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ جَاءُوا بِالْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِنْكُمْ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَكُمْ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ مَا اكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ وَالَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
