english_translation: 11.Those who brought forward The lie are a body Among yourselves : think it not To be an evil to you ; On the contrary it is good For you : to every man Among them (will come The punishment) of the sin That he earned, and to him Who took on himself the lead Among them, will be A Penalty grievous.

arabic_text: ١٢- لَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتُ بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا هَـٰذَا إِفْكٌ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 12. Why did not Believers— Men and women —when ye Heard of the affair,—put The best construction on it In their own minds And say, “ This (charge) Is an obvious lie ” ?

arabic_text: ١٣- لَوْلَا جَاءُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِالشُّهَدَاءِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ عِنْدَ اللَّـهِ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. Why did they not bring Four witnesses to prove it ? When they have not brought The witnesses, such men, In the sight of God, (Stand forth) themselves as liars !

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِي مَا أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 14. Were it not for the grace And mercy of God on you, In this world and the Hereafter, A grievous penalty would have Seized you in that ye rushed Glibly into this affair.

arabic_text: ١٥- إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ مَا لَيْسَ لَكُمْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِنْدَ اللَّـهِ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 15. Behold, ye received it On your tongues, And said out of your mouths Things of which ye had No knowledge ; and ye thought It to be a light matter, While it was most serious In the sight of God.

arabic_text: ١٦- وَلَوْلَا إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُمْ مَا يَكُونُ لَنَا أَنْ نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَانَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَانٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 16. And why did ye not, When ye heard it, say ?— “ It is not right of us To speak of this : Glory to God ! this is A most serious slander ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧- يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّـهُ أَنْ تَعُودُوا لِمِثْلِهِ أَبَدًا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 17.God doth admonish you, That ye may never repeat Such (conduct), if ye Are (true) Believers.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّـهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 18. And God makes the Signs Plain to you : for God Is full of knowledge and wisdom.

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. Those who love (to see) Scandal published broadcast Among the Believers, will have A grievous Penalty in this life And in the Hereafter : God Knows, and ye know not.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 20. Were it not for the grace And mercy of God on you, And that God is Full of kindness and mercy, (Ye would be ruined indeed).

arabic_text: ٢١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمَنْ يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْمُرُ بِالْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُزَكِّي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَاللَّـهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 21.Oye who believe ! Follow not Satan’s footsteps : If any will follow the footsteps Of Satan, he will (but) command What is shameful and wrong : And were it not for the grace And mercy of God on you, Not one of you would ever Have been pure : but God Doth purify whom He pleases : And God is One Who Hears and knows (all things).

arabic_text: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّـهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّـهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّـهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 22. Let not those among you Who are endued with grace And amplitude of means Resolve by oath against helping Their kinsmen, those in want, And those who have left Their homes in God’s cause : Let them forgive and overlook, Do you not wish That God should forgive you ? For God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْغَافِلَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ لُعِنُوا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 23. Those who slander chaste women, Indiscreet but believing, Are cursed in this life And in the Hereafter : For them is a grievous Penalty,—

arabic_text: ٢٤- يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. On the Day when their tongues, Their hands, and their feet Will bear witness against them As to their actions.

arabic_text: ٢٥- يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اللَّـهُ دِينَهُمُ الْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 25. On that Day God Will pay them back (All) their just dues, And they will realise That God is The (very) Truth, That makes all things manifest.

arabic_text: ٢٦- الْخَبِيثَاتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَاتِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَاتِ أُولَـٰئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 26. Women impure are for men impure, And men impure are for women impure And women of purity Are for men of purity, And men of purity Are for women of purity : These are not affected By what people say : For them there is forgiveness, And a provision honourable.

arabic_text: ٢٧- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا وَتُسَلِّمُوا عَلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 27.Oye who believe ! Enter not houses other than Your own, until ye have Asked permission and saluted Those in them : that is Best for you, in order that Ye may heed (what is seemly).

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا فِيهَا أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ وَإِنْ قِيلَ لَكُمُ ارْجِعُوا فَارْجِعُوا هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 28. If ye find no one In the house, enter not Until permission is given To you : if ye are asked To go back, go back : That makes for greater purity For yourselves : and God Knows well all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٢٩- لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَاعٌ لَكُمْ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. It is no fault on your part To enter houses not used For living in, which serve Some (other) use for you : And God has knowledge Of what ye reveal And what ye conceal.

arabic_text: ٣٠- قُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا فُرُوجَهُمْ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 30.Say to the believing men That they should lower Their gaze and guard Their modesty : that will make For greater purity for them : and God is well acquainted With all that they do.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَقُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَائِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ  الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَىٰ عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِنْ زِينَتِهِنَّ وَتُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. And say to the believing women That they should lower Their gaze and guard Their modesty ; that they Should not display their Beauty and ornaments except What (must ordinarily) appear Thereof ; that they should Draw their veils over Their bosoms and not display Their beauty except To their husbands, their fathers, Their husbands’ fathers, their sons, Their husbands’ sons, Their brothers or their brothers’ sons, Or their sisters’ sons, Or their women, or the slaves Whom their right hands Possess, or male servants Free of physical needs, Or small children who Have no sense of the shame Of sex ; and that they Should not strike their feet In order to draw attention To their hidden ornaments. And O ye Believers ! Turn ye all together Towards God, that ye May attain Bliss.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَأَنْكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنْكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ إِنْ يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّـهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّـهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 32.Marry those among you Who are single, or The virtuous ones among Your slaves, male or female : If they are in poverty, God will give them Means out of His grace : For God encompasseth all, And He knoweth all things.

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ اللَّـهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَالَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا وَآتُوهُمْ مِنْ مَالِ اللَّـهِ الَّذِي آتَاكُمْ وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَنْ يُكْرِهْهُنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ مِنْ بَعْدِ إِكْرَاهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 33. Let those who find not The wherewithal for marriage Keep themselves chaste, until God gives them means Out of His grace. And if any of your slaves Ask for a deed in writing (To enable them to earn Their freedom for a certain sum), Give them such a deed If ye know any good In them ; yea, give them Something yourselves Out of the means which God has given to you. But force not your maids To prostitution when they desire Chastity, in order that ye May make a gain In the goods of this life. But if anyone compels them, Yet, after such compulsion, Is God Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful (to them).

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ آيَاتٍ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةً لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 34.We have already sent down To you verses making things Clear, an illustration from (the story Of) people who passed away Before you, and an admonition For those who fear (God).

arabic_text: ٣٥- اللَّـهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ نُورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللَّـهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّـهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ وَاللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 35.God is the Light Of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light Is as if there were a Niche And within it a Lamp : The Lamp enclosed in Glass : The glass as it were A brilliant star : Lit from a blessed Tree, An Olive, neither of the East Nor of the West, Whose Oil is well-nigh Luminous, Though fire scarce touched it : Light upon Light ! God doth guide Whom He will To His Light : God doth set forth Parables For men : and God Doth know all things.

arabic_text: ٣٦- فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّـهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ◯
english_translation: 36. (Lit is such a Light) In houses, which God Hath permitted to be raised To honour ; for the celebration, In them, of His name : In them is He glorified In the mornings and In the evenings, (again and again),—

arabic_text: ٣٧- رِجَالٌ لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ◯
english_translation: 37. By men whom neither Traffic nor merchandise Can divert from the Remembrance Of God, nor from regular Prayer, Nor from the practice Of regular Charity : Their (only) fear is For the Day when Hearts and eyes Will be transformed (In a world wholly new),—

arabic_text: ٣٨- لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّـهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَاللَّـهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ◯
english_translation: 38. That God may reward them According to the best Of their deeds, and add Even more for them Out of His Grace : For God doth provide For those whom He will, Without measure.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَعْمَالُهُمْ كَسَرَابٍ بِقِيعَةٍ يَحْسَبُهُ الظَّمْآنُ مَاءً حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَهُ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَيْئًا وَوَجَدَ اللَّـهَ عِنْدَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ حِسَابَهُ وَاللَّـهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 39.But the Unbelievers,— Their deeds are like a mirage In sandy deserts, which The man parched with thirst Mistakes for water ; until When he comes up to it, He finds it to be nothing : But he finds God (Ever) with him, and God Will pay him his account : And God is swift In taking account.

arabic_text: ٤٠- أَوْ كَظُلُمَاتٍ فِي بَحْرٍ لُجِّيٍّ يَغْشَاهُ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ مَوْجٌ مِنْ فَوْقِهِ سَحَابٌ ظُلُمَاتٌ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ إِذَا أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَاهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجْعَلِ اللَّـهُ لَهُ نُورًا فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ نُورٍ◯
english_translation: 40. Or (the Unbelievers’ state) Is like the depths of darkness In a vast deep ocean, Overwhelmed with billow Topped by billow, Topped by (dark) clouds : Depths of darkness, one Above another : if a man Stretches out his hand, He can hardly see it ! For any to whom God Giveth not light, There is no light !

arabic_text: ٤١- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَافَّاتٍ كُلٌّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُ وَتَسْبِيحَهُ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 41.Seest thou not that it is God Whose praises all beings In the heavens and on earth Do celebrate, and the birds (Of the air) with wings Outspread ? Each one knows Its own (mode of) prayer And praise. And God Knows well all that they do.

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَلِلَّـهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 42. Yea, to God belongs The dominion of the heavens And the earth ; and to God Is the final goal (of all).

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِنْ جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِنْ بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَنْ مَنْ يَشَاءُ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ◯
english_translation: 43. Seest thou not that God Makes the clouds move Gently, then joins them Together, then makes them Into a heap ?—then wilt thou See rain issue forth From their midst. And He Sends down from the sky Mountain masses (of clouds) Wherein is hail : He strikes Therewith whom He pleases And He turns it away From whom He pleases. The vivid flash of His lightning Well-nigh blinds the sight.

arabic_text: ٤٤- يُقَلِّبُ اللَّـهُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ◯
english_translation: 44. It is God Who alternates The Night and the Day : Verily in these things Is an instructive example For those who have vision !

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَاللَّـهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَابَّةٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ بَطْنِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ رِجْلَيْنِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَىٰ أَرْبَعٍ يَخْلُقُ اللَّـهُ مَا يَشَاءُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 45. And God has created Every animal from water : Of them there are some That creep on their bellies ; Some that walk on two legs ; And some that walk on four. God creates what He wills ; For verily God has power Over all things.

arabic_text: ٤٦- لَقَدْ أَنْزَلْنَا آيَاتٍ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ وَاللَّـهُ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 46. We have indeed sent down Signs that make things manifest : And God guides whom He wills To a way that is straight.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَيَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِاللَّـهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَا أُولَـٰئِكَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 47.They say, “ We believe In God and in the Apostle, And we obey ” : but Even after that, some of them Turn away : they are not (Really) Believers.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَإِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. When they are summoned To God and His Apostle, In order that He may judge Between them, behold, some Of them decline (to come).

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَإِنْ يَكُنْ لَهُمُ الْحَقُّ يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. But if the right is On their side, they come To him with all submission.

arabic_text: ٥٠- أَفِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ أَمِ ارْتَابُوا أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَحِيفَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُ بَلْ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. Is it that there is A disease in their hearts ? Or do they doubt, Or are they in fear, That God and His Apostle Will deal unjustly with them ? Nay, it is they themselves Who do wrong.

arabic_text: ٥١- إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ أَنْ يَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 51.The answer of the Believers, When summoned to God And His Apostle, in order That He may judge between them, Is no other than this : They say, “ We hear and we obey ” : It is such as these That will attain felicity.

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَخْشَ اللَّـهَ وَيَتَّقْهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. It is such as obey God and His Apostle, And fear God and do Right, that will win (In the end).

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّـهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِنْ أَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّ قُلْ لَا تُقْسِمُوا طَاعَةٌ مَعْرُوفَةٌ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. They swear their strongest oaths By God that, if only thou Wouldst command them, they Would leave (their homes). Say : “ Swear ye not ; Obedience is (more) reasonable ; Verily, God is well acquainted With all that ye do.”

arabic_text: ٥٤- قُلْ أَطِيعُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُمْ مَا حُمِّلْتُمْ وَإِنْ تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُوا وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 54. Say : “ Obey God, and obey The Apostle ” : but if ye turn Away, he is only responsible For the duty placed on him And ye for that placed On you. If ye obey him, Ye shall be on right guidance. The Apostle’s duty is only To preach the clear (Message).

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَعَدَ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ كَمَا اسْتَخْلَفَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ الَّذِي ارْتَضَىٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمْ أَمْنًا يَعْبُدُونَنِي لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِي شَيْئًا وَمَنْ كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 55.God has promised, to those Among you who believe And work righteous deeds, that He Will, of a surety, grant them In the land, inheritance (Of power), as He granted it To those before them ; that He will establish in authority Their religion—the one Which He has chosen for them ; And that He will change (Their state), after the fear In which they (lived), to one Of security and peace : ‘ They will worship Me (alone) And not associate aught with Me.’ If any do reject Faith After this, they are Rebellious and wicked.

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. So establish regular Prayer And give regular Charity ; And obey the Apostle ; That ye may receive mercy.

arabic_text: ٥٧- لَا تَحْسَبَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ وَلَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 57. Never think thou That the Unbelievers Are going to frustrate (God’s Plan) on earth : Their abode is the Fire,— And it is indeed An evil refuge !

arabic_text: ٥٨- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِيَسْتَأْذِنْكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنْكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُمْ مِنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنْ بَعْدِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ طَوَّافُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّـهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 58.Oye who believe ! Let those whom your right hands Possess, and the (children) among you Who have not come of age Ask your permission (before They come to your presence), On three occasions : before Morning prayer ; the while Ye doff your clothes For the noonday heat ; And after the late-night prayer : These are your three times Of undress : outside those times It is not wrong for you Or for them to move about Attending to each other : Thus does God make clear The Signs to you : for God Is full of knowledge and wisdom.

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَإِذَا بَلَغَ الْأَطْفَالُ مِنْكُمُ الْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَأْذِنُوا كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّـهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 59. But when the children among you Come of age, let them (also) Ask for permission, as do those Senior to them (in age) : Thus does God make clear His Signs to you : for God Is full of knowledge and wisdom.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَالْقَوَاعِدُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ اللَّاتِي لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحًا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَاتٍ بِزِينَةٍ وَأَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرٌ لَهُنَّ وَاللَّـهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 60. Such elderly women as are Past the prospect of marriage,— There is no blame on them If they lay aside Their (outer) garments, provided They make not a wanton display Of their beauty : but It is best for them To be modest : and God Is One Who sees and knows All things.

arabic_text: ٦١- لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ آبَائِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَانِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَامِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّاتِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَالِكُمْ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَالَاتِكُمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُمْ مَفَاتِحَهُ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوا جَمِيعًا أَوْ أَشْتَاتًا فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُمْ بُيُوتًا فَسَلِّمُوا  عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةً مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّـهِ مُبَارَكَةً طَيِّبَةً كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّـهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 61.It is no fault in the blind Nor in one born lame, nor In one afflicted with illness, Nor in yourselves, that ye Should eat in your own houses, Or those of your fathers, Or your mothers, or your brothers, Or your sisters, or your father’s brothers Or your father’s sisters, Or your mother’s brothers, Or your mother’s sisters, Or in houses of which The keys are in your possession, Or in the house of a sincere Friend of yours : there is No blame on you, whether Ye eat in company or Separately. But if ye Enter houses, salute each other— A greeting of blessing And purity as from God. Thus does God make clear The Signs to you : that ye May understand.

arabic_text: ٦٢- إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا مَعَهُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَنْ لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّـهَ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 62.Only those are Believers, Who believe in God and His Apostle : when they are With him on a matter Requiring collective action, They do not depart until They have asked for his leave ; Those who ask for thy leave Are those who believe in God And His Apostle ; so when They ask for thy leave, For some business of theirs, Give leave to those of them Whom thou wilt, and ask God for their forgiveness : For God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦٣- لَا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُمْ بَعْضًا قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنْكُمْ لِوَاذًا فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 63. Deem not the summons Of the Apostle among yourselves Like the summons of one Of you to another : God Doth know those of you Who slip away under shelter Of some excuse : then Let those beware who Withstand the Apostle’s order, Lest some trial befall them, Or a grievous Penalty Be inflicted on them.

arabic_text: ٦٤- أَلَا إِنَّ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَاللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 64. Be quite sure that To God doth belong Whatever is in the heavens And on earth. Well doth He Know what ye are intent upon : And one day they will be Brought back to Him, and He Will tell them the truth Of what they did : For God doth know All things.

arabic_text: ١- تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 1.Blessed is He Who Sent down the Criterion To His Servant, that it May be an admonition To all creature ;—

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقْدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 2.  He to Whom belongs The dominion of the heavens And the earth : no son Has He begotten, nor has He A partner in His dominion : It is He Who created All things, and ordered them In due proportions.

arabic_text: ٣- وَاتَّخَذُوا مِنْ دُونِهِ آلِهَةً لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَاةً وَلَا نُشُورًا◯
english_translation: 3.  Yet have they taken, Besides Him, gods that can Create nothing but are themselves Created ; that have no control Of hurt or good to themselves ; Nor can they control Death Nor Life nor Resurrection.

arabic_text: ٤- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ افْتَرَاهُ وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ آخَرُونَ فَقَدْ جَاءُوا ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا◯
english_translation: 4.But the Misbelievers say : “ Naught is this but a lie Which he has forged, And others have helped him At it.” In truth it is they Who have put forward An iniquity and a falsehood.

arabic_text: ٥- وَقَالُوا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا◯
english_translation: 5.  And they say : “ Tales of The ancients, which he has caused To be written : and they Are dictated before him Morning and evening.”

arabic_text: ٦- قُلْ أَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِي يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 6.  Say : “ The (Qur-ān) was sent down By Him Who knows The Mystery (that is) in the heavens And the earth : verily He Is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

arabic_text: ٧- وَقَالُوا مَالِ هَـٰذَا الرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِي فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُ نَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 7.And they say : “ What sort Of an apostle is this, Who eats food, and walks Through the streets ? Why Has not an angel Been sent down to him To give admonition with him ?

arabic_text: ٨- أَوْ يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْهِ كَنْزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ الظَّالِمُونَ إِنْ تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَسْحُورًا◯
english_translation: 8.  “ Or (why) has not a treasure Been bestowed on him, or Why has he (not) a garden For enjoyment ? ” The wicked Say : “ Ye follow none other Than a man bewitched.”

arabic_text: ٩- انْظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا لَكَ الْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 9.  See what kinds of comparisons They make for thee ! But they have gone astray, And never a way will they Be able to find !

arabic_text: ١٠- تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَيَجْعَلْ لَكَ قُصُورًا◯
english_translation: 10.Blessed is He Who, If that were His Will, Could give thee better (things) Than those,—Gardens beneath which Rivers flow ; and He could Give thee Palaces (secure To dwell in).

arabic_text: ١١- بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالسَّاعَةِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 11. Nay, they deny the Hour (Of the Judgment to come) : But We have prepared A Blazing Fire for such As deny the Hour :

arabic_text: ١٢- إِذَا رَأَتْهُمْ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا◯
english_translation: 12. When it sees them From a place far off, They will hear its fury And its raging sigh.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِذَا أُلْقُوا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا◯
english_translation: 13. And when they are cast, Bound together, into a Constricted place therein, they Will plead for destruction There and then !

arabic_text: ١٤- لَا تَدْعُوا الْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَاحِدًا وَادْعُوا ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا◯
english_translation: 14. “ This day plead not For a single destruction : Plead for destruction oft-repeated ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَاءً وَمَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 15. Say : “ Is that best, or The eternal Garden, promised To the righteous ? For them, That is a reward as well As a goal (of attainment).

arabic_text: ١٦- لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَاءُونَ خَالِدِينَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَسْئُولًا◯
english_translation: 16. “ For them there will be Therein all that they wish for : They will dwell (there) for aye : A promise to be prayed for From thy Lord.”

arabic_text: ١٧- وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ فَيَقُولُ أَأَنْتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِي هَـٰؤُلَاءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيلَ◯
english_translation: 17.The Day He will gather Them together as well as Those whom they worship Besides God, He will ask : “ Was it ye who led These My servants astray, Or did they stray From the Path themselves ? ”

arabic_text: ١٨- قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَنَا أَنْ نَتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَـٰكِنْ مَتَّعْتَهُمْ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا الذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا قَوْمًا بُورًا◯
english_translation: 18. They will say : “ Glory to Thee ! Not meet was it for us That we should take For protectors others besides Thee : But Thou didst bestow, On them and their fathers, Good things (in life), until They forgot the Message : For they were a people (Worthless and) lost.”

arabic_text: ١٩- فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُمْ بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا وَمَنْ يَظْلِمْ مِنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 19. (God will say) : “ Now Have they proved you liars In what ye say : so Ye cannot avert (your penalty) Nor (get) help.” And whoever Among you does wrong, Him shall We cause to taste Of a grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 20. And the apostles whom We Sent before thee were all (Men) who ate food And walked through the streets : We have made some of you As a trial for others : Will ye have patience ? For God is One Who Sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٢١- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْا عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 21.Such as fear not The meeting with Us (For Judgment) say : “ Why are not the angels Sent down to us, or (Why) do we not see Our Lord ? ” Indeed they Have an arrogant conceit Of themselves, and mighty Is the insolence of their impiety !

arabic_text: ٢٢- يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا◯
english_translation: 22. The Day they see the angels,— No joy will there be To the sinners that Day : The (angels) will say : “ There is a barrier Forbidden (to you) altogether ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا◯
english_translation: 23. And We shall turn To whatever deeds they did (In this life), and We shall Make such deeds as floating dust Scattered about.

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا◯
english_translation: 24. The Companions of the Garden Will be well, that Day, In their abode, and have The fairest of places for repose.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَاءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تَنْزِيلًا◯
english_translation: 25. The Day the heaven shall be Rent asunder with clouds, And angels shall be sent down, Descending (in ranks),—

arabic_text: ٢٦- الْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ عَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 26. That Day, the dominion As of right and truth, Shall be (wholly) for (God) Most Merciful : it will be A Day of dire difficulty For the Misbelievers.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 27.The Day that the wrong-doer Will bite at his hands, He will say, “ Oh ! would that I had taken a (straight) path With the Apostle !

arabic_text: ٢٨- يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 28. “ Ah ! woe is me ! Would that I had never Taken such a one For a friend !

arabic_text: ٢٩- لَقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْإِنْسَانِ خَذُولًا◯
english_translation: 29. “ He did lead me astray From the Message (of God) After it had come to me ! Ah ! the Evil One is But a traitor to man !

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا◯
english_translation: 30. Then the Apostle will say : “ O my Lord ! Truly My people took this Qur-ān For just foolish nonsense.”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 31. Thus have We made For every prophet an enemy Among the sinners : but enough Is thy Lord to guide And to help.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا◯
english_translation: 32.Those who reject Faith Say : “ Why is not the Qur-ān Revealed to him all at once ? ” Thus (is it revealed), that We May strengthen thy heart Thereby, and We have Rehearsed it to thee in slow, Well-arranged stages, gradually.

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 33. And no question do they Bring to thee but We Reveal to thee the truth And the best explanation (thereof).

arabic_text: ٣٤- الَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُولَـٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 34.Those who will be gathered To Hell (prone) on their faces,— They will be in an evil Plight, and, as to Path, Most astray.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا◯
english_translation: 35. (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed His brother Aaron with him As Minister ;

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا◯
english_translation: 36. And We commanded : “ Go ye Both, to the people who Have rejected our Signs : ” And those (people) We destroyed With utter destruction.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ آيَةً وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 37. And the people of Noah,— When they rejected the apostles, We drowned them, And We made them As a Sign for mankind ; And We have prepared For (all) wrong-doers A grievous Penalty ;—

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا◯
english_translation: 38. As also ‘Ād andThamūd, And the Companions Of the Rass, and many A generation between them.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 39. To teach one We set forth Parables and examples ; And each one We broke To utter annihilation (For their sins).

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَهَا بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا◯
english_translation: 40. And the (Unbelievers) must indeed Have passed by the town On which was rained A shower of evil : did they not Then see it (with their own Eyes) ? But they fear not The Resurrection.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّـهُ رَسُولًا◯
english_translation: 41.When they see thee, They treat thee no otherwise Than in mockery : “ Is this The one whom God has sent As an apostle ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٢- إِنْ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 42. “ He indeed would well-nigh Have misled us from Our gods, had it not been That we were constant To them ! ”—Soon will they Know, when they see The Penalty, who it is That is most misled In Path !

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 43. Seest thou such a one As taketh for his god His own passion (or impulse) ? Couldst thou be a disposer Of affairs for him ?

arabic_text: ٤٤- أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 44. Or thinkest thou that most Of them listen or understand ? They are only like cattle ;— Nay, they are worse astray In Path.

arabic_text: ٤٥- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 45.Hast thou not turned Thy vision to thy Lord ?— How He doth prolong The Shadow ! If He willed, He could make it stationary ! Then do We make The sun its guide ;

arabic_text: ٤٦- ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 46. Then We draw it in Towards Ourselves,— A contraction by easy stages.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا◯
english_translation: 47.And He it is Who makes The Night as a Robe For you, and Sleep as Repose, And makes the Day (As it were) a Resurrection.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا◯
english_translation: 48.And He it is Who sends The Winds as heralds Of glad tidings, going before His Mercy, and We send down Purifying water from the sky,—

arabic_text: ٤٩- لِنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا◯
english_translation: 49. That with it We may give Life to a dead land, And slake the thirst Of things We have created,— Cattle and men in great numbers.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 50. And We have distributed The (water) amongst them, in order That they may celebrate (Our) praises, but most men Are averse (to aught) but (Rank) ingratitude.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 51.Had it been Our Will, We could have sent A warner to every centre Of population

arabic_text: ٥٢- فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُمْ بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 52. Therefore listen not To the Unbelievers, but strive Against them with the utmost Strenuousness, with the (Qur-ān).

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَحْجُورًا◯
english_translation: 53.It is He Who has Let free the two bodies Of flowing water : One palatable and sweet, And the other salt And bitter ; yet has He Made a barrier between them, A partition that is forbidden To be passed.

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 54.It is He Who has Created man from water : Then has He established Relationships of lineage And marriage : for thy Lord Has power (over all things).

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا◯
english_translation: 55.Yet do they worship, Besides God, things that can Neither profit them nor Harm them : and the Misbeliever Is a helper (of Evil), Against his own Lord !

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 56. But thee We only sent To give glad tidings And admonition.

arabic_text: ٥٧- قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 57. Say : “ No reward do I Ask of you for it but this : That each one who will May take a (straight) Path To his Lord.”

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 58.And put thy trust In Him Who lives And dies not ; and celebrate His praise ; and enough is He To be acquainted with The faults of His servants ;—

arabic_text: ٥٩- الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاسْأَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 59. He Who created the heavens And the earth and all That is between, in six days, And is firmly established On the Throne (of authority) : God Most Gracious : Ask thou, then, about Him Of any acquainted (with such things).

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوا لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا وَمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًاالسجدة◯
english_translation: 60. When it is said to them, “ Adore ye (God) Most Gracious ! ”, They say, “ And what is (God) Most Gracious ? Shall we adore That which thou commandest us ? ” And it increases their flight (From the Truth).

arabic_text: ٦١- تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنِيرًا◯
english_translation: 61.Blessed is He Who made Constellations in the skies, And placed therein a Lamp And a Moon giving light ;

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا◯
english_translation: 62. And it is He Who made The Night and the Day To follow each other : For such as have the will To celebrate His praises Or to show their gratitude.

arabic_text: ٦٣- وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا◯
english_translation: 63.And the servants of (God) Most Gracious are those Who walk on the earth In humility, and when the ignorant Address them, they say, “ Peace ! ” ;

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا◯
english_translation: 64. Those who spend the night In adoration of their Lord Prostrate and standing ;

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا◯
english_translation: 65. Those who say, “ Our Lord ! Avert from us the Wrath Of Hell, for its Wrath Is indeed an affliction grievous,—

arabic_text: ٦٦- إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا◯
english_translation: 66. “ Evil indeed is it As an abode, and as A place to rest in ” ;

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنْفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا◯
english_translation: 67. Those who, when they spend, Are not extravagant and not Niggardly, but hold a just (balance) Between those (extremes) ;

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّـهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا◯
english_translation: 68. Those who invoke not, With God, any other god, Nor slay such life as God Has made sacred, except For just cause, not commit Fornication ;—and any that does This (not only) meets punishment

arabic_text: ٦٩- يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَانًا◯
english_translation: 69. (But) the Penalty on the Day Of Judgment will be doubled To him, and he will dwell Therein in ignominy,—

arabic_text: ٧٠- إِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّـهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 70. Unless he repents, believes, And works righteous deeds, For God will change The evil of such persons Into good, and God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,

arabic_text: ٧١- وَمَنْ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّـهِ مَتَابًا◯
english_translation: 71. And whoever repents and does good Has truly turned to God With an (acceptable) conversion ;—

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِرَامًا◯
english_translation: 72. Those who witness no falsehood, And, if they pass by futility, They pass by it With honourable (avoidance) ;

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا◯
english_translation: 73. Those who, when they are Admonished with the Signs Of their Lord, droop not down At them as if they were Deaf or blind ;

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا◯
english_translation: 74. And those who pray, “ Our Lord ! Grant unto us Wives and offspring who will be The comfort of our eyes, And give us (the grace) To lead the righteous.”

arabic_text: ٧٥- أُولَـٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا◯
english_translation: 75. Those are the ones who Will be rewarded with The highest place in heaven, Because of their patient constancy : Therein shall they be met With salutations and peace,

arabic_text: ٧٦- خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا◯
english_translation: 76. Dwelling therein ;—how beautiful An abode and place of rest !

arabic_text: ٧٧- قُلْ مَا يَعْبَأُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا◯
english_translation: 77.Say (to the Rejecters) : “ My Lord is not uneasy Because of you if ye call not on Him : But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come The inevitable (punishment) ! ”

arabic_text: ١- طسم◯
english_translation: 1.Tā. Sīn. Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 2. These are Verses of the Book That makes (things) clear.

arabic_text: ٣-لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 3.It may be thou frettest Thy soul with grief, that they Do not become Believers.

arabic_text: ٤- إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 4. If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them From the sky a Sign, To which they would bend Their necks in humility.

arabic_text: ٥- وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 5. But there comes not To them a newly-revealed Message from (God) Most Gracious, But they turn away therefrom.

arabic_text: ٦- فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. They have indeed rejected (The Message) : so they will Know soon (enough) the truth Of what they mocked at !

arabic_text: ٧- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 7. Do they not look At the earth,—how many Noble things of all kinds We have produced therein ?

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. Verily, in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ٩- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9. And verily, thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 10.Behold, thy Lord called Moses : “ Go to the people Of iniquity,—

arabic_text: ١١- قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. “ The people of Pharaoh : Will they not fear God ? ”

arabic_text: ١٢- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ◯
english_translation: 12. He said : “ O my Lord ! I do fear that they Will charge me with falsehood :

arabic_text: ١٣- وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَارُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. “ My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (Smoothly) : so send unto Aaron.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ◯
english_translation: 14. “ And (further), they have A charge of crime against me ; And I fear they may Slay me.”

arabic_text: ١٥- قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَا ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. God said : “ By no means ! Proceed then, both of you, With Our Signs ; We Are with you, and will Listen (to your call).

arabic_text: ١٦- فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 16. “ So go forth, both of you, To Pharaoh, and say : ‘ We have been sent By the Lord and Cherisher Of the Worlds ;

arabic_text: ١٧- أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 17. “ ‘ Send thou with us The Children of Israel.’ ”

arabic_text: ١٨- قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 18. (Pharaoh) said : “ Did we not Cherish thee as a child Among us, and didst thou not Stay in our midst Many years of thy life ?

arabic_text: ١٩-وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 19. “ And thou didst a deed Of thine which (thou knowest) Thou didst, and thou art An ungrateful (wretch) ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ◯
english_translation: 20. Moses : “ I did it Then, when I was In error.

arabic_text: ٢١- فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 21. “ So I fled from you (all) When I feared you ; But my Lord has (since) Invested me with judgment (And wisdom) and appointed me As one of the apostles.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 22. “ And this is the favour With which thou dost Reproach me,—that thou Hast enslaved the Children Of Israel ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 23.Pharaoh said : “ And what Is the ‘ Lord and Cherisher Of the Worlds ’ ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. (Moses) said : “ The Lord And Cherisher of the heavens And the earth, and all between,—If ye want to be Quite sure.”

arabic_text: ٢٥- قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. (Pharaoh) said to those Around : “ Do ye not listen (To what he says) ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 26. (Moses) said : “ Your Lord And the Lord of your fathers From the beginning ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 27. (Pharaoh) said : “ Truly Your apostle who has been Sent to you is A veritable madman ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. (Moses) said : “ Lord of the East And the West, and all between ! If ye only had sense ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٩- قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. (Pharaoh) said : “ If thou Dost put forward any god Other than me, I will Certainly put thee in prison ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 30. (Moses) said : “ Even if I Showed you something Clear (and) convincing ? ”

arabic_text: ٣١- قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. (Pharaoh) said : “ Show it then, If thou tellest the truth ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 32. So (Moses) threw his rod, And behold, it was A serpent, plain (for all to see) !

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. And he drew out his hand, And behold, it was white To all beholders !

arabic_text: ٣٤- قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 34. (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs Around him : “ This is indeed A sorcerer well-versed :

arabic_text: ٣٥- يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. “ His plan is to get you out Of your land by his sorcery ; Then what is it ye counsel ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٦- قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 36. They said : “ Keep him And his brother in suspense (For a while), and dispatch To the Cities heralds to collect—

arabic_text: ٣٧- يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 37. “ And bring up to thee All (our) sorcerers well-versed.”

arabic_text: ٣٨- فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 38.So the sorcerers were got Together for the appointment Of a day well-known,

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. And the people were told : “ Are ye (now) assembled ?—

arabic_text: ٤٠- لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. “ That we may follow The sorcerers (in religion) If they win ? ”

arabic_text: ٤١- فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 41. So when the sorcerers arrived, They said to Pharaoh : “ Of course—shall we have A (suitable) reward If we win ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٢- قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 42. He said : “ Yea, (and more),— For ye shall in that case Be (raised to posts) Nearest (to my person).”

arabic_text: ٤٣- قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. Moses said to them : “ Throw ye—that which Ye are about to throw ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٤- فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. So they threw their ropes And their rods, and said : “ By the might of Pharaoh, It is we who will Certainly win ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 45. Then Moses threw his rod When, behold, it straightway Swallows up all The falsehoods which they fake !

arabic_text: ٤٦- فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 46.Then did the sorcerers Fall down, prostrate in adoration,

arabic_text: ٤٧- قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. Saying : “ We believe In the Lord of the Worlds,

arabic_text: ٤٨- رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. “ The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

arabic_text: ٤٩- قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. Said (Pharaoh) : “ Believe ye In him before I give You permission ? Surely he Is your leader, who has Taught you sorcery ! But soon shall ye know ! Be sure I will cut off Your hands and your feet On opposite sides, and I Will cause you all To die on the cross ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٠- قَالُوا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. They said : “ No matter ! For us, we shall but Return to our Lord !

arabic_text: ٥١- إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَن كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 51. “ Only, our desire is That our Lord will Forgive us our faults, That we may become Foremost among the Believers ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 52.By inspiration We told Moses : “ Travel by night with My servants ; for surely Ye shall be pursued.”

arabic_text: ٥٣- فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. Then Pharaoh sent heralds To (all) the Cities,

arabic_text: ٥٤- إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. (Saying) : “ These (Israelites) Are but a small band,

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. “ And they are raging Furiously against us ;

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. “ But we are a multitude Amply fore-warned.”

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُم مِّن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 57.So We expelled them From gardens, springs,

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 58. Treasures, and every kind Of honourable position ;

arabic_text: ٥٩- كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 59. Thus it was, but We made the Children Of Israel inheritors Of such things.

arabic_text: ٦٠- فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 60.So they pursued them At sunrise.

arabic_text: ٦١- فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. And when the two bodies Saw each other, the people Of Moses said : “ We are Sure to be overtaken.”

arabic_text: ٦٢- قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ◯
english_translation: 62. (Moses) said : “ By no means ! My Lord is with me ! Soon will He guide me ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٣- فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 63. Then We told Moses By inspiration : “ Strike The sea with thy rod.” So it divided, and each Separate part become Like the huge, firm mass Of a mountain.

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 64. And We made the other Party approach thither.

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 65. We delivered Moses and all Who were with him ;

arabic_text: ٦٦- ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 66. But We drowned the others.

arabic_text: ٦٧- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 67. Verily in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 68. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ◯
english_translation: 69.And rehearse to them (Something of) Abraham’s story.

arabic_text: ٧٠- إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. Behold, he said To his father and his people : “ What worship ye ? ”

arabic_text: ٧١- قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 71. They said : “ We worship Idols, and we remain constantly In attendance on them.”

arabic_text: ٧٢- قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. He said : “ Do they listen To you when ye call (on them),

arabic_text: ٧٣- أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ◯
english_translation: 73. “ Or do you good or harm ? ”

arabic_text: ٧٤- قَالُوا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 74. They said : “ Nay, but we Found our fathers doing Thus (what we do).”

arabic_text: ٧٥- قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. He said : “ Do ye then See whom ye have been Worshipping,—

arabic_text: ٧٦- أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 76. “ Ye and your fathers before you ?—

arabic_text: ٧٧- فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. “ For they are enemies to me ; Not so the Lord and Cherisher Of the Worlds ;

arabic_text: ٧٨- الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ◯
english_translation: 78. “ Who created me, and It is He who guides me ;

arabic_text: ٧٩- وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ◯
english_translation: 79. “ Who gives me food and drink,

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ◯
english_translation: 80. “ And when I am ill, It is He who cures me ;

arabic_text: ٨١- وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ◯
english_translation: 81. “ Who will cause me to die, And then to live (again) ;

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 82. “ And who, I hope, Will forgive me my faults On the Day of Judgment…

arabic_text: ٨٣- رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 83.Omy Lord ! bestow wisdom On me, and join me With the righteous ;

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 84. “ Grant me honourable mention On the tongue of truth Among the latest (generations) ;

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 85. “ Make me one of the inheritors Of the Garden of Bliss ;

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ◯
english_translation: 86. “ Forgive my father, for that He is among those astray ;

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 87. “ And let me not be In disgrace on the Day When (men) will be raised up ;—

arabic_text: ٨٨- يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. “The Day whereon neither Wealth nor sons will avail,

arabic_text: ٨٩- إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّـهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 89. “ But only he (will prosper) That brings to God A sound heart ;

arabic_text: ٩٠- وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 90. “ To the righteous, the Garden Will be brought near,

arabic_text: ٩١- وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ◯
english_translation: 91. “ And to those straying in Evil, The Fire will be placed In full view ;

arabic_text: ٩٢- وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 92. “ And it shall be said To them : ‘ Where are The (gods) ye worshipped—

arabic_text: ٩٣- مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 93. “ ‘ Besides God ? Can they Help you or help themselves ? ’

arabic_text: ٩٤- فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ◯
english_translation: 94. “ Then they will be thrown Headlong into the (Fire),— They and those straying In Evil,

arabic_text: ٩٥- وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 95. “ And the whole hosts Of Iblīs together.

arabic_text: ٩٦- قَالُوا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. “ They will say there In their mutual bickerings :

arabic_text: ٩٧- تَاللَّـهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 97. “ ‘ By God, we were truly In an error manifest,

arabic_text: ٩٨- إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 98. “ ‘ When we held you as equals With the Lord of the Worlds ;

arabic_text: ٩٩- وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 99. “ ‘ And our seducers were Only those who were Steeped in guilt.

arabic_text: ١٠٠- فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 100. “ ‘ Now, then, we have none To intercede (for us),

arabic_text: ١٠١- وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 101. “ ‘ Nor a single friend To feel (for us).

arabic_text: ١٠٢- فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 102. “ ‘ Now if we only had A chance of return, We shall truly be Of those who believe ! ’ ”

arabic_text: ١٠٣-إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 103.Verily in this is a Sign But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٠٤- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 104. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٠٥- كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 105.The people of Noah rejected The apostles.

arabic_text: ١٠٦- إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 106. Behold, their brother Noah Said to them : “ Will ye not Fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٠٧- إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 107. “ I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust :

arabic_text: ١٠٨- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 108. “ So fear God, and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٠٩- وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 109. “ No reward do I ask Of you for it : my reward Is only from the Lord Of the Worlds :

arabic_text: ١١٠- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 110. “ So fear God, and obey me.”

arabic_text: ١١١- قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 111. They said : “ Shall we Believe in thee when it is The meanest that follow thee ? ”

arabic_text: ١١٢- قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 112. He said : “ And what Do I know as to What they do ?

arabic_text: ١١٣- إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 113. “ Their account is only With my Lord, if ye Could (but) understand.

arabic_text: ١١٤- وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 114. “ I am not one to drive away Those who believe.

arabic_text: ١١٥- إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 115. “ I am sent only To warn plainly in public.”

arabic_text: ١١٦- قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا نُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ◯
english_translation: 116. They said : “ If thou Desist not, O Noah ! Thou shalt be stoned (to death).”

arabic_text: ١١٧- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ◯
english_translation: 117. He said : “ O my Lord ! Truly my people have Rejected me.

arabic_text: ١١٨- فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 118. “ Judge thou, then, between me And them openly, and deliver Me and those of the Believers Who are with me.”

arabic_text: ١١٩- فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ◯
english_translation: 119. So We delivered him And those with him, In the Ark filled (With all creatures).

arabic_text: ١٢٠- ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ◯
english_translation: 120. Thereafter We drowned those Who remained behind.

arabic_text: ١٢١- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 121. Verily in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٢٢- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 122. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٢٣-كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 123.The ‘Ād (people) rejected The apostles.

arabic_text: ١٢٤- إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 124. Behold, their brother Hūd Said to them : “ Will ye not Fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٢٥- إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 125. “ I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust :

arabic_text: ١٢٦- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 126. “ So fear God and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٢٧- وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 127. “ No reward do I ask Of you for it : my reward Is only from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١٢٨- أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 128. “ Do ye build a landmark On every high place To amuse yourselves ?

arabic_text: ١٢٩- وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 129. “ And do ye get for yourselves Fine buildings in the hope Of living therein (for ever) ?

arabic_text: ١٣٠- وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ◯
english_translation: 130. “ And when ye exert Your strong hand, Do ye do it like men Of absolute power ?

arabic_text: ١٣١- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 131. “ Now fear God, and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٣٢- وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 132. “ Yea, fear Him Who Has bestowed on you Freely all that ye know.

arabic_text: ١٣٣- أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ◯
english_translation: 133. “ Freely has He bestowed On you cattle and sons,—

arabic_text: ١٣٤- وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 134. “ And Gardens and Springs.

arabic_text: ١٣٥- إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 135. “ Truly I fear for you The Penalty of a Great Day.”

arabic_text: ١٣٦- قَالُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ◯
english_translation: 136.They said : “ It is the same To us whether thou Admonish us or be not Among (our) admonishers !

arabic_text: ١٣٧- إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 137. “ This is no other than A customary device Of the ancients,

arabic_text: ١٣٨- وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 138. “ And we are not the ones To receive Pains and Penalties ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣٩- فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 139. So they rejected him, And We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٤٠- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 140. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٤١- كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 141.TheThamūd (people) rejected The apostles.

arabic_text: ١٤٢- إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 142. Behold, their brother Ṣāliḥ Said to them : “ Will you not Fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٤٣- إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 143. “ I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust.

arabic_text: ١٤٤- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 144. “ So fear God, and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٤٥- وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 145. “ No reward do I ask Of you for it : my reward Is only from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١٤٦- أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 146. “ Will ye be left secure, In (the enjoyment of) all That ye have here ?—

arabic_text: ١٤٧- فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 147. “ Gardens and Springs,

arabic_text: ١٤٨- وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 148. “ And corn-fields and date palms With spathes near breaking (With the weight of fruit) ?

arabic_text: ١٤٩- وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ◯
english_translation: 149. “ And ye carve house Out of (rocky) mountains With great skill.

arabic_text: ١٥٠- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 150. “ But fear God and obey me ;

arabic_text: ١٥١- وَلَا تُطِيعُوا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 151. “ And follow not the bidding Of those who are extravagant,—

arabic_text: ١٥٢- الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 152. “ Who make mischief in the land, And mend not (their ways).”

arabic_text: ١٥٣- قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 153.They said : “ Thou art only One of those bewitched !

arabic_text: ١٥٤- مَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 154. “ Thou art no more than A mortal like us : Then bring us a Sign, If thou tellest the truth ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥٥- قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 155. He said : “ Here is A she-camel : she has A right of watering, And ye have a right Of watering, (severally) On a day appointed.

arabic_text: ١٥٦- وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 156. “ Touch her not with harm, Lest the Penalty Of a Great Day Seize you.”

arabic_text: ١٥٧- فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 157. But they ham-strung her : Then did they become Full of regrets.

arabic_text: ١٥٨- فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 158. But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٥٩- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 159. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٦٠- كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 160.The people of Lūṭ rejected The apostles.

arabic_text: ١٦١- إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 161. Behold, their brother Lūṭ Said to them : “ Will ye not Fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٦٢- إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 162. “ I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust.

arabic_text: ١٦٣- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 163. “ So fear God and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٦٤- وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 164. “ No reward do I ask Of you for it : my reward Is only from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١٦٥- أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 165. “ Of all the creatures In the world, will ye Approach males,

arabic_text: ١٦٦- وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ◯
english_translation: 166. “ And leave those whom God Has created for you To be your mates ? Nay, ye are a people Transgressing (all limits) ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦٧- قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ◯
english_translation: 167.They said : “ If thou desist not, O Lūṭ ! thou wilt assuredly Be cast out ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦٨- قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ الْقَالِينَ◯
english_translation: 168. He said : “ I do detest Your doings.”

arabic_text: ١٦٩- رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 169. “ O my Lord ! deliver me And my family from Such things as they do ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧٠- فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 170. So We delivered him And his family,—all

arabic_text: ١٧١- إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 171. Except an old woman Who lingered behind.

arabic_text: ١٧٢- ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 172. But the rest We destroyed Utterly.

arabic_text: ١٧٣- وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 173. We rained down on them A shower (of brimstone) : And evil was the shower On those who were admonished (But heeded not) !

arabic_text: ١٧٤- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 174. Verily in this is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٧٥- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 175. And verily thy Lord Is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٧٦- كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 176.The Companions of the Wood Rejected the apostles.

arabic_text: ١٧٧- إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 177. Behold, Shu‘aib said to them : “ Will ye not fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٧٨- إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 178. “ I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust.

arabic_text: ١٧٩- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 179. “ So fear God and obey me.

arabic_text: ١٨٠- وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 180. “ No reward do I ask Of you for it : my reward Is only from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١٨١- أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 181. “ Give just measure, And cause no loss (To others by fraud).

arabic_text: ١٨٢- وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ◯
english_translation: 182. “ And weigh with scales True and upright.

arabic_text: ١٨٣- وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 183. “ And withhold not things Justly due to men, Nor do evil in the land, Working mischief.

arabic_text: ١٨٤- وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 184. “ And fear Him Who created You and (Who created) The generations before (you) ”

arabic_text: ١٨٥- قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 185.They said : “ Thou art only One of those bewitched !

arabic_text: ١٨٦- وَمَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 186. “ Thou art no more than A mortal like us, And indeed we think Thou art a liar !

arabic_text: ١٨٧- فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 187. “ Now cause a piece Of the sky to fall on us, If thou art truthful ! ”

arabic_text: ١٨٨- قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 188. He said : “ My Lord Knows best what ye do.”

arabic_text: ١٨٩- فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 189. But they rejected him. Then the punishment Of a day of overshadowing gloom Seized them, and that was The Penalty of a Great Day.

arabic_text: ١٩٠- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 190. Verily in that is a Sign : But most of them Do not believe.

arabic_text: ١٩١- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 191. And verily thy Lord Is He, The Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٩٢- وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 192.Verily this is a Revelation From the Lord of the Worlds :

arabic_text: ١٩٣- نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ◯
english_translation: 193. With it came down The Spirit of Faith and Truth—

arabic_text: ١٩٤- عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 194. To thy heart and mind, That thou mayest admonish

arabic_text: ١٩٥- بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ◯
