english_translation: 195. In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.

arabic_text: ١٩٦- وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 196. Without doubt it is (announced) In the mystic Books Of former peoples.

arabic_text: ١٩٧- أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 197. Is it not a Sign To them that the Learned Of the Children of Israel Knew it (as true) ?

arabic_text: ١٩٨- وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 198. Had We revealed it To any of the non-Arabs,

arabic_text: ١٩٩- فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 199. And had he recited it To them, they would not Have believed in it.

arabic_text: ٢٠٠- كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 200.Thus have We caused it To enter the hearts Of the Sinners.

arabic_text: ٢٠١- لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ◯
english_translation: 201. They will not believe In it until they see The grievous Penalty ;

arabic_text: ٢٠٢- فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 202. But the (Penalty) will come To them of a sudden, While they perceive it not ;

arabic_text: ٢٠٣- فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 203. Then they will say : “ Shall we be respited ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٠٤- أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 204.Do they then ask For Our Penalty to be Hastened on ?

arabic_text: ٢٠٥- أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 205. Seest thou ? If We do Let them enjoy (this life) For a few years,

arabic_text: ٢٠٦- ثُمَّ جَاءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 206. Yet there comes to them At length the (Punishment) Which they were promised !

arabic_text: ٢٠٧- مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 207. It will profit them not That they enjoyed (this life) !

arabic_text: ٢٠٨- وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 208. Never did We destroy A population, but had Its warners—

arabic_text: ٢٠٩- ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 209. By way of reminder ; And We never are unjust.

arabic_text: ٢١٠- وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ◯
english_translation: 210.No evil ones have brought Down this (Revelation) :

arabic_text: ٢١١- وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ◯
english_translation: 211. It would neither suit them Nor would they be able (To produce it).

arabic_text: ٢١٢- إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 212. Indeed they have been removed Far from even (a chance of) Hearing it.

arabic_text: ٢١٣- فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 213. So call not on any Other god with God, Or thou wilt be among Those under the Penalty.

arabic_text: ٢١٤- وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ◯
english_translation: 214. And admonish thy nearest Kinsmen,

arabic_text: ٢١٥- وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 215. And lower thy wing To the Believers who Follow thee.

arabic_text: ٢١٦- فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 216. Then if they disobey thee, Say : “ I am free (of responsibility) For what ye do ! ”

arabic_text: ٢١٧- وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 217. And put thy trust On the Exalted in Might, The Merciful,—

arabic_text: ٢١٨- الَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ◯
english_translation: 218. Who seeth thee standing Forth (in prayer),

arabic_text: ٢١٩- وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 219. And thy movements among Those who prostrate themselves.

arabic_text: ٢٢٠- إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 220. For it is He Who heareth and knoweth All things.

arabic_text: ٢٢١- هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ◯
english_translation: 221.Shall I inform you, (O people !), on whom it is That the evil ones descend ?

arabic_text: ٢٢٢- تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 222. They descend on every Lying, wicked person,

arabic_text: ٢٢٣- يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 223. (Into whose ears) they pour Hearsay vanities, and most Of them are liars.

arabic_text: ٢٢٤- وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ◯
english_translation: 224. And the Poets,— It is those straying in Evil, Who follow them :

arabic_text: ٢٢٥- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ◯
english_translation: 225. Seest thou not that they Wander distracted in every Valley ?—

arabic_text: ٢٢٦- وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 226. And that they say What they practice not ?—

arabic_text: ٢٢٧- إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّـهَ كَثِيرًا وَانتَصَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 227. Except those who believe, Work righteousness, engage much In the remembrance of God, And defend themselves only after They are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust Assailants know what vicissitudes Their affairs will take !

arabic_text: ١- طس تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 1.Tā.Sīn. These are verses Of the Qur-ān,—a Book That makes (things) clear ;

arabic_text: ٢- هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 2. A Guide ; and Glad Tidings For the Believers,—

arabic_text: ٣- الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. Those who establish regular prayers And give in regular charity, And also have (full) assurance Of the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. As to those who believe not In the Hereafter, We have Made their deeds pleasing In their eyes ; and so they Wander about in distraction.

arabic_text: ٥- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Such are they for whom A grievous Penalty is (waiting) : And in the Hereafter theirs Will be the greatest loss.

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ لَدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 6. As to thee, the Qur-ān Is bestowed upon thee From the presence of One Who is Wise and All-Knowing.

arabic_text: ٧- إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِ إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا سَآتِيكُمْ مِنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 7.Behold ! Moses said To his family : “ I perceive A fire ; soon will I bring you From there some information, Or I will bring you A burning brand to light Our fuel, that ye may Warm yourselves.”

arabic_text: ٨- فَلَمَّا جَاءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنْ بُورِكَ مَنْ فِي النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. But when he came To the (Fire), a voice Was heard : “ Blessed are those In the Fire and those around : And Glory to God, The Lord of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ٩- يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّـهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9. “ O Moses ! Verily, I am God, the Exalted In Might, the Wise !…

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. “ Now do thou throw thy rod ! ” But when he saw it Moving (of its own accord) As if it had been a snake, He turned back in retreat, And retraced not his steps : “ O Moses ! ” (it was said), “ Fear not : truly, in My presence, Those called as apostles Have no fear,—

arabic_text: ١١- إِلَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًا بَعْدَ سُوءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11. “ But if any have done wrong And have thereafter substituted Good to take the place of evil, Truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 12. “ Now put thy hand into Thy bosom, and it will Come forth white without stain (Or harm) : (these are) among The nine Signs (thou wilt take) To Pharaoh and his people : For they are a people Rebellious in transgression.”

arabic_text: ١٣- فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 13. But when Our Signs came To them, that should have Opened their eyes, they said : “ This is sorcery manifest ! ”

arabic_text: ١٤- وَجَحَدُوا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 14. And they rejected those Signs In iniquity and arrogance, Though their souls were convinced Thereof : so see what was The end of those Who acted corruptly !

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 15.We gave (in the past) Knowledge to David and Solomon : And they both said : “ Praise be to God, Who Has favoured us above many Of His servants who believe ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦- وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 16. And Solomon was David’s heir. He said : “ O ye people ! We have been taught the speech Of Birds, and on us Has been bestowed (a little) Of all things : this is Indeed Grace manifest (from God.) ”

arabic_text: ١٧- وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. And before Solomon were marshalled His hosts,—of Jinns and men And birds, and they were all Kept in order and ranks.

arabic_text: ١٨- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. At length, when they came To a (lowly) valley of ants, One of the ants said : “ O ye ants, get into Your habitations, lest Solomon And his hosts crush you (Under foot) without knowing it.”

arabic_text: ١٩- فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 19. So he smiled, amused At her speech ; and he said : “O my Lord ! so order me That I may be grateful For Thy favours, which Thou Hast bestowed on me and On my parents, and that I may work the righteousness That will please Thee : And admit me, by Thy Grace, To the ranks of Thy Righteous Servants.”

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَائِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 20.And he took a muster Of the Birds ; and he said : “ Why is it I see not The Hoopoe ? Or is he Among the absentees ?

arabic_text: ٢١- لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَذْبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 21. “ I will certainly punish him With a severe penalty, Or execute him, unless he Bring me a clear reason (For absence).”

arabic_text: ٢٢- فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطْتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ◯
english_translation: 22.But the Hoopoe tarried not Far : he (came up and) said : “ I have compassed (territory) Which thou hast not compassed, And I have come to thee From Sabā with tidings true.

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنِّي وَجَدْتُ امْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 23. “ I found (there) a woman Ruling over them and provided With every requisite ; and she Has a magnificent throne.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَجَدْتُهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. “ I found her and her people Worshipping the sun besides God : Satan has made their deeds Seem pleasing in their eyes, And has kept them away From the Path,—so They receive no guidance,—

arabic_text: ٢٥- أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. “ (Kept them away from the Path), That they should not worship God, Who brings to light What is hidden in the heavens And the earth, and knows What ye hide and what Ye reveal.

arabic_text: ٢٦- اللَّـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِالسجدة◯
english_translation: 26. “ God !—there is no god But He !—Lord of the Throne Supreme ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. (Solomon) said : “ Soon shall we See whether thou hast told The truth or lied !

arabic_text: ٢٨- اذْهَبْ بِكِتَابِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. “ Go thou, with this letter Of mine, and deliver it To them : then draw back From them, and (wait to) see What answer they return ”…

arabic_text: ٢٩- قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ إِنِّي أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 29. (The Queen) said : “ Ye chiefs ! Here is—delivered to me— A letter worthy of respect.

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّهُ مِنْ سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 30. “ It is from Solomon, and is (As follows) : ‘ In the name Of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful :

arabic_text: ٣١- أَلَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. “ ‘ Be ye not arrogant Against me, but come To me in submission (To the true Religion).’ ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ◯
english_translation: 32.She said : “ Ye chiefs ! Advise me in (this) My affair : no affair Have I decided Except in your presence.”

arabic_text: ٣٣- قَالُوا نَحْنُ أُولُو قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُو بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَالْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. They said : “ We are endued With strength, and given To vehement war : But the command is With thee ; so consider What thou wilt command.”

arabic_text: ٣٤- قَالَتْ إِنَّ الْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوا أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَا أَذِلَّةً وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. She said : “ Kings, when they Enter a country, despoil it, And make the noblest Of its people its meanest : Thus do they behave.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. “ But I am going to send Him a present, and (wait) To see with what (answer) Return (my) ambassadors.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَا آتَانِيَ اللَّـهُ خَيْرٌ مِمَّا آتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ◯
english_translation: 36.Now when (the embassy) came To Solomon, he said : “ Will ye give me abundance In wealth ? But that which God has given me is better Than that which He has Given you ! Nay it is ye Who rejoice in your gift !

arabic_text: ٣٧- ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُودٍ لَا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِنْهَا أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. “ Go back to them, and be sure We shall come to them With such hosts as they Will never be able to meet : We shall expel them From there in disgrace, And they will feel Humbled (indeed).”

arabic_text: ٣٨- قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 38. He said (to his own men) : “ Ye Chiefs ! which of you Can bring me her throne Before they come to me In submission ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٩- قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌ مِنَ الْجِنِّ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مِنْ مَقَامِكَ وَإِنِّي عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 39. Said an ‘Ifrīt, of the Jinns : “ I will bring it to thee Before thou rise from thy Council : indeed I have Full strength for the purpose, And may be trusted.”

arabic_text: ٤٠- قَالَ الَّذِي عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ أَنَا آتِيكَ بِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهُ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّي غَنِيٌّ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 40. Said one who had knowledge Of the Book : “ I will Bring it to thee within The twinkling of an eye ! ” Then when (Solomon) saw it Placed firmly before him, He said : “ This is By the grace of my Lord !— To test me whether I am Grateful or ungrateful ! And if any is grateful, Truly his gratitude is (a gain) For his own soul ; but if Any is ungrateful, truly My Lord is Free of all Needs, Supreme in Honour ! ”

arabic_text: ٤١- قَالَ نَكِّرُوا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِي أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. He said : “ Transform her throne Out of all recognition by her : Let us see whether she Is guided (to the truth) Or is one of those who Receive no guidance.”

arabic_text: ٤٢- فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأُوتِينَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 42.So when she arrived, She was asked, “ Is this Thy throne ? ” She said, “ It was just like this ; And knowledge was bestowed On us in advance of this, And we have submitted To God (in Islām).”

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَعْبُدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 43. And he diverted her From the worship of others Besides God : for she was (Sprung) of a people That had no faith.

arabic_text: ٤٤- قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَا قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِنْ قَوَارِيرَ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. She was asked to enter That lofty Palace : but When she saw it, she Thought it was a lake Of water, and she (tucked up Her skirts), uncovering her legs. He said : “ This is But a palace paved Smooth with slabs of glass.” She said : “ O my Lord ! I have indeed wronged My soul : I do (now) Submit (in Islām), with Solomon, To the Lord of the Worlds.”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَالِحًا أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 45.We sent (aforetime), To theThamūd, their brother Ṣāliḥ, saying, “ Serve God ” : But behold, they became Two factions quarrelling With each other.

arabic_text: ٤٦- قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّـهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. He said : “ O my people ! Why ask ye to hasten on The evil in preference to the good ? If only ye ask God for forgiveness, Ye may hope to receive mercy.”

arabic_text: ٤٧- قَالُوا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَعَكَ قَالَ طَائِرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّـهِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. They said : “ Ill omen Do we augur from thee And those that are with thee ”. He said : “ Your ill omen Is with God ; yea, ye are A people under trial.”

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَكَانَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. There were in the City Nine men of a family, Who made mischief in the land, And would not reform.

arabic_text: ٤٩- قَالُوا تَقَاسَمُوا بِاللَّـهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. They said : “ Swear A mutual oath by God That we shall make A secret night attack On him and his people, And that we shall then Say to his heir (when he Seeks vengeance) : ‘ We were not Present at the slaughter Of his people, and we are Positively telling the truth ’.”

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. They plotted and planned, But We too planned, Even while they perceived it not.

arabic_text: ٥١- فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَاهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 51. Then see what was the end Of their plot !—this, That We destroyed them And their people, all (of them).

arabic_text: ٥٢- فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً بِمَا ظَلَمُوا إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. Now such were their houses,— In utter ruin,—because They practiced wrong-doing. Verily in this is a Sign For people of knowledge.

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَأَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. And We saved those Who believed and practiced Righteousness.

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. (We also sent) Lūṭ (As an apostle) : behold, He said to his people, “ Do ye do what is shameful Though ye see (its iniquity) ?

arabic_text: ٥٥- أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِنْ دُونِ النِّسَاءِ بَلْ أَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. “ Would ye really approach men In your lusts rather than Women ? Nay, ye are A people (grossly) ignorant ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٦- فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ قَالُوا أَخْرِجُوا آلَ لُوطٍ مِنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. But his people gave No other answer but this : They said, “ Drive out The followers of Lūṭ from Your city : these are Indeed men who want To be clean and pure ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَأَنْجَيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَاهَا مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 57. But We saved him And his family, except His wife : her We destined To be of those Who lagged behind.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَطَرًا فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. And We rained down on them A shower (of brimstone) : And evil was the shower On those who were admonished (But heeded not) !

arabic_text: ٥٩- قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَىٰ آللَّـهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 59.Say : Praise be to God, And Peace on His servants Whom He has chosen (For His Message). (Who) Is better ?—God or The false gods they associate (With Him) ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَنْ تُنْبِتُوا شَجَرَهَا أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّـهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. Or, who has created The heavens and the earth, And who sends you down Rain from the sky ? Yea, with it We cause To grow well-planted orchards Full of beauty and delight : It is not in your power To cause the growth Of the trees in them. (Can there be Another) god besides God ? Nay, they are a people Who swerve from justice.

arabic_text: ٦١- أَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّـهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. Or, who has made the earth Firm to live in ; made Rivers in its midst ; set Thereon mountains immovable ; And made a separating bar Between the two bodies Of flowing water ? (Can there be another) god Besides God ? Nay, most Of them know not.

arabic_text: ٦٢- أَمَّنْ يُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ الْأَرْضِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّـهِ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. Or, who listens to the (soul) Distressed when it calls On Him, and who relieves Its suffering, and makes you (Mankind) inheritors of the earth ? (Can there be another) god Besides God ? Little it is That ye heed !

arabic_text: ٦٣- أَمَّنْ يَهْدِيكُمْ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّـهِ تَعَالَى اللَّـهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. Or, who guides you Through the depths of darkness On land and sea, and who Sends the winds as heralds Of glad tidings, going before His Mercy ? (Can there be Another) god besides God ?— High is God above what They associate with Him !

arabic_text: ٦٤- أَمَّنْ يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَمَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَإِلَـٰهٌ مَعَ اللَّـهِ قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 64. Or, who originates Creation, Then repeats it, And who gives you sustenance From heaven and earth ? (Can there be another) god Besides God ? Say, “ Bring forth Your argument, if ye Are telling the truth ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- قُلْ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. Say : None in the heavens Or on earth, except God, Knows what is hidden : Nor can they perceive When they shall be raised Up (for Judgment).

arabic_text: ٦٦- بَلِ ادَّارَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْهَا بَلْ هُمْ مِنْهَا عَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. Still less can their knowledge Comprehend the Hereafter : nay They are in doubt and uncertainty Thereanent ; nay, they are blind Thereunto !

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَآبَاؤُنَا أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ◯
english_translation: 67.The Unbelievers say : “ What ! When we become dust,— We and our fathers,—shall we Really be raised (from the dead) ?

arabic_text: ٦٨- لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَـٰذَا نَحْنُ وَآبَاؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 68. “ It is true we were promised This,—we and our fathers Before (us) : these are nothing But tales of the ancients.”

arabic_text: ٦٩- قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 69. Say : “ Go ye through the earth And see what has been The end of those guilty (Of sin).”

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. But grieve not over them, Nor distress thyself Because of their plots.

arabic_text: ٧١- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 71.They also say : “ When will This promise (come to pass) ? (Say) if ye are truthful.”

arabic_text: ٧٢- قُلْ عَسَىٰ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِي تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. Say : “ It may be that Some of the events which Ye wish to hasten on May be (close) in your pursuit ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. But verily thy Lord is Full of grace to mankind : Yet most of them are ungrateful.

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 74. And verily thy Lord knoweth All that their hearts do hide, As well as all that They reveal.

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَمَا مِنْ غَائِبَةٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 75. Nor is there aught Of the Unseen, in heaven Or earth, but is (recorded) In a clear record.

arabic_text: ٧٦- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَكْثَرَ الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 76.Verily this Qur-ān doth explain To the Children of Israel Most of the matters In which they disagree.

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَإِنَّهُ لَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. And it certainly is A Guide and a Mercy To those who believe.

arabic_text: ٧٨- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 78. Verily thy Lord will decide Between them by His Decree : And He is Exalted in Might, All-Knowing.

arabic_text: ٧٩- فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّـهِ إِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 79. So put thy trust in God : For thou art on (the Path Of) manifest Truth.

arabic_text: ٨٠- إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 80. Truly thou canst not cause The Dead to listen, nor Canst thou cause the Deaf To hear the call, (Especially) when they Turn back in retreat.

arabic_text: ٨١- وَمَا أَنْتَ بِهَادِي الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلَالَتِهِمْ إِنْ تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 81. Nor canst thou be a guide To the Blind, (to prevent them) From straying : only those Wilt thou get to listen Who believe in Our Signs, And they will bow in Islam.

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَإِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَابَّةً مِنَ الْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. And when the Word is Fulfilled against them (the unjust), We shall produce from the earth A Beast to (face) them : He will speak to them, For that mankind did not Believe with assurance In Our Signs.

arabic_text: ٨٣- وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 83.One Day We shall gather Together from every people A troop of those who reject Our Signs, and they shall Be kept in ranks,—

arabic_text: ٨٤- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوا قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِآيَاتِي وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 84. Until, when they come (Before the Judgment-seat), (God) will say : “ Did ye Reject My Signs, though ye Comprehended them not In knowledge, or what Was it ye did ? ”

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. And the Word will be Fulfilled against them, because Of their wrong-doing, and they Will be unable to speak (In plea).

arabic_text: ٨٦- أَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 86. See they not that We Have made the Night For them to rest in And the Day to give Them light ? Verily in this Are Signs for any people That believe !

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَاخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 87. And the Day that the Trumpet Will be sounded—then will be Smitten with terror those Who are in the heavens, And those who are on earth, Except such as God will please (To exempt) : and all shall come To His (Presence) as beings Conscious of their lowliness.

arabic_text: ٨٨- وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ صُنْعَ اللَّـهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. Thou seest the mountains And thinkest them firmly fixed : But they shall pass away As the clouds pass away : (Such is) the artistry of God, Who disposes of all things In perfect order : for He is Wellacquainted with all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٨٩- مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَهُمْ مِنْ فَزَعٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ آمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 89. If any do good, good will (Accrue) to them therefrom ; And they will be secure From terror that Day.

arabic_text: ٩٠- وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 90. And if any do evil, Their faces will be thrown Headlong into the Fire : “ Do ye receive a reward Other than that which ye Have earned by your deeds ? ”

arabic_text: ٩١- إِنَّمَا أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَـٰذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 91.For me, I have been Commanded to serve the Lord Of this City, Him Who has Sanctified it and to Whom (Belong) all things : And I am commanded To be of those who bow In Islam to God’s Will,—

arabic_text: ٩٢- وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَ الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 92. And to rehearse the Qur-ān : And if any accept guidance, They do it for the good Of their own souls, And if any stray, say : “ I am only a Warner ”.

arabic_text: ٩٣- وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 93. And say : “ Praise be to God, Who will soon show you His Signs, so that ye Shall know them ” ; and thy Lord Is not unmindful Of all that ye do.

arabic_text: ١- طسم◯
english_translation: 1.Tā.Sīn.Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 2. These are Verses of the Book That makes (things) clear.

arabic_text: ٣- نَتْلُو عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. We rehearse to thee some Of the story of Moses And Pharaoh in Truth, For people who believe.

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَائِفَةً مِنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيِي نِسَاءَهُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 4.Truly Pharaoh elated himself In the land and broke up Its people into sections, Depressing a small group Among them : their sons he slew, But he kept alive their females : For he was indeed A maker of mischief.

arabic_text: ٥- وَنُرِيدُ أَنْ نَمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةً وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوَارِثِينَ◯
english_translation: 5. And We wished to be Gracious to those who were Being depressed in the land, To make them leaders (in faith) And make them heirs,

arabic_text: ٦- وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَحْذَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. To establish a firm place For them in the land, And to show Pharaoh, Hāmān, And their hosts, at their hands, The very things against which They were taking precautions.

arabic_text: ٧- وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحْزَنِي إِنَّا رَادُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 7.So We sent this inspiration To the mother of Moses : “ Suckle (thy child), but when Thou hast fears about him, Cast him into the river, But fear not nor grieve : For We shall restore him To thee, and We shall make Him one of Our apostles.”

arabic_text: ٨- فَالْتَقَطَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَحَزَنًا إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا خَاطِئِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. Then the people of Pharaoh Picked him up (from the river) : (It was intended) that (Moses) Should be to them an adversary And a cause of sorrow : For Pharaoh and Hāmān And (all) their hosts were Men of sin.

arabic_text: ٩- وَقَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍ لِي وَلَكَ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰ أَنْ يَنْفَعَنَا أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ وَلَدًا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. The wife of Pharaoh said : “ (Here is) a joy of the eye, For me and for thee : Slay him not. It may be That he will be of use To us, or we may adopt Him as a son.” And they Perceived not (what they Were doing) !

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا إِنْ كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَنْ رَبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. But there came to be A void in the heart Of the mother of Moses : She was going almost to Disclose his (case), had We Not strengthened her heart (With faith), so that she Might remain a (firm) believer.

arabic_text: ١١- وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِ قُصِّيهِ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِ عَنْ جُنُبٍ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. And she said to the sister Of (Moses), “ Follow him ”. So she (the sister) watched him In the character of a stranger. And they knew not.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ يَكْفُلُونَهُ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ نَاصِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. And We ordained that he Refused suck at first, until (His sister came up And) said : “ Shall I Point out to you the people Of a house that will nourish And bring him up for you And be sincerely attached To him ? ”…

arabic_text: ١٣- فَرَدَدْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ أُمِّهِ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. Thus did We restore him To his mother, that her eye Might be comforted, that she Might not grieve, and that She might know that the promise Of God is true : but Most of them do not understand.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَاسْتَوَىٰ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 14.When he reached full age, And was firmly established (In life), We bestowed on him Wisdom and knowledge : for thus Do We reward those Who do good.

arabic_text: ١٥- وَدَخَلَ الْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَـٰذَا مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ وَهَـٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ فَاسْتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِي مِنْ شِيعَتِهِ عَلَى الَّذِي مِنْ عَدُوِّهِ فَوَكَزَهُ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ مُضِلٌّ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 15. And he entered the City At a time when its people Were not watching : and he Found there two men fighting,— One of his own religion, And the other, of his foes. Now the man of his own Religion appealed to him Against his foe, and Moses Struck him with his fist And made an end of him. He said : “ This is a work Of Evil (Satan) : for he is An enemy that manifestly Misleads ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 16. He prayed : “ O my Lord ! I have indeed wronged my soul ! Do Thou then forgive me ! ” So (God) forgave him : for He Is the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٧- قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِلْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. He said : “ O my Lord ! For that Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace on me, never Shall I be a help To those who sin ! ”

arabic_text: ١٨- فَأَصْبَحَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي اسْتَنْصَرَهُ بِالْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ قَالَ لَهُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِيٌّ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 18. So he saw the morning In the City, looking about, In a state of fear, when Behold, the man who had, The day before, sought his help Called aloud for his help (Again). Moses said to him : “ Thou art truly, it is clear, A quarrelsome fellow ! ”

arabic_text: ١٩- فَلَمَّا أَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْطِشَ بِالَّذِي هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَهُمَا قَالَ يَا مُوسَىٰ أَتُرِيدُ أَنْ تَقْتُلَنِي كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا بِالْأَمْسِ إِنْ تُرِيدُ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ جَبَّارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 19. Then, when he decided to lay Hold of the man who was An enemy to both of them, That man said : “ O Moses ! Is it thy intention to slay me As thou slewest a man Yesterday ? Thy intention is None other than to become A powerful violent man In the land, and not to be One who sets things right ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّ الْمَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقْتُلُوكَ فَاخْرُجْ إِنِّي لَكَ مِنَ النَّاصِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. And there came a man, Running, from the furthest end Of the City. He said : “ O Moses ! the Chiefs Are taking counsel together About thee, to slay thee : So get thee away, for I Do give thee sincere advice.”

arabic_text: ٢١- فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَائِفًا يَتَرَقَّبُ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 21. He therefore got away therefrom, Looking about, in a state Of fear. He prayed : “ O my Lord ! save me From people given to wrong-doing.”

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَاءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَنْ يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ◯
english_translation: 22.Then, when he turned his face Towards (the land of) Madyan, He said : “ I do hope That my Lord will show me The smooth and straight Path.”

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَاءَ مَدْيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّةً مِنَ النَّاسِ يَسْقُونَ وَوَجَدَ مِنْ دُونِهِمُ امْرَأَتَيْنِ تَذُودَانِ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِي حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ الرِّعَاءُ وَأَبُونَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 23. And when he arrived at The watering (place) in Madyan, He found there a group Of men watering (their flocks), And besides them he found Two women who were keeping Back (their flocks). He said : “ What is the matter with you ? ” They said : “ We cannot water (Our flocks) until the shepherds Take back (their flocks) : And our father is A very old man.”

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَسَقَىٰ لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلَّىٰ إِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 24. So he watered (their flocks) For them ; then he turned back To the shade, and said : “ O my Lord ! Truly am I In (desperate) need Of any good That thou dost send me ! ”…

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 25.Afterwards one of the (damsels) Came (back) to him, walking Bashfully. She said : “ My father Invites thee that he may Reward thee for having watered (Our flocks) for us.” So when He came to him and narrated The story, he said : “ Fear thou not : (well) hast thou Escaped from unjust people.”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَالَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا يَا أَبَتِ اسْتَأْجِرْهُ إِنَّ خَيْرَ مَنِ اسْتَأْجَرْتَ الْقَوِيُّ الْأَمِينُ◯
english_translation: 26. Said one of the (damsels) : “ O my (dear) father ! engage Him on wages : truly the best Of men for thee to employ is The (man) who is strong and trusty ”…

arabic_text: ٢٧- قَالَ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنْكِحَكَ إِحْدَى ابْنَتَيَّ هَاتَيْنِ عَلَىٰ أَنْ تَأْجُرَنِي ثَمَانِيَ حِجَجٍ فَإِنْ أَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ سَتَجِدُنِي إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. He said : “ I intended to wed One of these my daughters To thee, on condition that Thou serve me for eight years ; But if thou complete ten years, It will be (grace) from thee. But I intend not to place Thee under a difficulty : Thou wilt find me, Indeed, if God wills, One of the righteous.”

arabic_text: ٢٨- قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ أَيَّمَا الْأَجَلَيْنِ قَضَيْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَانَ عَلَيَّ وَاللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ مَا نَقُولُ وَكِيلٌ◯
english_translation: 28. He said : “ Be that (the agreement) Between me and thee : Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, let there be No ill-will to me. Be God a witness To what we ”

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِ آنَسَ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا لَعَلِّي آتِيكُمْ مِنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 29.Now when Moses had fulfilled The term, and was travelling With his family, he perceived A fire in the direction Of Mount Ṭūr. He said To his family : “ Tarry ye ; I perceive a fire ; I hope To bring you from there Some information, or a burning Firebrand, that ye may Warm yourselves.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ مِنْ شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْأَيْمَنِ فِي الْبُقْعَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ أَنْ يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنِّي أَنَا اللَّـهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 30. But when he came To the (Fire), a voice Was heard from the right bank Of the valley, from a tree In hallowed ground : “ O Moses ! Verily I am God, the Lord Of the Worlds…

arabic_text: ٣١- وَأَنْ أَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يَا مُوسَىٰ أَقْبِلْ وَلَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ مِنَ الْآمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. “ Now do thou throw thy rod ! ” But when he saw it Moving (of its own accord) As if it had been a snake, He turned back in retreat, And retraced not his steps : “ O Moses ! ” (it was said), “ Draw near, and fear not : For thou art of those Who are secure.

arabic_text: ٣٢- اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ وَاضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ فَذَانِكَ بُرْهَانَانِ مِنْ رَبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. “ Move thy hand into Thy bosom, and it will Come forth white without stain (Or harm), and draw thy hand Close to thy side (To guard) against fear. Those are the two credentials From thy Lord to Pharaoh And his Chiefs : for truly They are a people Rebellious and wicked.”

arabic_text: ٣٣- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَقْتُلُونِ◯
english_translation: 33. He said : “ O my Lord ! I have slain a man Among them, and I fear Lest they slay me.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَأَخِي هَارُونُ هُوَ أَفْصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانًا فَأَرْسِلْهُ مَعِيَ رِدْءًا يُصَدِّقُنِي إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يُكَذِّبُونِ◯
english_translation: 34. “ And my brother Aaron— He is more eloquent in speech Than I : so send him With me as a helper, To confirm (and strengthen) me : For I fear that they may Accuse me of falsehood.”

arabic_text: ٣٥- قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطَانًا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيْكُمَا بِآيَاتِنَا أَنْتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغَالِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. He said : “ We will certainly Strengthen thy arm through Thy brother, and invest you both With authority, so they Shall not be able to Touch you : with Our Signs Shall ye triumph,—you two As well as those Who follow you.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالُوا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُفْتَرًى وَمَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 36.When Moses came to them With Our Clear Signs, they said : “ This is nothing but sorcery Faked up : never did we Hear the like among our fathers Of old ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ جَاءَ بِالْهُدَىٰ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ وَمَنْ تَكُونُ لَهُ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. Moses said : “ My Lord Knows best who it is That comes with guidance From Him and whose End Will be best in the Hereafter : Certain it is that The wrong-doers will not prosper.”

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرِي فَأَوْقِدْ لِي يَا هَامَانُ عَلَى الطِّينِ فَاجْعَلْ لِي صَرْحًا لَعَلِّي أَطَّلِعُ إِلَىٰ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 38. Pharaoh said : “ O Chiefs ! No god do I know for you But myself : therefore, O Hāmān ! light me a (kiln To bake bricks) out of clay, And build me a lofty Palace, that I may mount up To the god of Moses : But as far as I am concerned, I think (Moses) is a liar ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَاسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُودُهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا يُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. And he was arrogant and insolent In the land, beyond reason,— He and his hosts : they thought That they would not have To return to Us !

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. So We seized him And his hosts, and We Flung them into the sea : Now behold what was the End Of those who did wrong !

arabic_text: ٤١- وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَدْعُونَ إِلَى النَّارِ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا يُنْصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. And We made them (but) Leaders inviting to the Fire ; And on the Day of Judgment No help shall they find.

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَأَتْبَعْنَاهُمْ فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةً وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ هُمْ مِنَ الْمَقْبُوحِينَ◯
english_translation: 42. In this world We made A Curse to follow them : And on the Day of Judgment They will be among The loathed (and despised).

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُونَ الْأُولَىٰ بَصَائِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 43.We did reveal to Moses The Book after We had Destroyed the earlier generations, (To give) Insight to men, And Guidance and Mercy, That they might receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِيِّ إِذْ قَضَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَمْرَ وَمَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. Thou wast not on the Western Side when We decreed The Commission to Moses, Nor wast thou a witness (Of those events).

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَلَـٰكِنَّا أَنْشَأْنَا قُرُونًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ وَمَا كُنْتَ ثَاوِيًا فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ تَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. But We raised up (new) Generations, and long were the ages That passed over them ; But thou wast not a dweller Among the people of Madyan, Rehearsing Our Signs to them ; But it is We Who send Apostles (with inspiration).

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَمَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّورِ إِذْ نَادَيْنَا وَلَـٰكِنْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. Nor wast thou at the side Of (the Mountain of) Ṭūr When We called (to Moses). Yet (art thou sent) As a Mercy from thy Lord, To give warning to a people To whom no warner had come Before thee : in order that They may receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَلَوْلَا أَنْ تُصِيبَهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ وَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. If (We had) not (sent thee To the Quraish),—in case A calamity should seize them For (the deeds) that their hands Have sent forth, they might say : “ Our Lord ! why didst Thou not Send us an apostle ? We Should then have followed Thy Signs and been amongst Those who believe ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوا لَوْلَا أُوتِيَ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفُرُوا بِمَا أُوتِيَ مُوسَىٰ مِنْ قَبْلُ قَالُوا سِحْرَانِ تَظَاهَرَا وَقَالُوا إِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 48.But (now), when the Truth Has come to them from Ourselves, They say, “ Why are not (Signs) sent to him, like Those which were sent to Moses ? ” Do they not then reject (The Signs) which were formerly Sent to Moses ? They say : “ Two kinds of sorcery, Each assisting the other ! ” And they say : “ For us, We reject all (such things) ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٩- قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِكِتَابٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّـهِ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْهُمَا أَتَّبِعْهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. Say : “ Then bring ye A Book from God, Which is a better Guide Than either of them, That I may follow it ! (Do), if ye are truthful ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَكَ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُونَ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ بِغَيْرِ هُدًى مِنَ اللَّـهِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 50. But if they hearken not To thee, know that they Only follow their own lusts : And who is more astray Than one who follows his own Lusts, devoid of guidance From God ? For God guides not People given to wrong-doing.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 51.Now have We caused The Word to reach them Themselves, in order that They may receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٥٢- الَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ هُمْ بِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. Those to whom We sent The Book before this,—they Do believe in this (Revelation) ;

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَإِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِهِ إِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. And when it is recited To them, they say : “ We Believe therein, for it is The Truth from our Lord : Indeed we have been Muslims (Bowing to God’s Will) From before this.”

arabic_text: ٥٤- أُولَـٰئِكَ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ مَرَّتَيْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيَدْرَءُونَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. Twice will they be given Their reward, for that they Have persevered, that they avert Evil with Good, and that They spend (in charity) out of What We have given them.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَإِذَا سَمِعُوا اللَّغْوَ أَعْرَضُوا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ لَا نَبْتَغِي الْجَاهِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. And when they hear vain talk, They turn away therefrom And say : “ To us our deeds, And to you yours ; Peace be to you : we Seek not the ignorant.”

arabic_text: ٥٦- إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ◯
english_translation: 56. It is true thou wilt not Be able to guide every one Whom thou lovest ; but God Guides those whom He will. And He knows best those Who receive guidance.

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَقَالُوا إِنْ نَتَّبِعِ الْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَا أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَهُمْ حَرَمًا آمِنًا يُجْبَىٰ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَاتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رِزْقًا مِنْ لَدُنَّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.They say : “ If we were To follow the guidance with thee, We should be snatched away From our land.” Have We not Established for them a secure Sanctuary, to which are brought As tribute fruits of all kinds,— A provision from Ourselves ? But most of them understand not.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ بَطِرَتْ مَعِيشَتَهَا فَتِلْكَ مَسَاكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَنْ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا وَكُنَّا نَحْنُ الْوَارِثِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. And how many populations We destroyed, which exulted In their life (of ease and plenty) ! Now those habitations of theirs, After them, are deserted,— All but a (miserable) few ! And We are their heirs !

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ الْقُرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ يَبْعَثَ فِي أُمِّهَا رَسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِنَا وَمَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِي الْقُرَىٰ إِلَّا وَأَهْلُهَا ظَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Nor was thy Lord the one To destroy a population until He had sent to its Center An apostle, rehearsing to them Our Signs ; nor are We Going to destroy a population Except when its members Practice iniquity.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتُهَا وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. The (material) things which Ye are given are but The conveniences of this life And the glitter thereof ; But that which is with God Is better and more enduring : Will ye not then be wise ?

arabic_text: ٦١- أَفَمَنْ وَعَدْنَاهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَاقِيهِ كَمَنْ مَتَّعْنَاهُ مَتَاعَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 61.Are (these two) alike ?— One to whom We have made A goodly promise, and who Is going to reach its (fulfilment), And one to whom We have Given the good things of this Life, but who, on the Day Of Judgment, is to be among Those brought up (for punishment) ?

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. That Day (God) will Call to them, and say : “ Where are My ‘ partners ’ ?— Whom ye imagined (to be such) ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٣- قَالَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هَـٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَغْوَيْنَا أَغْوَيْنَاهُمْ كَمَا غَوَيْنَا تَبَرَّأْنَا إِلَيْكَ مَا كَانُوا إِيَّانَا يَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. Those against whom the charge Will be proved, will say : “ Our Lord ! These are the ones Whom we led astray : We led them astray, as we Were astray ourselves : we free Ourselves (from them) in Thy presence ! It was not us they worshipped.”

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَقِيلَ ادْعُوا شُرَكَاءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا لَهُمْ وَرَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. It will be said (to them) : “ Call upon your ‘ partners ’ (For help) ” : they will call Upon them, but they will not Listen to them ; and they Will see the Penalty (before them) ; (How they will wish) ‘ If only they had been Open to guidance ! ’

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَا أَجَبْتُمُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 65.That Day (God) will Call to them, and say : “ What was the answer Ye gave to the apostles ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٦- فَعَمِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَنْبَاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. Then the (whole) story that day Will seem obscure to them (Like light to the blind) And they will not be able (Even) to question each other.

arabic_text: ٦٧- فَأَمَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَعَسَىٰ أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 67.But any that (in this life) Had repented, believed, and worked Righteousness, will have hopes To be among those who Achieve salvation.

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَرَبُّكَ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيَخْتَارُ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 68.Thy Lord does create and choose As He pleases : no choice Have they (in the matter) : Glory to God ! and far Is He above the partners They ascribe (to Him) !

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. And thy Lord knows all That their hearts conceal And all that they reveal.

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَهُوَ اللَّـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْأُولَىٰ وَالْآخِرَةِ وَلَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. And He is God : there is No god but He. To Him Be praise, at the first And at the last : For Him is the Command, And to Him shall ye (All) be brought back.

arabic_text: ٧١- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ جَعَلَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّـهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِضِيَاءٍ أَفَلَا تَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 71.Say : See ye ? If God Were to make the Night Perpetual over you to the Day Of Judgment, what god Is there other than God, Who can give you enlightenment ? Will ye not then hearken ?

arabic_text: ٧٢- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ جَعَلَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّـهِ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. Say : See ye ? If God Were to make the Day Perpetual over you to the Day Of Judgment, what god Is there other than God, Who can give you a Night In which ye can rest ? Will ye not then see ?

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَمِنْ رَحْمَتِهِ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. It is out of His Mercy That He has made for you Night and Day,—that ye May rest therein, and that Ye may seek of His Grace ;— And in order that ye May be grateful.

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِيَ الَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 74.The Day that He will Call on them, He will say : “ Where are My ‘ partners ’ ?— Whom ye imagined (to be such) ? ”

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَنَزَعْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهِيدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوا أَنَّ الْحَقَّ لِلَّـهِ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. And from each people Shall We draw a witness, And We shall say : “ Produce your Proof ” : then shall they Know that the Truth is in God (alone), and the (lies) Which they invented will Leave them in the lurch.

arabic_text: ٧٦- إِنَّ قَارُونَ كَانَ مِنْ قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ وَآتَيْنَاهُ مِنَ الْكُنُوزِ مَا إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُ لَتَنُوءُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ إِذْ قَالَ لَهُ قَوْمُهُ لَا تَفْرَحْ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 76.Qārūn was doubtless, Of the people of Moses ; but He acted insolently towards them : Such were the treasures We Had bestowed on him, that Their very keys would Have been a burden to A body of strong men. Behold, his people said to him : “ Exult not, for God loveth not Those who exult (in riches).

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَابْتَغِ فِيمَا آتَاكَ اللَّـهُ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ وَلَا تَنْسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَأَحْسِنْ كَمَا أَحْسَنَ اللَّـهُ إِلَيْكَ وَلَا تَبْغِ الْفَسَادَ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. “ But seek, with the (wealth) Which God has bestowed on thee, The Home of the Hereafter, Nor forget thy portion in this World : but do thou good, As God has been good To thee, and seek not (Occasions for) mischief in the land : For God loves not those Who do mischief.”

arabic_text: ٧٨- قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِنْدِي أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ قَدْ أَهْلَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ مَنْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَأَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا وَلَا يُسْأَلُ عَنْ ذُنُوبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 78. He said : “ This has been given To me because of a certain Knowledge which I have.” Did he not know that God Had destroyed, before him, (Whole) generations,—which were Superior to him in strength And greater in amount (Of riches) they had collected ? But the wicked are not Called (immediately) to account For their sins.

arabic_text: ٧٩- فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فِي زِينَتِهِ قَالَ الَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا يَا لَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ قَارُونُ إِنَّهُ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 79. So he went forth among His people in the (pride Of his worldly) glitter. Said those whose aim is The Life of this World : “ Oh ! that we had the like Of what Qārūn has got ! For he is truly a lord Of mighty good fortune ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ لِمَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الصَّابِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. But those who had been granted (True) knowledge said : “ Alas For you ! The reward of God (In the Hereafter) is best For those who believe And work righteousness : but this None shall attain, save those Who steadfastly persevere (in good).”

arabic_text: ٨١- فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِنْ فِئَةٍ يَنْصُرُونَهُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّـهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنْتَصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 81. Then We caused the earth To swallow up him and His house ; and he had not (The least little) party To help him against God, Nor could he defend himself.

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَأَصْبَحَ الَّذِينَ تَمَنَّوْا مَكَانَهُ بِالْأَمْسِ يَقُولُونَ وَيْكَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَوْلَا أَنْ مَنَّ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا وَيْكَأَنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. And those who had envied His position the day before Began to say on the morrow : “ Ah ! It is indeed God Who enlarges the provision Or restricts it, to any Of His servants He pleases ! Had it not been that God Was gracious to us, He Could have caused the earth To swallow us up ! Ah ! those who reject God Will assuredly never prosper.”

arabic_text: ٨٣- تِلْكَ الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 83.That Home of the Hereafter We shall give to those Who intend not high-handedness Or mischief on earth : And the End is (best) For the righteous.

arabic_text: ٨٤- مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجْزَى الَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 84. If any does good, the reward To him is better than His deed ; but if any Does evil, the doers of evil Are only punished (to the extent) Of their deeds.

arabic_text: ٨٥- إِنَّ الَّذِي فَرَضَ عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لَرَادُّكَ إِلَىٰ مَعَادٍ قُلْ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَمَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 85. Verily He Who ordained The Qur-ān for thee, will bring Thee back to the Place Of Return. Say : “ My Lord Knows best who it is That brings true guidance, And who is in manifest error.”

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَمَا كُنْتَ تَرْجُو أَنْ يُلْقَىٰ إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِلْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 86. And thou hadst not expected That the Book would be Sent to thee except as A Mercy from thy Lord : Therefore lend not thou support In any way to those Who reject (God’s Message).

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أُنْزِلَتْ إِلَيْكَ وَادْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 87. And let nothing keep thee Back from the Signs of God After they have been revealed To thee : and invite (men) To thy Lord, and be not Of the company of those Who join gods with God.

arabic_text: ٨٨- وَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجْهَهُ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. And call not, besides God, On another god. There is No god but He. Everything (That exists) will perish Except His own Face. To Him belongs the Command, And to Him will ye (All) be brought back.

arabic_text: ١- الم◯
english_translation: 1.Alif Lam Mim.

arabic_text: ٢- أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوا أَن يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 2.Do men think that They will be left alone On saying, “ We believe ”, And that they will not Be tested ?

arabic_text: ٣- وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْكَاذِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. We did test those Before them, and God will Certainly know those who are True from those who are false.

arabic_text: ٤- أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Do those who practice Evil think that they Will get the better of us ? Evil is their judgment !

arabic_text: ٥- مَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ اللَّـهِ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّـهِ لَآتٍ ۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 5. For those whose hopes are In the meeting with God (In the Hereafter, let them strive) ; For the Term (appointed) By God is surely coming : And He hears and knows (All things).

arabic_text: ٦- وَمَن جَاهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَاهِدُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. And if any strive (with might And main), they do so For their own souls : For God is free of all Needs from all creation.

arabic_text: ٧- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 7.Those who believe and work Righteous deeds,—from them Shall We blot out all evil (That may be) in them, And We shall reward Them according to The best of their deeds.

arabic_text: ٨- وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حُسْنًا ۖ وَإِن جَاهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۚ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. We have enjoined on man Kindness to parents : but if They (either of them) strive (To force) thee to join With Me (in worship) Anything of which thou hast No knowledge, obey them not. Ye have (all) to return To Me, and I will Tell you (the truth) Of all that ye did.

arabic_text: ٩- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِي الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 9. And those who believe And work righteous deeds,— Them shall We admit To the company of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ آمَنَّا بِاللَّـهِ فَإِذَا أُوذِيَ فِي اللَّـهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ النَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ اللَّـهِ وَلَئِن جَاءَ نَصْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ اللَّـهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِي صُدُورِ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 10.Then there are among men Such as say, “ We believe In God ” ; but when they suffer Affliction in (the cause of) God, They treat men’s oppression As if it were the Wrath of God ! And if help Comes (to thee) from thy Lord, They are sure to say, “ We have (always) been With you ! ” Does not God Know best all that is In the hearts of all Creation ?

arabic_text: ١١- وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 11. And God most certainly knows Those who believe, and as certainly Those who are Hypocrites.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنَا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطَايَاكُمْ وَمَا هُم بِحَامِلِينَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. And the Unbelievers say To those who believe : “ Follow our path, and we Will bear (the consequences) Of your faults.” Never In the least will they Bear their faults : in fact They are liars !

arabic_text: ١٣- وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. They will bear their own Burdens, and (other) burdens Along with their own, And on the Day of Judgement They will be called to account For their falsehoods.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا فَأَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 14.We (once) sent Noah To his people, and he tarried Among them a thousand years Less fifty : but the Deluge Overwhelmed them while they (Persisted in) sin.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَأَصْحَابَ السَّفِينَةِ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا آيَةً لِّلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 15. But We saved him And the Companions Of the Ark, and We made The (Ark) a Sign For all Peoples !

arabic_text: ١٦- وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 16.And (We also saved) Abraham : behold, he said To his people, “ Serve God And fear Him : that Will be best for you— If ye understand !

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَوْثَانًا وَتَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لَكُمْ رِزْقًا فَابْتَغُوا عِندَ اللَّـهِ الرِّزْقَ وَاعْبُدُوهُ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ ۖ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. “ For ye do worship idols Besides God, and ye invent Falsehood. The things that ye Worship besides God have No power to give you sustenance : Then seek ye sustenance From God, serve Him, And be grateful to Him : To Him will be your return.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَإِن تُكَذِّبُوا فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٌ مِّن قَبْلِكُمْ ۖ وَمَا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 18. “ And if ye reject (the Message), So did generations before you : And the duty of the apostle Is only to preach publicly (And clearly).”

arabic_text: ١٩- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَيْفَ يُبْدِئُ اللَّـهُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 19.See they not how God Originates creation, then Repeats it : truly that Is easy for God.

arabic_text: ٢٠- قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ اللَّـهُ يُنشِئُ النَّشْأَةَ الْآخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 20. Say : “ Travel through the earth And see how God did Originate creation ; so will God produce a later creation : For God has power Over all things.

arabic_text: ٢١- يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَرْحَمُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ تُقْلَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. “ He punishes whom He pleases, And He grants mercy to whom He pleases, and towards Him Are ye turned.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 22. “ Not on earth nor in heaven Will ye be able (fleeing) To frustrate (His Plan), Nor have ye, besides God, Any protector or helper.”

arabic_text: ٢٣-23.وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ وَلِقَائِهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ يَئِسُوا مِن رَّحْمَتِي وَأُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌThose who reject the Signs Of God and the Meeting With Him (in the Hereafter),— It is they who shall despair Of My mercy : it is they Who will (suffer) A most grievous Penalty.
٢٤- فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا اقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَاهُ اللَّـهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 24.So naught was the answer Of (Abraham’s) people except That they said : “ Slay him Or burn him.” But God Did save him from the Fire. Verily in this are Signs For people who believe.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا اتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَوْثَانًا مَّوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُ بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 25. And He said : “ For you, Ye have taken (for worship) Idols besides God, out of Mutual love and regard Between yourselves in this life ; But on the Day of Judgement Ye shall disown each other And curse each other : And your abode will be The Fire, and ye shall have None to help.”

arabic_text: ٢٦- فَآمَنَ لَهُ لُوطٌ ۘ وَقَالَ إِنِّي مُهَاجِرٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 26. But Lūṭ had faith in Him : He said : “ I will leave Home for the sake of My Lord : for He is Exalted in Might, and Wise.”

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِ النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَجْرَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَإِنَّهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. And We gave (Abraham) Isaac and Jacob, and ordained Among his progeny Prophethood And Revelation, and We Granted him his reward In this life ; and he was In the Hereafter (of the company) Of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 28.And (remember) Lūṭ ; behold, He said to his people : “ Ye do commit lewdness, Such as no people in Creation (Ever) committed before you.

arabic_text: ٢٩- أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الرِّجَالَ وَتَقْطَعُونَ السَّبِيلَ وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنكَرَ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابِ اللَّـهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. “ Do ye indeed approach men, And cut off the highway ?— And practice wickedness (Even) in your councils ? ” But his people gave no answer But this : they said : “ Bring us the Wrath of God If thou tellest the truth.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- قَالَ رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 30. He said : “ O my Lord ! Help Thou me against people Who do mischief ! ”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلَمَّا جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ بِالْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا إِنَّا مُهْلِكُو أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ ۖ إِنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَانُوا ظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 31.When Our Messengers came To Abraham with the good news, They said : “ We are indeed Going to destroy the people Of this township : for truly They are (addicted to) crime.”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالَ إِنَّ فِيهَا لُوطًا ۚ قَالُوا نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِيهَا ۖ لَنُنَجِّيَنَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. He said : “ But there is Lūṭ there.” They said : “ Well do we know who Is there : we will certainly Save him and his following,— Except his wife : she is Of those who lag behind ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَلَمَّا أَن جَاءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًا سِيءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًا وَقَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ ۖ إِنَّا مُنَجُّوكَ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَكَ كَانَتْ مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. And when Our Messengers Came to Lūṭ, he was grieved on their account, And felt himself powerless (To protect) them : but they said : “ Fear thou not, nor grieve : We are (here) to save thee And thy following, except Thy wife : she is Of those who lag behind.

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. “ For we are going to Bring down on the people Of this township a Punishment From heaven, because they Have been wickedly rebellious.”

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. And We have left thereof An evident Sign, For any people who (Care to) understand.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًا فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ وَارْجُوا الْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 36.To the Madyan (people) (We sent) their brother Shu‘aib. Then he said : “ O my people ! Serve God, and fear the Last Day : nor commit evil On the earth, with intent To do mischief.”

arabic_text: ٣٧- فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا فِي دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. But they rejected him : Then the mighty Blast Seized them, and they lay Prostrate in their homes By the morning.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَقَد تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَاكِنِهِمْ ۖ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 38. (Remember also) the ‘Ād And theThamūd (people) : Clearly will appear to you From (the traces) of their buildings (Their fate) : the Evil One Made their deeds alluring To them, and kept them back From the Path, though they Were gifted with Intelligence And Skill.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَقَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا سَابِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 39. (Remember also) Qārūn, Pharaoh, and Hāmān : there came To them Moses with Clear Signs, But they behaved with insolence On the earth ; yet they Could not overreach (Us).

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَكُلًّا أَخَذْنَا بِذَنبِهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ حَاصِبًا وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَخَذَتْهُ الصَّيْحَةُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ خَسَفْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ أَغْرَقْنَا ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّـهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. Each one of them We seized For his crime : of them, Against some We sent A violent tornado (with showers Of stones) ; some were caught By a (mighty) Blast ; some We caused the earth To swallow up ; and some We drowned (in the waters) : It was not God Who Injured (or oppressed) them : They injured (and oppressed) Their own souls.

arabic_text: ٤١- مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ كَمَثَلِ الْعَنكَبُوتِ اتَّخَذَتْ بَيْتًا ۖ وَإِنَّ أَوْهَنَ الْبُيُوتِ لَبَيْتُ الْعَنكَبُوتِ ۖ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 41.The parable of those who Take protectors other than God Is that of the Spider, Who builds (to itself) A house ; but truly The flimsiest of houses Is the Spider’s house ;— If they but knew.

arabic_text: ٤٢- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 42. Verily God doth know Of (every thing) whatever That they call upon Besides Him : and He is Exalted (in power), Wise.
