arabic_text: ٤٣- وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ ۖ وَمَا يَعْقِلُهَا إِلَّا الْعَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. And such are the Parables We set forth for mankind, But only those understand them Who have Knowledge.

arabic_text: ٤٤- خَلَقَ اللَّـهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. God created the heavens And the earth in true (proportions) : Verily in that is a Sign For those who believe.

arabic_text: ٤٥- اتْلُ مَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ ۖ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ تَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ ۗ وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّـهِ أَكْبَرُ ۗ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 45.Recite what is sent Of the Book by inspiration To thee, and establish Regular Prayer : for Prayer Restrains from shameful And unjust deeds ; And remembrance of God Is the greatest (thing in life) Without doubt. And God knows The (deeds) that ye do.

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَلَا تُجَادِلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقُولُوا آمَنَّا بِالَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَأُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُنَا وَإِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَاحِدٌ وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. And dispute ye not With the People of the Book, Except with means better (Than mere disputation), unless It be with those of them Who inflict wrong (and injury) : But say, “ We believe In the Revelation which has Come down to us and in that Which came down to you ; Our God and your God Is one ; and it is to Him We bow (in Islam).”

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنْزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ ۚ فَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ ۖ وَمِنْ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِهِ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. And thus (it is) that We Have sent down the Book To thee. So the People Of the Book believe therein, As also do some of these (Pagan Arabs) : and none But Unbelievers reject Our Signs.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَمَا كُنْتَ تَتْلُو مِنْ قَبْلِهِ مِنْ كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًا لَارْتَابَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. And thou wast not (able) To recite a Book before This (Book came), nor art thou (Able) to transcribe it With thy right hand : In that case, indeed, would The talkers of vanities Have doubted.

arabic_text: ٤٩- بَلْ هُوَ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ فِي صُدُورِ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. Nay, here are Signs Self-evident in the hearts Of those endowed with knowledge : And none but the unjust Reject Our Signs.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْآيَاتُ عِنْدَ اللَّـهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 50. Yet they say : “ Why Are not Signs sent down To him from his Lord ? ” Say : “ The Signs are indeed With God : and I am Indeed a clear Warner.”

arabic_text: ٥١- أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 51. And is it not enough For them that We have Sent down to thee The Book which is rehearsed To them ? Verily, in it Is Mercy and a Reminder To those who believe.

arabic_text: ٥٢- قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ شَهِيدًا يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ وَكَفَرُوا بِاللَّـهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 52.Say : “ Enough is God For a Witness between me And you : He knows What is in the heavens And on earth. And it is Those who believe in vanities And reject God, that Will perish (in the end).”

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَلَوْلَا أَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى لَجَاءَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَلَيَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 53.They ask thee To hasten on the Punishment (For them) : had it not been For a term (of respite) Appointed, the Punishment Would certainly have come To them : and it will Certainly reach them,— Of a sudden, while they Perceive not !

arabic_text: ٥٤- يَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 54. They ask thee To hasten on the Punishment : But, of a surety, Hell will encompass The rejecters of Faith !—

arabic_text: ٥٥- يَوْمَ يَغْشَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِهِمْ وَيَقُولُ ذُوقُوا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. On the Day that The Punishment shall cover them From above them and From below them, And (a Voice) shall say : “ Taste ye (the fruits) Of your deeds ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٦- يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ أَرْضِي وَاسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّايَ فَاعْبُدُونِ◯
english_translation: 56.OMy servants who believe ! Truly, spacious is My Earth : Therefore serve ye Me— (And Me alone) !

arabic_text: ٥٧- كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 57. Every soul shall have A taste of death : In the end to Us Shall ye be brought back.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ غُرَفًا تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. But those who believe And work deeds of righteousness— To them shall We give A Home in Heaven,— Lofty mansions beneath which flow rivers,—to dwell therein For aye ;— an excellent reward For those who do (good) !

arabic_text: ٥٩- الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Those who persevere in patience, And put their trust In their Lord and Cherisher.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ دَابَّةٍ لَا تَحْمِلُ رِزْقَهَا اللَّـهُ يَرْزُقُهَا وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 60.How many are the creatures That carry not their own Sustenance ? It is God Who feeds (both) them and you : For He hears and knows (All things).

arabic_text: ٦١- وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. If indeed thou ask them Who has created the heavens And the earth and subjected The sun and the moon (To His Law), they will Certainly reply, “ God ”. How are they then deluded Away (from the truth) ?

arabic_text: ٦٢- اللَّـهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 62. God enlarges the sustenance (Which He gives) to whichever Of His servants He pleases ; And He (similarly) grants By (strict) measure, (as He pleases) : For God has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٦٣- وَلَئِنْ سَأَلْتَهُمْ مَنْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهَا لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. And if indeed thou ask them Who it is that sends down Rain from the sky, And gives life therewith To the earth after its death, They will certainly reply, “ God ! ” Say, “ Praise be To God ! ” But most Of them understand not.

arabic_text: ٦٤- وَمَا هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَهْوٌ وَلَعِبٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ لَهِيَ الْحَيَوَانُ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 64.What is the life of this world But amusement and play ? But verily the Home In the Hereafter,—that is Life indeed, if they but knew.

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا فِي الْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. Now if they embark On a boat, they call On God, making their devotion Sincerely (and exclusively) to Him ; But when He has delivered Them safely to (dry) land, Behold, they give a share (Of their worship to others) !—

arabic_text: ٦٦- لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. Disdaining ungratefully Our gifts, And giving themselves up To (worldly) enjoyment ! But soon Will they know.

arabic_text: ٦٧- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا حَرَمًا آمِنًا وَيُتَخَطَّفُ النَّاسُ مِنْ حَوْلِهِمْ أَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَةِ اللَّـهِ يَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. Do they not then see That We have made A Sanctuary secure, and that Men are being snatched away From all around them ? Then, do they believe in that Which is vain and reject The Grace of God ?

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِلْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 68. And who does more wrong Than he who invents A lie against God Or rejects the Truth When it reaches Him ? Is there not a home In Hell for those who Reject Faith ?

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَالَّذِينَ جَاهَدُوا فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَمَعَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 69. And those who strive In Our (Cause),—We will Certainly guide them To Our Paths : For verily God Is with those Who do right.

arabic_text: ١- الم◯
٢- غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ◯
english_translation: 2. The Roman Empire Has been defeated—

arabic_text: ٣- فِي أَدْنَى الْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. In a land close by ; But they, (even) after (This) defeat of theirs, Will soon be victorious—

arabic_text: ٤- فِي بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّـهِ الْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِن بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Within a few years. With God is the Decision, In the Past And in the Future : On that Day shall The Believers rejoice—

arabic_text: ٥- بِنَصْرِ اللَّـهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 5. With the help of God. He helps whom He will, And He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦- وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّـهُ وَعْدَهُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. (It is) the promise of God. Never does God depart From His promise : But most men understand not.

arabic_text: ٧- يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ الْآخِرَةِ هُمْ غَافِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. They know but the outer (Things) in the life Of this world : but Of the End of things They are heedless.

arabic_text: ٨- أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ اللَّـهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 8.Do they not reflect In their own minds ? Not but for just ends And for a term appointed, Did God create the heavens And the earth and all Between them : yet are there Truly many among men Who deny the meeting With their Lord (At the Resurrection) !

arabic_text: ٩- أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا الْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَا أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ اللَّـهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. Do they not travel Through the earth, and see What was the End Of those before them ? They were superior to them In strength : they tilled The soil and populated it In greater numbers than these Have done : there came to them Their apostles with Clear (Signs), (which they rejected, to their Own destruction) : it was not God Who wronged them, but They wronged their own souls.

arabic_text: ١٠- ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا السُّوأَىٰ أَن كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ وَكَانُوا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. In the long run Evil in the extreme Will be the End of those Who do evil ; for that They rejected the Signs Of God, and held them up To ridicule.

arabic_text: ١١- اللَّـهُ يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 11.It is God Who begins (The process of) creation ; Then repeats it ; then Shall ye be brought back To Him.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. On the Day that The Hour will be established, The guilty will be Struck dumb with despair.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَائِهِمْ شُفَعَاءُ وَكَانُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. No intercessor will they have Among their “ Partners ”, And they will (themselves) Reject their “ Partners ”.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. On the Day that The Hour will be established,—That Day shall (all men) Be sorted out.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَهُمْ فِي رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. Then those who have believed And worked righteous deeds, Shall be made happy In a Mead of Delight.

arabic_text: ١٦- وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَلِقَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. And those who have rejected Faith and falsely denied Our Signs and the meeting Of the Hereafter,—such Shall be brought forth to Punishment.

arabic_text: ١٧- فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 17.So (give) glory to God, When ye reach eventide And when ye rise In the morning ;

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. Yea, To Him be praise, In the heavens and on earth ; And in the late afternoon And when the day Begins to decline.

arabic_text: ١٩- يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. It is He Who brings out The living from the dead, And brings out the dead From the living, and Who Gives life to the earth After it is dead : And thus shall ye be Brought out (from the dead).

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 20.Among His Signs is this, That He created you From dust ; and then,— Behold, ye are men Scattered (far and wide) !

arabic_text: ٢١- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. And among His Signs Is this, that He created For you mates from among Yourselves, that ye may Dwell in tranquillity with them, And He has put love And mercy between your (hearts) : Verily in that are Signs For those who reflect.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْعَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 22. And among His Signs Is the creation of the heavens And the earth, and the variations In your languages And your colours : verily In that are Signs For those who know.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ مَنَامُكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَاؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. And among His Signs Is the sleep that ye take By night and by day, And the quest that ye (Make for livelihood) Out of His Bounty : verily In that are Signs For those who hearken.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَيُحْيِي بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. And among His Signs, He shows you the lightning, By way both of fear And of hope, and He sends Down rain from the sky And with it gives life to The earth after it is dead : Verily in that are Signs For those who are wise.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَن تَقُومَ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ إِذَا أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. And among His Signs is this, That heaven and earth Stand by His Command : Then when He calls you, By a single call, from the earth, Behold, ye (straightway) come forth.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ قَانِتُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. To Him belongs every being That is in the heavens And on earth : all are Devoutly obedient to Him.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْأَعْلَىٰ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 27. It is He Who begins (The process of) creation ; Then repeats it ; and For Him it is most easy. To Him belongs the loftiest Similitude (We can think of) In the heavens and the earth : For He is Exalted in Might, Full of wisdom.

arabic_text: ٢٨- ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن شُرَكَاءَ فِي مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 28.He does propound To you a similitude From your own (experience) : Do ye have partners Among those whom your right hands Possess, to share as equals In the wealth We have Bestowed on you ? Do ye Fear them as ye fear Each other ? Thus do We Explain the Signs in detail To a people that understand.

arabic_text: ٢٩- بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَهْوَاءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِي مَنْ أَضَلَّ اللَّـهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. Nay, the wrong-doers (merely) Follow their own lusts, Being devoid of knowledge. But who will guide those Whom God leaves astray ? To them there will be No helpers.

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا ۚ فِطْرَتَ اللَّـهِ الَّتِي فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ اللَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الدِّينُ الْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 30.So set thou thy face Steadily and truly to the Faith : (Establish) God’s handiwork according To the pattern on which He has made mankind : No change (let there be) In the work (wrought) By God : that is The standard Religion : But most among mankind Understand not.

arabic_text: ٣١- مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. Turn ye back in repentance To Him, and fear Him : Establish regular prayers, And be not ye among those Who join gods with God,—

arabic_text: ٣٢- مِنَ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا شِيَعًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. Those who split up Their Religion, and become (Mere) Sects,—each party Rejoicing in that which Is with itself !

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَإِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 33.When trouble touches men, They cry to their Lord, Turning back to Him In repentance : but when He gives them a taste Of Mercy as from Himself, Behold, some of them Pay part-worship to Other gods besides their Lord,—

arabic_text: ٣٤- لِيَكْفُرُوا بِمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. (As if) to show their ingratitude For the (favours) We have Bestowed on them ! Then enjoy (your brief day) ; but soon Will ye know (your folly).

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا بِهِ يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. Or have We sent down Authority to them, which Points out to them The things to which They pay part-worship ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَإِذَا أَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. When We give men A taste of Mercy, They exult thereat : And when some evil Afflicts them because of What their (own) hands Have sent forth, behold, They are in despair !

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. See they not that God Enlarges the provision and Restricts it, to whomsoever He pleases ? Verily in that Are Signs for those who believe.

arabic_text: ٣٨- فَآتِ ذَا الْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُ وَالْمِسْكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّـهِ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 38.So give what is due To kindred, the needy, And the wayfarer. That is best for those Who seek the Countenance, Of God, and it is they Who will prosper.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَمَا آتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَ فِي أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُو عِندَ اللَّـهِ ۖ وَمَا آتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَاةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ اللَّـهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. That which ye lay out For increase through the property Of (other) people, will have No increase with God : But that which ye lay out For charity, seeking The Countenance of God, (Will increase) : it is These who will get A recompense multiplied.

arabic_text: ٤٠- للَّـهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَائِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. It is God Who has created you : further, He has Provided for your Sustenance ; then He will cause you To die ; and again He will Give you life. Are there Any of your (false) “ Partners ” Who can do any single One of these things ? Glory to Him ! and High Is He above the partners they attribute (to Him) !

arabic_text: ٤١- ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 41.Mischief has appeared On land and sea because Of (the meed) that the hands Of men have earned, That (God) may give them A taste of some of their Deeds : in order that they May turn back (from Evil).

arabic_text: ٤٢- قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 42. Say : “ Travel through the earth And see what was the End Of those before (you) : Most of them worshipped Others besides God.”

arabic_text: ٤٣- فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ الْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّـهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. But set thou thy face To the right Religion, Before there come from God The Day which there is No chance of averting : On that Day shall men Be divided (in two).

arabic_text: ٤٤-  مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Those who reject Faith Will suffer from that rejection : And those who work righteousness Will spread their couch (Of repose) for themselves (In heaven) :

arabic_text: ٤٥- لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. That He may reward those Who believe and work righteous Deeds, out of His Bounty. For He loves not those Who reject Faith.

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَن يُرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 46.Among His Signs is this, That He sends the Winds, as heralds of Glad Tidings, Giving you a taste Of His (Grace and) Mercy,— That the ships may sail (Majestically) by His Command And that ye may seek Of His Bounty : in order That ye may be grateful.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَاءُوهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. We did indeed send, Before thee, apostles To their (respective) peoples, And they came to them With Clear Signs : then, To those who transgressed, We meted out Retribution : And it was due from us To aid those who believed.

arabic_text: ٤٨- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي يُرْسِلُ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ ۖ فَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 48.It is God Who sends the Winds, and they raise The Clouds : then does He Spread them in the sky As He wills, and break them Into fragments, until thou seest Rain-drops issue from the midst Thereof : then when He has Made them reach such Of His servants as He wills, Behold, they do rejoice !—

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَإِن كَانُوا مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. Even, though before they received (The rain)—just before this— They were dumb with despair !

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ آثَارِ رَحْمَتِ اللَّـهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 50. Then contemplate (O man !) The memorials of God’s Mercy !— How He gives life To the earth after Its death : verily the Same Will give life to the men Who are dead : for He Has power over all things.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا مِن بَعْدِهِ يَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 51. And if We (but) send A Wind from which They see (their tilth) Turn yellow,—behold, They become, thereafter, Ungrateful (Unbelievers) !

arabic_text: ٥٢- فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 52. So verily thou canst not Make the dead to hear, Nor canst thou make The deaf to hear The call, when they show Their backs and turn away.

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَمَا أَنتَ بِهَادِ الْعُمْيِ عَن ضَلَالَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. Nor canst thou lead back The blind from their straying : Only those wilt thou make To hear, who believe In Our Signs and submit (Their wills in Islam).

arabic_text: ٥٤- للَّـهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِن بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْقَدِيرُ◯
english_translation: 54.It is God Who Created you in a state Of (helpless) weakness, then Gave (you) strength after weakness, Then, after strength, gave (you) Weakness and a hoary head : He creates as He wills, And it is He Who has All knowledge and power.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا يُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. On the Day that The Hour (of reckoning) Will be established, The transgressors will swear That they tarried not But an hour : thus were They used to being deluded !

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّـهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. But those endued with knowledge And faith will say : “ Indeed ye did tarry, Within God’s Decree, To the Day of Resurrection, And this is the Day Of Resurrection : but ye— Ye were not aware ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 57. So on that Day no excuse Of theirs will Avail the Transgressors, Nor will they be invited (then) To seek grace (by repentance).

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِآيَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 58.Verily We have propounded For men, in this Qur-ān. Every kind of Parable : But if thou bring to them Any Sign, the Unbelievers Are sure to say, “ Ye Do nothing but talk vanities.”

arabic_text: ٥٩- كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Thus does God seal up The hearts of those Who understand not.

arabic_text: ٦٠- فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. So patiently persevere : for Verily the promise of God Is true : nor let those Shake thy firmness, who have (Themselves) no certainty of faith.

arabic_text: ١- الم◯
٢- تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. These are Verses Of the Wise Book,—

arabic_text: ٣- هُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. A Guide and a Mercy To the Doers of Good,—

arabic_text: ٤- الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Those who establish regular Prayer, And give regular Charity, And have (in their hearts) The assurance of the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٥- أُولَـٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. These are on (true) guidance From their Lord ; and these Are the ones who will prosper.

arabic_text: ٦- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِي لَهْوَ الْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 6.But there are, among men, Those who purchase idle tales, Without knowledge (or meaning), To mislead (men) from the Path Of God and throw ridicule (On the Path) ; for such There will be a humiliating Penalty.

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 7. When Our Signs are rehearsed To such a one, he turns Away in arrogance, as if He heard them not, as if There were deafness in both His ears : announce to him A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 8. For those who believe And work righteous deeds, There will be Gardens Of Bliss,—

arabic_text: ٩- خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقًّا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9. To dwell therein. The promise Of God is true : and He Is Exalted in power, Wise.

arabic_text: ١٠- خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 10.He created the heavens Without any pillars that ye Can see ; He set On the earth mountains Standing firm, lest it Should shake with you ; And He scattered through it Beasts of all kinds. We send down rain From the sky, and produce On the earth every kind Of noble creature, in pairs.

arabic_text: ١١- هَـٰذَا خَلْقُ اللَّـهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ بَلِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 11. Such is the Creation of God ; Now show Me what is there That others besides Him Have created : nay, but The Transgressors are In manifest error.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّـهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 12.We bestowed (in the past) Wisdom on Luqmān : “ Show (thy) gratitude to God.” Any who is (so) grateful Does so to the profit Of his own soul : but if Any is ungrateful, verily God is free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّـهِ ۖ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 13. Behold, Luqmān said To his son by way of Instruction : “ O my son ! Join not in worship (Others) with God : for False worship is indeed The highest wrong-doing.”

arabic_text: ١٤- وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 14. And We have enjoined on man (To be good) to his parents : In travail upon travail Did his mother bear him, And in years twain Was his weaning : (hear The command), “ Show gratitude To Me and to thy parents : To Me is (thy final) Goal.

arabic_text: ١٥- وَإِن جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا ۖ وَاتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَيَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. “ But if they strive To make thee join In worship with Me Things of which thou hast No knowledge, obey them not ; Yet bear them company In this life with justice (And consideration), and follow The way of those who Turn to Me (in love) : In the End the return Of you all is to Me, And I will tell you The truth (and meaning) Of all that ye did.”

arabic_text: ١٦- يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّهَا إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ فَتَكُن فِي صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَوْ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا اللَّـهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 16. “ O my son ! ” (said Luqmān), “ If there be (but) the weight Of a mustard-seed and It were (hidden) in a rock, Or (anywhere) in the heavens or On earth, God will bring it Forth : for God understands The finest mysteries, (and) Is well-acquainted (with them).

arabic_text: ١٧- يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ وَأْمُرْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَانْهَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ◯
english_translation: 17. “ O my son ! establish Regular prayer enjoin what is Just, and forbid what is wrong : And bear with patient constancy Whate’er betide thee ; for this Is firmness (of purpose) In (the conduct of) affairs.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ◯
english_translation: 18. “ And swell not thy cheek (for pride) at men, Nor walk in insolence Through the earth ; For God loveth not Any arrogant boaster.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَاقْصِدْ فِي مَشْيِكَ وَاغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ الْأَصْوَاتِ لَصَوْتُ الْحَمِيرِ◯
english_translation: 19. “ And be moderate In thy pace, and lower Thy voice ; for the harshest Of sounds without doubt Is the braying of the ass.”

arabic_text: ٢٠- أَلَمْ تَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُ ظَاهِرَةً وَبَاطِنَةً ۗ وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يُجَادِلُ فِي اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ وَلَا هُدًى وَلَا كِتَابٍ مُّنِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 20.Do ye not see That God has subjected To your (use) all things In the heavens and on earth, And has made His bounties Flow to you in exceeding Measure, (both) seen and unseen ? Yet there are among men Those who dispute about God, Without knowledge and without Guidance and without a Book To enlighten them !

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّبِعُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ قَالُوا بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَنَا ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 21. When they are told to follow The (Revelation) that God Has sent down, they say : “ Nay, we shall follow The ways that we found Our fathers (following).” What ! even if it is Satan beckoning them To the Penalty Of the (Blazing) Fire !

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ عَاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ◯
english_translation: 22.Whoever submits His whole self to God, And is a doer of good, Has grasped indeed The most trustworthy hand-hold : And with God rests the End And Decision of (all) affairs.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُ ۚ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 23. But if any reject Faith, Let not his rejection Grieve thee : to Us Is their Return and We Shall tell them the truth Of their deeds : for God Knows well all that is In (men’s) hearts.

arabic_text: ٢٤- نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ◯
english_translation: 24. We grant them their pleasure For a little while : In the end shall We Drive them to A chastisement unrelenting.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ ۚ قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 25.If thou ask them, Who it is that created The heavens and the earth. They will certainly say, “ God ”. Say : “ Praise be to God ! ” But most of them Understand not.

arabic_text: ٢٦- لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 26. To God belong all things In heaven and earth : verily God is He (that is) Free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّـهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 27. And if all the trees On earth were pens And the Ocean (were ink), With seven Oceans behind it To add to its (supply), Yet would not the Words Of God be exhausted (In the writing) : for God Is Exalted in power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٢٨- مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 28. And your creation Or your resurrection Is in no wise but As an individual soul : For God is He Who Hears and sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٢٩- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 29. Seest thou not that God merges Night into Day And He merges Day into Night ; That He has subjected the sun And the moon (to His Law), Each running its course For a term appointed ; and That God is well acquainted With all that ye do ?

arabic_text: ٣٠- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الْبَاطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 30. That is because God is The (only) Reality, and because Whatever else they invoke Besides Him is Falsehood ; And because God,—He is The Most High, Most Great.

arabic_text: ٣١- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ الْفُلْكَ تَجْرِي فِي الْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ اللَّـهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ آيَاتِهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ◯
english_translation: 31.Seest thou not that The ships sail through The Ocean by the grace Of God ?—that He may Show you of His Signs ? Verily in this are Signs For all who constantly persevere And give thanks.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌ كَالظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّاهُمْ إِلَى الْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍ كَفُورٍ◯
english_translation: 32. When a wave covers them Like the canopy (of clouds), They call to God, Offering Him sincere devotion. But when He has delivered them Safely to land, there are Among them those that halt Between (right and wrong). But none reject Our Signs Except only a perfidious Ungrateful (wretch) !

arabic_text: ٣٣- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا لَّا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّـهِ الْغَرُورُ◯
english_translation: 33. O mankind ! do your duty To your Lord, and fear (the coming of) a Day When no father can avail Aught for his son, nor A son avail aught For his father. Verily, the promise of God Is true : let not then This present life deceive you, Nor let the Chief Deceiver Deceive you about God.

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْأَرْحَامِ ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًا ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِي نَفْسٌ بِأَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 34. Verily the knowledge Of the Hour is With God (alone). It is He Who sends down Rain, and He Who knows What is in the wombs. Nor does anyone know What it is that he will Earn on the morrow : Nor does anyone know In what land he is To die. Verily with God Is full knowledge and He is acquainted (with all things).

arabic_text: ١- الم◯
٢- تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 2. (This is) the revelation Of the Book in which There is no doubt,— From the Lord of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ٣- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أَتَاهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. Or do they say, “ He has forged it ” ? Nay, it is the Truth From thy Lord, that thou Mayest admonish a people To whom no warner Has come before thee : In order that they May receive guidance.

arabic_text: ٤- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 4.It is God Who has Created the heavens And the earth, and all Between them, in six Days, And is firmly established On the Throne (of authority) : Ye have none, besides Him, To protect or intercede (for you) : Will ye not then Receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٥- يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ◯
english_translation: 5. He rules (all) affairs From the heavens To the earth : in the end Will (all affairs) go up To Him, on a Day, The space whereof will be (As) a thousand years Of your reckoning.

arabic_text: ٦- ذَٰلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 6. Such is He, the Knower Of all things, hidden And open, the Exalted (In power), the Merciful ;—

arabic_text: ٧- الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنسَانِ مِن طِينٍ◯
english_translation: 7. He Who has made Everything which He has created Most Good : He began The creation of man With (nothing more than) clay,

arabic_text: ٨- ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ◯
english_translation: 8. And made his progeny From a quintessence Of the nature of A fluid despised :

arabic_text: ٩- ثُمَّ سَوَّاهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. But He fashioned him In due proportion, and breathed Into him something of His spirit. And He gave You (the faculties of) hearing And sight and feeling (And understanding) : Little thanks do ye give !

arabic_text: ١٠- وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. And they say : “ What ! When we lie hidden And lost, in the earth, Shall we indeed be In a Creation renewed ? ” Nay, they deny the Meeting With their Lord !

arabic_text: ١١- قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُم مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. Say : “ The Angel of Death, Put in charge of you, Will (duly) take your souls : Then shall ye be brought Back to your Lord.”

arabic_text: ١٢- وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 12.If only thou couldst see When the guilty ones Will bend low their heads Before their Lord (saying :) “ Our Lord ! We have seen And we have heard : Now then send us back (To the world) : we will Work righteousness : for we Do indeed (now) believe.”

arabic_text: ١٣- وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَآتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَاهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّي لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. If We had so willed, We could certainly have brought Every soul its true guidance : But the Word from Me Will come true, “ I will Fill Hell with Jinns And men all together.”

arabic_text: ١٤- فَذُوقُوا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. “ Taste ye then—for ye Forgot the Meeting Of this Day of yours, And We too will Forget you—taste ye The Penalty of Eternity For your (evil) deeds ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِآيَاتِنَا الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهَا خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 15. Only those believe In Our Signs, who, when They are recited to them, Fall down in adoration, And celebrate the praises Of their Lord, nor are they (Ever) puffed up with pride.

arabic_text: ١٦- تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. Their limbs do forsake Their beds of sleep, the while They call on their Lord In Fear and Hope : And they spend (in charity) Out of the sustenance which We have bestowed on them.

arabic_text: ١٧- فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا أُخْفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. Now no person knows What delights of the eye Are kept hidden (in reserve) For them—as a reward For their (good) Deeds.

arabic_text: ١٨- أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُونَ◯
english_translation: 18.Is then the man Who believes no better Than the man who is Rebellious and wicked ? Not equal are they.

arabic_text: ١٩- أَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ الْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. For those who believe And do righteous deeds, Are Gardens as hospitable Homes, for their (good) deeds.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَن يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. As to those who are Rebellious and wicked, their abode Will be the Fire : every time They wish to get away Therefrom, they will be forced Thereinto, and it will be said To them : “ Taste ye The Penalty of the Fire, The which ye were wont To reject as false.”

arabic_text: ٢١- وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. And indeed We will make Them taste of the Penalty Of this (life) prior to The supreme Penalty, in order That they may (repent and) return.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. And who does more wrong Than one to whom are recited The Signs of his Lord, And who then turns away Therefrom ? Verily from those Who transgress We shall exact (Due) Retribution.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَائِهِ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 23.We did indeed aforetime Give the Book to Moses : Be not then in doubt of its reaching (thee) : And We made it A guide to the Children Of Israel.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا ۖ وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. And We appointed, from among Them, Leaders, giving guidance Under Our command, so long As they persevered with patience And continued to have faith In Our Signs.

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. Verily thy Lord will judge Between them on the Day Of Judgement, in the matters Wherein they differ (among themselves).

arabic_text: ٢٦- أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. Does it not teach them A lesson, how many generations We destroyed before them, In whose dwellings they (now) go to and fro ? Verily in that are Signs : Do they not then listen ?

arabic_text: ٢٧- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا نَسُوقُ الْمَاءَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَامُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. And do they not see That We do drive Rain To parched soil (bare Of herbage), and produce therewith Crops, providing food For their cattle and themselves ? Have they not the vision ?

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 28.They say : “ When will This Decision be, if ye Are telling the truth ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٩- قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِيمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. Say : “ On the Day Of Decision, no profit Will it be to Unbelievers If they (then) believe ! Nor will they be granted A respite.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. So turn away from them, And wait : they too Are waiting.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللَّـهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا◯
english_translation: 1.OProphet ! Fear God, And hearken not To the Unbelievers And the Hypocrites : Verily God is full Of knowledge and wisdom.

arabic_text: ٢- وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 2. But follow that which Comes to thee by inspiration From thy Lord : for God Is well acquainted With (all) that ye do.

arabic_text: ٣- وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 3. And put thy trust In God, and enough is God As a Disposer of affairs.

arabic_text: ٤- مَّا جَعَلَ اللَّـهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّن قَلْبَيْنِ فِي جَوْفِهِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَزْوَاجَكُمُ اللَّائِي تُظَاهِرُونَ مِنْهُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلَ أَدْعِيَاءَكُمْ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُم بِأَفْوَاهِكُمْ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِي السَّبِيلَ◯
english_translation: 4.God has not made For any man two hearts In his (one) body : nor has He made your wives whom Ye divorce byẒihār Your mothers : nor has He Made your adopted sons Your sons. Such is (only) Your (manner of) speech By your mouths. But God Tells (you) the Truth, and He Shows the (right) Way.

arabic_text: ٥- ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّـهِ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوا آبَاءَهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَمَوَالِيكُمْ ۚ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا أَخْطَأْتُم بِهِ وَلَـٰكِن مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوبُكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 5. Call them by (the names Of) their fathers : that is Juster in the sight of God. But if ye know not Their father’s (names, call Them) your Brothers in faith, Or yourMaulās. But there is no blame On you if ye make A mistake therein : (What counts is) The intention of your hearts : And God is Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦- النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ ۗ وَأُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّـهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا أَن تَفْعَلُوا إِلَىٰ أَوْلِيَائِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَسْطُورًا◯
english_translation: 6. The Prophet is closer To the Believers than Their own selves, And his wives are Their mothers. Blood-relations Among each other have Closer personal ties, In the Decree of God, Than (the Brotherhood of) Believers and Muhājirs : Nevertheless do ye What is just to your Closest friends : such is The writing in the Decree (Of God).

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِذْ أَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِيثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنكَ وَمِن نُّوحٍ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا◯
english_translation: 7.And remember We took From the Prophets their Covenant : As (We did) from thee : From Noah, Abraham, Moses, And Jesus the son of Mary : We took from them A solemn Covenant :

arabic_text: ٨- لِّيَسْأَلَ الصَّادِقِينَ عَن صِدْقِهِمْ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 8. That (God) may question The (Custodians) of Truth concerning The Truth they (were charged with) : And He has prepared For the Unbelievers A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَاءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.Oye who believe ! Remember the Grace of God, (Bestowed) on you, when There came down on you Hosts (to overwhelm you) : But We sent against them A hurricane and forces That ye saw not : But God sees (clearly) All that ye do.

arabic_text: ١٠- إِذْ جَاءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّـهِ الظُّنُونَا◯
english_translation: 10. Behold ! they came on you From above you and from Below you, and behold, The eyes became dim And the hearts gaped Up to the throats, And ye imagined various (Vain) thoughts about God !

arabic_text: ١١- هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا◯
english_translation: 11. In that situation Were the Believers tried : They were shaken as by A tremendous shaking.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَإِذْ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا اللَّـهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا◯
english_translation: 12.And behold ! The Hypocrites And those in whose hearts Is a disease (even) say : “ God And His Apostle promised us Nothing but delusions ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَا أَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوا ۚ وَيَسْتَأْذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۖ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا◯
english_translation: 13. Behold ! A party among them Said : “ Ye men of Yathrib ! Ye cannot stand (the attack) ! Therefore go back ! ” And a band of them Ask for leave of the Prophet, Saying, “ Truly our houses Are bare and exposed,” though They were not exposed : They intended nothing but To run away.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا الْفِتْنَةَ لَآتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا بِهَا إِلَّا يَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 14. And if an entry had Been effected to them From the sides of the (City), And they had been Incited to sedition, They would certainly have Brought it to pass, with None but a brief delay !

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا عَاهَدُوا اللَّـهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ الْأَدْبَارَ ۚ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللَّـهِ مَسْئُولًا◯
english_translation: 15. And yet they had already Covenanted with God not to turn Their backs, and a covenant With God must (surely) Be answered for.

arabic_text: ١٦- قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ الْمَوْتِ أَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 16. Say : “ Running away will not Profit you if ye are Running away from death Or slaughter ; and even if (Ye do escape), no more Than a brief (respite) Will ye be allowed to enjoy ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧- قُلْ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً ۚ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 17. Say : “ Who is it that can Screen you from God If it be His wish To give you Punishment Or to give you Mercy ? ” Nor will they find for themselves, Besides God, any protector Or helper.

arabic_text: ١٨- قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّـهُ الْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالْقَائِلِينَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَلَا يَأْتُونَ الْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 18. Verily God knows those Among you who keep back (Men) and those who say To their brethren, “ Come along to us ”, but come not To the fight except For just a little while,

arabic_text: ١٩- أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّـهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 19. Covetous over you. Then when fear comes, Thou wilt see them looking To thee, their eyes revolving, Like (those of) one over whom Hovers death : but when The fear is past, They will smite you With sharp tongues, covetous Of goods. Such men have No faith, and so God Has made their deeds Of none effect : and that Is easy for God.

arabic_text: ٢٠- يَحْسَبُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ الْأَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوا لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَنبَائِكُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كَانُوا فِيكُم مَّا قَاتَلُوا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 20. They think that the Confederates Have not withdrawn ; and if The Confederates should come (again), They would wish they were In the deserts (wandering) Among the Bedouins, and Seeking news about you (From a safe distance) ; And if they were In your midst, they Would fight but little.

arabic_text: ٢١- لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّـهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّـهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّـهَ كَثِيرًا◯
english_translation: 21.Ye have indeed In the Apostle of God A beautiful pattern (of conduct) For anyone whose hope is In God and the Final Day, And who engages much In the praise of God.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَلَمَّا رَأَى الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْأَحْزَابَ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّـهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَصَدَقَ اللَّـهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ۚ وَمَا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا إِيمَانًا وَتَسْلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 22. When the Believers saw The Confederate forces, They said : “ This is What God and His Apostle Had promised us, and God And His Apostle told us What was true.” And it Only added to their faith And their zeal in obedience.

arabic_text: ٢٣- مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّـهَ عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّن قَضَىٰ نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنتَظِرُ ۖ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا تَبْدِيلًا◯
english_translation: 23. Among the Believers are men Who have been true to Their Covenant with God : Of them some have completed Their vow (to the extreme), And some (still) wait : But they have never changed (Their determination) in the least :

arabic_text: ٢٤- لِّيَجْزِيَ اللَّـهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِن شَاءَ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 24. That God may reward The men of Truth for Their Truth, and punish The Hypocrites if that be His Will, or turn to them In Mercy : for God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَرَدَّ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا خَيْرًا ۚ وَكَفَى اللَّـهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا◯
english_translation: 25.And God turned back The Unbelievers for (all) Their fury : no advantage Did they gain ; and enough Is God for the Believers In their fight. And God Is full of Strength, Able To enforce His Will.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَأَنزَلَ الَّذِينَ ظَاهَرُوهُم مِّنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ وَتَأْسِرُونَ فَرِيقًا◯
english_translation: 26. And those of the people Of the Book who aided Them— God did take them Down from their strongholds And cast terror into Their hearts, (so that) Some ye slew, and some Ye made prisoners.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَأَوْرَثَكُمْ أَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ وَأَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَئُوهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 27. And He made you heirs Of their lands, their houses, And their goods, And of a land which Ye had not frequented (Before). And God has Power over all things.

arabic_text: ٢٨- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا◯
english_translation: 28.OProphet ! say To thy Consorts : “ If it be that ye desire The life of this world, And its glitter,— then come ! I will provide for your Enjoyment and set you free In a handsome manner.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَإِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 29. “ But if ye seek God And His Apostle, and The Home of the Hereafter, Verily God has prepared For the well-doers amongst you A great reward.”

arabic_text: ٣٠- يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ مَن يَأْتِ مِنكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُضَاعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 30. O Consorts of the Prophet If any of you were guilty Of evident unseemly conduct, The Punishment would be Doubled to her, and that Is easy for God.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَمَن يَقْنُتْ مِنكُنَّ لِلَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُّؤْتِهَا أَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيمًا◯
english_translation: 31. But any of you that is Devout in the service of God and His Apostle, And works righteousness,— To her shall We grant Her reward twice : and We Have prepared for her A generous Sustenance.

arabic_text: ٣٢- يَا نِسَاءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَأَحَدٍ مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ ۚ إِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِي فِي قَلْبِهِ مَرَضٌ وَقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا◯
english_translation: 32. O Consorts of the Prophet ! Ye are not like any Of the (other) women : If ye do fear (God), Be not too complaisant Of speech, lest one In whose heart is A disease should be moved With desire : but speak ye A speech (that is) just.

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتِينَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّـهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا◯
english_translation: 33. And stay quietly in Your houses, and make not A dazzling display, like That of the former Times Of Ignorance ; and establish Regular Prayer, and give Regular Charity ; and obey God and His Apostle. And God only wishes To remove all abomination From you, ye Members Of the Family, and to make You pure and spotless.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلَىٰ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ لَطِيفًا خَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 34. And recite what is Rehearsed to you in your Homes, of the Signs of God And His Wisdom : For God understands The finest mysteries and Is well-acquainted (with them).

arabic_text: ٣٥- إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْقَانِتِينَ وَالْقَانِتَاتِ وَالصَّادِقِينَ وَالصَّادِقَاتِ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَالصَّابِرَاتِ وَالْخَاشِعِينَ وَالْخَاشِعَاتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقَاتِ وَالصَّائِمِينَ وَالصَّائِمَاتِ وَالْحَافِظِينَ فُرُوجَهُمْ وَالْحَافِظَاتِ وَالذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّـهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّـهُ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 35.For Muslim men and women,— For believing men and women, For devout men and women, For true men and women, For men and women who are Patient and constant, for men And women who humble themselves, For men and women who give In charity, for men and women Who fast (and deny themselves), For men and women who Guard their chastity, and For men and women who Engage much in God’s praise,— For them has God prepared Forgiveness and great reward.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّـهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُّبِينًا◯
english_translation: 36.It is not fitting For a Believer, man or woman, When a matter has been decided By God and His Apostle, To have any option About their decision : If anyone disobeys God And His Apostle, he is indeed On a clearly wrong Path.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّـهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّـهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ وَاللَّـهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ مَفْعُولًا◯
english_translation: 37. Behold ! thou didst say To one who had received The grace of God And thy “ Retain thou (In wedlock) thy wife, And fear God.” But thou Didst hide in thy heart That which God was about To make manifest : thou didst Fear the people, but it is More fitting that thou shouldst Fear God. Then when Zaid Had dissolved (his marriage) With her, with the necessary (Formality), We joined her In marriage to thee : In order that (in future) There may be no difficulty To the Believers in (the matter Of) marriage with the wives Of their adopted sons, when The latter have dissolved With the necessary (formality) (Their marriage) with them. And God’s command must Be fulfilled.

arabic_text: ٣٨- مَّا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيمَا فَرَضَ اللَّـهُ لَهُ ۖ سُنَّةَ اللَّـهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلُ ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُورًا◯
english_translation: 38. There can be no difficulty To the Prophet in what God has indicated to him As a duty. It was The practice (approved) of God Amongst those of old That have passed away. And the command of God Is a decree determined.

arabic_text: ٣٩- الَّذِينَ يُبَلِّغُونَ رِسَالَاتِ اللَّـهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهُ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّـهَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ حَسِيبًا◯
english_translation: 39. (It is the practice of those) Who preach the Messages Of God, and fear Him And fear none but God. And enough is God To call (men) to account.

arabic_text: ٤٠- مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن رَّسُولَ اللَّـهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 40. Muhammad is not The father of any Of your men, but (he is) The Apostle of God, And the Seal of the Prophets : And God has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٤١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّـهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا◯
english_translation: 41.Oye who believe ! Celebrate the praises of God, And do this often ;

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا◯
english_translation: 42. And glorify Him Morning and evening.

arabic_text: ٤٣- هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 43. He it is Who sends Blessings on you, as do His angels, that He may Bring you out from the depths Of Darkness into Light : And He is Full of Mercy To the Believers.

arabic_text: ٤٤- تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهُ سَلَامٌ ۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًا كَرِيمًا◯
english_translation: 44. Their salutation on the Day They meet Him will be “ peace ! ” ; and He has Prepared for them A generous Reward.

arabic_text: ٤٥- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 45.OProphet ! Truly We Have sent thee as A Witness, a Bearer Of Glad Tidings, And a Warner,—

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّـهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيرًا◯
english_translation: 46. And as one who invites To God’s (Grace) by His leave, And as a Lamp Spreading Light.

arabic_text: ٤٧-وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 47. Then give the glad tidings To the Believers, that They shall have from God A very great Bounty.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَدَعْ أَذَاهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 48. And obey not (the behests) Of the Unbelievers And the Hypocrites, And heed not their annoyances, But put thy trust in God For enough is God As a Disposer of affairs.

arabic_text: ٤٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّونَهَا ۖ فَمَتِّعُوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا◯
english_translation: 49.Oye who believe ! When ye marry believing women, And then divorce them Before ye have touched them, No period of ‘Iddat Have ye to count In respect of them : So give them a present, And set them free In a handsome manner.

arabic_text: ٥٠- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِنَّا أَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ أَزْوَاجَكَ اللَّاتِي آتَيْتَ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنَاتِ عَمَّاتِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنَاتِ خَالَاتِكَ اللَّاتِي هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَ وَامْرَأَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ إِنْ أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ أَن يَسْتَنكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۗ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِي أَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُونَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 50.OProphet ! We have Made lawful to thee Thy wives to whom thou Hast paid their dowers ; And those whom thy Right hand possesses out of The prisoners of war whom God has assigned to thee ; And daughters of thy paternal Uncles and aunts, and daughters Of thy maternal uncles And aunts, who migrated (From Mecca) with thee ; And any believing woman Who dedicates her soul To the Prophet if the Prophet Wishes to wed her ;— this Only for thee, and not For the Believers (at large) ; We know what We have Appointed for them as to Their wives and the captives Whom their right hands Possess ;— in order that There should be no difficulty For thee. And God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٥١- تُرْجِي مَن تَشَاءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُؤْوِي إِلَيْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ ۖ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَا آتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلِيمًا حَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 51. Thou mayest defer (the turn Of) any of them that thou Pleasest, and thou mayest receive Any thou pleasest : and there Is no blame on thee if Thou invite one whose (turn) Thou hadst set aside. This were nigher to The cooling of their eyes, The prevention of their grief, And their satisfaction— That of all of them— With that which thou Hast to give them : And God knows (all) That is in your hearts : And God is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

arabic_text: ٥٢- لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِن بَعْدُ وَلَا أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَّقِيبًا◯
english_translation: 52. It is not lawful for thee (To marry more) women After this, nor to change Them for (other) wives, Even though their beauty Attract thee except any Thy right hand should Possess (as handmaidens) : And God doth watch Over all things.

arabic_text: ٥٣- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانتَشِرُوا وَلَا مُسْتَأْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيِي مِنكُمْ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ ۚ وَإِذَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَاسْأَلُوهُنَّ مِن وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُؤْذُوا رَسُولَ اللَّـهِ وَلَا أَن تَنكِحُوا أَزْوَاجَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ أَبَدًا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِندَ اللَّـهِ عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 53.Oye who Believe ! Enter not the Prophet’s houses,— Until leave is given you,— for a meal, (and then) Not (so early as) to wait For its preparation : but when Ye are invited, enter ; And when ye have taken Your meal, disperse, Without seeking familiar talk. Such (behaviour) annoys The Prophet : he is ashamed To dismiss you but God is not ashamed (to tell you) the truth.And when ye Ask (his ladies) For anything ye want, Ask them from before A screen : that makes For greater purity for Your hearts and for theirs.Nor is it right for you That ye should annoy God’s Apostle, or that Ye should marry his widows After him at any time. Truly such a thing is In God’s sight an enormity.

arabic_text: ٥٤- إِن تُبْدُوا شَيْئًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 54. Whether ye reveal anything Or conceal it, verily God has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٥٥- لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِي آبَائِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَائِهِنَّ وَلَا إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَا أَبْنَاءِ أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَائِهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ ۗ وَاتَّقِينَ اللَّـهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا◯
english_translation: 55. There is no blame (On these ladies if they Appear) before their fathers Or their sons, their brothers, Or their brothers’ sons, Or their sisters’ sons, Or their women, Or the (slaves) whom Their right hands possess. And, (ladies), fear God ; For God is Witness To all things.

arabic_text: ٥٦- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 56.God and His Angels Send blessings on the Prophet : O ye that believe ! Send ye blessings on him, And salute him With all respect.

arabic_text: ٥٧- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّـهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا◯
english_translation: 57. Those who annoy God and His Apostle— God has cursed them In this world and In the Hereafter, And has prepared for them A humiliating Punishment.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوا بُهْتَانًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا◯
english_translation: 58. And those who annoy Believing men and women Undeservedly, bear (on themselves) A calumny and a glaring sin.

arabic_text: ٥٩- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 59.OProphet ! Tell Thy wives and daughters, And the believing women, That they should cast Their outer garments over Their persons (when abroad) : That is most convenient, That they should be known (as such) and not molested. And God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦٠- لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 60. Truly, if the Hypocrites, And those in whose hearts Is a disease, and those who Stir up sedition in the City, Desist not, We shall certainly Stir thee up against them : Then will they not be Able to stay in it As thy neighbours For any length of time :

arabic_text: ٦١- مَّلْعُونِينَ ۖ أَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوا أُخِذُوا وَقُتِّلُوا تَقْتِيلًا◯
english_translation: 61. They shall have a curse On them : wherever they Are found, they shall be Seized and slain (Without mercy).

arabic_text: ٦٢- سُنَّةَ اللَّـهِ فِي الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّـهِ تَبْدِيلًا◯
english_translation: 62. (Such was) the practice (Approved) of God among those Who lived aforetime : No change wilt thou find In the practice (approved) Of God.

arabic_text: ٦٣- يَسْأَلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا◯
english_translation: 63.Men ask thee concerning The Hour : say, “ The knowledge Thereof is with God (alone) ” ; And what will make thee Understand ?—Perchance The Hour is nigh !

arabic_text: ٦٤- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَعَنَ الْكَافِرِينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 64. Verily God has cursed The Unbelievers and prepared For them a Blazing Fire,—

arabic_text: ٦٥- خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 65. To dwell therein for ever : No protector will they find, Nor helper.

arabic_text: ٦٦- يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِي النَّارِ يَقُولُونَ يَا لَيْتَنَا أَطَعْنَا اللَّـهَ وَأَطَعْنَا الرَّسُولَا◯
english_translation: 66. The Day that their faces Will be turned upside down In the Fire, they will say : “ Woe to us ! would that We had obeyed God And obeyed the Apostle ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّا أَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَاءَنَا فَأَضَلُّونَا السَّبِيلَا◯
english_translation: 67. And they would say : “ Our Lord ! We obeyed Our chiefs and our great ones, And they misled us As to the (right) path.

arabic_text: ٦٨- رَبَّنَا آتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 68. “ Our Lord ! Give them Double Penalty And curse them With a very great Curse ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّـهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا ۚ وَكَانَ عِندَ اللَّـهِ وَجِيهًا◯
english_translation: 69.Oye who believe ! Be ye not like those Who vexed and insulted Moses, But God cleared him Of the (calumnies) they Had uttered : and he Was honourable in God’s sight.

arabic_text: ٧٠- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا◯
english_translation: 70. O ye who believe ! Fear God, and (always) say A word directed to the Right :

arabic_text: ٧١- يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 71. That He may make Your conduct whole and sound And forgive you your sins : He that obeys God And His Apostle, has already Attained the highest Achievement.

arabic_text: ٧٢- إِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْأَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَن يَحْمِلْنَهَا وَأَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْإِنسَانُ ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ ظَلُومًا جَهُولًا◯
english_translation: 72.We did indeed offer The Trust to the Heavens And the Earth And the Mountains ; But they refused To undertake it, Being afraid thereof : But man undertook it ;— He was indeed unjust And foolish ;—

arabic_text: ٧٣- لِّيُعَذِّبَ اللَّـهُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ وَيَتُوبَ اللَّـهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 73. (With the result) that God has to punish The Hypocrites, men and women, And the Unbelievers, men And women, and God turns In Mercy to the Believers, Men and women : for God Is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١- الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 1.Praise be to God, To Whom belong all things In the heavens and on earth : To Him be Praise In the Hereafter : And He is Full of Wisdom, Acquainted with all things.

arabic_text: ٢- يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ الْغَفُورُ◯
