english_translation: 2. He knows all that goes Into the earth, and all that Comes out thereof ; all that Comes down from the sky And all that ascends thereto : And He is the Most Merciful, The Oft-Forgiving.

arabic_text: ٣- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ ۖ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ ۖ لَا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 3.The Unbelievers say, “ Never to us will come The Hour ” : say, “ Nay ! But most surely, By my Lord, it will come Upon you ;—by Him Who knows the unseen,— From Whom is not hidden The least little atom In the Heavens or on earth : Nor is there anything less Than that, or greater, but Is in the Record Perspicuous :

arabic_text: ٤- لِّيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 4. That He may reward Those who believe and work Deeds of righteousness : for such Is Forgiveness and a Sustenance Most Generous.”

arabic_text: ٥- وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي آيَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 5. But those who strive Against Our Signs, to frustrate Them,—for such will be A Penalty,—a Punishment Most humiliating.

arabic_text: ٦- وَيَرَى الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ هُوَ الْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ◯
english_translation: 6.And those to whom Knowledge has come see That the (Revelation) sent down To thee from thy Lord— That is the Truth, And that it guides To the Path of the Exalted (In Might), Worthy Of all praise.

arabic_text: ٧- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُمْ إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 7.The Unbelievers say (In ridicule) : “ Shall we Point out to you a man That will tell you, When ye are all scattered To pieces in disintegration, That ye shall (then be Raised) in a New Creation ?

arabic_text: ٨- أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِ جِنَّةٌ ۗ بَلِ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ فِي الْعَذَابِ وَالضَّلَالِ الْبَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 8. “ Has he invented a falsehood Against God, or has A spirit (seized) him ?”— Nay, it is those who Believe not in the Hereafter, That are in (real) Penalty, And in farthest Error.

arabic_text: ٩- أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَىٰ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِن نَّشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 9. See they not what is Before them and behind them, Of the sky and the earth ? If We wished, We could Cause the earth to swallow Them up, or cause a piece Of the sky to fall upon them. Verily in this is a Sign For every devotee that Turns to God (in repentance).

arabic_text: ١٠- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا ۖ يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ ۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ◯
english_translation: 10.We bestowed Grace aforetime On David from Ourselves : “ O ye Mountains ! sing ye Back the Praises of God With him ! and ye birds (Also) ! And We made The iron soft for him ;—

arabic_text: ١١- أَنِ اعْمَلْ سَابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ ۖ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا ۖ إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 11. (Commanding), “ Make thou Coats of mail, balancing well The rings of chain armour, And work ye righteousness ; For be sure I see (Clearly) all that ye do.”

arabic_text: ١٢- وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 12.And to Solomon (We Made) the Wind (obedient) : Its early morning (stride) Was a month’s (journey), And its evening (stride) Was a month’s (journey) ; And We made a Font Of molten brass to flow For him ; and there were Jinns that worked in front Of him, by the leave Of his Lord, and if any Of them turned aside From Our command, We Made Him taste Of the Penalty Of the Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ١٣- يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ مَا يَشَاءُ مِن مَّحَارِيبَ وَتَمَاثِيلَ وَجِفَانٍ كَالْجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٍ رَّاسِيَاتٍ ۚ اعْمَلُوا آلَ دَاوُودَ شُكْرًا ۚ وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ◯
english_translation: 13. They worked for him As he desired, (making) Arches, Images, Basons As large as Reservoirs, And (cooking) Cauldrons fixed (In their places) : “ Work ye, Sons of David, with thanks ! But few of My servants Are grateful !”

arabic_text: ١٤- فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِ إِلَّا دَابَّةُ الْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ الْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا فِي الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ◯
english_translation: 14.Then, when We decreed (Solomon’s) death, nothing showed them His death except a little Worm of the earth, which Kept (slowly) gnawing away At his staff : so when he Fell down, the Jinns saw Plainly that if they had Known the unseen, they Would not have tarried In the humiliating Penalty (Of their Task).

arabic_text: ١٥- لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ آيَةٌ ۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ ۖ كُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ ۚ بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 15.There was, for Sabā, Aforetime, a Sign in their Home-land—two Gardens To the right and to the left. “ Eat of the Sustenance (provided) By your Lord, and be grateful To Him : a territory fair and happy, And a Lord Oft-Forgiving !”

arabic_text: ١٦- فَأَعْرَضُوا فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَاهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَيْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ وَأَثْلٍ وَشَيْءٍ مِّن سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 16. But they turned away (From God), and We sent Against them the flood (Released) from the Dams, And We converted their two Garden (rows) into “ gardens ” Producing bitter fruit, And tamarisks, and some few (Stunted) Lote-trees.

arabic_text: ١٧- ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيْنَاهُم بِمَا كَفَرُوا ۖ وَهَلْ نُجَازِي إِلَّا الْكَفُورَ◯
english_translation: 17. That was the Requital We gave them because They ungratefully rejected Faith : And never do We give (Such) requital except to such As are ungrateful rejecters.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَى الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا قُرًى ظَاهِرَةً وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا السَّيْرَ ۖ سِيرُوا فِيهَا لَيَالِيَ وَأَيَّامًا آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 18. Between them and the Cities On which We had poured Our blessings, We had placed Cities in prominent positions, And between them We had Appointed stages of journey In due proportion : “ Travel therein, Secure, by night and by day.”

arabic_text: ١٩- فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا بَاعِدْ بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا وَظَلَمُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ وَمَزَّقْنَاهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ◯
english_translation: 19. But they said : “ Our Lord ! Place longer distances Between our journey-stages ” : But they wronged themselves (therein). At length We made them As a tale (that is told), And We dispersed them All in scattered fragments. Verily in this are Signs For every (soul that is) Patiently constant and grateful.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَلَقَدْ صَدَّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُ فَاتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقًا مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. And on them did Satan Prove true his idea, And they followed him, all But a Party that believed.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِالْآخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِي شَكٍّ ۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ◯
english_translation: 21. But he had no authority Over them,—except that We Might test the man who Believes in the Hereafter From him who is in doubt Concerning it : and thy Lord Doth watch over all things.

arabic_text: ٢٢- قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرْكٍ وَمَا لَهُ مِنْهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 22.Say : “ Call upon other (gods) Whom ye fancy, besides God : They have no power,— Not the weight of an atom,— In the heavens or on earth : No (sort of) share have they Therein, nor is any of them A helper to God.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 23. “ No intercession can avail In His Presence, except for those For whom He has granted Permission. So far (is this The case) that, when terror Is removed from their hearts (At the Day of Judgement, then) Will they say, ‘ What is it That your Lord commanded ?’ They will say, ‘ That which is True and just ; and He is The Most High, Most Great ’.”

arabic_text: ٢٤- قُلْ مَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ قُلِ اللَّـهُ ۖ وَإِنَّا أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 24. Say : “ Who gives you Sustenanc, from the heavens And the earth ?” Say : “ It is God ; and certain it is That either we or ye Are on right guidance Or in manifest error !”

arabic_text: ٢٥- قُل لَّا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا أَجْرَمْنَا وَلَا نُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. Say : “ Ye shall not be Questioned as to our sins, Nor shall we be questioned As to what ye do.”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 26. Say : “ Our Lord will gather us Together and will in the end Decide the matter between us (And you) in truth and justice : And He is the One to decide, The One Who knows all.”

arabic_text: ٢٧- قُلْ أَرُونِيَ الَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِ شُرَكَاءَ ۖ كَلَّا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 27. Say : “ Show me those whom Ye have joined with Him As partners : by no means (Can ye). Nay, He is God, The Exalted in Power, The Wise.”

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا كَافَّةً لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. We have not sent thee But as a universal (Messenger) To men, giving them Glad tidings, and warning them (Against sin), but most men Understand not.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. They say : “ When will this Promise (come to pass) If ye are telling the truth ?”

arabic_text: ٣٠- قُل لَّكُم مِّيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَّا تَسْتَأْخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. Say : “ The appointment to you Is for a Day, which ye Cannot put back for an hour Nor put forward.”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ الْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا لَوْلَا أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 31.The Unbelievers say : “ We shall neither believe In this scripture nor in (any) That (came) before it.” Couldst thou but see when The wrong-doers will be made To stand before their Lord, Throwing back the word (of blame) On one another ! Those who Had been despised will say To the arrogant ones : “ Had it not been for you, We should certainly Have been believers !”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَاكُمْ عَنِ الْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. The arrogant ones will say To those who had been despised : “ Was it we who kept you Back from Guidance after It reached you ? Nay, rather, It was ye who transgressed.”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا بَلْ مَكْرُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَا أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِاللَّـهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُ أَندَادًا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَغْلَالَ فِي أَعْنَاقِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. Those who had been despised Will say to the arrogant ones : “ Nay ! it was a plot (Of yours) by day and by night : Behold ! ye (constantly) ordered us To be ungrateful to God And to attribute equals to Him !” They will declare (their) repentance When they see the Penalty : We shall put yokes On the necks of the Unbelievers : It would only be a requital For their (ill) Deeds.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 34.Never did We send A Warner to a population, But the wealthy ones among them Said : “ We believe not In the (Message) with which Ye have been sent.”

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَقَالُوا نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَالًا وَأَوْلَادًا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 35. They said : “ We have more In wealth and in sons, And we cannot be punished.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. Say : “ Verily my Lord enlarges And restricts the Provision To whom He pleases, but Most men understand not.”

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُم بِالَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰ إِلَّا مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَاءُ الضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَهُمْ فِي الْغُرُفَاتِ آمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 37.It is not your wealth Nor your sons, that will Bring you nearer to Us In degree : but only Those who believe and work Righteousness—these are The ones for whom there is A multiplied Reward For their deeds, while Secure they (reside) In the dwellings on high !

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَالَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِي آيَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. Those who strive against Our Signs, to frustrate them, Will be given over Into Punishment.

arabic_text: ٣٩- قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُ ۚ وَمَا أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ ﴿◯
english_translation: 39. Say : “ Verily my Lord enlarges And restricts the Sustenance To such of His servants As He pleases : and nothing Do ye spend in the least (In His Cause) but He Replaces it : for He is The Best of those who Grant Sustenance.

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ أَهَـٰؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 40.One day He will Gather them all together, And say to the angels, “ Was it you that these Men used to worship ?”

arabic_text: ٤١- قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ الْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. They will say, “ Glory to Thee ! Our (tie) is with Thee— As Protector—not with them. Nay, but they worshipped The Jinns : most of them Believed in them.”

arabic_text: ٤٢- فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ نَّفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. So on that Day No power shall they have Over each other, for profit Or harm : and We shall Say to the wrong-doers, “ Taste ye the Penalty Of the Fire,—the which Ye were wont to deny !”

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالُوا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا إِفْكٌ مُّفْتَرًى ۚ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 43.When Our Clear Signs Are rehearsed to them, They say, “ This is only A man who wishes To hinder you from the (worship) Which your fathers practiced.” And they say, “ This is Only a falsehood invented !” And the Unbelievers say Of the Truth when it comes To them, “ This is nothing But evident magic !”

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَمَا آتَيْنَاهُم مِّن كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 44. But We had not given Them Books which they could Study, nor sent apostles To them before thee As Warners.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا مِعْشَارَ مَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا رُسُلِي ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ◯
english_translation: 45. And their predecessors rejected (The Truth) ; these have Not received a tenth Of what We had granted To those : yet when they rejected My apostles, how (terrible) Was My rejection (of them) !

arabic_text: ٤٦- قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَعِظُكُم بِوَاحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا لِلَّـهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَادَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَيْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 46.Say : “ I do admonish you On one point : that ye Do stand up before God,—(It may be) in pairs, Or (it may be) singly,— And reflect (within yourselves) : Your Companion is not Possessed : he is no less Than a Warner to you, In face of a terrible Penalty.”

arabic_text: ٤٧- قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّـهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 47. Say : “ No reward do I Ask of you : it is (all) In your interest : my reward Is only due from God : And He is Witness To all things.”

arabic_text: ٤٨- قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ◯
english_translation: 48. Say : “ Verily my Lord Doth cast the (mantle Of) Truth (over His servants),— He that has full knowledge Of (all) that is hidden.”

arabic_text: ٤٩- قُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ◯
english_translation: 49. Say : “ The Truth has arrived, And Falsehood neither creates Anything new, nor restores Anything.”

arabic_text: ٥٠- قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَا أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي ۖ وَإِنِ اهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِي إِلَيَّ رَبِّي ۚ إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 50. Say : “ If I am astray, I only stray to the loss Of my own soul : but if I receive guidance, it is Because of the inspiration Of my Lord to me : It is He Who hears All things, and is (ever) near.”

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ فَزِعُوا فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 51.If thou couldst but see When they will quake With terror : but then There will be no escape (For them), and they will be Seized from a position (Quite) near.

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَقَالُوا آمَنَّا بِهِ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 52. And they will say, “ We do believe (now) In the (Truth) ” ; but how Could they receive (Faith) From a position (so) far off,—

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 53. Seeing that they did reject Faith (entirely) before, and That they (continually) cast (Slanders) on the Unseen From a position far off ?

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا فِي شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 54. And between them And their desires, Is placed a barrier, As was done in the past With their partisans : For they were indeed In suspicious (disquieting) doubt.

arabic_text: ١- الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولِي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِي الْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: Praise be to God, Who created (out of nothing) The heavens and the earth, Who made the angels Messengers with wings,— Two, or three, or four (Pairs) : He adds to Creation As He pleases : for God Has power over all things.

arabic_text: ٢- مَّا يَفْتَحِ اللَّـهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 2. What God out of His Mercy Doth bestow on mankind There is none can withhold : What He doth withhold, There is none can grant, Apart from Him : And He is the Exalted In Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّـهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّـهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 3.Omen! call to mind The grace of God unto you ! Is there a Creator, other Than God, to give you Sustenance from heaven Or earth ? There is No god but He : how Then are ye deluded Away from the Truth ?

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ◯
english_translation: 4. And if they reject thee, So were apostles rejected Before thee : to God Go back for decision All affairs.

arabic_text: ٥- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّـهِ الْغَرُورُ◯
english_translation: 5. O men ! certainly The promise of God Is true. Let not then This present life deceive you, Nor let the Chief Deceiver Deceive you about God.

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُو حِزْبَهُ لِيَكُونُوا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 6. Verily Satan is an enemy To you : so treat him As an enemy. He only Invites his adherents, That they may become Companions of the Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ٧- الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 7. For those who reject God, Is a terrible Penalty : but For those who believe And work righteous deeds, Is Forgiveness, and A magnificent Reward.

arabic_text: ٨- أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَآهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 8.Is he, then, to whom The evil of his conduct Is made alluring, so That he looks upon it As good, (equal to one Who is rightly guided) ? For God leaves to stray Whom He wills, and guides Whom He wills. So Let not thy soul go out In (vainly) sighing after them : For God knows well All that they do !

arabic_text: ٩- وَاللَّـهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ◯
english_translation: 9. It is God Who sends Forth the Winds, so that They raise up the Clouds, And We drive them To a Land that is dead, And revive the earth therewith After its death : even so (Will be) the Resurrection !

arabic_text: ١٠- مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّـهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ◯
english_translation: 10. If any do seek For glory and power,— To God belong All glory and power. To Him mount up (All) Words of Purity : It is He Who exalts Each Deed of Righteousness. Those that lay Plots Of Evil,— for them Is a Penalty terrible ; And the plotting of such Will be void (of result).

arabic_text: ١١- وَاللَّـهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 11. And God did create You from dust ; Then from a sperm-drop ; Then He made you In pairs. And no female Conceives, or lays down (Her load), but with His Knowledge. Nor is a man Long-lived granted length Of days, nor is a part Cut off from his life, But is in a Decree (Ordained). All this Is easy to God.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. Nor are the two bodies Of flowing water alike,— The one palatable, sweet, And pleasant to drink, And the other, salt And bitter. Yet from each (Kind of water) do ye Eat flesh fresh and tender, And ye extract ornaments To wear ; and thou seest The ships therein that plough The waves, that ye may Seek (thus) of the Bounty Of God that ye May be grateful.

arabic_text: ١٣- يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّـهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 13.He merges Night into Day, And He merges Day Into Night, and He has Subjected the sun and The moon (to His Law) : Each one runs its course For a term appointed. Such is God your Lord : To Him belongs all Dominion. And those whom ye invoke Besides Him have not The least power.

arabic_text: ١٤- إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 14. If ye invoke them, They will not listen To your call, and if They were to listen, They cannot answer Your (prayer). On the Day Of Judgement they will reject Your “Partnership”. And none, (O man !) can tell thee (The Truth) like the One Who is acquainted with all things.

arabic_text: ١٥- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 15.Oye men ! It is Ye that have need Of God : but God is The One Free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ١٦- إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 16. If He so pleased, He Could blot you out And bring in A New Creation :

arabic_text: ١٧- وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ بِعَزِيزٍ◯
english_translation: 17. Nor is that (at all) Difficult for God.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 18. Nor can a bearer of burdens Bear another’s burden. If one heavily laden should Call another to (bear) his load, Not the least portion of it Can be carried (by the other), Even though he be nearly Related. Thou canst but Admonish such as fear Their Lord unseen And establish regular Prayer. And whoever purifies himself Does so for the benefit Of his own soul ; and The destination (of all) Is to God.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 19.The blind and the seeing Are not alike ;

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ◯
english_translation: 20. Nor are the depths Of Darkness and the Light ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ◯
english_translation: 21. Nor are the (chilly) shade And the (genial) heat of the sun :

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِي الْقُبُورِ◯
english_translation: 22. Nor are alike those That are living and those That are dead. God can Make any that He wills To hear ; but thou Canst not make those To hear who are (Buried) in graves.

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 23. Thou art no other Than a warner.

arabic_text: ٢٤- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 24. Verily We have sent thee In truth, as a bearer Of glad tidings, And as a warner : And there never was A people, without a warner Having lived among them (In the past).

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ◯
english_translation: 25. And if they reject thee, So did their predecessors, To whom came their apostles With Clear Signs, Books Of dark prophecies, And the Book Of Enlightenment.

arabic_text: ٢٦- ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ◯
english_translation: 26. In the end did I Punish those who rejected Faith : and how (terrible) Was My rejection (of them) !

arabic_text: ٢٧- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ◯
english_translation: 27.Seest thou not that God sends down rain From the sky ? With it We then bring out produce Of various colours. And in the mountains Are tracts white and red, Of various shades of colour, And black intense in hue.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّـهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 28. And so amongst men And crawling creatures and cattle, Are they of various colours. Those truly fear God, Among His Servants, Who have knowledge : For God is Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving.

arabic_text: ٢٩- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّـهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ◯
english_translation: 29. Those who rehearse the Book Of God, establish regular Prayer, And spend (in Charity) Out of what We have provided For them, secretly and openly, Hope for a Commerce That will never fail :

arabic_text: ٣٠- لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ◯
english_translation: 30. For He will pay them Their meed, nay, He will Give them (even) more Out of His Bounty : For He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (service).

arabic_text: ٣١- وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 31.That which We have revealed To thee of the Book Is the Truth,— confirming What was (revealed) before it : For God is assuredly— With respect to His servants— Well acquainted and Fully Observant.

arabic_text: ٣٢- ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 32. Then We have given the Book for inheritance To such of Our servants As We have chosen : But there are among them Some who wrong their own Souls ; some who follow A middle course ; and some Who are by God’s leave Foremost in good deeds ; That is the highest Grace.

arabic_text: ٣٣- جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 33. Gardens of Eternity will they Enter : therein will they Be adorned with bracelets Of gold and pearls ; And their garments there Will be of silk.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ◯
english_translation: 34. And they will say : “ Praise be to God, Who has removed from us (All) sorrow : for our Lord is indeed Oft-Forgiving Ready to appreciate (service) :

arabic_text: ٣٥- الَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ◯
english_translation: 35. “ Who has, out of His Bounty, Settled us in a Home That will last : no toil nor sense of weariness Shall touch us therein.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ◯
english_translation: 36.But those who reject (God)— For them will be The Fire of Hell : No term shall be determined For them, so they should die, Nor shall its Penalty Be lightened for them. Thus do We reward Every ungrateful one !

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 37. Therein will they cry Aloud (for assistance) : “ Our Lord ! Bring us out : We shall work righteousness, Not the (deeds) we used To do ! ”—“ Did We not Give you long enough life So that he that would Should receive admonition ? And (moreover) the warner Came to you. So taste ye (The fruit of your deeds) : For the Wrong-doers There is no helper.”

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 38.Verily God knows (All) the hidden things Of the heavens and the earth : Verily He has full knowledge Of all that is In (men’s) hearts.

arabic_text: ٣٩- هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا◯
english_translation: 39. He it is that has made You inheritors in the earth : If, then, any do reject (God), their rejection (works) Against themselves : their rejection But adds to the odium For the Unbelievers in the sight of their Lord : Their rejection but adds To (their own) undoing.

arabic_text: ٤٠- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا◯
english_translation: 40. Say : “ Have ye seen (These) ‘ Partners ’ of yours Whom ye call upon Besides God ? ” Show me What it is they have created In the (wide) earth. Or have they a share In the heavens ? Or Have We given them a Book From which they (can derive) Clear (evidence) ?—Nay, the wrong-doers promise Each other nothing but delusions.

arabic_text: ٤١- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 41. It is God Who sustains The heavens and the earth, Lest they cease (to function) : And if they should fail, There is none—not one— Can sustain them thereafter : Verily He is Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّـهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِن جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا◯
english_translation: 42.They swore their strongest oaths By God that if a warner Came to them, they would Follow his guidance better Than any (other) of the Peoples : But when a warner came To them, it has only Increased their flight (From righteousness),—

arabic_text: ٤٣- اسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّـهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّـهِ تَحْوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 43. On account of their arrogance In the land and their Plotting of Evil. But the plotting of Evil Will hem in only The authors thereof. Now Are they but looking for The way the ancients Were dealt with ? But No change wilt thou find In God’s way (of dealing) : No turning off wilt thou Find in God’s way (of dealing).

arabic_text: ٤٤- أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّـهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 44. Do they not travel Through the earth, and see What was the End Of those before them,— Though they were superior To them in strength ? Nor is God to be frustrated By anything whatever In the heavens Or on earth : for He Is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّـهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 45. If God were to punish Men according to what They deserve, He would not Leave on the back Of the (earth) a single Living creature : but He Gives them respite For a stated Term : When their Term expires, Verily God has in His sight All His servants.

arabic_text: ١- يس◯
english_translation: 1.Ya Sin.

arabic_text: ٢- وَالْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. By the Qur-ān, Full of Wisdom,—

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. Thou art indeed One of the apostles,

arabic_text: ٤- عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 4. On a Straight Way.

arabic_text: ٥- تَنزِيلَ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 5. It is a Revelation Sent down by (Him) The Exalted in Might, Most Merciful,

arabic_text: ٦- لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أُنذِرَ آبَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. In order that thou mayest Admonish a people, Whose fathers had received No admonition, and who Therefore remain heedless (Of the Signs of God).

arabic_text: ٧- لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 7.The Word is proved true Against the greater part of them : For they do not believe.

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ أَغْلَالًا فَهِيَ إِلَى الْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. We have put yokes Round their necks Right up to their chins, So that their heads are Forced up (and they cannot see).

arabic_text: ٩- وَجَعَلْنَا مِن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَاهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. And We have put A bar in front of them And a bar behind them, And further, We have Covered them up ; so that They cannot see.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَسَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. The same is it to them Whether thou admonish them Or thou do not admonish Them : they will not believe.

arabic_text: ١١- إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 11.Thou canst but admonish Such a one as follows The Message and fears The (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen : Give such a one, therefore, Good tidings, of Forgiveness And a Reward most generous.

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 12. Verily We shall give life To the dead, and We record That which they send before And that which they leave Behind, and of all things Have We taken account In a clear Book (Of evidence).

arabic_text: ١٣- وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَابَ الْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَاءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 13.Set forth to them, By way of a parable, The (story of) the Companions Of the City. Behold, There came apostles to it.

arabic_text: ١٤- إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. When We (first) sent To them two apostles, They rejected them : But We strengthened them With a third : they said, “ Truly, we have been sent On a mission to you.”

arabic_text: ١٥- قَالُوا مَا أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَا أَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. The (people) said : “ Ye are Only men like ourselves ; And (God) Most Gracious Sends no sort of revelation : Ye do nothing but lie.”

arabic_text: ١٦- قَالُوا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. They said : “ Our Lord doth Know that we have been sent On a mission to you :

arabic_text: ١٧- وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 17. “ And Our duty is only To proclaim the clear Message.”

arabic_text: ١٨- قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 18. The (people) said : “ For us, We augur an evil omen From you : if ye desist not, We will certainly stone you, And a grievous punishment Indeed will be inflicted On you by us.”

arabic_text: ١٩- قَالُوا طَائِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. They said : “ Your evil omens Are with yourselves : (Deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished ? Nay, but ye are a people Transgressing all bounds!”

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَجَاءَ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 20. Then there came running, From the farthest part Of the City, a man, Saying, “ O my People! Obey the apostles :

arabic_text: ٢١- اتَّبِعُوا مَن لَّا يَسْأَلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. “ Obey those who ask No reward of you (For themselves), and who have Themselves received Guidance.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَا لِيَ لَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. “ It would not be reasonable In me if I did not Serve Him Who created me, And to Whom ye shall (All) be brought back.

arabic_text: ٢٣- أَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ◯
english_translation: 23. “ Shall I take (other) gods Besides Him ? If (God) Most Gracious should Intend some adversity for me, Of no use whatever Will be their intercession For me nor, can they Deliver me.

arabic_text: ٢٤- إِنِّي إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 24. “ I would indeed, If I were to do so, Be in manifest Error.

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنِّي آمَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ◯
english_translation: 25. “ For me, I have faith In the Lord of you (all) : Listen, then, to me !”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. It was said : “ Enter thou The Garden.” He said : “ Ah me ! Would that My People knew (what I know) !—

arabic_text: ٢٧- بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. “ For that my Lord Has granted me Forgiveness And has enrolled me Among those held in honour !”

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 28. And We sent not down Against his People, after him. Any hosts from heaven, Nor was it needful For Us so to do.

arabic_text: ٢٩- إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. It was no more than A single mighty Blast, And behold ! they were (like ashes) Quenched and silent.

arabic_text: ٣٠- يَا حَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. Ah ! alas for (My) servants ! There comes not an apostle To them but they mock him !

arabic_text: ٣١- أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. See they not how many Generations before them We destroyed ? Not to them Will they return :

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. But each one of them All—will be Brought before Us (for judgment).

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَاهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 33.ASign for them Is the earth that is dead : We do give it life, And produce grain therefrom, Of which ye do eat.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ◯
english_translation: 34. And We produce therein Orchards with date-palms And vines, and We cause Springs to gush forth therein :

arabic_text: ٣٥- لِيَأْكُلُوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. That they may enjoy The fruits of this (artistry) : It was not their hands That made this : Will they not then give thanks ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. Glory to God, Who created In pairs all things that The earth produces, as well as Their own (human) kind And (other) things of which They have no knowledge.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 37.And a Sign for them Is the Night : We withdraw Therefrom the Day, and behold They are plunged in darkness ;

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ◯
english_translation: 38. And the Sun Runs his course For a period determined For him : that is The decree of (Him) The Exalted in Might The All-Knowing.

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ◯
english_translation: 39. And the Moon,— We have measured for her Mansions (to traverse) Till she returns Like the old (and withered) Lower part of a date-stalk.

arabic_text: ٤٠- لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنبَغِي لَهَا أَن تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. It is not permitted To the Sun to catch up The Moon, nor can The Night outstrip the Day : Each (just) swims along In (its own) orbit (According to Law).

arabic_text: ٤١- وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ◯
english_translation: 41.And a Sign for them Is that We bore Their race (through the flood) In the loaded Ark ;

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. And We have created For them similar (vessels) On which they ride.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. If it were Our Will, We could drown them : Then would there be No helper (to hear Their cry), nor could They be delivered,

arabic_text: ٤٤- إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 44. Except by way of Mercy From Us, and by way Of (worldly) convenience (To serve them) for a time.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 45.When they are told, “ Fear ye that which is Before you and that which Will be after you, in order That ye may receive Mercy,” (They turn back).

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ مِّنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. Not a Sign comes to them From among the Signs Of their Lord, but they Turn away therefrom.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّـهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّـهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 47. And when they are told, “ Spend ye of (the bounties) With which God Has provided you,” the Unbelievers Say to those who believe : “ Shall we then feed those Whom, if God had so willed, He would have fed, (himself) ?— Ye are in nothing But manifest error.”

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 48. Further, they say, “ When Will this promise (come to pass), If what ye say is true ?”

arabic_text: ٤٩- مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. They will not (have To) wait for aught But a single Blast : It will seize them while They are yet disputing Among themselves !

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. No (chance) will they then Have, by will, to dispose (Of their affairs), nor To return to their own people !

arabic_text: ٥١- وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 51.The trumpet shall be Sounded. when behold ! From the sepulchres (men) Will rush forth To their Lord !

arabic_text: ٥٢- قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَن بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. They will say : “ Ah ! Woe unto us ! Who Hath raised us up From our beds of repose ?”… (A voice will say :) “ This is what (God) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word Of the apostles !”

arabic_text: ٥٣- إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. It will be no more Than a single Blast, When lo ! they will all Be brought up before Us !

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. Then, on that Day, Not a soul will be Wronged in the least, And ye shall but Be repaid the meeds Of your past Deeds.

arabic_text: ٥٥- إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ◯
english_translation: 55.Verily the Companions Of the Garden shall That Day have joy In all that they do ;

arabic_text: ٥٦- هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 56. They and their associates Will be in groves Of (cool) shade, reclining On Thrones (of dignity) ;

arabic_text: ٥٧- لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 57. (Every) fruit (enjoyment) Will be there for them ; They shall have whatever They call for ;

arabic_text: ٥٨- سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 58. “ Peace !”—a Word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful !

arabic_text: ٥٩- وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. “And O ye in sin ! Get ye apart this Day !

arabic_text: ٦٠- أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَا بَنِي آدَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطَانَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 60. “ Did I not enjoin On you, O ye children Of Adam, that ye Should not worship Satan ; For that he was to you An enemy avowed ?—

arabic_text: ٦١- وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 61. “ And that ye should Worship Me, (for that) this Was the Straight Way ?

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. “ But he did lead astray A great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand ?

arabic_text: ٦٣- هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. “ This is the Hell Of which ye were (Repeatedly) warned !

arabic_text: ٦٤- اصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. “ Embrace ye the (Fire) This Day, for that ye (Persistently) rejected (Truth).”

arabic_text: ٦٥- الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 65.That Day shall We set A seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak To Us, and their feet Bear witness, to all That they did.

arabic_text: ٦٦- وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. If it had been Our Will, We could surely have Blotted, out their eyes ; Then should they have Run about groping for the Path, But how could they have seen ?

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. And if it had been Our Will, We could Have transformed them (To remain) in their places ; Then should they have been Unable to move about, Nor could they have returned (After error).

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 68.If We grant long life To any, We cause him To be reversed in nature : Will they not then understand ?

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 69.We have not instructed The (Prophet) in Poetry, Nor is it meet for Him : This is no less than A Message and a Qur-ān Making things clear :

arabic_text: ٧٠- لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 70. That it may give admonition To any (who are) alive, And that the charge May be proved against those Who reject (Truth).

arabic_text: ٧١- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 71. See they not that it is We Who have created For them—among the things Which Our hands have fashioned—Cattle, which are under Their dominion ?—

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. And that We have Subjected them to their (use) ? Of them some do carry them And some they eat :

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. And they have (other) profits From them (besides), and they Get (milk) to drink. Will they not then Be grateful ?

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ آلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 74. Yet they take (for worship) Gods other than God, (Hoping) that they might Be helped !

arabic_text: ٧٥- لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. They have not the power To help them : but they Will be brought up (Before Our Judgment-seat) As a troop (to be condemned).

arabic_text: ٧٦- فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 76. Let not their speech, then, Grieve thee. Verily We know What they hide as well as What they disclose.

arabic_text: ٧٧- أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 77.Doth not man see That it is We Who Created Him from sperm ? Yet behold ! he (stands forth) As an open adversary !

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 78. And he makes comparisons For Us, and forgets his own (Origin and) Creation : He says, “ Who can give Life to (dry) bones And decomposed ones (at that) ?”

arabic_text: ٧٩- قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 79. Say, “ He will give them Life Who created them For the first time ! For He is well-versed In every kind of creation !—

arabic_text: ٨٠- الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. “ The same Who produces For you fire out of The green tree, when behold ! Ye kindle therewith (Your own fires) !

arabic_text: ٨١- أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 81. “ Is not He Who created The heavens and the earth Able to create the like Thereof ?”—Yea, indeed ! For He is the Creator Supreme, Of skill and knowledge (infinite) !

arabic_text: ٨٢- إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ◯
english_translation: 82. Verily, when He intends A thing, His Command is, “ Be ”, and it is !

arabic_text: ٨٣- فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 83. So glory to Him In Whose hands is The dominion of all things : And to Him will ye Be all brought back.

arabic_text: ١- وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا◯
english_translation: 1.By those who range Themselves in ranks,

arabic_text: ٢- فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا◯
english_translation: 2. And so are strong In repelling (evil),

arabic_text: ٣- فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا◯
english_translation: 3. And thus proclaim The Message (of God) !

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ◯
english_translation: 4. Verily, verily, your God Is One !—

arabic_text: ٥- رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ◯
english_translation: 5. Lord of the heavens And of the earth, And all between them, And Lord of every point At the rising of the sun !

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ◯
english_translation: 6.We have indeed decked The lower heaven with beauty (In) the stars,—

arabic_text: ٧- وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ◯
english_translation: 7. (For beauty) and for guard Against all obstinate Rebellious evil spirits,

arabic_text: ٨- لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ◯
english_translation: 8. (So) they should not strain Their ears in the direction Of the Exalted Assembly But be cast away From every side,

arabic_text: ٩- دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Repulsed, for they are Under a perpetual penalty,

arabic_text: ١٠- إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ◯
english_translation: 10. Except such as snatch away Something by stealth, and they Are pursued by a flaming Fire, of piercing brightness.

arabic_text: ١١- فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَا ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ◯
english_translation: 11.Just ask their opinion : Are they the more difficult To create, or the (other) beings We have created ? Them have We created Out of a sticky clay !

arabic_text: ١٢- بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. Truly dost thou marvel, While they ridicule,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. And, when they are Admonished, pay no heed,—

arabic_text: ١٤- وَإِذَا رَأَوْا آيَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. And, when they see A Sign, turn it To mockery,

arabic_text: ١٥- وَقَالُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 15. And say, “ This is nothing But evident sorcery !

arabic_text: ١٦- أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. “ What ! when we die, And become dust and bones, Shall we (then) be Raised up (again) ?

arabic_text: ١٧- أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. “ And also our fathers Of old ?”

arabic_text: ١٨- قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. Say thou : “ Yea, and ye shall Then be humiliated (On account of your evil).”

arabic_text: ١٩- فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. Then it will be a single (Compelling) cry ; And behold, they will Begin to see !

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَقَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 20. They will say, “ Ah ! Woe to us ! this is The Day of Judgement !”

arabic_text: ٢١- هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. (A voice will say,) “ This is the Day Of Sorting Out, whose Truth ye (once) denied !”

arabic_text: ٢٢- احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. “Bring ye up”, It shall be said, “ The wrong-doers And their wives, And the things they worshipped—

arabic_text: ٢٣- مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 23. “ Besides God, And lead them to the Way To the (Fierce) Fire !

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْئُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. “ But stop them, For they must be asked :

arabic_text: ٢٥- مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. “ ‘ What is the matter With you that ye Help not each other ? ’ ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.Nay, but that day they Shall submit (to Judgment) ;

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. And they will turn to One another, and question One another.

arabic_text: ٢٨- قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 28. They will say : “ It was ye Who used to come to us From the right hand (Of power and authority) !”

arabic_text: ٢٩- قَالُوا بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. They will reply : “ Nay, ye Yourselves had no Faith !

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ◯
english_translation: 30. “ Nor had we any authority Over you. Nay, it was Ye who were a people In obstinate rebellion !

arabic_text: ٣١- فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا ۖ إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. “ So now has been proved true, Against us, the Word Of our Lord that we Shall indeed (have to) taste (The punishment of our sins).

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. “ We led you astray : for truly We were ourselves astray.”

arabic_text: ٣٣- فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 33.Truly, that Day, they will (All) share in the Penalty.

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 34. Verily that is how We Shall deal with Sinners.

arabic_text: ٣٥- إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. For they, when they were Told that there is No god except God, would Puff themselves up with Pride,

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 36. And say : “ What ! Shall we Give up our gods, For the sake of A Poet possessed ?”

arabic_text: ٣٧- بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. Nay ! he has come With the (very) Truth, And he confirms (the Message Of) the apostles (before him).

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ◯
english_translation: 38. Ye shall indeed taste Of the Grievous Penalty ;—

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. But it will be no more Than the retribution Of (the Evil) that ye Have wrought ;—

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of God,—

arabic_text: ٤١- أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ◯
english_translation: 41. For them is a Sustenance Determined,

arabic_text: ٤٢- فَوَاكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. Fruits (Delights) ; and they (Shall enjoy) honour and dignity,

arabic_text: ٤٣- فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 43. In Gardens of Felicity,

arabic_text: ٤٤- عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. Facing each other On Thrones (of dignity) :

arabic_text: ٤٥- يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ◯
english_translation: 45. Round will be passed To them a Cup From a clear-flowing fountain,

arabic_text: ٤٦- بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. Crystal-white, of a taste Delicious to those Who drink (thereof),

arabic_text: ٤٧- لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. Free from headiness ; Nor will they suffer Intoxication therefrom.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ◯
english_translation: 48. And besides them will be Chaste women, restraining Their glances, with big eyes (Of wonder and beauty).

arabic_text: ٤٩- كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 49. As if they were (Delicate) eggs closely guarded.

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 50.Then they will turn to One another and question One another.

arabic_text: ٥١- قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ◯
english_translation: 51. One of them will start The talk and say : “ I had an intimate Companion (on the earth),

arabic_text: ٥٢- يَقُولُ أَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 52. “ Who used to say, ‘ What ! art thou amongst those Who bear witness to The truth (of the Message) ?

arabic_text: ٥٣- أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. “ ‘ When we die and become Dust and bones, shall we Indeed receive rewards And punishments ? ’ ”

arabic_text: ٥٤- قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. (A voice) said : “ Would ye Like to look down ?”

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 55. He looked down And saw him In the midst of the Fire.

arabic_text: ٥٦- قَالَ تَاللَّـهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ◯
english_translation: 56. He said : “ By God ! Thou wast little short Of bringing me to perdition !

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 57. “ Had it not been for The Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been Among those brought (there) !

arabic_text: ٥٨- أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. “ Is it (the case) that We shall not die,

arabic_text: ٥٩- إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 59. “ Except our first death, And thatweShall not be punished ?”

arabic_text: ٦٠- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 60. Verily this is The supreme achievement !

arabic_text: ٦١- لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. For the like of this Let all strive, Who wish to strive.

arabic_text: ٦٢- أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ◯
english_translation: 62.Is that the better entertainment Or the Tree of Zaqqūm ?

arabic_text: ٦٣- إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 63. For We have truly Made it (as) a trial For the wrong-doers.

arabic_text: ٦٤- إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 64. For it is a tree That springs out Of the bottom of Hell-fire :

arabic_text: ٦٥- طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ◯
english_translation: 65. The shoots of its fruit-stalks Are like the heads Of devils :

arabic_text: ٦٦- فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. Truly they will eat thereof And fill their bellies therewith.

arabic_text: ٦٧- ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 67. Then on top of that They will be given A mixture made of Boiling water.

arabic_text: ٦٨- ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 68. Then shall their return Be to the (Blazing) Fire.

arabic_text: ٦٩- إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا آبَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ◯
english_translation: 69. Truly they found their fathers On the wrong Path ;

arabic_text: ٧٠-فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. So they (too) were rushed Down on their footsteps !

arabic_text: ٧١- وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 71. And truly before them, Many of the ancients Went astray ;—

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 72. But We sent aforetime, Among them, (apostles) To admonish them ;—

arabic_text: ٧٣- فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنذَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 73. Then see what was The End of those who Were admonished (but heeded not),—

arabic_text: ٧٤- إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 74. Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of God.

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, And We are the Best To hear prayer.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 76. And We delivered him And his people from The Great Calamity,

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ◯
english_translation: 77. And made his progeny To endure (on this earth) ;

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 78. And We left (this blessing) For him among generations To come in later times :

arabic_text: ٧٩- سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 79. “ Peace and salutation to Noah Among the nations !”

arabic_text: ٨٠- إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 80. Thus indeed do We reward Those who do right.

arabic_text: ٨١- إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 81. For he was one Of Our believing Servants.

arabic_text: ٨٢- ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 82. Then the rest We overwhelmed In the Flood.

arabic_text: ٨٣- وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ◯
english_translation: 83.Verily among those Who followed his Way Was Abraham.

arabic_text: ٨٤- إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 84. Behold, He approached his Lord With a sound heart.

arabic_text: ٨٥- إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. Behold, he said to his father And to his people, “ What Is that which ye worship ?

arabic_text: ٨٦- أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّـهِ تُرِيدُونَ◯
english_translation: 86. “ Is it a Falsehood— Gods other than God— That ye desire ?

arabic_text: ٨٧- فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 87. “ Then what is your idea About the Lord of the Worlds ?”

arabic_text: ٨٨- فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ◯
english_translation: 88. Then did he cast A glance at the Star,

arabic_text: ٨٩- فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 89. And he said, “ I am Indeed sick (at heart) !”

arabic_text: ٩٠- فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 90. So they turned away From him, and departed.

arabic_text: ٩١- فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 91.Then did he turn To their gods and said, “ Will ye not eat (Of the offerings before you) ?…

arabic_text: ٩٢- مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 92. “ What is the matter With you that ye Speak not (intelligently) ?”

arabic_text: ٩٣- فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 93. Then did he turn Upon them, striking (them) With the right hand.

arabic_text: ٩٤- فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ◯
english_translation: 94. Then came (the worshippers) With hurried steps, And faced (him).

arabic_text: ٩٥- قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ◯
english_translation: 95. He said : “ Worship ye That which ye have (Yourselves) carved ?

arabic_text: ٩٦- وَاللَّـهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 96. “ But God has created you And your handiwork !”

arabic_text: ٩٧- قَالُوا ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 97. They said, “ Build him A furnace, and throw him Into the blazing fire !”

arabic_text: ٩٨- فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 98. (This failing), they then Sought a stratagem against him, But We made them the ones Most humiliated !

arabic_text: ٩٩- وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ◯
english_translation: 99.He said : “ I will go To my Lord ! He Will surely guide me !

arabic_text: ١٠٠- رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 100. “ O my Lord ! grant me A righteous (son) !”

arabic_text: ١٠١- فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 101. So We gave him The good news Of a boy ready To suffer and forbear.

arabic_text: ١٠٢- فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّـهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 102. Then, when (the son) Reached (the age of) (Serious) work with him, He said : “ O my son ! I see in vision That I offer thee in sacrifice : Now see what is Thy view !” (The son) said : “ O my father ! Do As thou art commanded : Thou will find me, If God so wills one Practicing Patience and Constancy !”

arabic_text: ١٠٣- فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ◯
english_translation: 103. So when they had both Submitted their wills (to God), And he had laid him Prostrate on his forehead (For sacrifice),

arabic_text: ١٠٤- وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ◯
english_translation: 104. We called out to him, “ O Abraham !

arabic_text: ١٠٥- قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 105. “ Thou hast already fulfilled The vision !”—thus indeed Do We reward Those who do right.

arabic_text: ١٠٦- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَاءُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 106. For this was obviously A trial—

arabic_text: ١٠٧- وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 107. And We ransomed him With a momentous sacrifice :

arabic_text: ١٠٨- وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 108. And We left (this blessing) For him among generations (To come) in later times :

arabic_text: ١٠٩- سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ◯
english_translation: 109. “ Peace and salutation To Abraham !”

arabic_text: ١١٠- كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 110. Thus indeed do We reward Those who do right.

arabic_text: ١١١- إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 111. For he was one Of Our believing Servants.

arabic_text: ١١٢- وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 112. And We gave him The good news Of Isaac—a prophet,— One of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ١١٣- وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 113. We blessed him and Isaac : But of their progeny Are (some) that do right, And (some) that obviously Do wrong, to their own souls.

arabic_text: ١١٤- وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ◯
english_translation: 114.Again, (of old,) We bestowed Our favour On Moses and Aaron,

arabic_text: ١١٥- وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 115. And We delivered them And their people from (Their) Great Calamity ;

arabic_text: ١١٦- وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 116. And We helped them, So they overcame (their troubles) ;

arabic_text: ١١٧- وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا الْكِتَابَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ◯
english_translation: 117. And We gave them The Book which helps To make things clear ;

arabic_text: ١١٨- وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ◯
english_translation: 118. And We guided them To the Straight Way.

arabic_text: ١١٩- وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 119. And We left (this blessing) For them among generations (To come) in later times :

arabic_text: ١٢٠- سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ◯
english_translation: 120. “ Peace and salutation To Moses and Aaron !”

arabic_text: ١٢١- إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 121. Thus indeed do We reward Those who do right.

arabic_text: ١٢٢- إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 122. For they were two Of Our believing Servants.

arabic_text: ١٢٣- وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 123.So also was Elias Among those sent (by Us).

arabic_text: ١٢٤- إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 124. Behold, he said To his people, “ Will ye not fear (God) ?

arabic_text: ١٢٥- أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 125. “ Will ye call upon Baal And forsake the Best Of Creators,—

arabic_text: ١٢٦- اللَّـهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 126. “ God, your Lord and Cherisher And the Lord and Cherisher Of your fathers of old ?”

arabic_text: ١٢٧- فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 127. But they rejected him, And they will certainly Be called up (for punishment),—

arabic_text: ١٢٨- إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 128. Except the sincere and devoted Servants of God (among them).

arabic_text: ١٢٩- وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 129. And We left (this blessing) For him among generations (To come) in later times :

arabic_text: ١٣٠- سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ◯
english_translation: 130. “ Peace and salutation To such as Elias !”

arabic_text: ١٣١- إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 131. Thus indeed do We reward Those who do right.

arabic_text: ١٣٢- إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 132. For He was one Of Our believing Servants.

arabic_text: ١٣٣- وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 133.So also was Lūt Among those sent (by Us).

arabic_text: ١٣٤- إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 134. Behold, We delivered him And his adherents, all

arabic_text: ١٣٥- إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 135. Except an old woman Who was among those Who lagged behind :

arabic_text: ١٣٦- ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 136. Then We destroyed The rest.

arabic_text: ١٣٧- وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 137. Verily, ye pass By their (sites), By day—

arabic_text: ١٣٨- وَبِاللَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 138. And by night : Will ye not understand ?

arabic_text: ١٣٩- وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 139.So also was Jonah Among those sent (by Us).

arabic_text: ١٤٠- إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ◯
english_translation: 140. When he ran away (Like a slave from captivity) To the ship (fully) laden,

arabic_text: ١٤١- فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ◯
english_translation: 141. He (agreed to) cast lots, And he was condemned :

arabic_text: ١٤٢- فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 142. Then the big Fish Did swallow him, And he had done Acts worthy of blame.

arabic_text: ١٤٣- فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ◯
english_translation: 143. Had it not been That he (repented and) Glorified God,

arabic_text: ١٤٤- لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 144. He would certainly have Remained inside the Fish Till the Day of Resurrection.

arabic_text: ١٤٥- فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 145. But We cast him forth On the naked shore In a state of sickness,

arabic_text: ١٤٦- وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ◯
english_translation: 146. And We caused to grow, Over him, a spreading plant Of the Gourd kind.

arabic_text: ١٤٧- وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ◯
english_translation: 147. And We sent him (On a mission) To a hundred thousand (Men) or more.

arabic_text: ١٤٨- فَآمَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 148. And they believed ; So We permitted them To enjoy (their life) For a while.

arabic_text: ١٤٩- فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 149.Now ask them their opinion : Is it that thy Lord Has (only) daughters, and they Have sons ?—

arabic_text: ١٥٠- أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 150. Or that We created The angels female, and they Are witnesses (thereto) ?

arabic_text: ١٥١- أَلَا إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 151. Is it not that they Say, from their own invention,

arabic_text: ١٥٢- وَلَدَ اللَّـهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 152. “ God has begotten children” ? But they are liars !

arabic_text: ١٥٣- أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ◯
english_translation: 153. Did He (then) choose Daughters rather than sons ?
