arabic_text: ١٥٤- مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 154. What is the matter With you ? How judge ye ?

arabic_text: ١٥٥- أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 155. Will ye not then Receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ١٥٦- أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 156. Or have ye An authority manifest ?

arabic_text: ١٥٧- فَأْتُوا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 157. Then bring ye your Book (Of authority) if ye be Truthful !

arabic_text: ١٥٨- وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 158.And they have invented A blood-relationship Between Him and the Jinns : But the Jinns know (Quite well) that they Have indeed to appear (Before His Judgment-seat) !

arabic_text: ١٥٩- سُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 159. Glory to God ! (He is free) From the things they ascribe (To Him) !

arabic_text: ١٦٠- إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 160. Not (so do) the Servants Of God, sincere and devoted.

arabic_text: ١٦١- فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 161. For, verily, neither ye Nor those ye worship—

arabic_text: ١٦٢- مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 162. Can lead (any) Into temptation Concerning God,

arabic_text: ١٦٣- إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 163. Except such as are (Themselves) going to The blazing Fire !

arabic_text: ١٦٤- وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ◯
english_translation: 164. (Those ranged in ranks say) : “ Not one of us but has A place appointed ;

arabic_text: ١٦٥- وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ◯
english_translation: 165. “ And we are verily Ranged in ranks (for service) ;

arabic_text: ١٦٦- وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ◯
english_translation: 166. “ And we are verily those Who declare (God’s) glory !”

arabic_text: ١٦٧- وَإِن كَانُوا لَيَقُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 167.And there were those Who said,

arabic_text: ١٦٨- لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 168. “ If only we had had Before us a Message From those of old,

arabic_text: ١٦٩- لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 169. “ We should certainly have Been Servants of God, Sincere (and devoted) !”

arabic_text: ١٧٠- فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 170. But (now that the Qur-ān Has come), they reject it : But soon will they know !

arabic_text: ١٧١- وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 171. Already has Our Word Been passed before (this) To Our Servants sent (by Us),

arabic_text: ١٧٢- إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنصُورُونَ◯
english_translation: 172. That they would certainly Be assisted,

arabic_text: ١٧٣- وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 173. And that Our forces,— They surely must conquer.

arabic_text: ١٧٤- فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 174. So turn thou away From them for a little while,

arabic_text: ١٧٥- وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 175. And watch them (how They fare), and they soon Shall see (how thou farest) !

arabic_text: ١٧٦- أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 176.Do they wish (indeed) To hurry on Our Punishment ?

arabic_text: ١٧٧- فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنذَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 177. But when it descends Into the open space Before them, evil will be The morning for those who Were warned (and heeded not) !

arabic_text: ١٧٨- وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 178. So turn thou away From them for a little while,

arabic_text: ١٧٩- وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 179. And watch (how they fare) And they soon shall see (How thou farest) !

arabic_text: ١٨٠- سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 180. Glory to thy Lord, The Lord of Honour And Power ! (He is free) From what they ascribe (To Him) !

arabic_text: ١٨١- وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 181. And Peace on the apostles !

arabic_text: ١٨٢- وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 182. And Praise to God, The Lord and Cherisher Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١- ص ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ◯
english_translation: 1.Sād: By the Qur-ān, Full of Admonition : (This is the Truth).

arabic_text: ٢- بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 2. But the Unbelievers (Are steeped) in Self-glory And Separatism.

arabic_text: ٣- كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ◯
english_translation: 3. How many generations Before them did We destroy ? In the end they cried (For mercy)—when There was no longer time For being saved !

arabic_text: ٤- وَعَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 4.So they wonder That a Warner has come To them from among themselves ! And the Unbelievers say, “ This is a sorcerer Telling lies !

arabic_text: ٥- أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ◯
english_translation: 5. “ Has he made the gods (All) into one God ? Truly this is A wonderful thing ! ”

arabic_text: ٦- وَانطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ◯
english_translation: 6. And the leaders among them Go away (impatiently), (saying), “ Walk ye away, and remain Constant to your gods ! For this is truly A thing designed (against you) !

arabic_text: ٧- مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ◯
english_translation: 7. “ We never heard (the like) Of this among the people Of these latter days : This is nothing but A made-up tale ! ”

arabic_text: ٨- أَأُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ◯
english_translation: 8. “ What ! Has the Message Been sent to him— (Of all persons) among us ? ” But they are in doubt Concerning My (own) Message ! Nay, they have not yet Tasted My Punishment !

arabic_text: ٩- أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ◯
english_translation: 9. Or have they the Treasures Of the Mercy of thy Lord,— The Exalted in Power, The Grantor of Bounties Without measure ?

arabic_text: ١٠- أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 10. Or have they the dominion Of the heavens and the earth And all between ? If so, Let them mount up With the ropes and means (To reach that end) !

arabic_text: ١١- جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ الْأَحْزَابِ◯
english_translation: 11. But there—will be Put to flight even a host Of confederates.

arabic_text: ١٢- كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ◯
english_translation: 12. Before them (were many Who) rejected apostles,— The People of Noah, And ‘Ad, and Pharaoh The Lord of Stakes,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ◯
english_translation: 13. AndThamūd, and the People Of Lūt, and the Companions Of the Wood ;—such were The Confederates.

arabic_text: ١٤- إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 14. Not one (of them) but Rejected the apostles, But My Punishment Came justly and inevitably (On them).

arabic_text: ١٥- وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 15.These (to-day) only wait For a single mighty Blast, Which (when it comes) Will brook no delay.

arabic_text: ١٦- وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 16. They say : “ Our Lord ! Hasten to us our sentence (Even) before the Day Of Account ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧- اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 17. Have patience at what they Say, and remember Our Servant David, the man of strength : For he ever turned (to God).

arabic_text: ١٨- إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ◯
english_translation: 18. It was We that made The hills declare, In unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide And at break of day,

arabic_text: ١٩- وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 19. And the birds gathered (In assemblies) : all with him Did turn (to God).

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ◯
english_translation: 20. We strengthened his kingdom, And gave him wisdom And sound judgment In speech and decision.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ◯
english_translation: 21.Has the Story of The Disputants reached thee ? Behold, they climbed over The wall of the private chamber ;

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ◯
english_translation: 22. When they entered The presence of David, And he was terrified Of them, they said : “ Fear not : We are two Disputants, one of whom Has wronged the other : Decide now between us With truth, and treat us not With unjustice, but guide us To the even Path.

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ◯
english_translation: 23. “ This man is my brother ; He has nine and ninety Ewes, and I have (but) one : Yet he says, ‘ Commit her To my care, ’ and is (moreover) Harsh to me in speech.”

arabic_text: ٢٤- قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 24. (David) said : “ He has Undoubtedly wronged thee In demanding thy (single) ewe To be added to his (flock Of) ewes : truly many Are the Partners (in business) Who wrong each other : Not so do those who believe And work deeds of righteousness, And how few are they ? ”… And David gathered that We Had tried him : he asked Forgiveness of his Lord, Fell down, bowing (In prostration), and turned (To God in repentance).

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ◯
english_translation: 25. So We forgave him This (lapse) : he enjoyed, Indeed, a Near Approach to Us, And a beautiful Place Of (final) Return.

arabic_text: ٢٦- يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 26. O David ! We did indeed Make thee a vicegerent On earth : so judge thou Between men in truth (and justice) : Nor follow thou the lusts (Of thy heart), for they will Mislead thee from the Path Of God : for those who Wander astray from the Path Of God, is a Penalty Grievous, For that they forget The Day of Account.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 27.Not without purpose did We Create heaven and earth And all between ! That Were the thought of Unbelievers ! But woe to the Unbelievers Because of the Fire (of Hell) !

arabic_text: ٢٨- أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ◯
english_translation: 28. Shall We treat those Who believe and work deeds Of righteousness, the same As those who do mischief On earth ? Shall We treat Those who guard against evil, The same as those who Turn aside from the right ?

arabic_text: ٢٩- كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 29. (Here is) a Book which We have sent down Unto thee, full of blessings, That they may meditate On its Signs, and that Men of understanding may Receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 30.To David We gave Solomon (for a son),— How excellent in Our service ! Ever did he turn (to Us) !

arabic_text: ٣١- إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ◯
english_translation: 31. Behold, there were brought Before him at eventide, Coursers of the highest breeding, And swift of foot ;

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ◯
english_translation: 32. And he said, “ Truly Do I love the love Of Good with a view To the glory of my Lord, ”— Until (the sun) was hidden In the veil (of Night) :

arabic_text: ٣٣- رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ◯
english_translation: 33. “ Bring them back to me.” Then began he to pass His hand over (their) legs And their necks.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ◯
english_translation: 34.And We did try Solomon : We placed On his throne a body (Without life) : but he did turn (To Us in true devotion) :

arabic_text: ٣٥- قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ◯
english_translation: 35. He said, “ O my Lord ! Forgive me, and grant me A Kingdom which, (It may be), suits not Another after me : For Thou art the Grantor Of Bounties (without measure).”

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ◯
english_translation: 36. Then We subjected the Wind To his power, to flow Gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,—

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ◯
english_translation: 37. As also the evil ones, (Including) every kind Of builder and diver,—

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ◯
english_translation: 38. As also others bound Together in fetters.

arabic_text: ٣٩- هَـٰذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ◯
english_translation: 39. “ Such are Our Bounties : Whether thou bestow them (On others) or withhold them, No account will be asked.”

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ◯
english_translation: 40. And he enjoyed, indeed, A Near Approach to Us, And a beautiful Place Of (final) Return.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ◯
english_translation: 41.Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord : “ The Evil One has afflicted Me with distress and suffering ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٢- ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ◯
english_translation: 42. (The command was given :) “ Strike with thy foot : Here is (water) wherein To wash, cool and refreshing, And (water) to drink.”

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 43. And We gave him (back) His people and doubled Their number,—as a Grace From Ourselves, and a thing For commemoration, for all Who have Understanding.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِب بِّهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 44. “ And take in thy hand A little grass, and strike Therewith : and break not (Thy oath).” Truly We found Him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service ! Ever did he turn (to Us) !

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ◯
english_translation: 45.And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Possessors of Power and Vision.

arabic_text: ٤٦- إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 46. Verily We did chose them For a special (purpose)— Proclaiming the Message Of the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ◯
english_translation: 47. They were, in Our sight, Truly, of the company Of the Elect and the Good.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ◯
english_translation: 48.And commemorate Ismā‘īl, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl : Each of them was Of the company of the Good.

arabic_text: ٤٩- هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ◯
english_translation: 49.This is a Message (Of admonition) : and verily, For the Righteous, Is a beautiful place Of (final) Return,—

arabic_text: ٥٠- جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ◯
english_translation: 50. Gardens of Eternity, Whose doors will (ever) Be open to them ;

arabic_text: ٥١- مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ◯
english_translation: 51. Therein will they Recline (at ease) ; Therein can they Call (at pleasure) For fruit in abundance, And (delicious) drink ;

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ◯
english_translation: 52. And beside them will be Chaste women restraining Their glances, (companions) Of equal age.

arabic_text: ٥٣- هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 53. Such is the Promise Made to you For the Day of Account !

arabic_text: ٥٤- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِن نَّفَادٍ◯
english_translation: 54. Truly such will be Our Bounty (to you) ; It will never fail ;—

arabic_text: ٥٥- هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ◯
english_translation: 55.Yea, such ! But— For the wrong-doers Will be an evil place Of (final) Return !—

arabic_text: ٥٦- جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ◯
english_translation: 56. Hell !—they will burn Therein,—an evil bed (Indeed, to lie on) !—

arabic_text: ٥٧- هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ◯
english_translation: 57. Yea, such !—Then Shall they taste it,— A boiling fluid, and a fluid Dark, murky, intensely cold !—

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ◯
english_translation: 58. And other Penalties Of a similar kind, To match them !

arabic_text: ٥٩- هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 59. Here is a troop Rushing headlong with you ! No welcome for them ! Truly, they shall burn In the Fire !

arabic_text: ٦٠- قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ◯
english_translation: 60. (The followers shall cry To the misleaders :) “ Nay, ye (too) ! No welcome For you ! It is ye who Have brought this upon us ! Now evil is (this) place To stay in ! ”

arabic_text: ٦١- قَالُوا رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 61. They will say : “ Our Lord ! Whoever brought this upon,— us Add to him a double Penalty in the Fire ! ”

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ الْأَشْرَارِ◯
english_translation: 62. And they will say : “ What has happened to us That we see not men Whom we used to number Among the bad ones ?

arabic_text: ٦٣- أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ◯
english_translation: 63. “ Did we treat them (As such) in ridicule, Or have (our) eyes Failed to perceive them ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٤- إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 64. Truly that is just and fitting,— The mutual recriminations Of the People of the Fire !

arabic_text: ٦٥- قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ◯
english_translation: 65.Say : “ Truly am I A Warner : no god Is there but the One God, Supreme and Irresistible,—

arabic_text: ٦٦- رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ◯
english_translation: 66. “ The Lord of the heavens And the earth, and all Between,—Exalted in Might, Able to enforce His Will, Forgiving again and again.”

arabic_text: ٦٧- قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 67. Say : “ That is a Message Supreme (above all),—

arabic_text: ٦٨- أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 68. “ From which ye Do turn away !

arabic_text: ٦٩- مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. “ No knowledge have I Of the Chiefs on high, When they discuss (Matters) among themselves.

arabic_text: ٧٠- إِن يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 70. “ Only this has been revealed To me : that I am To give warning Plainly and publicly.”

arabic_text: ٧١- إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ◯
english_translation: 71.Behold, thy Lord said To the angels : “ I am About to create man From clay :

arabic_text: ٧٢- فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 72. “ When I have fashioned him (In due proportion) and breathed Into him of My spirit, Fall ye down in obeisance Unto him.”

arabic_text: ٧٣- فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. So the angels prostrated themselves, All of them together :

arabic_text: ٧٤- إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 74. Not so Iblīs : he Was haughty, and became One of those who reject Faith.

arabic_text: ٧٥- قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ◯
english_translation: 75. (God) said : “ O Iblīs ! what prevents thee from Prostrating thyself to one Whom I have created With My hands ? Art thou haughty ? Or art thou one Of the high (and mighty) ones ?”

arabic_text: ٧٦- قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِي مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِن طِينٍ◯
english_translation: 76. (Iblīs) said : “ I am better Than he : Thou createdst Me from fire, and him Thou createdst from clay.”

arabic_text: ٧٧- قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 77. (God) said : “ Then get thee Out from here : for thou Art rejected, accursed.

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 78. “ And My Curse shall be On thee till the Day of Judgement.”

arabic_text: ٧٩- قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. (Iblīs) said : “ O my Lord ! Give me then respite Till the Day The (dead) are raised.”

arabic_text: ٨٠- قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 80. (God) said : “ Respite then Is granted thee—

arabic_text: ٨١- إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ◯
english_translation: 81. “ Till the Day of the Time Appointed.”

arabic_text: ٨٢- قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 82. (Iblīs) said : “ Then, By Thy Power, I will Put them all in the wrong,—

arabic_text: ٨٣- إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ◯
english_translation: 83. “ Except Thy Servants Amongst them, sincere And purified (by Thy grace).”

arabic_text: ٨٤- قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ◯
english_translation: 84. (God) said : “ Then It is just And fitting— and I say what is Just and fitting—

arabic_text: ٨٥- لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 85. “ That I will certainly fill Hell with thee And those that follow thee,— Every one.”

arabic_text: ٨٦- قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ◯
english_translation: 86.Say : “ No reward do I ask Of you for this (Qur-ān), Nor am I a pretender.

arabic_text: ٨٧- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 87. “ This is no less than A Message to (all) The Worlds.

arabic_text: ٨٨- وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 88. “ And ye shall certainly Know the truth of it (all) After a while.”

arabic_text: ١- تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّـهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 1. The revelation Of this Book Is from God, The Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٢- إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ◯
english_translation: 2. Verily it is We Who have Revealed the Book to thee In Truth : so serve God, Offering Him sincere devotion.

arabic_text: ٣- أَلَا لِلَّـهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّـهِ زُلْفَىٰ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ◯
english_translation: 3. Is it not to God That sincere devotion Is due ? But those who Take for protectors other Than God (say) : “ We only Serve them in order that They may bring us nearer To God.” Truly God Will judge between them In that wherein they differ. But God guides not Such as are false And ungrateful.

arabic_text: ٤- لَّوْ أَرَادَ اللَّـهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ ۖ هُوَ اللَّـهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ◯
english_translation: 4.Had God wished To take to Himself A son, He could have Chosen whom He pleased Out of those whom He Doth create : but Glory Be to Him ! (He is above Such things.) He is God, The One, the Irresistible.

arabic_text: ٥- خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ◯
english_translation: 5. He created the heavens And the earth In true (proportions) : He makes the Night Overlap the Day, and the Day Overlap the Night : He has subjected The sun and the moon (To His law) : Each one follows a course For a time appointed. Is not He the Exalted In Power—He Who forgives Again and again ?

arabic_text: ٦- خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّن بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّـهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. He created you (all) From a single Person : Then created of like nature, His mate ; and He Sent down for you eight head Of cattle in pairs : He makes you, In the wombs Of your mothers, In stages, one after another, In three veils of darkness. Such is God, your Lord And Cherisher : to Him belongs (All) dominion. There is No god but He : then How are ye turned away (From your true Center) ?

arabic_text: ٧- إِن تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 7. If ye reject (God), Truly God hath no need Of you ; but He liketh not Ingratitude from His servants : If ye are grateful, He Is pleased with you. No bearer of burdens Can bear the burden Of another. In the End, To your Lord is your Return, When He will tell you The truth of all That ye did (in this life). For He knoweth well All that is in (men’s) hearts.

arabic_text: ٨- وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّـهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 8. When some trouble toucheth man, He crieth unto his Lord, Turning to Him in repentance : But when He bestoweth A favour upon him As from Himself, (man) Doth forget what he cried And prayed for before, And he doth set up Rivals unto God, Thus misleading others From God’s Path. Say, “ Enjoy thy blasphemy For a little while : Verily thou art (one) Of the Companions of the Fire ! ”

arabic_text: ٩- أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْآخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُو رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 9.Is one who worships devoutly During the hours of the night Prostrating himself or standing (In adoration), who takes heed Of the Hereafter, and who Places his hope in the Mercy Of his Lord—(like one Who does not) ? Say : “ Are those equal, those who know And those who do not know ? It is those who are Endued with understanding That receive admonition.

arabic_text: ١٠- قُلْ يَا عِبَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ اللَّـهِ وَاسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ◯
english_translation: 10.Say : “ O ye My servants who believe ! Fear your Lord. Good is (the reward) For those who do good In this world. Spacious is God’s earth ! Those who patiently persevere Will truly receive A reward without measure !”

arabic_text: ١١- قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ◯
english_translation: 11.Say : “ Verily, I am commanded To serve God With sincere devotion ;

arabic_text: ١٢- وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 12. “ And I am commanded To be the first Of those who bow To God in Islam.”

arabic_text: ١٣- قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 13. Say : “ I would, if I Disobeyed my Lord, Indeed have fear Of the Penalty Of a Mighty Day.”

arabic_text: ١٤- قُلِ اللَّـهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ دِينِي◯
english_translation: 14. Say : “ It is God I serve, With my sincere (And exclusive) devotion :

arabic_text: ١٥- فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 15. “ Serve ye what ye will Besides Him.” Say : “ Truly, those in loss Are those who lose Their own souls And their People On the Day of Judgement : Ah ! that is indeed The (real and) evident Loss !

arabic_text: ١٦- لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّـهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ ۚ يَا عِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ◯
english_translation: 16. They shall have Layers Of Fire above them, And Layers (of Fire) Below them : with this Doth God warn off His Servants : “ O My Servants ! Then fear ye Me ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧- وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ◯
english_translation: 17.Those who eschew Evil,— And fall not into Its worship,—and turn To God (in repentance),— For them is Good News : So announce the Good News To My Servants,—

arabic_text: ١٨- الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّـهُ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 18. Those who listen To the Word, And follow The best (meaning) in it : Those are the ones Whom God has guided, and those Are the ones endued With understanding.

arabic_text: ١٩- أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 19. Is, then, one against whom The decree of Punishment Is justly due (equal to one who eschews evil) ? Wouldst thou, then, deliver One (who is) in the Fire ?

arabic_text: ٢٠- لَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّـهُ الْمِيعَادَ◯
english_translation: 20. But it is for those Who fear their Lord, That lofty mansions, One above another, Have been built : Beneath them flow Rivers (of delight) : (such is) The Promise of God : Never doth God fail in (His) promise.

arabic_text: ٢١- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 21. Seest thou not that God Sends down rain from The sky, and leads it Through springs in the earth ? Then He causes to grow, Therewith, produce of various Colours : then it withers ; Thou wilt see it grow yellow ; Then He makes it Dry up and crumble away. Truly, in this, is A Message of remembrance to Men of understanding.

arabic_text: ٢٢- أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّـهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 22.Is one whose heart God has opened to Islam, So that he has received Enlightenment from God, (No better than one hard-hearted) ? Woe to those whose hearts Are hardened against celebrating The praises of God ! They Are manifestly wandering (In error) !

arabic_text: ٢٣- اللَّـهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّـهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ◯
english_translation: 23. God has revealed (From time to time) The most beautiful Message In the form of a Book, Consistent with itself, (Yet) repeating (its teaching In various aspects) : The skins of those who Fear their Lord tremble thereat ; then their skins And their hearts do soften To the celebration of God’s praises. Such is The guidance of God : He guides therewith Whom He pleases, but such As God leaves to stray, Can have none to guide.

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوا مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. Is, then, one who Has to fear the brunt Of the Penalty on the Day of Judgement (and receive it) On his face, (like one Guarded therefrom) ? It will Be said to the wrong-doers : “ Taste ye (the fruits Of) what ye earned ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. Those before them (also) Rejected (revelation), and so The Punishment came to them From directions they did not Perceive.

arabic_text: ٢٦- فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّـهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. So God gave them A taste of humiliation In the present life, But greater is the Punishment Of the Hereafter, If they only knew !

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 27.We have put forth For men, in this Qur-ān Every kind of Parable, In order that they May receive admonition.

arabic_text: ٢٨- قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. (It is) A Qur-ān In Arabic, without any Crookedness (therein) : In order that they May guard against Evil.

arabic_text: ٢٩- ضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. God puts forth a Parable— A man belonging to many Partners at variance with each other, And a man belonging entirely To one master : are those two Equal in comparison ? Praise be to God ! But most of them Have no knowledge.

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. Truly thou wilt die (One day), and truly they (Too) will die (one day).

arabic_text: ٣١- ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. In the End will ye (All), on the Day Of Judgement, settle your disputes In the presence of your Lord.

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 32.Who, then, doth more wrong Than one who utters A lie concerning God, And rejects the Truth When it comes to him Is there not in Hell An abode for blasphemers ?

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ ۙ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. And he who brings the Truth And he who confirms (And supports) it— such are the men who do right.

arabic_text: ٣٤- لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 34. They shall have all That they wish for, In the presence of their Lord : Such is the reward Of those who do good :

arabic_text: ٣٥- لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّـهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. So that God will Turn off from them (Even) the worst in their deeds And give them their reward According to the best Of what they have done.

arabic_text: ٣٦- أَلَيْسَ اللَّـهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ◯
english_translation: 36.Is not God enough For His servant ? But They try to frighten thee With other (gods) besides Him ! For such as God leaves To stray, there can be No guide.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ اللَّـهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انتِقَامٍ◯
english_translation: 37. And such as God doth Guide there can be None to lead astray. Is not God Exalted In Power, (Able to enforce His Will), Lord of Retribution ?

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّـهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّـهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. If indeed thou ask them Who it is that created The heavens and the earth, They would be sure to say, “ God ”. Say : “ See ye then ? The things that ye invoke Besides God,—can they, If God wills some Penalty For me, remove His Penalty ?— Or if He wills some Grace For me, can they keep back His Grace ? ” Say : “ Sufficient Is God for me ! In Him trust those Who put their trust.”

arabic_text: ٣٩- قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. Say : “ O my people ! Do whatever ye can : I will do (my part) : But soon will ye know—

arabic_text: ٤٠- مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 40. “ Who it is to whom Comes a Penalty of ignominy, and on whom Descends a Penalty that abides.”

arabic_text: ٤١- إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 41.Verily We have revealed The Book to thee In Truth, for (instructing) mankind. He, then, that receives guidance Benefits his own soul : But he that strays Injures his own soul. Nor art thou set Over them to dispose Of their affairs.

arabic_text: ٤٢- اللَّـهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرَىٰ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 42.It is God that takes The souls (of men) at death ; And those that die not (He takes) during their sleep : Those on whom He Has passed the decree Of death, He keeps back (from returning to life), But the rest He sends (To their bodies) For a term appointed. Verily in this are Signs for those who reflect.

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ شُفَعَاءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. What ! Do they take For intercessors others Besides God ? Say : “ Even if They have no power whatever And no intelligence ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٤- قُل لِّلَّـهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Say : “ To God belongs Exclusively (the right To grant) Intercession : To Him belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth : In the End, it is to Him That ye shall be Brought back.”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّـهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 45. When God, the One and Only, Is mentioned, the hearts Of those who believe not In the Hereafter are filled With disgust and horror ; But when (gods) other than He Are mentioned, behold, They are filled with joy !

arabic_text: ٤٦- قُلِ اللَّـهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. Say : “ O God ! Creator of the heavens And the earth ! Knower of all that is Hidden and open ! It is Thou that wilt Judge between Thy Servants In those matters about which They have differed.”

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِن سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَحْتَسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 47.Even if the wrong-doers Had all that there is On earth, and as much more, (In vain) would they offer it For ransom from the pain Of the Penalty on the Day Of Judgement : but something Will confront them from God, which they could never Have counted upon !

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. For the evils of their Deeds Will confront them, And they will be (completely) Encircled by that which They used to mock at !

arabic_text: ٤٩- فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ ۚ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. Now, when trouble touches man, He cries to Us : But when We bestow A favour upon him As from Ourselves, He says, “ This has been Given to me because of A certain knowledge (I have) ! ” Nay, but this is But a trial, but most Of them understand not !

arabic_text: ٥٠- قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. Thus did the (generations) Before them say ! But All that they did Was of no profit to them.

arabic_text: ٥١- فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا ۚ وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ◯
english_translation: 51. Nay, the evil results Of their deeds overtook them. And the wrong-doers Of this (generation)—the evil results of their deeds Will soon overtake them (too), And they will never be Able to frustrate (Our Plan) !

arabic_text: ٥٢- أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 52. Know they not that God enlarges the provision Or restricts it, for any He pleases ? Verily, in this are Signs for those who believe !

arabic_text: ٥٣- قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 53.Say : “ O my Servants who Have transgressed against their souls ! Despair not of the Mercy Of God : for God forgives All sins : for He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٥٤- وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 54. “ Turn ye to your Lord (In repentance) and bow To His (Will) Before The Penalty comes on you : After that ye shall not Be helped.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 55. “ And follow the Best Of (the courses) revealed To you from your Lord, before the Penalty comes On you—of a sudden, While ye perceive not !–

arabic_text: ٥٦- أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَا حَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنبِ اللَّـهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 56. “ Lest the soul should (then) Say : ‘ Ah ! woe is me !—In that I neglected (My Duty) towards God, And was but among those Who mocked ! ’—

arabic_text: ٥٧- أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 57. “ Or (lest) it should say : ‘ If only God had guided Me, I should certainly Have been among the righteous ! ’—

arabic_text: ٥٨- أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 58. “ Or (lest) it should say When it (actually) sees the Penalty : ‘ If only I had another chance, I should certainly be Among those who do good ! ’

arabic_text: ٥٩- بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ آيَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 59. “ (The reply will be :) ‘ Nay, But there came to thee My Signs and thou didst Reject them : thou wast Haughty, and became one Of those who reject Faith ! ’ ”

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّـهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 60.On the Day of Judgement Wilt thou see those Who told lies against God ;— Their faces will be turned Black ; is there not In Hell an abode For the Haughty ?

arabic_text: ٦١- وَيُنَجِّي اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. But God will deliver The righteous to their place Of salvation : no evil Shall touch them, Nor shall they grieve.

arabic_text: ٦٢- اللَّـهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ◯
english_translation: 62. God is the Creator Of all things, and He Is the Guardian and Disposer Of all affairs.

arabic_text: ٦٣- لَّهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. To Him belong the keys Of the heavens And the earth : And those who reject The Signs of God,— It is they who will Be in loss.

arabic_text: ٦٤- قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّـهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 64.Say : “ Is it Some one other than God That ye order me To worship, O ye Ignorant ones ? ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 65. But it has already Been revealed to thee,— As it was to those Before thee,—“ If thou Wert to join (gods with God), truly fruitless Will be thy work (in life) And thou wilt surely Be in the ranks of those Who lose (all spiritual good) ”

arabic_text: ٦٦- بَلِ اللَّـهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 66. Nay, but worship God And be of those who Give thanks.

arabic_text: ٦٧- وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّـهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. No just estimate Have they made of God Such as is due to Him : On the Day of Judgement The whole of the earth Will be but His handful, and the heavens will be Rolled up in His right hand : Glory to Him ! High is He above The Partners they attribute To Him !

arabic_text: ٦٨- وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 68. The Trumpet will (just) Be sounded, when all That are in the heavens And on earth will swoon, Except such as it will Please God (to exempt). Then will a second one Be sounded, when, behold, They will be standing And looking on !

arabic_text: ٦٩- وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِيءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. And the Earth will shine With the glory of its Lord : The Record (of Deeds) Will be placed (open) ; The prophets and the witnesses Will be brought forward ; And a just decision Pronounced between them ; And they will not Be wronged (in the least).

arabic_text: ٧٠- وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. And to every soul will be Paid in full (the fruit) Of its deeds ; and (God) knoweth best all that They do.

arabic_text: ٧١- وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 71.The Unbelievers will be Led to Hell in crowd : Until, when they arrive there, Its gates will be opened. And its Keepers will say, “ Did not apostles come To you from among yourselves, Rehearsing to you the Signs Of your Lord, and warning you Of the Meeting of this Day Of yours ? ” The answer Will be : “ True : but The Decree of Punishment Has been proved true Against the Unbelievers ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٢- قِيلَ ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 72. (To them) will be said : “ Enter ye the gates of Hell, To dwell therein : And evil is (this) Abode of the arrogant ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٣- وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 73.And those who feared Their Lord will be led To the Garden in crowds : Until behold, they arrive there ; Its gates will be opened ; And its Keepers will say : “ Peace be upon you ! Well have ye done ! Enter ye here, To dwell therein.”

arabic_text: ٧٤- وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 74. They will say : “ Praise be to God, Who has Truly fulfilled His promise To us, and has given us (This) land in heritage : We can dwell in the Garden as we will : how excellent A reward for those Who work (righteousness) ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٥- وَتَرَى الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 75. And thou wilt see The angels surrounding the Throne (Divine) On all sides, singing Glory And Praise to their Lord. The Decision between them (At Judgment) will be In (perfect) justice, And the cry (on all sides) will be, “ Praise be to God, The Lord of the Worlds ! ”

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّـهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. The revelation Of this Book Is from God, Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge,—

arabic_text: ٣- غَافِرِ الذَّنبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 3. Who forgiveth Sin, Accepteth Repentance, Is Strict in Punishment, And hath a Long Reach (In all things). There is no god But He : to Him Is the Final Goal.

arabic_text: ٤- مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ◯
english_translation: 4.None can dispute About the Signs of God But the Unbelievers. Let not, then, Their strutting about Through the land Deceive thee !

arabic_text: ٥- كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَادَلُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 5. But (there were people) before them, Who denied (the Signs),—The People of Noah, And the Confederates (Of Evil) after them ; And every People plotted Against their prophet, To seize him, and disputed By means of vanities, Therewith to condemn The Truth ; but it was I That seized them ! And how (terrible) Was My Requital !

arabic_text: ٦- وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 6. Thus was the Decree Of thy Lord proved true Against the Unbelievers ; That truly they are Companions of the Fire !

arabic_text: ٧- الَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 7.Those who sustain The Throne (of God) And those around it Sing Glory and Praise To their Lord ; believe In Him ; and implore Forgiveness For those who believe : “ Our Lord ! Thy Reach Is over all things, In Mercy and Knowledge. Forgive, then, those who Turn in Repentance, and follow Thy Path ; and preserve them From the Penalty Of the Blazing Fire !

arabic_text: ٨- رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 8. “ And grant, our Lord ! That they enter The Gardens of Eternity, Which Thou hast promised To them, and to the righteous Among their fathers, Their wives, and their posterity ! For Thou art (He), The Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٩- وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9. “ And preserve them From (all) ills ; And any whom Thou Dost preserve from ills That Day,—on them Wilt Thou have bestowed Mercy indeed : and that Will be truly (for them) The highest Achievement.”

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّـهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 10.The Unbelievers will be Addressed : “ Greater was The aversion of God to you Than (is) your aversion To yourselves, seeing that ye Were called to the Faith And ye used to refuse.”

arabic_text: ١١- قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 11. They will say : “ Our Lord ! Twice hast Thou made us Without life, and twice Hast Thou given us Life ! Now have we recognised Our sins : is there Any way out (of this) ? ”

arabic_text: ١٢- ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّـهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوا ۚ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّـهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ◯
english_translation: 12. (The answer will be :) “ This is because, when God was invoked as The Only (object of worship), Ye did reject Faith, But when partners were Joined to Him, ye believed ! The Command is with God, Most High, Most Great ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣- هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ◯
english_translation: 13.He it is Who showeth You His Signs, and sendeth Down Sustenance for you From the sky : but only Those receive admonition Who turn (to God).

arabic_text: ١٤- فَادْعُوا اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. Call ye, then, upon God With sincere devotion to Him, Even though the Unbelievers May detest it.

arabic_text: ١٥- رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ◯
english_translation: 15. Raised high above ranks (Or degrees), (He is) the Lord Of the Throne (of authority) : By His Command doth He Send the spirit (of inspiration) To any of His servants He pleases, that it may Warn (men) of the Day Of Mutual Meeting,—

arabic_text: ١٦- يَوْمَ هُم بَارِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّـهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ◯
english_translation: 16. The Day whereon They will (all) come forth : Not a single thing Concerning them is hidden From God. Whose will be The Dominion that Day ? That of God, the One, The Irresistible !

arabic_text: ١٧- الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 17. That Day will every soul Be requited for what It earned ; no injustice Will there be that Day, For God is Swift In taking account.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ◯
english_translation: 18.Warn them of the Day That is (ever) drawing near, When the Hearts will (Come) right up to the Throats To choke (them) ; No intimate friend Nor intercessor will the wrong-doers Have, who could be Listened to.

arabic_text: ١٩- يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ الْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي الصُّدُورُ◯
english_translation: 19. (God) knows of (the tricks) That deceive with the eyes, And all that hearts (Of men) conceal.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَاللَّـهُ يَقْضِي بِالْحَقِّ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَيْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 20. And God will judge With (Justice and) Truth : But those whom (men) Invoke besides Him, will Not (be in a position) To judge at all. Verily it is God (alone) Who hears and sees (All things).

arabic_text: ٢١- أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَآثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّـهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مِن وَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 21.Do they not travel Through the earth and see What was the End Of those before them ? They were even superior To them in strength, And in the traces (they Have left) in the land : But God did call them To account for their sins, And none had they To defend them against God.

arabic_text: ٢٢- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَكَفَرُوا فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّـهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 22. That was because there came To them their apostles With Clear (Signs), But they rejected them : So God called them To account : for He is Full of Strength, Strict in Punishment.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 23.Of old We sent Moses, With Our Signs And an Authority manifest,

arabic_text: ٢٤- إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُوا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 24. To Pharaoh, Hāmān, And Qārūn ; but they Called (him) “ a sorcerer Telling lies ! ”…

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا اقْتُلُوا أَبْنَاءَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ وَاسْتَحْيُوا نِسَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ◯
english_translation: 25. Now, when he came to them In Truth, from Us, They said, “ Slay the sons Of those who believe With him, and keep alive Their females, ” but the plots Of Unbelievers (end) in nothing But errors (and delusions) !…

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِي أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِي الْأَرْضِ الْفَسَادَ◯
english_translation: 26. Said Pharaoh : “ Leave me To slay Moses ; and let him Call on his Lord ! What I fear is lest He should change your religion, Or lest he should cause Mischief to appear In the land ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ إِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ◯
english_translation: 27. Moses said : “ I have indeed Called upon my Lord And your Lord (For protection) from every Arrogant one who believes not In the Day of Account ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَانَهُ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّيَ اللَّـهُ وَقَدْ جَاءَكُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَاذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ الَّذِي يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ◯
english_translation: 28.ABeliever, a man From among the people Of Pharaoh, who had concealed His faith, said : “ Will ye Slay a man because he Says, ‘ My Lord is God ’ ?— When he has indeed come To you with Clear (Signs) From your Lord ? And if He be a liar, on him Is (the sin of) his lie ; But, if he is telling The Truth, then will Fall on you something Of the (calamity) of which He warns you : truly God guides not one Who transgresses and lies !

arabic_text: ٢٩- يَا قَوْمِ لَكُمُ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ظَاهِرِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِن بَأْسِ اللَّـهِ إِن جَاءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَا أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَرَىٰ وَمَا أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ◯
english_translation: 29. “ O my People ! yours Is the dominion this day : Ye have the upper hand In the land : but who Will help us from The Punishment of God, Should it befall us ? ” Pharaoh said : “ I but Point out to you that Which I see (myself) ; Nor do I guide you But to the Path of Right ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَقَالَ الَّذِي آمَنَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ◯
english_translation: 30.Then said the man Who believed : “ O my People ! Truly I do fear For you something like The Day (of disaster) Of the Confederates (in sin) !—

arabic_text: ٣١- مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَالَّذِينَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا اللَّـهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ◯
english_translation: 31. “ Something like the fate Of the People of Noah, The ‘Ad, and theThamūd, And those who came After them : but God Never wishes injustice To His Servants.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَيَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ التَّنَادِ◯
english_translation: 32. “ And O my People ! I fear for you a Day When there will be Mutual calling (and wailing),—

arabic_text: ٣٣- يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ◯
english_translation: 33. “ A Day when ye Shall turn your backs And flee : no defender Shall ye have from God : Any whom God leaves To stray, there is none To guide…

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَاءَكُم بِهِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ اللَّـهُ مِن بَعْدِهِ رَسُولًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّـهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ◯
english_translation: 34. “ And to you there came Joseph in times gone by, With Clear Signs, but Ye ceased not to doubt Of the (mission) for which He had come : at length, When he died, ye said : ‘ No apostle will God send After him. ’ Thus doth God Leave to stray such as Transgress and live in doubt,—

arabic_text: ٣٥- الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّـهِ وَعِندَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ◯
english_translation: 35. “ (Such) as dispute about The Signs of God, Without any authority That hath reached them. Grievous and odious (Is such conduct) In the sight of God And of the Believers. Thus doth God seal up Every heart—of arrogant And obstinate transgressors.”

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا هَامَانُ ابْنِ لِي صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّي أَبْلُغُ الْأَسْبَابَ◯
english_translation: 36.Pharaoh said : “ O Hāmān ! Build me a lofty palace, That I may attain The ways and means—

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَسْبَابَ السَّمَاوَاتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّي لَأَظُنُّهُ كَاذِبًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَصُدَّ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِي تَبَابٍ◯
english_translation: 37. “ The ways and means Of (reaching) the heavens, And that I may mount up To the God of Moses : But as far as I am concerned, I think (Moses) is a liar ! ” Thus was made alluring, In Pharaoh’s eyes, The evil of his deeds, And he was hindered From the Path ; and the plot Of Pharaoh led to nothing But perdition (for him).

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَقَالَ الَّذِي آمَنَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ الرَّشَادِ◯
english_translation: 38.The man who believed said Further : “ O my People ! Follow me : I will lead You to the Path of Right.

arabic_text: ٣٩- يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ◯
english_translation: 39. “ O my People ! This life Of the present is nothing But (temporary) convenience : It is the Hereafter That is the Home That will last.

arabic_text: ٤٠- مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ◯
english_translation: 40. “ He that works evil Will not be requited But by the like thereof : And he that works A righteous deed—whether Man or woman—and is A Believer—such will enter The Garden (of Bliss) : therein Will they have abundance Without measure.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَيَا قَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَاةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 41. “ And O my People ! How (strange) it is For me to call you To Salvation while ye Call me to the Fire !

arabic_text: ٤٢- تَدْعُونَنِي لِأَكْفُرَ بِاللَّـهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى الْعَزِيزِ الْغَفَّارِ◯
english_translation: 42. “ Ye do call upon me To blaspheme against God, And to join with Him Partners of whom I have No knowledge ; and I Call you to the Exalted In Power, Who forgives Again and again ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٣- لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَا إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَأَنَّ الْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 43. “ Without doubt ye do call Me to one who is not Fit to be called to, Whether in this world, Or in the Hereafter ; Our Return will be To God ; and the Transgressors Will be Companions Of the Fire !

arabic_text: ٤٤- فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ◯
english_translation: 44. “ Soon will ye remember What I say to you (now). My (own) affair I commit To God : for God (ever) Watches over His Servants.”

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَوَقَاهُ اللَّـهُ سَيِّئَاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا ۖ وَحَاقَ بِآلِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ◯
english_translation: 45.Then God saved him From (every) ill that they Plotted (against him), But the brunt of the Penalty Encompassed on all sides The People of Pharaoh.

arabic_text: ٤٦- النَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ◯
english_translation: 46. In front of the Fire Will they be brought, Morning and evening : And (the Sentence will be) On the Day that Judgment will be established : “ Cast ye the People Of Pharaoh into The severest Penalty ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَإِذْ يَتَحَاجُّونَ فِي النَّارِ فَيَقُولُ الضُّعَفَاءُ لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 47.Behold, they will dispute With each other in the Fire ! The weak ones (who followed) Will say to those who Had been arrogant, “ We but Followed you : can ye then Take (on yourselves) from us Some share of the Fire ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا إِنَّ اللَّـهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ الْعِبَادِ◯
english_translation: 48. Those who had been arrogant Will say : “ We are all In this (Fire) ! Truly, God has judged Between (His) Servants ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ فِي النَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ادْعُوا رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ◯
english_translation: 49. Those in the Fire will say To the Keepers of Hell : “ Pray to your Lord To lighten us the Penalty For a Day (at least) ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٠- قَالُوا أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا فَادْعُوا ۗ وَمَا دُعَاءُ الْكَافِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ◯
english_translation: 50. They will say : “ Did there Not come to you Your apostles with Clear Signs ? ” They will say, “ Yes ”. They will reply, “ Then Pray (as ye like) ! But The Prayer of those Without Faith is nothing But (futile wandering) In (mazes of) error ! ”

arabic_text: ٥١- إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْأَشْهَادُ◯
english_translation: 51.We will, without doubt, Help Our apostles and those Who believe, (both) In this world’s life And on the Day When the Witnesses Will stand forth,—

arabic_text: ٥٢- يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ◯
english_translation: 52. The Day when no profit Will it be to Wrong-doers To present their excuses, But they will (only) have The Curse and the Home Of Misery.

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ◯
english_translation: 53. We did aforetime give Moses The (Book of) Guidance, And We gave the Book In inheritance to the Children Of Israel,—

arabic_text: ٥٤- هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ◯
english_translation: 54. A Guide and a Message To men of understanding.

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ◯
english_translation: 55. Patiently, then, persevere : For the Promise of God Is true : and ask forgiveness For thy fault, and celebrate The Praises of thy Lord In the evening And in the morning.

arabic_text: ٥٦- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَانٍ أَتَاهُمْ ۙ إِن فِي صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَالِغِيهِ ۚ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّـهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 56. Those who dispute About the Signs of God Without any authority Bestowed on them,—there is Nothing in their breasts But (the quest of) greatness, Which they shall never Attain to : seek refuge, Then, in God : it is He Who hears and sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٥٧- لَخَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.Assuredly the creation Of the heavens And the earth Is a greater (matter) Than the creation of men : Yet most men understand not.

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَلَا الْمُسِيءُ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 58. Not equal are the blind And those who (clearly) see : Nor are (equal) those Who believe and work Deeds of righteousness, and Those who do evil. Little do ye learn By admonition !

arabic_text: ٥٩- إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. The Hour will certainly come : Therein is no doubt : Yet most men believe not.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 60. And your Lord says : “ Call on Me ; I Will answer your (Prayer) : But those who are Too arrogant to serve Me Will surely find themselves In Hell—in humiliation ! ”

arabic_text: ٦١- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا فِيهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 61.It is God Who has Made the Night for you, That ye may rest therein, And the Day, as that Which helps (you) to see. Verily God is Full of Grace and Bounty to men : Yet most men give No thanks.

arabic_text: ٦٢- ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّـهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لَّا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. Such is God, your Lord, The Creator of all things. There is no god but He : Then how ye are deluded Away from the Truth !

arabic_text: ٦٣- كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ يَجْحَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 63. Thus are deluded those Who are wont to reject The Signs of God.

arabic_text: ٦٤- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّـهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّـهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 64.It is God Who has Made for you the earth As a resting place, And the sky as a canopy, And has given you shape—And made your shapes Beautiful,—and has provided For you Sustenance, Of things pure and good ;—Such is God your Lord. So Glory to God, The Lord of the Worlds !

arabic_text: ٦٥- هُوَ الْحَيُّ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَادْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ ۗ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّـهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 65. He is the Living (One) : There is no god but He : Call upon Him, giving Him Sincere devotion. Praise be To God, Lord of the Worlds !

arabic_text: ٦٦- قُلْ إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ لَمَّا جَاءَنِيَ الْبَيِّنَاتُ مِن رَّبِّي وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 66.Say : “ I have been forbidden To invoke those whom ye Invoke besides God,—seeing that The Clear Signs have come To me from my Lord ; And I have been commanded To bow (in Islām) To the Lord of the Worlds.”

arabic_text: ٦٧- هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا شُيُوخًا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. It is He Who has Created you from dust, Then from a sperm-drop, Then from a leech-like clot ; Then does He get you Out (into the light) As a child : then lets you (Grow and) reach your age Of full strength ; then Lets you become old,—Though of you there are Some who die before ;—And lets you reach A Term appointed ; In order that ye May learn wisdom.

arabic_text: ٦٨- هُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ◯
english_translation: 68. It is He Who gives Life And Death ; and when He Decides upon an affair, He says to it, “ Be ”, And it is.

arabic_text: ٦٩- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ◯
english_translation: 69.Seest thou not those That dispute concerning The Signs of God ? How are they turned away (From Reality) ?—

arabic_text: ٧٠- الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِالْكِتَابِ وَبِمَا أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. Those who reject the Book And the (revelations) with which We sent Our apostles : But soon shall they know,—

arabic_text: ٧١- إِذِ الْأَغْلَالُ فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ وَالسَّلَاسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 71. When the yokes (shall be) Round their necks, And the chains ; They shall be dragged along—

arabic_text: ٧٢- فِي الْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِي النَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. In the boiling fetid fluid ; Then in the Fire Shall they be burned ;

arabic_text: ٧٣- ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. Then shall it be said To them : “ Where are The (deities) to which Ye gave part-worship—

arabic_text: ٧٤- مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ ۖ قَالُوا ضَلُّوا عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُو مِن قَبْلُ شَيْئًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّـهُ الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 74. “ In derogation of God ? ” They will reply : “ They have Left us in the lurch : Nay, we invoked not, Of old, anything (that had Real existence).” Thus Does God leave The Unbelievers to stray.

arabic_text: ٧٥- ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. “ That was because Ye were wont to rejoice On the earth in things Other than the Truth, And that ye were wont To be insolent.

arabic_text: ٧٦- ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ◯
english_translation: 76. “ Enter ye the gates Of Hell, to dwell therein : And evil is (this) abode Of the arrogant ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٧-فَاصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ الَّذِي نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 77.So persevere in patience ; For the Promise of God Is true : and whether We show thee (in this life) Some part of what We Promise them,—or We Take thy soul (to Our Mercy) (Before that),—(in any case) It is to Us that They shall (all) return.

arabic_text: ٧٨- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِيَ بِآيَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ قُضِيَ بِالْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْمُبْطِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 78. We did aforetime send Apostles before thee : of them There are some whose story We have related to thee, And some whose story We have not related To thee. It was not (Possible) for any apostle To bring a Sign except By the leave of God : But when the Command Of God issued, The matter was decided In truth and justice, And there perished, There and then, those Who stood on Falsehoods.

arabic_text: ٧٩- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَنْعَامَ لِتَرْكَبُوا مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 79.It is God Who made Cattle for you, that ye May use some for riding And some for food ;

arabic_text: ٨٠- وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِي صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. And there are (other) advantages In them for you (besides) ; That ye may through them Attain to any need (There may be) in your hearts ; And on them and on ships Ye are carried.

arabic_text: ٨١- وَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ فَأَيَّ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ تُنكِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 81. And He shows you (always) His Signs : then which Of the Signs of God Will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٨٢- أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَآثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. Do they not travel through The earth and see what Was the End of those Before them ? They were More numerous than these And superior in strength And in the traces (They have left) in the land : Yet all that they accomplished Was of no profit to them.

arabic_text: ٨٣- فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَرِحُوا بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 83. For when their apostles Came to them With Clear Signs, they exulted In such knowledge (and skill) As they had ; but That very (Wrath) at which They were wont to scoff Hemmed them in.

arabic_text: ٨٤- فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِاللَّـهِ وَحْدَهُ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 84. But when they saw Our Punishment, they said : “ We believe in God,—The One God—and we Reject the partners we used To join with Him.”
