arabic_text: ٨٥- فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ اللَّـهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ فِي عِبَادِهِ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. But their professing the Faith When they (actually) saw Our Punishment was not going To profit them. (Such has been) God’s way Of dealing with His servants (From the most ancient times). And even thus did The rejecters of God Perish (utterly) !

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm:

arabic_text: ٢- تَنزِيلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. A revelation from (God), Most Gracious, Most Merciful ;—

arabic_text: ٣- كِتَابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. A Book, whereof the verses Are explained in detail ;—A Qur-ān in Arabic, For people who understand ;—

arabic_text: ٤- بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا فَأَعْرَضَ أَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Giving Good News And Admonition : yet most Of them turn away, And so they hear not.

arabic_text: ٥- وَقَالُوا قُلُوبُنَا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَيْهِ وَفِي آذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَمِن بَيْنِنَا وَبَيْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنَا عَامِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 5.They say : “ Our hearts are Under veils, (concealed) From that to which thou Dost invite us, and In our ears is a deafness, And between us and thee Is a screen : so do Thou (what thou wilt) ; For us, we shall do (What we will !) ”

arabic_text: ٦- قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. Say thou : “ I am But a man like you : It is revealed to me By inspiration, that your God Is One God : so stand True to Him, and ask For His forgiveness. ” And woe to those who Join gods with God,—

arabic_text: ٧- الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. Those who practice not Regular Charity, and who Even deny the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 8. For those who believe And work deeds of righteousness Is a reward that will Never fail.

arabic_text: ٩- قُلْ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَتَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَندَادًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 9.Say : Is it that ye Deny Him Who created The earth in two Days ? And do ye join equals With Him ? He is The Lord of (all) The Worlds.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّائِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. He set on the (earth), Mountains standing firm, High above it, And bestowed blessings on The earth, and measured therein All things to give them Nourishment in due proportion, In four Days, in accordance With (the needs of) Those who seek (sustenance).

arabic_text: ١١- ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيَا طَوْعًا أَوْ كَرْهًا قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 11. Moreover He comprehended In His design the sky, And it had been (as) smoke : He said to it And to the earth : “ Come ye together, Willingly or unwillingly. ” They said : “ We do come (Together), in willing obedience. ”

arabic_text: ١٢- فَقَضَاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ وَأَوْحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَاءٍ أَمْرَهَا ۚ وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَحِفْظًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ◯
english_translation: 12. So He completed them As seven firmaments In two Days, and He Assigned to each heaven Its duty and command. And We adorned The lower heaven With lights, and (provided it) With guard. Such Is the Decree of (Him) The Exalted in Might, Full of knowledge.

arabic_text: ١٣- فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا فَقُلْ أَنذَرْتُكُمْ صَاعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صَاعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَثَمُودَ◯
english_translation: 13.But if they turn away, Say thou : “ I have warned You of a stunning Punishment (As of thunder and lightning) Like that which (overtook) The ‘Ad and theThamūd ! ”

arabic_text: ١٤- إِذْ جَاءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّـهَ ۖ قَالُوا لَوْ شَاءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً فَإِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. Behold, the apostles came To them, from before them And behind them, (preaching) : “ Serve none but God. ” They said, “ If our Lord Had so pleased, He would Certainly have sent down angels (To preach) : now we reject Your mission (altogether). ”

arabic_text: ١٥- فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۖ وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. Now the ‘Ad behaved Arrogantly through the land, Against (all) truth and reason, And said : “ Who is superior To us in strength ? ” What ! Did they not see that God, Who created them, Was superior to them In strength ? But they Continued to reject Our Signs !

arabic_text: ١٦- فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي أَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَخْزَىٰ ۖ وَهُمْ لَا يُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. So We sent against them A furious Wind through days Of disaster, that We might Give them a taste Of a Penalty of humiliation In this Life ; but the Penalty Of a Hereafter will be More humiliating still : And they will find No help.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْنَاهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمَىٰ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتْهُمْ صَاعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُونِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. As to theThamūd, We gave them guidance, But they preferred blindness (Of heart) to Guidance : So the stunning Punishment Of humiliation seized them, Because of what they had earned.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَنَجَّيْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَكَانُوا يَتَّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. But We delivered those Who believed and practiced righteousness.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَيَوْمَ يُحْشَرُ أَعْدَاءُ اللَّـهِ إِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 19.On the Day that The enemies of God Will be gathered together To the Fire, they will Be marched in ranks.

arabic_text: ٢٠- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا مَا جَاءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصَارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. At length, when they reach The (Fire), their hearing, Their sight, and their skins Will bear witness against them, As to (all) their deeds.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَقَالُوا لِجُلُودِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدتُّمْ عَلَيْنَا ۖ قَالُوا أَنطَقَنَا اللَّـهُ الَّذِي أَنطَقَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. They will say to their skins : “ Why bear ye witness Against us ? ” They will say : “ God hath given us speech,—(He) Who giveth speech To everything : He created You for the first time, And unto Him were ye To return.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَن يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلَا جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن ظَنَنتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. “ Ye did not seek To hide yourselves, lest Your hearing, your sight, And your skins should bear Witness against you ! But Ye did think that God Knew not many of the things That ye used to do !

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَذَٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِي ظَنَنتُم بِرَبِّكُمْ أَرْدَاكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 23. “ But this thought of yours Which ye did entertain Concerning your Lord, hath Brought you to destruction, And (now) have ye become Of those utterly lost ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَإِن يَصْبِرُوا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَسْتَعْتِبُوا فَمَا هُم مِّنَ الْمُعْتَبِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. If, then, they have patience, The Fire will be A Home for them ! And if they beg To be received into favour, Into favour will they not (Then) be received.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَقَيَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَاءَ فَزَيَّنُوا لَهُم مَّا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا خَاسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 25. And We have destined For them intimate companions (Of like nature), who made Alluring to them what was Before them and behind them ; And the sentence among The previous generations of Jinns And men, who have passed away, Is proved against them ; For they are utterly lost.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَسْمَعُوا لِهَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَالْغَوْا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.The Unbelievers say : “ Listen not to this Qur-ān, But talk at random In the midst Of its (reading), that ye May gain the upper hand ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. But We will certainly Give the Unbelievers a taste Of a severe Penalty, And We will requite them For the worst of their deeds.

arabic_text: ٢٨- ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ أَعْدَاءِ اللَّـهِ النَّارُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ ۖ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. Such is the requital Of the enemies of God,—The Fire : therein will be For them the Eternal Home : A (fit) requital, for That they were wont To reject Our Signs.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا رَبَّنَا أَرِنَا اللَّذَيْنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ الْأَسْفَلِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. And the Unbelievers will say : “ Our Lord ! Show us those, Among Jinns and men, Who misled us : we shall Crush them beneath our feet, So that they become The vilest (before all). ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّـهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 30.In the case of those Who say, “ Our Lord Is God ”, and, further, Stand straight and steadfast, The angels descend on them (From time to time) : “ Fear ye not ! ” (they suggest), “ Nor grieve ! But receive The Glad Tidings Of the Garden (of Bliss), The which ye were promised !

arabic_text: ٣١- نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. “ We are your protectors In this life and In the Hereafter : Therein shall ye have All that your souls Shall desire ; therein Shall ye have all That ye ask for !—

arabic_text: ٣٢- نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 32. “ A hospitable gift from One Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَا إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 33.Who is better in speech Than one who calls (men) To God, works righteousness, And says, “ I am of those Who bow in Islam ” ?

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَا تَسْتَوِي الْحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُ ۚ ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 34. Nor can Goodness and Evil Be equal. Repel (Evil) With what is better : Then will he between whom And thee was hatred Become as it were Thy friend and intimate !

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا وَمَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 35. And no one will be Granted such goodness Except those who exercise Patience and self-restraint,—None but persons of The greatest good fortune.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّـهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 36. And if (at any time) An incitement to discord Is made to thee By the Evil One, Seek refuge in God. He is the One Who hears and knows All things.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ ۚ لَا تَسْجُدُوا لِلشَّمْسِ وَلَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّـهِ الَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 37.Among His Signs are The Night and the Day, And the Sun and the Moon. Adore not the sun And the moon, but adore God, Who created them, If it is Him ye wish To serve.

arabic_text: ٣٨- فَإِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوا فَالَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْأَمُونَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 38. But if they (Unbelievers) Are arrogant, (no matter) : For in the presence Of thy Lord are those Who celebrate His praises By night and by day. And they never flag (Nor feel themselves above it).

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَحْيَاهَا لَمُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 39. And among His Signs In this : thou seest The earth barren and desolate ; But when We send down Rain to it, it is stirred To life and yields increase. Truly, He Who gives life To the (dead) earth Can surely give life To (men) who are dead. For He has power Over all things.

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا لَا يَخْفَوْنَ عَلَيْنَا ۗ أَفَمَن يُلْقَىٰ فِي النَّارِ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّن يَأْتِي آمِنًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 40.Those who pervert The Truth in Our Signs Are not hidden from Us. Which is better ?—he that Is cast into the Fire, Or he that comes safe through On the Day of Judgement ? Do what ye will : Verily He seeth (clearly) All that ye do.

arabic_text: ٤١- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ ۖ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ◯
english_translation: 41. Those who reject the Message When it comes to them (Are not hidden from Us). And indeed it is a Book Of exalted power.

arabic_text: ٤٢- لَّا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ ۖ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 42. No falsehood can approach it From before or behind it : It is sent down By One Full of Wisdom, Worthy of all Praise.

arabic_text: ٤٣- مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبْلِكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 43. Nothing is said to thee That was not said To the apostles before thee : That thy Lord has At His command (all) Forgiveness As well as a most Grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ ۖ أَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ ۗ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 44. Had We sent this as A Qur-ān (in a language) Other than Arabic, they would Have said : “ Why are not Its verses explained in detail ? What ! (a Book) not in Arabic And (a Messenger) an Arab ? ” Say : “ It is a guide And a healing to those Who believe ; and for those Who believe not, there is A deafness in their ears, And it is blindness in their (eyes) : They are (as it were) Being called from a place Far distant ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 45.We certainly gave Moses The Book aforetime : but disputes Arose therein. Had it not Been for a Word That went forth before From thy Lord, (their differences) Would have been settled Between them : but they Remained in suspicious Disquieting doubt thereon.

arabic_text: ٤٦- مَّنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ◯
english_translation: 46. Whoever works righteousness Benefits his own soul ; Whoever works evil, it is Against his own soul : Nor is thy Lord ever Unjust (in the least) To His servants.

arabic_text: ٤٧- إِلَيْهِ يُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ ۚ وَمَا تَخْرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَاتٍ مِّنْ أَكْمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ يُنَادِيهِمْ أَيْنَ شُرَكَائِي قَالُوا آذَنَّاكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 47. To Him is referred The Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment : He knows all) : No date-fruit comes out Of its sheath nor does A female conceive (within Her womb) nor bring forth (Young), but by His Knowledge. The Day that (God) will propound To them the (question), “ Where are the Partners (Ye attributed) to Me ? ” They will say, “ We do Assure Thee not one Of us can bear witness ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَدْعُونَ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَظَنُّوا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ◯
english_translation: 48. The (deities) they used to invoke Aforetime will leave them In the lurch, and they Will perceive that they Have no way of escape.

arabic_text: ٤٩- لَّا يَسْأَمُ الْإِنسَانُ مِن دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ◯
english_translation: 49.Man does not weary Of asking for good (things), But if ill touches him, He gives up all hope (and) is lost in despair.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِن بَعْدِ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَـٰذَا لِي وَمَا أَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَائِمَةً وَلَئِن رُّجِعْتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي إِنَّ لِي عِندَهُ لَلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍ◯
english_translation: 50. When We give him a taste Of some mercy from Ourselves, After some adversity has Touched him, he is sure To say, “ This is due To my (merit) : I think not That the Hour (of Judgment) Will (ever) Be established ; But if I am brought back To my Lord, I have (much) good (stored) in His sight ! ” But We will show The Unbelievers the truth Of all that they did, And We shall give them The taste of a severe Penalty.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَإِذَا أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَأَىٰ بِجَانِبِهِ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ◯
english_translation: 51.When We bestow favours On man, he turns away, And gets himself remote On his side (instead of Coming to Us) ; and when Evil seizes him, (he comes) Full of prolonged prayer !

arabic_text: ٥٢- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّـهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُم بِهِ مَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 52.Say : “ See ye if The (Revelation) is (really) From God, and yet do ye Reject it ? Who is more Astray than one who Is in a schism Far (from any purpose) ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٣- سَنُرِيهِمْ آيَاتِنَا فِي الْآفَاقِ وَفِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 53. Soon will We show them Our Signs in the (furthest) Regions (of the earth), and In their own souls, until It becomes manifest to them That this is the Truth. Is it not enough that Thy Lord doth witness All things ?

arabic_text: ٥٤- أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُّحِيطٌ◯
english_translation: 54. Ah indeed ! are they In doubt concerning The Meeting with their Lord ? Ah indeed ! it is He That doth encompass All things !

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm;

arabic_text: ٢- عسق◯
english_translation: 2.‘Ain. Sīn. Kāf.

arabic_text: ٣- كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِي إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ اللَّـهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 3. Thus doth (He) send Inspiration to thee As (He did) to those before thee,— God, Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٤- لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 4. To Him belongs all That is in the heavens And on earth : and He Is Most High, Most Great.

arabic_text: ٥- تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِن فَوْقِهِنَّ ۚ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 5. The heavens are almost Rent asunder from above them (By His Glory) : And the angels celebrate The Praises of their Lord, And pray for forgiveness For (all) beings on earth : Behold ! Verily God is He, the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦- وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّـهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 6.And those who take As protectors others besides Him,— God doth watch over them ; And thou art not The disposer of their affairs.

arabic_text: ٧- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوْمَ الْجَمْعِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ فَرِيقٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقٌ فِي السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 7. Thus have We sent By inspiration to thee An Arabic Qur-ān : That thou mayest warn The Mother of Cities And all around her,– And warn (them) of The Day of Assembly, Of which there is no doubt : (When) some will be In the Garden, and some In the Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ٨- وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّـهُ لَجَعَلَهُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 8. If God had so willed, He could have made them A single people ; but He Admits whom He will To His Mercy ; And the wrong-doers Will have no protector Nor helper.

arabic_text: ٩- أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۖ فَاللَّـهُ هُوَ الْوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 9. What ! Have they taken (For worship) protectors Besides Him ? But it is God,—He is the Protector, And it is He Who Gives life to the dead : It is He Who has power Over all things.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّـهُ رَبِّي عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ◯
english_translation: 10.Whatever it be wherein Ye differ, the decision Thereof is with God : Such is God my Lord : In Him I trust, And to Him I turn.

arabic_text: ١١- فَاطِرُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا وَمِنَ الْأَنْعَامِ أَزْوَاجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 11. (He is) the Creator Of the heavens And the earth : He has made For you pairs From among yourselves, And pairs among cattle : By this means does He Multiply you : there is nothing Whatever like unto Him, And He is the One That hears and sees (all things).

arabic_text: ١٢- لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 12. To Him belong the keys Of the heavens and the earth : He enlarges and restricts. The Sustenance to whom He will : for He knows Full well all things.

arabic_text: ١٣- شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ ۖ أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ ۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا تَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَيْهِ ۚ اللَّـهُ يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي إِلَيْهِ مَن يُنِيبُ◯
english_translation: 13. The same religion has He Established for you as that Which He enjoined on Noah–The which We have sent By inspiration to thee–And that which We enjoined On Abraham, Moses, and Jesus : Namely, that ye should remain Steadfast in Religion, and make No divisions therein : To those who worship Other things than God, Hard is the (way) To which thou callest them. God chooses to Himself Those whom He pleases, And guides to Himself Those who turn (to Him).

arabic_text: ١٤- وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 14. And they became divided Only after knowledge Reached them,—through selfish Envy as between themselves. Had it not been For a Word that Went forth before From thy Lord, (Tending) to a Term appointed, The matter would have Been settled between them : But truly those who have Inherited the Book after them Are in suspicious (disquieting) Doubt concerning it.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَادْعُ ۖ وَاسْتَقِمْ كَمَا أُمِرْتَ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۖ وَقُلْ آمَنتُ بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ مِن كِتَابٍ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّـهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمْ ۖ لَنَا أَعْمَالُنَا وَلَكُمْ أَعْمَالُكُمْ ۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ ۖ اللَّـهُ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 15.Now then, for that (reason), Call (them to the Faith), And stand steadfast As thou art commanded, Nor follow thou their vain Desires ; but say : “ I believe In the Book which God has sent down ; And I am commanded To judge justly between you. God is Our Lord And your Lord. For us (Is the responsibility for) Our deeds, and for you For your deeds. There is No contention between us And you. God will Bring us together, And to Him is (Our) final goal.

arabic_text: ١٦- وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّـهِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ حُجَّتُهُمْ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 16. But those who dispute Concerning God after He Has been accepted,— Futile is their dispute In the sight of Their Lord : on them Is Wrath and for them Will be a Penalty Terrible.

arabic_text: ١٧- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ وَالْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 17. It is God Who has Sent down the Book in truth, And the Balance (By which to weigh conduct). And what will make thee Realise that perhaps the Hour Is close at hand ?

arabic_text: ١٨- يَسْتَعْجِلُ بِهَا الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهَا ۖ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مُشْفِقُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا الْحَقُّ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي السَّاعَةِ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 18. Only those wish to Hasten it who believe not In it : those who believe Hold it in awe, And know that it is The Truth. Behold, verily Those that dispute concerning The Hour are far astray.

arabic_text: ١٩- اللَّـهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ◯
english_translation: 19. Gracious is God To His servants : He gives Sustenance To whom He pleases : And He has Power And can carry out His Will.

arabic_text: ٢٠- مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الْآخِرَةِ نَزِدْ لَهُ فِي حَرْثِهِ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرْثَ الدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 20.To any that desires The tilth of the Hereafter, We give increase In his tilth ; and to any That desires the tilth Of this world, We grant Somewhat thereof, but he Has no share or lot In the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٢١- أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوا لَهُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَن بِهِ اللَّـهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةُ الْفَصْلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 21.What ! Have they partners (In godhead), who have Established for them some Religion without the permission Of God ? Had it not Been for the Decree Of Judgement, the matter Would have been decided Between them (at once). But verily the wrong-doers Will have a grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٢٢- تَرَى الظَّالِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا وَهُوَ وَاقِعٌ بِهِمْ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فِي رَوْضَاتِ الْجَنَّاتِ ۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 22. Thou wilt see the wrong-doers In fear on account of what They have earned, and (the burden Of) that must (necessarily) Fall on them. But those Who believe and work Righteous deeds will be In the luxuriant meads Of the Gardens : they shall Have, before their Lord, All that they wish for. That will indeed be The magnificent Bounty (Of God).

arabic_text: ٢٣- ذَٰلِكَ الَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ اللَّـهُ عِبَادَهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ ۗ قُل لَّا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبَىٰ ۗ وَمَن يَقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهُ فِيهَا حُسْنًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ◯
english_translation: 23. That is (the Bounty) whereof God gives Glad Tidings To His Servants who Believe and do righteous deeds. Say : “ No reward do I Ask of you for this Except the love Of those near of kin. ” And if any one earns Any good, We shall give Him an increase of good In respect thereof : for God Is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready To appreciate (service).

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا ۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ اللَّـهُ يَخْتِمْ عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ ۗ وَيَمْحُ اللَّـهُ الْبَاطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ الْحَقَّ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 24.What ! Do they say, “ He has forged a falsehood Against God ” ? But if God Willed, He could seal up Thy heart. And God Blots out Vanity, and proves The Truth by His Words. For He knows well The secrets of all hearts.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. He is the One that accepts Repentance from His Servants And forgives sins : And He knows all That ye do.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَيَسْتَجِيبُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ وَالْكَافِرُونَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 26. And He listens to Those who believe and Do deeds of righteousness, And gives them increase Of His Bounty : but For the Unbelievers there is A terrible Penalty.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَلَوْ بَسَطَ اللَّـهُ الرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِ لَبَغَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍ مَّا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِعِبَادِهِ خَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 27. If God were to enlarge The provision for His Servants, They would indeed transgress Beyond all bounds Through the earth ; But He sends (it) down In due measure As He pleases : For He is with His Servants Well-acquainted, Watchful.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ الْغَيْثَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا قَنَطُوا وَيَنشُرُ رَحْمَتَهُ ۚ وَهُوَ الْوَلِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 28. He is the One that sends down Rain (even) after (men) have Given up all hope, And scatters His Mercy (Far and wide). And He Is the Protector, Worthy Of all Praise.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمْعِهِمْ إِذَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 29. And among His Signs Is the creation of The heavens and the earth, And the living creatures That He has scattered Through them : and He Has power to gather them Together when He wills.

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَمَا أَصَابَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةٍ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَيَعْفُو عَن كَثِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 30.Whatever misfortune Happens to you, is because Of the things your hands Have wrought and for many (Of them) He grants forgiveness.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَمَا أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مِن وَلِيٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 31. Nor can ye frustrate (aught), (Fleeing) through the earth ; Nor have ye besides God Any one to protect Or to help.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ◯
english_translation: 32. And among His Signs Are the ships, smooth-running Through the ocean, (tall) As mountains.

arabic_text: ٣٣- إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ◯
english_translation: 33. If it be His Will, He can still the Wind : Then would they become Motionless on the back Of the (ocean). Verily In this are Signs For everyone who patiently Perseveres and is grateful.

arabic_text: ٣٤- أَوْ يُوبِقْهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُوا وَيَعْفُ عَن كَثِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 34. Or He can cause them To perish because of The (evil) which (the men) Have earned ; but much Doth He forgive.

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍ◯
english_translation: 35. But let those know, who Dispute about Our Signs, That there is for them No way of escape.

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَمَا أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 36.Whatever ye are given (here) Is (but) a convenience Of this Life : but that Which is with God Is better and more lasting : (It is) for those who believe And put their trust In their Lord ;

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَالَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُوا هُمْ يَغْفِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. Those who avoid the greater Crimes and shameful deeds, And, when they are angry Even then forgive ;

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَالَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. Those who hearken To their Lord, and establish Regular prayer ; who (conduct) Their affairs by mutual Consultation ; Who spend out of what We bestow on them For Sustenance ;

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْبَغْيُ هُمْ يَنتَصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. And those who, when An oppressive wrong is inflicted On them, (are not cowed But) help and defend themselves.

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا ۖ فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 40.The recompense for an injury Is an injury equal thereto (In degree) : but if a person Forgives and makes reconciliation, His reward is due From God : for (God) Loveth not those who Do wrong.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَلَمَنِ انتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 41. But indeed if any do Help and defend themselves After a wrong (done) To them, against such There is no cause Of blame.

arabic_text: ٤٢- إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 42. The blame is only Against those who oppress Men with wrong-doing And insolently transgress Beyond bounds through the land, Defying right and justice : For such there will be A Penalty grievous.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ الْأُمُورِ◯
english_translation: 43. But indeed if any Show patience and forgive, That would truly be An exercise of courageous will And resolution in the conduct Of affairs.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن وَلِيٍّ مِّن بَعْدِهِ ۗ وَتَرَى الظَّالِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 44.For any whom God Leaves astray, there is No protector thereafter. And thou wilt see The wrong-doers, when In sight of the Penalty, Say : “ Is there any way (To effect) a return ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 45. And thou wilt see them Brought forward to the (Penalty), In a humble frame of mind Because of (their) disgrace, (And) looking with a stealthy Glance. And the Believers Will say : “ Those are indeed In loss who have given To perdition their own selves And those belonging to them On the Day of Judgement. Behold ! Truly the wrong-doers Are in a lasting Penalty ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّـهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن سَبِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 46. And no protectors have they To help them, Other than God. And for any whom God Leaves to stray, there is No way (to the Goal).

arabic_text: ٤٧- اسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّـهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 47.Hearken ye to your Lord, Before there come a Day Which there will be No putting back, because Of (the ordainment of) God ! That Day there will be For you no place of refuge Nor will there be for you Any room for denial (Of your sins) !

arabic_text: ٤٨- فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ ۗ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ كَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 48. If then they turn away, We have not sent thee As a guard over them. Thy duty is but to convey (The Message). And truly, When We give man A taste of a Mercy From Ourselves, he doth Exult thereat, but When some ill happens To him, on account Of the deeds which His hands have sent forth, Truly then is man ungrateful !

arabic_text: ٤٩- لِّلَّـهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ◯
english_translation: 49.To God belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills (And plans). He bestows (Children) male or female According to His Will (and Plan),

arabic_text: ٥٠- أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 50. Or He bestows both males And females, and He leaves Barren whom He will : For He is full Of knowledge and power.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّـهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 51.It is not fitting For a man that God Should speak to him Except by inspiration, Or from behind a veil, Or by the sending Of a Messenger To reveal, with God’s permission, What God wills : for He Is Most High, Most Wise.

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْإِيمَانُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِي بِهِ مَن نَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 52. And thus have We, By Our command, sent Inspiration to thee : Thou knowest not (before) What was Revelation, and What was Faith ; but We Have made the (Qur-ān) A Light, wherewith We Guide such of Our servants As We will ; and verily Thou dost guide (men) To the Straight Way,—

arabic_text: ٥٣- صِرَاطِ اللَّـهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّـهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ◯
english_translation: 53. The Way of God, To Whom belongs Whatever is in the heavens And whatever is on earth. Behold (how) all affairs Tend towards God !

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Ha-Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 2. By the Book that Makes things clear,—

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. We have made it A Qur-ān in Arabic, That ye may be able To understand (and learn wisdom).

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 4. And verily, it is In the Mother of the Book, In Our Presence, high (In dignity), full of wisdom.

arabic_text: ٥- أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 5.Shall We then Take away the Message From you and repel (you), For that ye are a people Transgressing beyond bounds ?

arabic_text: ٦- وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. But how many were The prophets We sent Amongst the peoples of old ?

arabic_text: ٧- وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. And never came there A prophet to them But they mocked him.

arabic_text: ٨- فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. So We destroyed (them)—Stronger in power than these ;—And (thus) has passed on The Parable of the peoples Of old.

arabic_text: ٩- وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9.If thou wert To question them, ‘ Who created The heavens and the earth ? ’ They would be sure to reply, ‘ They were created by (Him), The Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge ’ ;—

arabic_text: ١٠- الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. (Yea, the same that) Has made for you The earth (like a carpet) Spread out, and has made For you roads (and channels) Therein, in order that ye May find guidance (on the way) ;

arabic_text: ١١- وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. That sends down (From time to time) Rain from the sky In due measure ;— And We raise to life Therewith a land that is Dead ; even so will ye Be raised (from the dead) ;—

arabic_text: ١٢- وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. That has created pairs In all things, and has made For you ships and cattle On which ye ride,

arabic_text: ١٣- لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. In order that ye may Sit firm and square On their backs, and when So seated, ye may Celebrate the (kind) favour Of your Lord, and say, “ Glory to Him Who Has subjected these To our (use), for we Could never have accomplished This (by ourselves),

arabic_text: ١٤- وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. “ And to our Lord, surely, Must we turn back ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 15. Yet they attribute To some of His servants A share with Him (In His godhead) ! Truly is man a blasphemous Ingrate avowed !

arabic_text: ١٦- أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُم بِالْبَنِينَ◯
english_translation: 16.What ! Has He taken Daughters out of what He Himself creates, and granted To you sons for choice ?

arabic_text: ١٧- وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 17. When news is brought To one of them of (the birth Of) what he sets up As a likeness to (God) Most Gracious, his face Darkens, and he is filled With inward grief !

arabic_text: ١٨- أَوَمَن يُنَشَّأُ فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 18. Is then one brought up Among trinkets, and unable To give a clear account In a dispute (to be Associated with God) ?

arabic_text: ١٩- وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَاثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْأَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. And they make into females Angels who themselves serve God. Did they witness Their creation ? Their evidence Will be recorded, and they Will be called to account !

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَقَالُوا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. (“Ah ! ”) they say, “ If It had been the Will Of (God) Most Gracious, We should not have Worshipped such (deities) ! ” Of that they have No knowledge ! They Do nothing but lie !

arabic_text: ٢١- أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. What ! have We given them A Book before this, To which they are Holding fast ?

arabic_text: ٢٢- بَلْ قَالُوا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. Nay ! they say : “ We found Our fathers following A certain religion, And we do guide ourselves By their footsteps. ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. Just in the same way, Whenever We sent a Warner Before thee to any people, The wealthy ones among them Said : “ We found our fathers Following a certain religion, And we will certainly Follow in their footsteps. ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. He said : “ What ! Even if I brought you Better guidance than that Which ye found Your fathers following ? ” They said : “ For us, We deny that ye (prophets) Are sent (on a mission At all). ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 25. So We exacted retribution From them : now see What was the end Of those who rejected (Truth) !

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.Behold ! Abraham said To his father and his people : “ I do indeed clear myself Of what ye worship :

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ◯
english_translation: 27. “ (I worship) only Him Who made me, and He Will certainly guide me. ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. And he left it As a Word To endure among those Who came after him, That they may turn back (To God).

arabic_text: ٢٩- بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 29. Yea, I have given The good things of this life To these (men) and Their fathers, until the Truth Has come to them, And an Apostle Making things clear.

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. But when the Truth came To them, they said : “ This is sorcery, and we Do reject it. ”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 31.Also, they say : “ Why Is not this Qur-ān sent Down to some leading man In either of the two (Chief) cities ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا  سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. Is it they who would portion out The Mercy of thy Lord ? It is We Who portion out Between them their livelihood In the life of this world : And We raise some of them Above others in ranks, So that some may command Work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord Is better than the (wealth) Which they amass.

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَلَوْلَا أَن يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. And were it not that (All) men might become Of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, For everyone that blasphemes Against (God) Most Gracious, Silver roofs for their houses, And (silver) stair-ways On which to go up,

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. And (silver) doors To their houses, and thrones (Of silver) on which They could recline,

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَالْآخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 35. And also adornments Of gold. But all this Were nothing but conveniences Of the present life : The Hereafter, in the sight Of thy Lord, is For the Righteous.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ◯
english_translation: 36.If anyone withdraws himself From remembrance Of (God) Most Gracious, We appoint for him An evil one, to be An intimate companion to him.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. Such (evil ones) really Hinder them from the Path, But they think that they Are being guided aright !

arabic_text: ٣٨- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ◯
english_translation: 38. At length, when (such a one) Comes to Us, he says (To his evil companion) : “ Would that between me And thee were the distance Of East and West ! ” Ah ! Evil is the companion (indeed) !

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. When ye have done wrong, It will avail you nothing, That day, that ye shall be Partners in punishment !

arabic_text: ٤٠- أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 40.Canst thou then make The deaf to hear, or give Direction to the blind Or to such as (wander) In manifest error ?

arabic_text: ٤١- فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. Even if We take thee Away, We shall be sure To exact retribution from them,

arabic_text: ٤٢- أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. Or We shall show thee That (accomplished) which We Have promised them : For verily We shall Prevail over them.

arabic_text: ٤٣- فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 43. So hold thou fast To the Revelation sent down To thee : verily thou Art on Straight Way.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْأَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. The (Qur-ān) is indeed The Message, for thee And for thy people ; And soon shall ye (All) be brought to account.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَاسْأَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 45. And question thou Our apostles Whom We sent before thee ; Did We appoint any deities Other than (God) Most Gracious, To be worshipped ?

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 46.We did send Moses Aforetime, with Our Signs, To Pharaoh and his Chiefs : He said, “ I am an apostle Of the Lord of the Worlds. ”

arabic_text: ٤٧- فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِآيَاتِنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. But when he came to them With Our Signs, behold, They ridiculed them.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. We showed them Sign After Sign, each grater Than its fellow, and We Seized them with Punishment, In order that they Might turn (to Us).

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. And they said, “ O thou Sorcerer ! Invoke thy Lord For us according to His covenant with thee ; For we shall truly Accept guidance. ”

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. But when We removed The Penalty from them, Behold, they broke their word.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِي ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 51. And Pharaoh proclaimed Among his people, saying : “ O my people ! Does not The dominion of Egypt Belong to me, (witness) These streams flowing Underneath my (palace) ? What ! See ye not then ?

arabic_text: ٥٢- أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 52. “ Am I not better Than this (Moses), who Is a contemptible wretch And can scarcely Express himself clearly ?

arabic_text: ٥٣- فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. “ Then why are not Gold bracelets bestowed On him, or (why) Come (not) with him Angels accompanying him In procession ? ”

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 54. Thus did he make Fools of his people, And they obeyed him : Truly were they a people Rebellious (against God).

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا انتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. When at length they Provoked Us, We exacted Retribution from them, and We drowned them all.

arabic_text: ٥٦- فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 56. And We made them (A people) of the Past And an Example To later ages.

arabic_text: ٥٧- وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ◯
english_translation: 57.When (Jesus) the son Of Mary is held up As an example, behold, Thy people raise a clamour Thereat (in ridicule) !

arabic_text: ٥٨- وَقَالُوا أَآلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 58. And they say, “ Are Our gods best, or he ? ” This they set forth To thee, only by way Of disputation : yea, they Are a contentious people.

arabic_text: ٥٩- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ◯
english_translation: 59. He was no more than A servant : We granted Our favour to him, And We made him An example to the Children Of Israel.

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. And if it were Our Will, We could make angels From amongst you, succeeding Each other on the earth.

arabic_text: ٦١- وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 61. And (Jesus) shall be A Sign (for the coming Of) the Hour (of Judgment) : Therefore have no doubt About the (Hour), but Follow ye Me : this Is a Straight Way.

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 62. Let not the Evil One Hinder you : for he is To you an enemy avowed.

arabic_text: ٦٣- وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 63.When Jesus came With Clear Signs, he said : “ Now have I come To you with Wisdom, And in order to make Clear to you some Of the (points) on which Ye dispute : therefore fear God And obey me.

arabic_text: ٦٤- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 64. “ For God, He is my Lord And your Lord : so worship Ye Him : this is A Straight Way. ”

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 65. But sects from among Themselves fell into disagreement : Then woe to the wrong-doers, From the Penalty Of a Grievous Day !

arabic_text: ٦٦- هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. Do they only wait For the Hour—that it Should come on them All of a sudden, While they perceive not ?

arabic_text: ٦٧- الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 67. Friends on that Day Will be foes, one To another,—except The Righteous.

arabic_text: ٦٨- يَا عِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 68.My devotees ! No fear shall be On you that Day, Nor shall ye grieve,—

arabic_text: ٦٩- الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 69.(Being) those who have believed In Our Signs and bowed (Their wills to Ours) in Islām.

arabic_text: ٧٠- ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. Enter ye the Garden, Ye and your wives, In (beauty and) rejoicing.

arabic_text: ٧١- يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 71. To them will be passed Round, dishes and goblets Of gold : there will be There all that the souls Could desire, all that The eyes could delight in : And ye shall abide Therein (for aye).

arabic_text: ٧٢- وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. Such will be the Garden Of which ye are made Heirs for your (good) deeds (In life).

arabic_text: ٧٣- لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 73. Ye shall have therein Abundance of fruit, from which Ye shall have satisfaction.

arabic_text: ٧٤- إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 74.The Sinners will be In the Punishment of Hell, To dwell therein (for aye) :

arabic_text: ٧٥- لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ◯
english_translation: 75. Nowise will the (punishment) Be lightened for them, And in despair will they Be there overwhelmed.

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 76. Nowise shall We Be unjust to them : But it is they who Have been unjust themselves.

arabic_text: ٧٧- وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّاكِثُونَ◯
english_translation: 77. They will cry : “ O Mālik ! Would that thy Lord Put and end to us ! ” He will say, “ Nay, but Ye shall abide ! ”

arabic_text: ٧٨- لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ◯
english_translation: 78.Verily We have brought The Truth to you : But most of you Have a hatred for Truth.

arabic_text: ٧٩- أَمْ أَبْرَمُوا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. What ! Have they settled Some Plan (among themselves) ? But it is We Who Settle things.

arabic_text: ٨٠- أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ◯
english_translation: 80. Or do they think That We hear not Their secrets and their Private counsels ? Indeed (We do), and Our Messengers Are by them, to record.

arabic_text: ٨١- قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ◯
english_translation: 81.Say : “ If (God) Most Gracious Had a son, I would Be the first to worship. ”

arabic_text: ٨٢- سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. Glory to the Lord Of the heavens and the earth, The Lord of the Throne (Of Authority) ! (He is Free) from the things They attribute (to Him) !

arabic_text: ٨٣- فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 83. So leave them to babble And play (with vanities) Until they meet that Day Of theirs, which they Have been promised.

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 84. It is He Who is God In heaven and God on earth ; And He is Full Of Wisdom and Knowledge.

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. And blessed is He To Whom belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth, And all between them : With Him is the knowledge Of the Hour (of Judgment) : And to Him shall ye Be brought back.

arabic_text: ٨٦- وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 86. And those whom they invoke Besides God have no power Of intercession ;—only he Who bears witness to the Truth, And they know (him).

arabic_text: ٨٧- وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّـهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 87. If thou ask them, Who Created them, they will Certainly say, God : how Then are they deluded Away (from the Truth) ?

arabic_text: ٨٨- وَقِيلِهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 88. (God has knowledge) Of the (Prophet’s) cry, “ O my Lord ! Truly These are a people Who will not believe ! ”

arabic_text: ٨٩- فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 89. But turn away from them, And say “ Peace ! ” But soon shall they know !

arabic_text: ١-حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 2. By the Book that Makes things clear ;—

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. We sent it down During a blessed night : For We (ever) wish To warn (against Evil).

arabic_text: ٤- فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 4. In that (night) is made Distinct every affair Of wisdom,

arabic_text: ٥- أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 5. By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) Send (revelations),

arabic_text: ٦- رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 6. As a Mercy From thy Lord : For He hears and knows (All things) ;

arabic_text: ٧- رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 7. The Lord of the heavens And the earth and all Between them, if ye (but) Have an assured faith.

arabic_text: ٨- لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. There is no god but He : It is He Who gives life And gives death,— The Lord and Cherisher To you and your earliest Ancestors.

arabic_text: ٩- بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.Yet they play about In doubt.

arabic_text: ١٠- فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 10. Then watch thou For the Day That the sky will Bring forth a kind Of smoke (or mist) Plainly visible,

arabic_text: ١١- يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11. Enveloping the people : This will be a Penalty Grievous.

arabic_text: ١٢- رَّبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. (They will say :) “ Our Lord ! Remove The Penalty from us, For We do really believe ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣- أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 13. How shall the Message Be (effectual) for them, Seeing that an Apostle Explaining things clearly Has (already) come to them,—

arabic_text: ١٤- ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 14. Yet they turn away From him and say : “ Tutored (By others), a man possessed ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. We shall indeed remove The Penalty for a while, (But) truly ye will revert (To your ways).

arabic_text: ١٦- يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. One day We shall seize You with a mighty onslaught : We will indeed (then) Exact Retribution !

arabic_text: ١٧- وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 17.We did, before them, Try the people of Pharaoh : There came to them An apostle most honourable,

arabic_text: ١٨- أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّـهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ◯
english_translation: 18. Saying : “ Restore to me The servants of God : I am to you an apostle Worthy of all trust ;

arabic_text: ١٩- وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّـهِ ۖ إِنِّي آتِيكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 19. “ And be not arrogant As against God : For I come to you With authority manifest.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ◯
english_translation: 20. “ For me, I have sought Safety with my Lord And your Lord, against Your injuring me.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ◯
english_translation: 21. “ If ye believe me not, At least keep yourselves Away from me. ”

arabic_text: ٢٢- فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. (But they were aggressive :) Then he cried To his Lord : “ These are indeed A people given to sin. ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. (The reply came :) “ March forth with My servants By night : for ye are Sure to be pursued.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. “ And leave the sea As a furrow (divided) : For they are a host (Destined) to be drowned. ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 25. How many were the gardens And springs they left behind,

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 26. And corn-fields And noble buildings,

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. And wealth (and conveniences Of life), wherein they Had taken such delight !

arabic_text: ٢٨- كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 28. Thus (was their end) ! And We made other people Inherit (those things) !

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنظَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. And neither heaven Nor earth shed a tear Over them : nor were They given a respite (again).

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ◯
english_translation: 30.We did deliver aforetime The Children of Israel From humiliating Punishment,

arabic_text: ٣١- مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he Was arrogant (even) among Inordinate transgressors.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. And We chose them aforetime Above the nations, knowingly,

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 33. And granted them Signs In which there was A manifest trial.

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ◯
english_translation: 34.As to these (Quraish), They say forsooth :

arabic_text: ٣٥- إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ◯
english_translation: 35. “ There is nothing beyond Our first death, And we shall not Be raised again.

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَأْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 36. “ Then bring (back) Our forefathers, if what Ye say is true ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. What ! are they better Than the people of Tubba‘ And those who were Before them? We destroyed Them because they were Guilty of sin.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 38.We created not The heavens, the earth, And all between them, Merely in (idle) sport :

arabic_text: ٣٩- مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. We created them not Except for just ends : But most of them Do not understand.

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. Verily the Day of Sorting Out is the time Appointed for all of them,—

arabic_text: ٤١- يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. The Day when no protector Can avail his client In aught, and no help Can they receive,

arabic_text: ٤٢- إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ اللَّـهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 42. Except such as receive God’s Mercy : for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٤٣- إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ◯
english_translation: 43.Verily the tree Of Zaqqūm

arabic_text: ٤٤- طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ◯
english_translation: 44. Will be the food Of the Sinful,—

arabic_text: ٤٥- كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ◯
english_translation: 45. Like molten brass ; It will boil In their insides,

arabic_text: ٤٦- كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ◯
english_translation: 46. Like the boiling Of scalding water.

arabic_text: ٤٧- خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 47. (A voice will cry : “ Seize ye him And drag him Into the midst Of the Blazing Fire !

arabic_text: ٤٨- ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ◯
english_translation: 48. “ Then pour over his head The Penalty of Boiling Water

arabic_text: ٤٩- ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ◯
english_translation: 49. “ Taste thou (this) ! Truly wast thou Mighty, full of honour !

arabic_text: ٥٠- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. “ Truly this is what Ye used to doubt ! ”

arabic_text: ٥١- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ◯
english_translation: 51.As to the Righteous (They will be) in A position of Security,

arabic_text: ٥٢- فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 52. Among Gardens and Springs ;

arabic_text: ٥٣- يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 53. Dressed in fine silk And in rich brocade, They will face each other ;

arabic_text: ٥٤- كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ◯
english_translation: 54. So ; and We shall Join them to Companions With beautiful, big, And lustrous eyes.

arabic_text: ٥٥- يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ آمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. There can they call For every kind of fruit In peace and security ;

arabic_text: ٥٦- لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 56. Nor will they there Taste Death, except the first Death ; and He will preserve Them from the Penalty Of the Blazing Fire,—

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 57. As a Bounty from thy Lord ! That will be The supreme achievement !

arabic_text: ٥٨- فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 58.Verily, We have made This (Qur-ān) easy, In thy tongue, In order that they May give heed.

arabic_text: ٥٩- فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. So wait thou and watch ; For they (too) are waiting.

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّـهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. The revelation Of the Book Is from God The Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 3. Verily in the heavens And the earth, are Signs For those who believe.

arabic_text: ٤- وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. And in the creation Of yourselves and the fact That animals are scattered (Through the earth), are Signs For those of assured Faith.

arabic_text: ٥- وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. And in the alternation Of Night and Day, And the fact that God Sends down Sustenance from The sky, and revives therewith The earth after its death, And the change Of the winds,—are Signs For those that are wise.

arabic_text: ٦- تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّـهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّـهِ وَآيَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. Such are the Signs Of God, which We rehearse to thee In truth : then in what Exposition will they believe After (rejecting) God And His Signs ?

arabic_text: ٧- وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 7.Woe to each sinful Dealer in Falsehoods :

arabic_text: ٨- يَسْمَعُ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 8. He hears the Signs Of God rehearsed to him, Yet is obstinate and lofty, As if he had not Heard them : then announce To him a Penalty Grievous !

arabic_text: ٩- وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 9. And when he learns Something of Our Signs, He takes them in jest : For such there will be A humiliating Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٠- مِّن وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 10. In front of them is Hell : and of no profit To them is anything They may have earned, Nor any protectors they May have taken to themselves Besides God : for them Is a tremendous Penalty.

arabic_text: ١١- هَـٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11.This is (true) Guidance : And for those who reject The Signs of their Lord, Is a grievous Penalty Of abomination.

arabic_text: ١٢- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 12.It is God Who has Subjected the sea to you, That ships may sail Through it by His command, That ye may seek Of His Bounty, and that Ye may be grateful.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. And He has subjected To you, as from Him, All that is in the heavens And on earth : behold, In that are Signs indeed For those who reflect.

arabic_text: ١٤- قُل لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّـهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. Tell those who believe, To forgive those who Do not look forward To the Days of God : It is for Him to recompense (For good or ill) each People According to what They have earned.

arabic_text: ١٥- مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. If any one does A righteous deed It enures to the benefit Of his own soul ; If he does evil, It works against (His own soul). In the end will ye (All) be brought back To your Lord.

arabic_text: ١٦- وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 16.We did aforetime Grant to the Children Of Israel the Book, The Power of Command, And Prophethood ; We gave Them, for Sustenance, things Good and pure ; and We Favoured them above the nations.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَآتَيْنَاهُم بَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. And We granted them Clear Signs in affairs (Of Religion) : it was only After knowledge had been Granted to them that they Fell into schisms, through Insolent envy among themselves. Verily thy Lord will judge Between them on the Day Of Judgement as to those Matters in which they Set up differences.

arabic_text: ١٨- ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. Then We put thee On the (right) Way Of Religion : so follow Thou that (Way), And follow not the desires Of those who know not.

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا عَنكَ مِنَ اللَّـهِ شَيْئًا ۚ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 19. They will be of no Use to thee in the sight Of God : it is only Wrong-doers (that stand as) Protectors, one to another : But God is the Protector Of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ٢٠- هَـٰذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. These are clear evidences To men, and a Guidance And Mercy to those Of assured Faith.

arabic_text: ٢١- أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. What ! do those who Seek after evil ways Think that We shall Hold them equal with Those who believe and Do righteous deeds,—that Equal will be their Life and their death ? Ill is the judgment That they make.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَخَلَقَ اللَّـهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 22.God created the heavens And the earth for Just ends, and in order That each soul may find The recompense of what It has earned, and none Of them be wronged.

arabic_text: ٢٣- أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِن بَعْدِ اللَّـهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. Then seest thou such A one as takes As his god his own Vain desire ? God has, Knowing (him as such), Left him astray, and sealed His hearing and his heart (And understanding), and put A cover on his sight. Who, then, will guide him After God (has withdrawn Guidance) ? Will ye not Then receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَقَالُوا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ◯
english_translation: 24. And they say : “ What is There but our life In this world ? We shall die and we live, And nothing but Time Can destroy us. ” But Of that they have no Knowledge : they merely conjecture :

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا ائْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 25. And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, Their argument is nothing But this : they say, “ Bring (Back) our forefathers, if What ye say is true ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- قُلِ اللَّـهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. Say : “ It is God Who Gives you life, then Gives you death ; then He will gather you together For the Day of Judgement About which there is No doubt ” : but most Men do not understand.

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَلِلَّـهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 27.To God belongs The dominion of the heavens And the earth, and The Day that the Hour Of Judgment is established,—That Day will the dealers In Falsehood perish !

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰ إِلَىٰ كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. And thou wilt see Every sect bowing the knee : Every sect will be called To its Record : “ This Day Shall ye be recompensed For all that ye did !

arabic_text: ٢٩- هَـٰذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
