english_translation: 29. “ This Our Record speaks About you with truth : For We were wont To put on record All that ye did. ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 30.Then, as to those who Believed and did righteous Deeds, their Lord will Admit them to His Mercy : That will be the Achievement For all to see.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. But as to those who Rejected God, (to them Will be said) : “ Were not Our Signs rehearsed to you ? But ye were arrogant, And were a people Given to sin !

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. “ And when it was said That the promise of God Was true, and that the Hour—There was no doubt About its (coming), ye Used to say, ‘ We Know not what is The Hour : we only think It is an idea, and we Have no firm assurance. ’ ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. Then will appear to them The evil (fruits) of what They did, and they will be Completely encircled by that Which they used to mock at !

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 34.It will also be said : “ This Day We will forget You as ye forgot The meeting of this Day Of yours ! And your Abode is the Fire, and No helpers have ye !

arabic_text: ٣٥- ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. “ This, because ye used To take the Signs of God In jest, and the life Of the world deceived you : ” (From) the Day, therefore, They shall not be taken out Thence, nor shall they be Received into Grace.

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَلِلَّـهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 36.Then Praise be to God, Lord of the heavens And Lord of the earth,—Lord and Cherisher Of all the worlds !

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 37. To Him be Glory Throughout the heavens And the earth : and He Is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom !

arabic_text: ١- حم◯
english_translation: 1.Hā-Mīm.

arabic_text: ٢- تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّـهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. The revelation Of the Book Is from God The Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣- مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَمَّا أُنذِرُوا مُعْرِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. We created not The heavens and the earth And all between them But for just ends, and For a term appointed : But those who reject Faith Turn away from that Whereof they are warned.

arabic_text: ٤- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ۖ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 4. Say : “Do ye see What it is ye invoke Besides God ? Show me What it is they Have created on earth, Or have they a share In the heavens ? Bring me a Book (Revealed) before this, Or any remnant of knowledge (Ye may have), if ye Are telling the truth !

arabic_text: ٥- وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُو مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. And who is more astray Than one who invokes, Besides God, such as will Not answer him to the Day Of Judgement, and who (In fact) are unconscious Of their call (to them) ?

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. And when mankind Are gathered together (At the Resurrection), They will be hostile To them and reject Their worship (altogether) !

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 7.When Our Clear Signs Are rehearsed to them, The Unbelievers say, Of the Truth When it comes to them : “ This is evident sorcery ! ”

arabic_text: ٨- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّـهِ شَيْئًا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 8. Or do they say, “ He has forged it ” ? Say : “ Had I forged it, Then can ye obtain No single (blessing) for me From God. He knows best Of that whereof ye talk (So glibly) ! Enough is He For a witness between me And you ! And He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful. ”

arabic_text: ٩- قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Say : “ I am no bringer Of new-fangled doctrine Among the apostles, nor Do I know what will Be done with me or With you. I follow But that which is revealed To me by inspiration ; I am but a Warner Open and clear. ”

arabic_text: ١٠- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّـهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ فَآمَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. Say : “ See ye ? If (this teaching) be From God, and ye reject it, And a witness from among The Children of Israel testifies To its similarity (With earlier scriptures), And has believed While ye are arrogant (How unjust ye are !) Truly, God guides not A people unjust. ”

arabic_text: ١١- وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11.The Unbelievers say Of those who believe : “ If (this Message) were A good thing, (such men) Would not have gone To it first, before us ! ” And seeing that they Guide not themselves thereby, They will say, “ This is An (old,) old falsehood ! ”

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتَابٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 12. And before this, was The Book of Moses As a guide and a mercy : And this Book confirms (it) In the Arabic tongue ; To admonish the unjust, And as Glad Tidings To those who do right.

arabic_text: ١٣- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّـهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. Verily those who say, “ Our Lord is God, ” And remain firm (On that Path),— On them shall be no fear, Nor shall they grieve.

arabic_text: ١٤- أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. Such shall be Companions Of the Garden, dwelling Therein (for aye) : a recompense For their (good) deeds.

arabic_text: ١٥- وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 15. We have enjoined on man Kindness to his parents : In pain did his mother Bear him, and in pain Did she give him birth. The carrying of the (child) To his weaning is (A period of) thirty months. At length, when he reaches The age of full strength And attains forty years, He says “ O my Lord! Grant me that I may be Grateful for Thy favour Which Thou hast bestowed Upon me, and upon both My parents, and that I May work righteousness Such as Thou mayest approve ; And be gracious to me In my issue. Truly Have I turned to Thee And truly do I bow (To Thee) in Islam. ”

arabic_text: ١٦- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. Such are they from whom We shall accept the best Of their deeds and pass by Their ill deeds : (they shall Be) among the Companions Of the Garden : a promise Of truth, which was Made to them (In this life).

arabic_text: ١٧- وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّـهَ وَيْلَكَ آمِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّـهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 17.But (there is one) Who says to his parents, “ Fie on you ! Do ye Hold out the promise To me that I Shall be raised up, Even though generations Have passed before me (Without rising again) ? ” And they two seek God’s aid, (and rebuke The son) : “ Woe to thee ! Have Faith ! For the promise Of God is true. ” But he says, “ This is Nothing but tales Of the ancients ! ”

arabic_text: ١٨- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا خَاسِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 18. Such are they against whom Is proved the Sentence Among the previous generations Of Jinns and men, that have Passed away ; for they will Be (utterly) lost.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. And to all Are (assigned) degrees According to the deeds Which they (have done), And in order that (God) May recompense their deeds, And no injustice be done To them.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. And on the Day that The Unbelievers will be Placed before the Fire, (it will be said to them) : “ Ye received your good things In the life of the world, And ye took your pleasure Out of them : but to-day Shall ye be recompensed With a Penalty of humiliation : For that ye were arrogant On earth without just cause, And that ye (ever) transgressed. ”

arabic_text: ٢١- وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّـهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 21.Mention (Hūd) One of ‘Ād’s (own) brethren : Behold, he warned his people About the winding Sand-tracts : But there have been Warners Before him and after him : “ Worship ye none other Than God : truly I fear For you the Penalty Of a Mighty Day. ”

arabic_text: ٢٢- قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 22. They said : “ Hast thou come In order to turn us aside From our gods ? Then bring Upon us the (calamity) With which thou dost Threaten us, if thou Art telling the truth ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّـهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَـٰكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. He said : “ The Knowledge (Of when it will come) Is only with God : I Proclaim to you the mission On which I have been sent : But I see that ye Are a people in ignorance ! ” …

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِ ۖ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 24. Then, when they saw The (Penalty in the shape of) A cloud traversing the sky, Coming to meet their valleys, They said, “ This cloud Will give us rain ! ” “ Nay, it is the (calamity) Ye were asking to be Hastened !— a wind Wherein is a Grievous Penalty !

arabic_text: ٢٥- تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا لَا يُرَىٰ إِلَّا مَسَاكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْقَوْمَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 25. “ Everything will it destroy By the command of its Lord ! ” Then by the morning they— Nothing was to be seen But (the ruins of) their houses ! Thus do We recompense Those given to sin !

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِيمَا إِن مَّكَّنَّاكُمْ فِيهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَأَبْصَارًا وَأَفْئِدَةً فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَلَا أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَا أَفْئِدَتُهُم مِّن شَيْءٍ إِذْ كَانُوا يَجْحَدُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. And We had firmly established Them in a (prosperity and) power Which We have not given To you (ye Quraish !) And We had endowed them With (faculties of) Hearing, seeing, heart and intellect : But of no profit to them Were their (faculties of) Hearing, sight, and heart And intellect, when they Went on rejecting the Signs of God ; and they were (Completely) encircled By that which they Used to mock at !

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا مَا حَوْلَكُم مِّنَ الْقُرَىٰ وَصَرَّفْنَا الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. We destroyed aforetime Populations round about you ; And We have shown The Signs in various ways, That they may turn (to Us).

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَلَوْلَا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ قُرْبَانًا آلِهَةً ۖ بَلْ ضَلُّوا عَنْهُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ إِفْكُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. Why then was no help Forthcoming to them from those Whom they worshipped as gods, Besides God, as a means Of access (to God) ? Nay, They left them in the lurch : But that was their Falsehood and their invention.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَإِذْ صَرَفْنَا إِلَيْكَ نَفَرًا مِّنَ الْجِنِّ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلَمَّا حَضَرُوهُ قَالُوا أَنصِتُوا ۖ فَلَمَّا قُضِيَ وَلَّوْا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِم مُّنذِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 29.Behold, We turned Towards thee a company Of Jinns (quietly) listening To the Qur-ān : when they Stood in the presence Thereof, they said, “ Listen In silence ! ” When the (reading) Was finished, they returned To their people, to warn (Them of their sins).

arabic_text: ٣٠- قَالُوا يَا قَوْمَنَا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا كِتَابًا أُنزِلَ مِن بَعْدِ مُوسَىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْحَقِّ وَإِلَىٰ طَرِيقٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 30. They said, “ O our people ! We have heard a Book Revealed after Moses, Confirming what came Before it : it guides (men) To the Truth and To a Straight Path.

arabic_text: ٣١- يَا قَوْمَنَا أَجِيبُوا دَاعِيَ اللَّـهِ وَآمِنُوا بِهِ يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُجِرْكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 31. “ O our people, hearken To the one who invites (You) to God, and believe In him : He will forgive You your faults, And deliver you from A Penalty Grievous.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَمَن لَّا يُجِبْ دَاعِيَ اللَّـهِ فَلَيْسَ بِمُعْجِزٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 32. “ If any does not hearken To the one who invites (Us) to God, he cannot Frustrate (God’s Plan) on earth, And no protectors can he have Besides God : such men (Wander) in manifest error. ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَمْ يَعْيَ بِخَلْقِهِنَّ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۚ بَلَىٰ إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 33.See they not that God, Who created the heavens And the earth, and never Wearied with their creation, Is able to give life To the dead ? Yea, verily He has power over all things.

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ أَلَيْسَ هَـٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. And on the Day that The Unbelievers will be Placed before the Fire, (They will be asked,) “ Is this not the Truth ? ” They will say, “ Yea, By our Lord ! ” (One will say :) “ Then taste ye The Penalty, for that ye Were wont to deny (Truth) ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٥- فَاصْبِرْ كَمَا صَبَرَ أُولُو الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلَا تَسْتَعْجِل لَّهُمْ ۚ كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ مَا يُوعَدُونَ لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا سَاعَةً مِّن نَّهَارٍ ۚ بَلَاغٌ ۚ فَهَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 35.Therefore patiently persevere, As did (all) apostles Of inflexible purpose ; And be in no haste About the (Unbelievers). On the Day That they see the (Punishment) Promised them, (it will be) As if they had not Tarried more than an hour In a single day. (Thine But) to proclaim the Message : But shall any be destroyed Except those who transgress ?

arabic_text: ١- الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 1.Those who reject God And hinder (men) from The Path of God,—Their deeds will God Render astray (From their mark).

arabic_text: ٢- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَآمَنُوا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَأَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 2. But those who believe And work deeds of Righteousness, and believe In the (Revelation) sent down To Muhammad—for it is The Truth from their Lord,—He will remove from them Their ills and improve Their condition.

arabic_text: ٣- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّـهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 3. This because those who Reject God follow vanities, While those who believe follow The Truth from their Lord : Thus does God set forth For men their lessons By similitudes.

arabic_text: ٤- فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّـهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 4. Therefore, when ye meet The Unbelievers (in fight), Smite at their necks ; At length, when ye have Thoroughly subdued them, Bind a bond Firmly (on them) : thereafter (Is the time for) either Generosity or ransom : Until the war lays down Its burdens. Thus (are ye Commanded) : but if it Had been God’s Will, He could certainly have exacted Retribution from them (Himself) ; but (He lets you fight) In order to test you, Some with others. But those who are slain In the way of God,—He will never let Their deeds be lost.

arabic_text: ٥- سَيَهْدِيهِمْ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 5. Soon will He guide them And improve their condition,

arabic_text: ٦- وَيُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 6. And admit them to The Garden which He Has announced for them.

arabic_text: ٧- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن تَنصُرُوا اللَّـهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 7.Oye who believe ! If ye will aid (The cause of) God, He will aid you, And plant your feet firmly.

arabic_text: ٨- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَأَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 8. But those who reject (God),—For them is destruction, And (God) will render Their deeds astray (from their mark).

arabic_text: ٩- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوا مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 9. That is because they Hate the Revelation of God ; So He has made Their deeds fruitless.

arabic_text: ١٠- أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ دَمَّرَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ أَمْثَالُهَا◯
english_translation: 10. Do they not travel Through the earth, and see What was the End Of those before them (Who did evil) ? God brought utter destruction On them, and similar (Fates await) those who Reject God.

arabic_text: ١١- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَأَنَّ الْكَافِرِينَ لَا مَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 11. That is because God Is the Protector of those Who believe, but Those who reject God Have no protector.

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُدْخِلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يَتَمَتَّعُونَ وَيَأْكُلُونَ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ الْأَنْعَامُ وَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ◯
english_translation: 12.Verily God will admit Those who believe and do Righteous deeds, to Gardens Beneath which rivers flow ; While those who reject God Will enjoy (this world) And eat as cattle eat ; And the Fire will Be their abode.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ هِيَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّن قَرْيَتِكَ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَتْكَ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 13. And how many cities, With more power than Thy city which has Driven thee out, Have We destroyed (For their sins) ? And there was none To aid them.

arabic_text: ١٤- أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُم◯
english_translation: 14. Is then one who is On a clear (Path) From his Lord, No better than one To whom the evil Of his conduct seems pleasing, And such as follow Their own lusts ?

arabic_text: ١٥- مَّثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِّن مَّاءٍ غَيْرِ آسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 15. (Here is) a Parable Of the Garden which The righteous are promised : In it are rivers Of water incorruptible : Rivers of milk Of which the taste Never changes ; rivers Of wine, a joy To those who drink ; And rivers of honey Pure and clear. In it There are for them All kinds of fruits ; And Grace from their Lord. (Can those in such Bliss) Be compared to such as Shall dwell for ever In the Fire, and be given, To drink, boiling water, So that it cuts up Their bowels (to pieces) ?

arabic_text: ١٦- وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا خَرَجُوا مِنْ عِندِكَ قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ آنِفًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ طَبَعَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 16.And among them are men Who listen to thee, But in the end, when they Go out from thee, They say to those who Have received Knowledge, “ What is it he said Just then ? ” Such are Men whose hearts God Has sealed, and who Follow their own lusts.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَآتَاهُمْ تَقْوَاهُمْ◯
english_translation: 17. But to those who receive Guidance, He increases (The light of) Guidance, And bestows on them Their Piety and Restraint (From evil).

arabic_text: ١٨- فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً ۖ فَقَدْ جَاءَ أَشْرَاطُهَا ۚ فَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمْ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ◯
english_translation: 18. Do they then only wait For the Hour,—that it Should come on them Of a sudden ? But already Have come some tokens Thereof, and when it (Actually) is on them, How can they benefit Then by their admonition ?

arabic_text: ١٩- فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّـهُ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۗ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَاكُمْ◯
english_translation: 19. Know, therefore, that There is no god But God, and ask Forgiveness for thy fault, And for the men And women who believe : For God knows how ye Move about and how Ye dwell in your homes.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَتْ سُورَةٌ ۖ فَإِذَا أُنزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا الْقِتَالُ ۙ رَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِيِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَأَوْلَىٰ لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 20.Those who believe say, “ Why is not a Sūra Sent down (for us) ? ” But when a Sūra Of basic or categorical Meaning is revealed, And fighting is mentioned Therein, thou wilt see those In whose hearts is a disease Looking at thee with a look Of one in swoon at The approach of death. But more fitting for them—

arabic_text: ٢١- طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ ۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ الْأَمْرُ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللَّـهَ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ◯
english_translation: 21. Were it to obey And say what is just, And when a matter Is resolved on, it were Best for them if they Were true to God.

arabic_text: ٢٢- فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 22. Then, is it To be expected of you, If ye were put in authority, That ye will do mischief In the land, and break Your ties of kith and kin ?

arabic_text: ٢٣- أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّـهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَىٰ أَبْصَارَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 23.Such are the men Whom God has cursed For He has made them Deaf and blinded their sight.

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا◯
english_translation: 24. Do they not then Earnestly seek to understand The Qur-ān, or are Their hearts locked up By them?

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ ارْتَدُّوا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِهِم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى ۙ الشَّيْطَانُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ وَأَمْلَىٰ لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 25. Those who turn back As apostates after Guidance Was clearly shown to them,—The Evil One has instigated Them and buoyed them up With false hopes.

arabic_text: ٢٦- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ كَرِهُوا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّـهُ سَنُطِيعُكُمْ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ إِسْرَارَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 26. This, because they said To those who hate what God has revealed, “ We Will obey you in part Of (this) matter ” ; but God Knows their (inner) secrets.

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَكَيْفَ إِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 27. But how (will it be) When the angels take Their souls at death, And smite their faces And their backs ?

arabic_text: ٢٨- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوا مَا أَسْخَطَ اللَّـهَ وَكَرِهُوا رِضْوَانَهُ فَأَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 28. This because they followed That which called forth The Wrath of God, and They hated God’s good pleasure ; So He made their deeds Of no effect.

arabic_text: ٢٩- أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخْرِجَ اللَّـهُ أَضْغَانَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 29.Or do those in whose Hearts is a disease, think That God will not bring To light all their rancour ?

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَأَرَيْنَاكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُم بِسِيمَاهُمْ ۚ وَلَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِي لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ أَعْمَالَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 30. Had We so willed, We could have shown them Up to thee, and thou Shouldst have known them By their marks : but surely Thou wilt know them By the tone of their speech ! And God knows All that ye do.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَ أَخْبَارَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 31. And We shall try you Until We test those Among you who strive Their utmost and persevere In patience ; and We shall Try your reported (mettle).

arabic_text: ٣٢- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ وَشَاقُّوا الرَّسُولَ مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا اللَّـهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 32. Those who reject God, Hinder (men) from The Path of God, and resist The Apostle, after Guidance Has been clearly shown to them, Will not injure God In the least, but He Will make their deeds Of no effect.

arabic_text: ٣٣- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبْطِلُوا أَعْمَالَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 33. O ye who believe ! Obey God, and obey The Apostle, and make Not vain your deeds !

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّـهُ لَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 34. Those who reject God, And hinder (men) from the Path Of God, then die rejecting God,—God will not forgive them.

arabic_text: ٣٥- فَلَا تَهِنُوا وَتَدْعُوا إِلَى السَّلْمِ وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ وَاللَّـهُ مَعَكُمْ وَلَن يَتِرَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 35.Be not weary and Faint-hearted, crying for peace, When ye should be Uppermost : for God is With you, and will never Put you in loss For your (good) deeds.

arabic_text: ٣٦- إِنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۚ وَإِن تُؤْمِنُوا وَتَتَّقُوا يُؤْتِكُمْ أُجُورَكُمْ وَلَا يَسْأَلْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 36. The life of this world Is but play and amusement : And if ye believe And guard against evil, He will grant you Your recompense, and will not Ask you (to give up) Your possessions.

arabic_text: ٣٧- إِن يَسْأَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَانَكُمْ◯
english_translation: 37. If He were to ask you For all of them, and Press you, ye would Covetously withhold, and He would Bring out all your ill-feeling.

arabic_text: ٣٨- هَا أَنتُمْ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبْخَلُ ۖ وَمَن يَبْخَلْ فَإِنَّمَا يَبْخَلُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ الْغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ  ۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا يَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوا أَمْثَالَكُم◯
english_translation: 38. Behold ye are those Invited to spend (Of your substance) In the way of God : But among you are some That are niggardly. But any Who are niggardly are so At the expense of Their own souls. But God is free Of all wants, And it is ye that are needy. If ye turn back (From the Path), He will Substitute in your stead another people ; then they Would not be like you !

arabic_text: ١- إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا◯
english_translation: 1.Verily We have granted Thee a manifest Victory :

arabic_text: ٢- لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّـهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا◯
english_translation: 2. That God may forgive thee Thy faults of the past And those to follow ; Fulfil His favour to thee ; And guide thee On the Straight Way ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَيَنصُرَكَ اللَّـهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا◯
english_translation: 3. And that God may help Thee with powerful help.

arabic_text: ٤- هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيمَانًا مَّعَ إِيمَانِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّـهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا◯
english_translation: 4. It is He Who sent Down Tranquillity Into the hearts of The Believers, that they may Add Faith to their Faith ;—For to God belong The Forces of the heavens And the earth ; and God is Full of Knowledge and Wisdom ;—

arabic_text: ٥- لِّيُدْخِلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ اللَّـهِ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 5. That He may admit The men and women Who believe, to Gardens Beneath which rivers flow, To dwell therein for aye, And remove their ills From them ; and that is, In the sight of God, The highest achievement (For man),—

arabic_text: ٦- وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ وَالْمُشْرِكَاتِ الظَّانِّينَ بِاللَّـهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَاءَتْ مَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 6. And that He may punish The Hypocrites, men and Women, and the Polytheists, Men and women, who imagine An evil opinion of God. On them is a round Of Evil : the Wrath of God Is on them : He has cursed Them and got Hell ready For them: and evil Is it for a destination.

arabic_text: ٧- وَلِلَّـهِ جُنُودُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا◯
english_translation: 7. For to God belong The Forces of the heavens And the earth ; and God is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا◯
english_translation: 8.We have truly sent thee As a witness, as a Bringer of Glad Tidings, And as a Warner :

arabic_text: ٩- لِّتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا◯
english_translation: 9. In order that ye (O men) may believe In God and His Apostle, That ye may assist and honour Him, And celebrate His praises Morning and evening.

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ اللَّـهَ يَدُ اللَّـهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَاهَدَ عَلَيْهُ اللَّـهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 10. Verily those who plight Their fealty to thee Do no less than plight Their fealty to God : The Hand of God is Over their hands : Then any one who violates His oath, does so To the harm of his own Soul, and any one who Fulfils what he has Covenanted with God,—God will soon grant him A great Reward.

arabic_text: ١١- سَيَقُولُ لَكَ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَا أَمْوَالُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ شَيْئًا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ اللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 11.The desert Arabs who Lagged behind will Say to thee : “ We were engaged in (Looking after) our flocks And herds, and our families : Do thou then ask Forgiveness for us. ” They say with their tongues What is not in their hearts. Say : “ Who then has Any power at all (To intervene) on your behalf With God, if His Will Is to give you some loss Or to give you some profit ? But God is well acquainted With all that ye do.

arabic_text: ١٢- بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ الرَّسُولُ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا بُورًا◯
english_translation: 12. “ Nay, ye thought that The Apostle and the Believers Would never return to Their families ; this seemed Pleasing in your hearts, and Ye conceived an evil thought, For ye are a people Lost (in wickedness). ”

arabic_text: ١٣- وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِن بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَإِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 13. And if any believe not In God and His Apostle, We have prepared, For those who reject God, A Blazing Fire !

arabic_text: ١٤- وَلِلَّـهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 14. To God belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth : He forgives whom He wills, And He punishes whom He Wills : but God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٥- سَيَقُولُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا انطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا كَلَامَ اللَّـهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ اللَّـهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 15.Those who lagged behind (Will say), when ye (are Free to) march and take Booty (in war) : “ Permit us To follow you. ” They wish To change God’s decree : Say : “ Not thus Will ye follow us : God has already declared (This) beforehand ” : then they Will say, “ But ye are Jealous of us. ” Nay, But little do they understand (Such things).

arabic_text: ١٦- قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ الْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُولِي بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا يُؤْتِكُمُ اللَّـهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 16. Say to the desert Arabs Who lagged behind : “ Ye Shall be summoned (to fight) Against a people given to Vehement war : then shall ye Fight, or they shall submit. Then if ye show obedience, God will grant you A goodly reward, but if Ye turn back as ye Did before, He will punish You with a grievous Penalty. ”

arabic_text: ١٧- لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 17. No blame is there On the blind, nor is There blame on the lame, Nor on one ill (if he Joins not the war) : But he that obeys God And His Apostle,—(God) Will admit him to Gardens Beneath which rivers flow ; And he who turns back, (God) will punish him With a grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٨- لَّقَدْ رَضِيَ اللَّـهُ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ السَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَابَهُمْ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا◯
english_translation: 18.God’s Good Pleasure Was on the Believers When they swore Fealty To thee under the Tree : He knew what was In their hearts, and He Sent down Tranquillity To them ; and He rewarded Them with a speedy Victory ;

arabic_text: ١٩- وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا◯
english_translation: 19. And many gains will they Acquire (besides) : and God Is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّـهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةً تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَـٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَ النَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ آيَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَاطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا◯
english_translation: 20. God has promised you Many gains that ye shall Acquire, and He has given You these beforehand ; and He has restrained the hands Of men from you ; that it May be a Sign for The Believers, and that He may guide you To a Straight Path ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ اللَّـهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 21. And other gains (there are), Which are not within Your power, but which God has compassed : and God Has power over all things.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَلَوْ قَاتَلَكُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوَلَّوُا الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 22.If the Unbelievers Should fight you, they would Certainly turn their backs ; Then would they find Neither protector nor helper.

arabic_text: ٢٣- سُنَّةَ اللَّـهِ الَّتِي قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّـهِ تَبْدِيلًا◯
english_translation: 23. (Such has been) the practice (Approved) of God already In the past : no change Wilt thou find in The practice (approved) of God.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَهُوَ الَّذِي كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 24. And it is He Who Has restrained their hands From you and your hands From them in the midst Of Mecca, after that He Gave you the victory Over them. And God sees Well all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٢٥- هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّـهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 25. They are the ones who Denied revelation and hindered you From the Sacred Mosque And the sacrificial animals, Detained from reaching their Place of sacrifice. Had there Not been believing men And believing women whom Ye did not know that Ye were trampling down And on whose account A crime would have accrued To you without (your) knowledge, (God would have allowed you To force your way, but He held back your hands) That He may admit To His Mercy whom He will. If they had been Apart, We should Certainly have punished The Unbelievers among them With a grievous punishment.

arabic_text: ٢٦- إِذْ جَعَلَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ سَكِينَتَهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ وَعَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ التَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوا أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ اللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 26. While the Unbelievers Got up in their hearts Heat and cant—the heat And cant of Ignorance,—God sent down His Tranquillity To His Apostle and to The Believers, and made them Stick close to the command Of self-restraint ; and well Were they entitled to it And worthy of it. And God has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٢٧- لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ اللَّـهُ رَسُولَهُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ إِن شَاءَ اللَّـهُ آمِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًا قَرِيبًا◯
english_translation: 27. Truly did God fulfil The vision for His Apostle : Ye shall enter the Sacred Mosque, if God wills, With minds secure, heads shaved, Hair cut short, and without fear. For He knew what ye Knew not, and He granted, Besides this, a speedy victory.

arabic_text: ٢٨- هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّـهِ شَهِيدًا◯
english_translation: 28. It is He Who has sent His Apostle with Guidance And the Religion of Truth, To proclaim it over All religion : and enough Is God for a Witness.

arabic_text: ٢٩- مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا◯
english_translation: 29. Muhammad is the Apostle Of God ; and those who are With him are strong Against Unbelievers, (but) Compassionate amongst each other. Thou wilt see them bow And prostrate themselves (In prayer), seeking Grace From God and (His) Good Pleasure. On their faces are their Marks, (being) the traces Of their prostration. This is their similitude In the Taurāt ; And their similitude In the Gospel is : Like a seed which sends Forth its blade, then Makes it strong ; it then Becomes thick, and it stands On its own stem, (filling) The sowers with wonder And delight. As a result, It fills the Unbelievers With rage at them. God has promised those Among them who believe And do righteous deeds Forgiveness, And a great Reward.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 1.Oye who believe ! Put not yourselves forward Before God and His Apostle; But fear God : for God Is He Who hears And knows all things.

arabic_text: ٢- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 2.Oye who believe ! Raise not your voices Above the voice of the Prophet, Nor speak aloud to him In talk, as ye may Speak aloud to one another, Lest your deeds become Vain and ye perceive not.

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَاتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّـهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ امْتَحَنَ اللَّـهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 3. Those that lower their voice In the presence of God’s Apostle,—their hearts Has God tested for piety : For them is Forgiveness And a great Reward.

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَاءِ الْحُجُرَاتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 4.Those who shout out To thee from without The Inner Apartments— Most of them lack understanding.

arabic_text: ٥- وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 5. If only they had patience Until thou couldst Come out to them, It would be best For them : but God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٦- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَن تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 6.Oye who believe ! If a wicked person comes To you with any news, Ascertain the truth, lest Ye harm people unwittingly, And afterwards become Full of repentance for What ye have done.

arabic_text: ٧- وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّـهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِي كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّـهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الرَّاشِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 7.And know that among you Is God’s Apostle : were he, In many matters, to follow Your (wishes), ye would Certainly fall into misfortune : But God has endeared The Faith to you, and Has made it beautiful In your hearts, and He Has made hateful to you Unbelief, wickedness, and Rebellion : such indeed are Those who walk in righteousness ;—

arabic_text: ٨- فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَنِعْمَةً ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 8. A grace and favour From God ; and God Is full of Knowledge And Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٩- وَإِن طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِن بَغَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى الْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَاتِلُوا الَّتِي تَبْغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيءَ إِلَىٰ أَمْرِ اللَّـهِ ۚ فَإِن فَاءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا بِالْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوا ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ◯
english_translation: 9.If two parties among The Believers fall into A quarrel, make ye peace Between them : but if One of them transgresses Beyond bounds against the other, Then fight ye (all) against The one that transgresses Until it complies with The command of God ; But if it complies, then Make peace between them With justice, and be fair : For God loves those Who are fair (and just).

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. The Believers are but A single Brotherhood : So make peace and Reconciliation between your Two (contending) brothers ; And fear God, that ye May receive Mercy.

arabic_text: ١١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُونُوا خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَاءٌ مِّن نِّسَاءٍ عَسَىٰ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ  ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقَابِ ۖ بِئْسَ الِاسْمُ الْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ الْإِيمَانِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 11.Oye who believe ! Let not some men Among you laugh at others : It may be that The (latter) are better Than the (former) : Nor let some women Laugh at others : It may be that The (latter) are better Than the (former) : Nor defame nor be Sarcastic to each other, Nor call each other By (offensive) nicknames : Ill-seeming is a name Connoting wickedness, (To be used of one) After he has believed : And those who Do not desist are (Indeed) doing wrong.

arabic_text: ١٢- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 12.Oye who believe ! Avoid suspicion as much (As possible) : for suspicion In some cases is a sin : And spy not on each other, Nor speak ill of each other Behind their backs. Would any Of you like to eat The flesh of his dead Brother ? Nay, ye would Abhor it … But fear God : For God is Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٣- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ اللَّـهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 13.Omankind ! We created You from a single (pair) Of a male and a female, And made you into Nations and tribes, that Ye may know each other (Not that ye may despise Each other). Verily The most honoured of you In the sight of God Is (he who is) the most Righteous of you. And God has full knowledge And is well acquainted (With all things).

arabic_text: ١٤- قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَـٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 14.The desert Arabs say, “ We believe. ” Say, “ Ye Have no faith ; but ye (Only) say, ‘ We have submitted Our wills to God, ’ For not yet has Faith Entered your hearts. But if ye obey God And His Apostle, He Will not belittle aught Of your deeds : for God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الصَّادِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. Only those are Believers Who have believed in God And His Apostle, and have Never since doubted, but Have striven with their Belongings and their persons In the Cause of God : Such are the sincere ones.

arabic_text: ١٦- قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ اللَّـهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 16. Say: “ What ! Will ye Instruct God about your Religion ? But God knows All that is in the heavens And on earth : He has Full knowledge of all things.

arabic_text: ١٧- يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا عَلَيَّ إِسْلَامَكُم ۖ بَلِ اللَّـهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَاكُمْ لِلْإِيمَانِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. They impress on thee As a favour that they Have embraced Islam. Say, “ Count not your Islam As a favour upon me : Nay, God has conferred A favour upon you That He has guided you To the Faith, if ye Be true and sincere.

arabic_text: ١٨- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بَصِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. “ Verily God knows The secrets of the heavens And the earth : and God Sees well all That ye do. ”

arabic_text: ١- ق ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ◯
english_translation: 1.Qāf: By the Glorious Qur-ān (Thou art God’s Apostle).

arabic_text: ٢- بَلْ عَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ◯
english_translation: 2. But they wonder that There has come to them A Warner from among Themselves. So the Unbelievers say : “ This is a wonderful thing !

arabic_text: ٣- أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 3. “ What ! When we die And become dust, (shall we Live again ?) That is A (sort of) Return Far (from our understanding). ”

arabic_text: ٤- قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ◯
english_translation: 4.We already know How much of them The earth takes away : With Us is a Record Guarding (the full account).

arabic_text: ٥- بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ◯
english_translation: 5. But they deny the truth When it comes to them : So they are in A confused state.

arabic_text: ٦- أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ◯
english_translation: 6. Do they not look At the sky above them ?— How We have made it And adorned it, And there are no Flaws in it ?

arabic_text: ٧- وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ◯
english_translation: 7. And the earth—We have spread it out, And set thereon mountains Standing firm, and produced Therein every kind of Beautiful growth (in pairs)—

arabic_text: ٨- تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 8. To be observed And commemorated By every devotee Turning (to God).

arabic_text: ٩- وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُّبَارَكًا فَأَنبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ◯
english_translation: 9. And We send down From the sky Rain Charged with blessing, And We produce therewith Gardens and Grain for harvests ;

arabic_text: ١٠- وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 10. And tall (and stately) Palm-trees, with shoots Of fruit-stalks, piled One over another ;—

arabic_text: ١١- رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ◯
english_translation: 11. As sustenance for (God’s) Servants ;— And We give (new) life Therewith to land that is Dead : thus will be The Resurrection.

arabic_text: ١٢- كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ◯
english_translation: 12.Before them was denied (The Hereafter) by the People Of Noah, the Companions Of the Rass, theThamūd,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ◯
english_translation: 13. The ‘Ad, Pharaoh, The Brethren of Lūt,

arabic_text: ١٤- وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 14. The Companions of the Wood, And the People of Tubba‘ ; Each one (of them) rejected The apostles, and My warning Was duly fulfilled (in them).

arabic_text: ١٥- أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 15. Were We then weary With the first Creation, That they should be In confused doubt About a new Creation ?

arabic_text: ١٦- وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ◯
english_translation: 16.It was We Who Created man, and We know What dark suggestions his soul Makes to him : for We Are nearer to him Than (his) jugular vein.

arabic_text: ١٧- إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 17. Behold, two (guardian angels) Appointed to learn (his doings) Learn (and note them), One sitting on the right And one on the left.

arabic_text: ١٨- مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 18. Not a word does he Utter but there is A sentinel by him, Ready (to note it).

arabic_text: ١٩- وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ◯
english_translation: 19. And the stupor of death Will bring truth (before His eyes) : “ This was The thing which thou Wast trying to escape ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 20.And the Trumpet Shall be blown : That will be the Day Whereof Warning (had been given).

arabic_text: ٢١- وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 21. And there will come forth Every soul : with each Will be an (angel) to drive, And an (angel) to Bear witness.

arabic_text: ٢٢- لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 22. (It will be said :) “ Thou wast heedless Of this ; now have We Removed thy veil, And sharp is thy sight This Day ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 23. And his Companion will say : “ Here is (his record) ready With me ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 24. (The sentence will be :) “ Throw, throw into Hell Every contumacious Rejector (Of God) !—

arabic_text: ٢٥- مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 25. “ Who forbade what was good, Transgressed all bounds, Cast doubts and suspicions ;

arabic_text: ٢٦- الَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ◯
english_translation: 26. “ Who set up another god Besides God : throw him Into a severe Penalty. ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 27. His Companion will say : “ Our Lord ! I did not Make him transgress, But he was (himself) Far astray. ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِالْوَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 28. He will say : “ Dispute not With each other In My Presence : I had already in advance Sent you Warning.

arabic_text: ٢٩- مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ◯
english_translation: 29. “ The Word changes not Before Me, and I do not The least injustice To My Servants. ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 30.One Day We will ask Hell, “ Art thou Filled to the full ? ” It will say, “ Are there Any more (to come) ? ”

arabic_text: ٣١- وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ◯
english_translation: 31.And the Garden Will be brought nigh To the Righteous,—no more A thing distant.

arabic_text: ٣٢- هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ◯
english_translation: 32. (A voice will say :) “ This is what was Promised for you,— For every one who turned (To God) in sincere repentance, Who kept (His Law),

arabic_text: ٣٣- مَّنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 33. “Who feared (God) Most Gracious unseen, And brought a heart Turned in devotion (to Him) :

arabic_text: ٣٤- ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ◯
english_translation: 34. “ Enter ye therein In Peace and Security ; This is a Day Of Eternal Life ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٥- لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 35. There will be for them Therein all that they wish,—And more besides In Our Presence.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ◯
english_translation: 36.But how many Generations before them Did We destroy (for their Sins),—stronger in power Than they ? Then did they Wander through the land : Was there any place Of escape (for them) ?

arabic_text: ٣٧- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 37. Verily in this Is a Message For any that has A heart and understanding Or who gives ear and Earnestly witnesses (the truth).

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ◯
english_translation: 38.We created the heavens And the earth and all Between them in Six Days, Nor did any sense Of weariness touch Us.

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ◯
english_translation: 39. Bear, then, with patience, All that they say, And celebrate the praises Of thy Lord, before The rising of the sun And before (its) setting,

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ◯
english_translation: 40. And during part Of the night, (also,) Celebrate His praises, And (so likewise) After the postures Of adoration.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 41. And listen for the Day When the Caller will call Out from a place Quite near,—

arabic_text: ٤٢- يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ◯
english_translation: 42. The Day when they will Hear a (mighty) Blast In (very) truth) : that Will be the Day Of Resurrection.

arabic_text: ٤٣- إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 43. Verily it is We Who Give Life and Death ; And to Us is The Final Goal—

arabic_text: ٤٤- يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 44. The Day when The Earth will be Rent asunder, from (men) Hurrying out : that will be A gathering together,—Quite easy for Us.

arabic_text: ٤٥- نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ◯
english_translation: 45.We know best what they Say ; and thou art not One to overawe them By force. So admonish With the Qur-ān such As fear My Warning !

arabic_text: ١- وَالذَّارِيَاتِ ذَرْوًا◯
english_translation: 1.By the (Winds) That scatter broadcast ;

arabic_text: ٢- فَالْحَامِلَاتِ وِقْرًا◯
english_translation: 2. And those that Lift and bear away Heavy weights ;

arabic_text: ٣- فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 3. And those that Flow with ease And gentleness ;

arabic_text: ٤- فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا◯
english_translation: 4. And those that Distribute and apportion By Command ;—

arabic_text: ٥- إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ◯
english_translation: 5. Verily that which ye Are promised is true ;

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِنَّ الدِّينَ لَوَاقِعٌ◯
english_translation: 6. And verily Judgment And Justice must Indeed come to pass.

arabic_text: ٧- وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْحُبُكِ◯
english_translation: 7.By the Sky With (its) numerous Paths,

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ◯
english_translation: 8. Truly ye are in A doctrine discordant,

arabic_text: ٩- يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ◯
english_translation: 9. Through which are deluded (away From the Truth) such As would be deluded.

arabic_text: ١٠- قُتِلَ الْخَرَّاصُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. Woe to the falsehood-mongers,—

arabic_text: ١١- الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. Those who (flounder) heedless In a flood of confusion :

arabic_text: ١٢- يَسْأَلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 12. They ask, “ When will be The Day of Judgment And Justice ? ”

arabic_text: ١٣- يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. (It will be) a Day When they will be tried (And tested) over the Fire !

arabic_text: ١٤- ذُوقُوا فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. “ Taste ye your trial ! This is what ye used To ask to be hastened ! ”

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 15.As to the Righteous, They will be in the midst Of Gardens and Springs,

arabic_text: ١٦- آخِذِينَ مَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 16. Taking joy in the things Which their Lord gives them, Because, before then, they Lived a good life.

arabic_text: ١٧- كَانُوا قَلِيلًا مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. They were in the habit Of sleeping but little By night,

arabic_text: ١٨- وَبِالْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. And in the hours Of early dawn, They (were found) praying For Forgiveness ;

arabic_text: ١٩- وَفِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ◯
english_translation: 19. And in their wealth And possessions (was remembered) The right of the (needy,) Him who asked, and him Who (for some reason) was Prevented (from asking).

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَفِي الْأَرْضِ آيَاتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 20.On the earth Are Signs for those Of assured Faith,

arabic_text: ٢١- وَفِي أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. As also in your own Selves : will ye not Then see ?

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. And in heaven is Your Sustenance, as (also) That which ye are promised.

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. Then, by the Lord Of heaven and earth, This is the very Truth, As much as the fact That ye can speak Intelligently to each other.

arabic_text: ٢٤- هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 24.Has the story Reached thee, of the honoured Guests of Abraham ?

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا سَلَامًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَامٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 25. Behold, they entered His presence, and said : “ Peace ! ” He said, “ Peace ! ” (And thought, “ These seem) Unusual people. ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ فَجَاءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ◯
english_translation: 26. Then he turned quickly To his household, brought Out a fatted calf,

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. And placed it before them … He said, “ Will ye not Eat ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَامٍ عَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 28. (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, “ Fear not, ” And they gave him Glad tidings of a son Endowed with knowledge.

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَأَقْبَلَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 29. But his wife came forward (Laughing) aloud : she smote Her forehead and said : “ A barren old woman ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- قَالُوا كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ◯
english_translation: 30. They said, “ Even so Has thy Lord spoken : And He is full Of Wisdom and Knowledge. ”

arabic_text: ٣١- قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. (Abraham) said : “ And what, O ye Messengers, Is your errand (now) ? ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- قَالُوا إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 32. They said, “ We have Been sent to a people (Deep) in sin ;—

arabic_text: ٣٣- لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ◯
english_translation: 33. “ To bring on, on them, (A shower of) stones Of clay (brimstone),

arabic_text: ٣٤- مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ◯
english_translation: 34. “ Marked as from thy Lord For those who trespass Beyond bounds. ”

arabic_text: ٣٥- فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 35. Then We evacuated Those of the Believers Who were there,

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 36. But We found not there Any just (Muslim) persons Except in one house :

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَا آيَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ◯
english_translation: 37. And We left there A Sign for such as Fear the Grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَفِي مُوسَىٰ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 38.And in Moses (Was another Sign) : Behold, We sent him To Pharaoh, with authority Manifest.

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 39. But (Pharaoh) turned back With his Chiefs, and said, “ A sorcerer, or One possessed ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي الْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 40. So We took him And his forces, and Threw them into the sea ; And his was the blame.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ◯
english_translation: 41.And in the ‘Ad (people) (Was another Sign) : Behold, We sent against them The devastating Wind :

arabic_text: ٤٢- مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَالرَّمِيمِ◯
english_translation: 42. It left nothing whatever That it came up against. But reduced it to ruin And rottenness.

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ◯
english_translation: 43.And in theThamūd (Was another Sign) : Behold, they were told, “ Enjoy (your brief day) For a little while ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٤- فَعَتَوْا عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. But they insolently defied The Command of their Lord : So the stunning noise (Of an earthquake) seized Them, even while they Were looking on.

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنتَصِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. Then they could not Even stand (on their feet), Nor could they help themselves.

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 46.So were the People Of Noah before them : For they wickedly transgressed.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 47.With power and skill Did We construct The Firmament : For it is We Who create The vastness of Space.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. And We have spread out The (spacious) earth : How excellently We do spread out !

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 49. And of every thing We have created pairs : That ye may receive Instruction.

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 50. Hasten ye then (at once) To God : I am from Him A Warner to you, Clear and open !

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا مَعَ اللَّـهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 51.And make not another An object of worship With God : I am from Him A Warner to you, Clear and open !

arabic_text: ٥٢- كَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَتَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 52.Similarly, no apostle came To the Peoples before them, but They said (of him) In like manner, “ A sorcerer, or One possessed ” !

arabic_text: ٥٣- أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. Is this the legacy They have transmitted, One to another ? Nay, they are themselves A people transgressing Beyond bounds !

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 54. So turn away From them : not thine Is the blame.

arabic_text: ٥٥- وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 55. But teach (thy Message) : For teaching benefits The Believers.

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ◯
english_translation: 56.Ihave only created Jinns and men, that They may serve Me.

arabic_text: ٥٧- مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ◯
english_translation: 57. No Sustenance do I require Of them, nor do I Require that they should Feed Me.

arabic_text: ٥٨- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ◯
english_translation: 58. For God is He Who Gives (all) Sustenance,—Lord of Power,—Steadfast (for ever).

arabic_text: ٥٩- فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ◯
english_translation: 59. For the wrong-doers, Their portion is like Unto the portion of their Fellows (of earlier generations) : Then let them not ask Me To hasten (that portion) !

arabic_text: ٦٠- فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, On account of that Day Of theirs which they Have been promised !

arabic_text: ١- وَالطُّورِ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Mount (of Revelation) ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ◯
english_translation: 2. By a Decree Inscribed

arabic_text: ٣- فِي رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ◯
english_translation: 3. In a Scroll unfolded ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ◯
english_translation: 4. By the much-frequented Fane ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ◯
english_translation: 5. By the Canopy Raised High ;

arabic_text: ٦- وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ◯
english_translation: 6. And by the Ocean Filled with Swell ;—

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ◯
english_translation: 7. Verily, the Doom of thy Lord Will indeed come to pass ;—

arabic_text: ٨- مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ◯
english_translation: 8. There is none Can avert it ;—

arabic_text: ٩- يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا◯
english_translation: 9. On the Day when The firmament will be In dreadful commotion.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا◯
english_translation: 10. And the mountains will fly Hither and thither.

arabic_text: ١١- فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 11.Then woe that Day To those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood ;—

arabic_text: ١٢- الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. That play (and paddle) In shallow trifles.

arabic_text: ١٣- يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا◯
english_translation: 13. That Day shall they be Thrust down to the Fire Of Hell, irresistibly.

arabic_text: ١٤- هَـٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. “ This ”, it will be said, “ Is the Fire,—which ye Were wont to deny !

arabic_text: ١٥- أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. “ Is this then a fake, or is it ye that Do not see ?

arabic_text: ١٦- اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 16. “ Burn ye therein : The same is it to you Whether ye bear it With patience, or not : Ye but receive the recompense Of your (own) deeds. ”

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 17.As to the Righteous, They will be in Gardens, And in Happiness,—

arabic_text: ١٨- فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 18. Enjoying the (Bliss) which Their Lord hath bestowed On them, and their Lord Shall deliver them from The Penalty of the Fire.

arabic_text: ١٩- كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. (To them will be said :) “ Eat and drink ye, With profit and health, Because of your (good) deeds. ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ◯
english_translation: 20. They will recline (with ease) On Thrones (of dignity) Arranged in ranks ; And We shall join them To Companions, with beautiful Big and lustrous eyes.

arabic_text: ٢١- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 21.And those who believe And whose families follow Them in Faith,—to them Shall We join their families : nor shall We deprive them (Of the fruit) of aught Of their works : (Yet) is each individual In pledge for his deeds.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. And We shall bestow On them, of fruit and meat, Anything they shall desire.

arabic_text: ٢٣- يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 23. They shall there exchange, One with another, A (loving) cup Free of frivolity, Free of all taint Of ill.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 24. Round about them will serve, (Devoted) to them, Youths (handsome) as Pearls Well-guarded.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 25.They will advance To each other, engaging In mutual enquiry.

arabic_text: ٢٦- قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 26. They will say : “ Aforetime, We were not without fear For the sake of our people.

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَمَنَّ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ◯
english_translation: 27. “ But God has been good To us, and has delivered us From the Penalty Of the Scorching Wind.

arabic_text: ٢٨- إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 28. “ Truly, we did call Unto Him from of old : Truly it is He, The Beneficent, the Merciful ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 29.Therefore proclaim thou The praises (of thy Lord) : For by the Grace Of thy Lord, thou art No (vulgar) soothsayer, nor Art thou one possessed.

arabic_text: ٣٠- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ◯
english_translation: 30. Or do they say :— “ A Poet! we await For him some calamity (Hatched) by Time ! ”

arabic_text: ٣١- قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. Say thou : “ Await ye !— I too will wait Along with you ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٢- أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُم بِهَـٰذَا ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. Is it that their faculties Of understanding urge them To this, or are they But a people transgressing Beyond bounds ?

arabic_text: ٣٣- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. Or do they say, “ He fabricated the (Message) ” ? Nay, they have no faith !

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 34. Let them then produce A recital like unto it,— If (it be) they speak The Truth !

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 35.Were they created of nothing, Or were they themselves The creators ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. Or did they create The heavens and the earth ? Nay, they have No firm belief.

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. Or are the Treasures Of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (Of affairs) ?

arabic_text: ٣٨- أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 38. Or have they a ladder, By which they can (climb Up to heaven and) listen (To its secrets) ? Then let (Such a) listener of theirs Produce a manifest proof.

arabic_text: ٣٩- أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. Or has He only daughters And ye have sons ?

arabic_text: ٤٠- أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. Or is it that thou Dost ask for a reward So that they are burdened With a load of debt ?—

arabic_text: ٤١- أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. Or that the Unseen Is in their hands, and they write it down ?

arabic_text: ٤٢- أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. Or do they intend A plot (against thee) ? But those who defy God Are themselves involved In a Plot !

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّـهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. Or have they a god Other than God ? Exalted is God Far above the things They associate with Him !

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَإِن يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ◯
english_translation: 44.Were they to see A piece of the sky Falling (on them), they Would (only) say : “ Clouds Gathered in heaps ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ◯
english_translation: 45. So leave them alone Until they encounter That Day of theirs, Wherein they shall (perforce) Swoon (with terror),—

arabic_text: ٤٦- يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. The Day when their plotting Will avail them nothing And no help shall be Given them.
