arabic_text: ٤٧- وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. And verily, for those Who do wrong, there is Another punishment besides this : But most of them Understand not.

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ◯
english_translation: 48. Now await in patience The command of thy Lord : For verily thou art In our eyes : And celebrate the praises Of thy Lord the while Thou standest forth,

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ◯
english_translation: 49. And for part of the night Also praise thou Him,— And at the retreat Of the stars !

arabic_text: ١- وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Star When it goes down,—

arabic_text: ٢- مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 2. Your Companion is neither Astray nor being misled.

arabic_text: ٣- وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 3. Nor does he say (aught) Of (his own) Desire.

arabic_text: ٤- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا  وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ◯
english_translation: 4. It is no less than Inspiration sent down to him :

arabic_text: ٥- عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 5. He was taught by one Mighty in Power,

arabic_text: ٦- ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6. Endued with Wisdom : For he appeared (In stately form)

arabic_text: ٧- وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. While he was in The highest part Of the horizon :

arabic_text: ٨- ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 8. Then he approached And came closer.

arabic_text: ٩- فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 9. And was at a distance Of but two bow-lengths Or (even) nearer ;

arabic_text: ١٠- فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَىٰ◯
english_translation: 10. So did (God) convey The inspiration to His Servant— (Conveyed) what He (meant) To convey.

arabic_text: ١١- مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰ◯
english_translation: 11. The (Prophet’s) (mind and) heart In no way falsified That which he saw.

arabic_text: ١٢- أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 12.Will ye then dispute With him concerning What he saw ?

arabic_text: ١٣- وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 13. For indeed he saw him At a second descent,

arabic_text: ١٤- عِندَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنتَهَىٰ◯
english_translation: 14. Near the Lote-tree Beyond which none may pass :

arabic_text: ١٥- عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 15. Near it is the Garden Of Abode.

arabic_text: ١٦- إِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 16. Behold, the Lote-tree Was shrouded (In mystery unspeakable !)

arabic_text: ١٧- مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ◯
english_translation: 17. (His) sight never swerved, Nor did it go wrong !

arabic_text: ١٨- لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 18. For truly did he see, Of the Signs of his Lord, The Greatest !

arabic_text: ١٩- أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 19.Have ye seen Lāt, and ‘Uzzā,

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَمَنَاةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 20. And another, The third (goddess), Manāt?

arabic_text: ٢١- أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنثَىٰ◯
english_translation: 21. What ! For you The male sex, And for Him, the female ?

arabic_text: ٢٢- تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰ◯
english_translation: 22. Behold, such would be Indeed a division Most unfair !

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم مَّا أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 23. These are nothing but names Which ye have devised ,— Ye and your fathers,— For which God has sent Down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but Conjecture and what Their own souls desire !— Even though there has already Come to them Guidance From their Lord !

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَمْ لِلْإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 24. Nay, shall man have (just) Anything he hankers after ?

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَلِلَّـهِ الْآخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 25. But it is to God That the End and The Beginning (of all things) Belong.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ اللَّـهُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ◯
english_translation: 26.How many-so-ever be The angels in the heavens, Their intercession will avail nothing Except after God has given Leave for whom He pleases And that he is acceptable To Him.

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنثَىٰ◯
english_translation: 27. Those who believe not In the Hereafter, name The angels with female names.

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَمَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا◯
english_translation: 28. But they have no knowledge Therein. They follow nothing But conjecture ; and conjecture Avails nothing against Truth.

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا◯
english_translation: 29. Therefore shun those who Turn away from Our Message And desire nothing but The life of this world.

arabic_text: ٣٠- ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 30. That is as far as Knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best Those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth Best those who receive guidance.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَلِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى◯
english_translation: 31. Yea, to God belongs all That is in the heavens And on earth : so that He rewards those who do Evil, according to their deeds, And He rewards those who Do good, with what is best.

arabic_text: ٣٢- الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ◯
english_translation: 32. Those who avoid Great sins and shameful deeds, Only (falling into) small faults,— Verily thy Lord is ample In forgiveness. He knows You well when He brings You out of the earth, And when ye are hidden In your mothers’ wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves : He knows best who it is That guards against evil.

arabic_text: ٣٣- أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 33.Seest thou one Who turns back,

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 34. Gives a little, Then hardens (his heart) ?

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 35. What ! Has he knowledge Of the unseen So that he can see ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ◯
english_translation: 36. Nay, is he not acquainted With what is in the books Of Moses—

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 37. And of Abraham Who fulfilled his engagements ?—

arabic_text: ٣٨- أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 38. Namely, that no bearer Of burdens can bear The burden of another ;

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 39. That man can have nothing But what he strives for ;

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 40. That (the fruit of) his striving Will soon come in sight ;

arabic_text: ٤١- ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَىٰ◯
english_translation: 41. Then will he be rewarded With a reward complete ;

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الْمُنتَهَىٰ◯
english_translation: 42. That to thy Lord Is the final Goal ;

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ◯
english_translation: 43. That it is He Who Granteth Laughter and Tears ;

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا◯
english_translation: 44. That it is He Who Granteth Death and Life ;

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ◯
english_translation: 45. That He did create In pairs,— male and female,

arabic_text: ٤٦- مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 46. From a seed when lodged (In its place) ;

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 47. That He hath promised A Second Creation (Raising of the Dead) ;

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 48. That it is He Who Giveth wealth and satisfaction ;

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 49. That He is the Lord Of Sirius (the Mighty Star) ;

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 50. And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) Ancient ‘Ād (people),

arabic_text: ٥١- وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَىٰ◯
english_translation: 51. And theThamūd, Nor gave them a lease Of perpetual life.

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ◯
english_translation: 52. And before them, The people of Noah, For that they were (all) Most unjust And most insolent transgressors,

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 53.And He destroyed The Overthrown Cities (Of Sodom and Gomorrah),

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 54. So that (ruins unknown) Have covered them up.

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ◯
english_translation: 55. Then which of the gifts Of thy Lord, (O man,) Wilt thou dispute about ?

arabic_text: ٥٦- هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 56. This is a Warner, Of the (series of) Warners Of old !

arabic_text: ٥٧- أَزِفَتِ الْآزِفَةُ◯
english_translation: 57. The (Judgment) ever approaching Draws nigh :

arabic_text: ٥٨- لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ كَاشِفَةٌ◯
english_translation: 58. No (soul) but God Can lay it bare.

arabic_text: ٥٩- أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Do ye then wonder At this recital ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ◯
english_translation: 60. And will ye laugh And not weep,—

arabic_text: ٦١- وَأَنتُمْ سَامِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. Wasting your time In vanities ?

arabic_text: ٦٢- فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّـهِ وَاعْبُدُواالسجدة◯
english_translation: 62. But fall ye down in prostration To God, and adore (Him)!

arabic_text: ١- اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ◯
english_translation: 1.The Hour (of Judgment) Is nigh, and the moon Is cleft asunder.

arabic_text: ٢- وَإِن يَرَوْا آيَةً يُعْرِضُوا وَيَقُولُوا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ◯
english_translation: 2. But if they see A Sign, they turn away, And say, “ This is (But) transient magic. ”

arabic_text: ٣- وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ◯
english_translation: 3. They reject (the warning) And follow their (own) lusts But every matter has Its appointed time.

arabic_text: ٤- وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّنَ الْأَنبَاءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ◯
english_translation: 4. There have already come To them Recitals wherein There is (enough) to check (them),

arabic_text: ٥- حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ◯
english_translation: 5. Mature wisdom ;—but (The preaching of) Warners Profits them not.

arabic_text: ٦- فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍ◯
english_translation: 6.Therefore, (O Prophet,) Turn away from them. The Day that the Caller Will call (them) To a terrible affair,

arabic_text: ٧- خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ◯
english_translation: 7. They will come forth,—Their eyes humbled—From (their) graves, (torpid) Like locusts scattered abroad,

arabic_text: ٨- مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ◯
english_translation: 8. Hastening with eyes transfixed, Towards the Caller !— “ Hard is this Day! ”, The Unbelievers will say.

arabic_text: ٩- كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ◯
english_translation: 9.Before them the People Of Noah rejected (their apostle) : They rejected Our servant, And said, “ Here is One possessed ! ”, and he Was driven out.

arabic_text: ١٠- فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ◯
english_translation: 10. Then he called on his Lord : “ I am one overcome : Do Thou then help (me) ! ”

arabic_text: ١١- فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ◯
english_translation: 11. So We opened the gates Of heaven, with water Pouring forth.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ◯
english_translation: 12. And We caused the earth To gush forth with springs. So the waters met (and rose) To the extent decreed.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ◯
english_translation: 13. But We bore him On an (Ark) made of Broad planks and caulked With palm-fibre :

arabic_text: ١٤- تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ◯
english_translation: 14. She floats under our eyes (And care) : a recompense To one who had been Rejected (with scorn) !

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 15. And We have left This as a Sign (For all time) : then Is there any that will Receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ١٦- فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 16.But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning ?

arabic_text: ١٧- وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 17. And We have indeed Made the Qur-ān easy To understand and remember : Then is there any that Will receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ١٨- كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 18.The ‘Ad (people) (too) Rejected (Truth) : then How terrible was My Penalty and My Warning ?

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ◯
english_translation: 19. For We sent against them A furious wind, on a Day Of violent Disaster,

arabic_text: ٢٠- تَنزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ◯
english_translation: 20. Plucking out men as if They were roots of palm-trees Torn up (from the ground).

arabic_text: ٢١- فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 21. Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning !

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 22. But We have indeed Made the Qur-ān easy To understand and remember : Then is there any that Will receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٢٣- كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ◯
english_translation: 23.TheThamūd (also) Rejected (their) Warners.

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ◯
english_translation: 24. For they said : “ What ! A man ! a solitary one From among ourselves ! Shall we follow such a one ? Truly should we then be Straying in mind, and mad !

arabic_text: ٢٥- أَأُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ◯
english_translation: 25. “ Is it that the Message Is sent tohim, Of all people amongst us ? Nay, he is a liar, An insolent one ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ◯
english_translation: 26. Ah ! they will know On the morrow, which is The liar, the insolent one !

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّا مُرْسِلُو النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ◯
english_translation: 27. For We will send The she-camel By way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Sālih), And possess thyself in patience !

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ◯
english_translation: 28. And tell them that The water is to be Divided between them : each one’s right to drink Being brought forward (By suitable turns).

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ◯
english_translation: 29. But they called To their companion, And he took a sword In hand, and hamstrung (her).

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 30. Ah ! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning !

arabic_text: ٣١- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ◯
english_translation: 31. For We sent against them A single Mighty Blast, And they became Like the dry stubble used By one who pens cattle.

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 32. And We have indeed Made the Qur-ān easy To understand and remember : Then is there any that Will receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٣٣- كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ◯
english_translation: 33.The People of Lūt Rejected (his) Warning.

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَاهُم بِسَحَرٍ◯
english_translation: 34. We sent against them A violent tornado With showers of stones, (Which destroyed them), except Lūt’s household : them We Delivered by early Dawn,—

arabic_text: ٣٥- نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَن شَكَرَ◯
english_translation: 35. As a Grace from Us : Thus do We reward Those who give thanks.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ◯
english_translation: 36. And (Lūt) did warn them Of Our Punishment, but They disputed about the Warning.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 37. And they even sought To snatch away his guests From him, but We blinded Their eyes. (They heard :) “ Now taste ye My Wrath And My Warning. ”

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ◯
english_translation: 38. Early on the morrow An abiding Punishment Seized them :

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ◯
english_translation: 39. “ So taste ye My Wrath And My Warning. ”

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 40. And We have indeed Made the Qur-ān easy To understand and remember : Then is there any that Will receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٤١- وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ◯
english_translation: 41.To the people Of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, Came Warners (from God).

arabic_text: ٤٢- كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ◯
english_translation: 42. The (people) rejected all Our Signs ; but We Seized them with such Penalty (As comes) from One Exalted in Power, Able to carry out His Will.

arabic_text: ٤٣- أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُولَـٰئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ◯
english_translation: 43. Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they ? Or have ye an immunity In the Sacred Books ?

arabic_text: ٤٤- أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ◯
english_translation: 44. Or do they say : “ We acting together Can defend ourselves ” ?

arabic_text: ٤٥- سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ◯
english_translation: 45. Soon will their multitude Be put to flight, And they will show Their backs.

arabic_text: ٤٦- بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ◯
english_translation: 46. Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) Is the time promised them (For their full recompense) : And that Hour will be Most grievous and most bitter.

arabic_text: ٤٧- إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ◯
english_translation: 47. Truly those in sin Are the ones Straying in mind, and mad.

arabic_text: ٤٨- يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ◯
english_translation: 48. The Day they will be Dragged through the Fire On their faces, (they Will hear :) “ Taste ye The touch of Hell ! ”

arabic_text: ٤٩- إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ◯
english_translation: 49. Verily, all things Have We created In proportion and measure.

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ◯
english_translation: 50. And Our command Is but a single (Act),— Like the twinkling Of an eye.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ◯
english_translation: 51. And (oft) in the past, Have We destroyed gangs Like unto you : then Is there any that Will receive admonition ?

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ◯
english_translation: 52.All that they do Is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds) :

arabic_text: ٥٣- وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ◯
english_translation: 53. Every matter, small and great, Is on record.

arabic_text: ٥٤- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ◯
english_translation: 54.As to the Righteous, They will be in the midst Of Gardens and Rivers,

arabic_text: ٥٥- فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ◯
english_translation: 55. In an Assembly of Truth, In the Presence of A Sovereign Omnipotent.

arabic_text: ١- الرَّحْمَـٰنُ◯
english_translation: 1. (God) Most Gracious !

arabic_text: ٢- عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ◯
english_translation: 2. It is He Who has Taught the Qur-ān.

arabic_text: ٣- خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ◯
english_translation: 3.He has created man :

arabic_text: ٤- عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ◯
english_translation: 4. He has taught him speech (And Intelligence).

arabic_text: ٥- الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ◯
english_translation: 5. The sun and the moon Follow courses (exactly) computed ;

arabic_text: ٦- وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ◯
english_translation: 6. And the herbs and the trees—Both (alike) bow in adoration.

arabic_text: ٧- وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ◯
english_translation: 7. And the Firmament has He Raised high, and He has set up The Balance (of Justice),

arabic_text: ٨- أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ◯
english_translation: 8. In order that ye may Not transgress (due) balance.

arabic_text: ٩- وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ◯
english_translation: 9. So establish weight with justice And fall not short In the balance.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ◯
english_translation: 10. It is He Who has Spread out the earth For (His) creatures :

arabic_text: ١١- فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَالنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ الْأَكْمَامِ◯
english_translation: 11. Therein is fruit And date-palms, producing Spathes (enclosing dates) ;

arabic_text: ١٢-وَالْحَبُّ ذُو الْعَصْفِ وَالرَّيْحَانُ◯
english_translation: 12. Also corn, with (its) Leaves and stalk for fodder, And sweet-smelling plants.

arabic_text: ١٣-فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 13. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ١٤- خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ◯
english_translation: 14.He created man From sounding clay Like unto pottery,

arabic_text: ١٥- وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ◯
english_translation: 15. And He created Jinns From fire free of smoke :

arabic_text: ١٦- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 16. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ١٧- رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ◯
english_translation: 17. (He is) Lord Of the two Easts And Lord Of the two Wests :

arabic_text: ١٨- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 18. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ١٩- مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ◯
english_translation: 19.He has let free The two bodies Of flowing water, Meeting together :

arabic_text: ٢٠- بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ◯
english_translation: 20. Between them is a Barrier Which they do not transgress :

arabic_text: ٢١- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 21. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٢٢- يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ◯
english_translation: 22.Out of them come Pearls and Coral :

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 23. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنشَآتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ◯
english_translation: 24.And His are the Ships Sailing smoothly through the seas, Lofty as mountains :

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 25. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٢٦- كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ◯
english_translation: 26.All that is on earth Will perish :

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ◯
english_translation: 27. But will abide (for ever) The Face of thy Lord,—Full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.

arabic_text: ٢٨- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 28. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٢٩- يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ◯
english_translation: 29.Of Him seeks (its needs) Every creature in the heavens And on earth : Every day in (new) Splendour Doth He (shine) !

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 30. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٣١- سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ الثَّقَلَانِ◯
english_translation: 31.Soon shall We Settle your affairs, O both ye worlds !

arabic_text: ٣٢- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 32. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٣٣- يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ◯
english_translation: 33.Oye assembly of Jinns And men ! If it be Ye can pass beyond The zones of the heavens And the earth, pass ye ! Not without authority Shall ye be able to pass !

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 34. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٣٥- يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ◯
english_translation: 35.On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain !) A flame of fire (to burn) And a smoke (to choke) : No defence will ye have :

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 36. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٣٧- فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ◯
english_translation: 37. When the sky is rent Asunder, and it becomes red Like ointment :

arabic_text: ٣٨- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 38. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْأَلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَانٌّ◯
english_translation: 39. On that day No question will be asked Of man or Jinn As to his sin,

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 40. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٤١- يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالْأَقْدَامِ◯
english_translation: 41. (For) the sinners will be Known by their Marks : And they will be seized By their forelocks and Their feet.

arabic_text: ٤٢- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 42. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٤٣- هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. This is the Hell which The Sinners deny :

arabic_text: ٤٤- يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ آنٍ◯
english_translation: 44. In its midst And in the midst Of boiling hot water Will they wander round !

arabic_text: ٤٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 45. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ◯
english_translation: 46.But for such as fear The time when they will Stand before (the Judgment Seat Of) their Lord, There will be two Gardens—

arabic_text: ٤٧- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 47. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٤٨- ذَوَاتَا أَفْنَانٍ◯
english_translation: 48. Containing all kinds (Of trees and delights) ;—

arabic_text: ٤٩- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 49. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٥٠- فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ◯
english_translation: 50. In them (each) will be Two Springs flowing (free) ;

arabic_text: ٥١- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 51. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٥٢- فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ◯
english_translation: 52. In them will be Fruits Of every kind, two and two.

arabic_text: ٥٣- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 53. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٥٤- مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ◯
english_translation: 54. They will recline on Carpets, Whose inner linings will be Of rich brocade : the Fruit Of the Gardens will be Near (and easy of reach).

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 55. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٥٦- فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ◯
english_translation: 56. In them will be (Maidens), Chaste, restraining their glances, Whom no man or Jinn Before them has touched ;—

arabic_text: ٥٧- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 57. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٥٨- كَأَنَّهُنَّ الْيَاقُوتُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ◯
english_translation: 58. Like unto rubies and coral.

arabic_text: ٥٩- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 59. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ◯
english_translation: 60. Is there any Reward For Good—other than Good ?

arabic_text: ٦١- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 61. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ◯
english_translation: 62.And besides these two, There are two other Gardens,—

arabic_text: ٦٣- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 63. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٦٤- مُدْهَامَّتَانِ◯
english_translation: 64. Dark-green in colour (From plentiful watering).

arabic_text: ٦٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 65. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٦٦- فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ◯
english_translation: 66. In them (each) will be Two Springs pouring forth water In continuous abundance :

arabic_text: ٦٧- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 67. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٦٨- فِيهِمَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ◯
english_translation: 68. In them will be Fruits, And dates and pomegranates :

arabic_text: ٦٩- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 69. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٧٠- فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ◯
english_translation: 70. In them will be Fair (Companions), good, beautiful ;

arabic_text: ٧١- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 71. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٧٢- حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ◯
english_translation: 72. Companions restrained (as to Their glances), in (goodly) pavilions ;

arabic_text: ٧٣- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 73. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٧٤- لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ◯
english_translation: 74. Whom no man or Jinn Before them has touched ;—

arabic_text: ٧٥- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 75. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?—

arabic_text: ٧٦- مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ◯
english_translation: 76. Reclining on green Cushions And rich Carpets of beauty.

arabic_text: ٧٧- فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ◯
english_translation: 77. Then which of the favours Of your Lord will ye deny ?

arabic_text: ٧٨- تَبَارَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ◯
english_translation: 78.Blessed be the name Of thy Lord, Full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ◯
english_translation: 1.When the Event Inevitable Cometh to pass,

arabic_text: ٢- لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ◯
english_translation: 2. Then will no (soul) Entertain falsehood Concerning its coming.

arabic_text: ٣- خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ◯
english_translation: 3. (Many) will it bring low ; (Many) will it exalt ;

arabic_text: ٤- إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا◯
english_translation: 4. When the earth shall be Shaken to its depths,

arabic_text: ٥- وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا◯
english_translation: 5. And the mountains shall Be crumbled to atoms,

arabic_text: ٦- فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُّنبَثًّا◯
english_translation: 6. Becoming dust scattered abroad,

arabic_text: ٧- وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً◯
english_translation: 7. And ye shall be sorted out Into three classes.

arabic_text: ٨- فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ◯
english_translation: 8.Then (there will be) The Companions of The Right Hand ;—What will be The Companions of The Right Hand ?

arabic_text: ٩- وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ◯
english_translation: 9. And the Companions of The Left Hand,—What will be The Companions of The Left Hand ?

arabic_text: ١٠- وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. And those Foremost (In Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).

arabic_text: ١١- أُولَـٰئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 11.These will be Those Nearest to God :

arabic_text: ١٢- فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 12. In Gardens of Bliss :

arabic_text: ١٣- ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. A number of people From those of old,

arabic_text: ١٤- وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 14. And a few from those Of later times.

arabic_text: ١٥- عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ◯
english_translation: 15. (They will be) on Thrones Encrusted (with gold And precious stones),

arabic_text: ١٦- مُّتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 16. Reclining on them, Facing each other.

arabic_text: ١٧- يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. Round about them will (serve) Youths of perpetual (freshness),

arabic_text: ١٨- بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ◯
english_translation: 18. With goblets, (shining) beakers, And cups (filled) out of Clear-flowing fountains :

arabic_text: ١٩- لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. No after-ache will they Receive therefrom, nor will they Suffer intoxication :

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. And with fruits, Any that they may select ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. And the flesh of fowls, Any that they may desire.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَحُورٌ عِينٌ◯
english_translation: 22. And (there will be) Companions With beautiful, big, And lustrous eyes,—

arabic_text: ٢٣- كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ◯
english_translation: 23. Like unto Pearls Well-guarded.

arabic_text: ٢٤- جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. A Reward for the Deeds Of their past (Life).

arabic_text: ٢٥- لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا◯
english_translation: 25. No frivolity will they Hear therein, nor any Taint of ill,—

arabic_text: ٢٦- إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا◯
english_translation: 26. Only the saying, “ Peace ! Peace. ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 27.The Companions of The Right Hand,—What will be The Companions of The Right Hand ?

arabic_text: ٢٨- فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ◯
english_translation: 28. (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ◯
english_translation: 29. Among Talh trees With flowers (or fruits) Piled one above another,—
30. In shade long-extended,

arabic_text: ٣١- وَمَاءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ◯
english_translation: 31. By water flowing constantly,

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ◯
english_translation: 32. And fruit in abundance.

arabic_text: ٣٣- لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ◯
english_translation: 33. Whose season is not limited, Nor (supply) forbidden,

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ◯
english_translation: 34. And on Thrones (of Dignity), Raised high.

arabic_text: ٣٥- إِنَّا أَنشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنشَاءً◯
english_translation: 35. We have created (their Companions) Of special creation.

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا◯
english_translation: 36. And made them Virgin-pure (and undefiled),—

arabic_text: ٣٧- عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا◯
english_translation: 37. Beloved (by nature), Equal in age,—

arabic_text: ٣٨- لِّأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 38. For the companions Of the Right Hand.

arabic_text: ٣٩- ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 39.A(goodly) number From those of old,

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. And a (goodly) number From those of later times.

arabic_text: ٤١- وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ◯
english_translation: 41.The Companions of the Left Hand,—What will be The Companions of The Left Hand ?

arabic_text: ٤٢- فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 42. (They will be) in the midst Of a fierce Blast of Fire And in Boiling Water,

arabic_text: ٤٣- وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ◯
english_translation: 43. And in the shades Of Black Smoke :

arabic_text: ٤٤- لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 44. Nothing (will there be) To refresh, nor to please :

arabic_text: ٤٥- إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. For that they were wont To be indulged, before that, In wealth (and luxury),

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَكَانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنثِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 46. And persisted obstinately In wickedness supreme !

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. And they used to say, “ What ! when we die And become dust and bones, Shall we then indeed Be raised up again ?—

arabic_text: ٤٨- أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ◯
english_translation: 48. “ (We) and our fathers of old ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٩- قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. Say : “ Yea, those of old And those of later times,

arabic_text: ٥٠- لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 50. “ All will certainly be Gathered together for the meeting Appointed for a Day Well-known.

arabic_text: ٥١- ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 51. “ Then will ye truly,— O ye that go wrong, And treat (Truth) as Falsehood !—

arabic_text: ٥٢- لَآكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ◯
english_translation: 52. “ Ye will surely taste Of the Tree of Zaqqūm.

arabic_text: ٥٣- فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ◯
english_translation: 53. “ Then will ye fill Your insides therewith,

arabic_text: ٥٤- فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ◯
english_translation: 54. “ And drink Boiling Water On top of it :

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ◯
english_translation: 55. “ Indeed ye shall drink Like diseased camels Raging with thirst ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٦- هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 56. Such will be their entertainment On the Day of Requital !

arabic_text: ٥٧- نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ◯
english_translation: 57.It is We Who have Created you : why will ye Not witness the Truth ?

arabic_text: ٥٨- أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ◯
english_translation: 58. Do ye then see ?— The (human Seed) that Ye throw out,—

arabic_text: ٥٩- أَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 59. Is it ye who create it, Or are We the Creators ?

arabic_text: ٦٠- نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ◯
english_translation: 60. We have decreed Death To be your common lot, And We are not To be frustrated

arabic_text: ٦١- عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 61. From changing your Forms And creating you (again) In (Forms) that ye know not.

arabic_text: ٦٢- وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 62. And ye certainly know already The first form of creation : Why then do ye not Celebrate His praises ?

arabic_text: ٦٣- أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ◯
english_translation: 63.See ye the seed that Ye sow in the ground ?

arabic_text: ٦٤- أَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ◯
english_translation: 64. Is it ye that cause it To grow, or are We The Cause ?

arabic_text: ٦٥- لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ◯
english_translation: 65. Were it Our Will, We could crumble it To dry powder, and ye would Be left in wonderment,

arabic_text: ٦٦- إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 66. (Saying), “ We are indeed Left with debts (for nothing) :

arabic_text: ٦٧- بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ◯
english_translation: 67. “ Indeed are we shut out (Of the fruits of our labour). ”

arabic_text: ٦٨- أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ الْمَاءَ الَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 68.See ye the water Which ye drink ?

arabic_text: ٦٩- أَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنزِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 69. Do ye bring it Down (In rain) from the Cloud Or do We ?

arabic_text: ٧٠- لَوْ نَشَاءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 70. Were it Our Will, We could make it Salt (and unpalatable) : Then why do ye not Give thanks ?

arabic_text: ٧١- أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ النَّارَ الَّتِي تُورُونَ◯
english_translation: 71.See ye the Fire Which ye kindle ?

arabic_text: ٧٢- أَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنشِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 72. Is it ye who grow The tree which feeds The fire, or do We Grow it ?

arabic_text: ٧٣- نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَاهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَاعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ◯
english_translation: 73. We have made it A memorial (of Our handiwork), And an article of comfort And convenience for The denizens of deserts.

arabic_text: ٧٤- فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 74. Then celebrate with praises The name of thy Lord, The Supreme !

arabic_text: ٧٥- فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ◯
english_translation: 75.Furthermore I call To witness the setting Of the Stars,—

arabic_text: ٧٦- وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 76. And that is indeed A mighty adjuration If ye but knew,—

arabic_text: ٧٧- إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 77. That this is indeed A Qur-ān most honourable,

arabic_text: ٧٨- فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 78. In a Book well-guarded,

arabic_text: ٧٩- لَّا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 79. Which none shall touch But those who are clean :

arabic_text: ٨٠- تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 80. A Revelation from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ٨١- أَفَبِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 81.Is it such a Message That ye would hold In light esteem ?

arabic_text: ٨٢- وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 82. And have ye made it Your livelihood that ye Should declare it false ?

arabic_text: ٨٣- فَلَوْلَا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ◯
english_translation: 83. Then why do ye not (Intervene) when (the soul Of the dying man) Reaches the throat,—

arabic_text: ٨٤- وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 84. And ye the while (Sit) looking on,—

arabic_text: ٨٥- وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 85. But We are nearer To him than ye, And yet see not,—

arabic_text: ٨٦- فَلَوْلَا إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ◯
english_translation: 86. Then why do you not,— If you are exempt From (future) account,—

arabic_text: ٨٧- تَرْجِعُونَهَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 87. Call back the soul, If ye are true (In your claim of Independence) ?

arabic_text: ٨٨- فَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 88.Thus, then, if he Be of those Nearest to God,

arabic_text: ٨٩- فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 89. (There is for him) Rest And Satisfaction, and A Garden of Delights.

arabic_text: ٩٠- وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 90. And if he be Of the Companions of The Right Hand,

arabic_text: ٩١- فَسَلَامٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 91. (For him is the salutation), “ Peace be unto thee ”, From the Companions Of the Right Hand.

arabic_text: ٩٢- وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّالِّينَ◯
english_translation: 92. And if he be Of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, Who go wrong,

arabic_text: ٩٣- فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 93. For him is Entertainment With Boiling Water,

arabic_text: ٩٤- وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 94. And burning in Hell-Fire.

arabic_text: ٩٥- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ◯
english_translation: 95. Verily, this is The Very Truth And Certainty.

arabic_text: ٩٦- فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 96.So celebrate with praises The name of thy Lord, The Supreme.

arabic_text: ١- سَبَّحَ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 1.Whatever is in The heavens and on earth,— Let it declare The Praises and Glory of God : For He is the Exalted In Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: ٢- لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 2. To Him belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth : It is He Who gives Life and Death ; and He Has Power over all things.

arabic_text: ٣- هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 3. He is the First And the Last, The Evident And the Immanent : And He has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٤- هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 4. He it is Who created The heavens and the earth In six Days, and is moreover Firmly established on the Throne (Of authority). He knows What enters within the earth And what comes forth out Of it, what comes down From heaven and what mounts Up to it. And He is With you wheresoever ye May be. And God sees Well all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٥- لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى اللَّـهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ◯
english_translation: 5. To Him belongs the dominion Of the heavens and the earth : And all affairs are Referred back to God.

arabic_text: ٦- يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 6. He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night ; and He has full knowledge Of the secrets of (all) hearts.

arabic_text: ٧- آمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَأَنفِقُوا مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 7.Believe in God And His Apostle, And spend (in charity) Out of the (substance) Whereof He has made you Heirs. For, those of you Who believe and spend (In charity),—for them Is a great Reward.

arabic_text: ٨- وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ ۙ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. What cause have ye Why ye should not believe In God ?—And the Apostle Invites you to believe In your Lord, and has Indeed taken your Covenant, If ye are men of faith.

arabic_text: ٩- هُوَ الَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 9. He is the One Who Sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He May lead you from The depths of Darkness into the Light. And verily, God is to you Most kind and Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ وَلِلَّـهِ مِيرَاثُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِي مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ الْفَتْحِ وَقَاتَلَ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ الَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا مِن بَعْدُ وَقَاتَلُوا ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّـهُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 10. And what cause have ye Why ye should not spend In the cause of God ?—For to God belongs The heritage of the heavens And the earth. Not equal among you Are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (With those who did so later). Those are higher in rank Than those who spent (freely) And fought afterwards. But to all has God promised A goodly (reward). And God Is well-acquainted With all that ye do.

arabic_text: ١١- مَّن ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّـهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11.Who is he that will Loan to God a beautiful Loan ? For (God) will Increase it manifold To his credit, And he will have (besides) A liberal reward.

arabic_text: ١٢- يَوْمَ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِم بُشْرَاكُمُ الْيَوْمَ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 12. One Day shalt thou see The believing men and The believing women—How their Light runs Forward before them And by their right hands : (Their greeting will be) : “ Good News for you this Day ! Gardens beneath which flow rivers ! To dwell therein for aye ! This is indeed The highest Achievement ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣- يَوْمَ يَقُولُ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالْمُنَافِقَاتُ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا انظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ارْجِعُوا وَرَاءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُوا نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُ بَابٌ بَاطِنُهُ فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ وَظَاهِرُهُ مِن قِبَلِهِ الْعَذَابُ◯
english_translation: 13. One day will the Hypocrites—Men and women—say To the Believers : “ Wait For us ! Let us borrow (A light) from your Light ! ” It will be said : “ Turn Ye back to your rear ! Then seek a light (where Ye can) ! ” So a wall Will be put up betwixt them, With a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy Throughout, and without it, All alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment !

arabic_text: ١٤- يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْأَمَانِيُّ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِاللَّـهِ الْغَرُورُ◯
english_translation: 14. (Those without) will call out, “ Were we not with you ? ” (The others) will reply, “ True ! But ye led yourselves Into temptation ; ye looked forward (To our ruin) ; ye doubted (God’s Promise) ; and (your false) Desires deceived you ; until There issued the Command Of God. And the Deceiver Deceived you in respect of God.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ مَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ ۖ هِيَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 15. “ This Day shall no ransom Be accepted of you, nor Of those who rejected God. Your abode is the Fire : That is the proper place To claim you : and an evil Refuge it is ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦- أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 16.Has not the time arrived For the Believers that Their hearts in all humility Should engage in the remembrance Of God and of the truth Which has been revealed (to them), And that they should not Become like those to whom Was given Revelation aforetime, But long ages passed over them And their hearts grew hard ? For many among them Are rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ١٧- اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يُحْيِي الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. Know ye (all) that God giveth life To the earth after its death ! Already have We shown The Signs plainly to you, That ye may learn wisdom.

arabic_text: ١٨- إِنَّ الْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَاتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا اللَّـهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 18. For those who give In Charity, men and women, And loan to God A Beautiful Loan, It shall be increased manifold (To their credit), And they shall have (besides) A liberal reward.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرُسُلِهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَالشُّهَدَاءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 19. And those who believe In God and His apostles—They are the Sincere (Lovers of truth), and The Witnesses (who testify), In the eyes of their Lord : They shall have their Reward And their Light. But those who reject God And deny Our Signs,—They are the Companions Of Hell-Fire.

arabic_text: ٢٠- اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا ۖ وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ ۚ وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ◯
english_translation: 20.Know ye (all), that The life of this world Is but play and amusement, Pomp and mutual boasting And multiplying, (in rivalry) Among yourselves, riches And children: Here is a similitude : How rain and the growth Which it brings forth, delight (The hearts of) the tillers ; Soon it withers ; thou Wilt see it grow yellow ; Then it becomes dry And crumbles away. But in the Hereafter Is a Penalty severe (For the devotees of wrong). And Forgiveness from God And (His) Good Pleasure (For the devotees of God). And what is the life Of this world, but Goods and chattels Of deception ?

arabic_text: ٢١- سَابِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 21. Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, And a Garden (of Bliss), The width whereof is As the width of Heaven and earth, Prepared for those who believe In God and His apostles : That is the Grace of God, Which He bestows on whom He pleases : and God is The Lord of Grace abounding.

arabic_text: ٢٢- مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَا ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 22.No misfortune can happen On earth or in your souls But is recorded in A decree before We bring It into existence : That is truly easy for God :

arabic_text: ٢٣- لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا بِمَا آتَاكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّـهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ◯
english_translation: 23. In order that ye may Not despair over matters That pass you by, Nor exult over favours Bestowed upon you. For God loveth not Any vainglorious boaster,—

arabic_text: ٢٤- الَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ النَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 24. Such persons as are Covetous and commend Covetousness to men. And if any turn back (From God’s Way), verily God is free of all needs, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ٢٥- لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ النَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّـهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ◯
english_translation: 25.We sent aforetime Our apostles with Clear Signs And sent down with them The Book and the Balance (Of Right and Wrong), that men May stand forth in justice ; And We sent down Iron, In which is (material for) Mighty war, as well as Many benefits for mankind, That God may test who It is that will help, Unseen, Him and His apostles : For God is Full of Strength, Exalted in Might (And able to enforce His Will).

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالْكِتَابَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.And We sent Noah And Abraham, and established In their line Prophethood And Revelation : and some of them Were on right guidance, But many of them Became rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ٢٧- ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ابْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَاهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ رِضْوَانِ اللَّـهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَآتَيْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. Then, in their wake, We followed them up With (others of) Our apostles : We sent after them Jesus the son of Mary, And bestowed on him The Gospel ; and We ordained In the hearts of those Who followed him Compassion and Mercy. But the Monasticism Which they invented For themselves, We did not Prescribe for them : (We commanded) only The seeking for the Good Pleasure of God ; but that They did not foster As they should have done. Yet We bestowed, on those Among them who believed, Their (due) reward, but Many of them are Rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ٢٨- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَآمِنُوا بِرَسُولِهِ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 28.Oye that believe ! Fear God, and believe In His apostle, and He will Bestow on you a double Portion of His Mercy : He will provide for you A light by which ye Shall walk (straight In your path), and He Will forgive you (your past) : For God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful :

arabic_text: ٢٩- لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ اللَّـهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللَّـهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 29. That the People of The Book may know That they have no power Whatever over the Grace Of God, that (His) Grace Is (entirely) in his hand, To bestow it on Whomsoever He wills. For God is the Lord Of Grace abounding.

arabic_text: ١- قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّـهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّـهِ وَاللَّـهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 1.God has indeed Heard (and accepted) the statement Of the woman who pleads With thee concerning her husband And carries her complaint (In prayer) to God : and God (always) hears The arguments between both Sides among you : for God Hears and sees (all things).

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَائِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّائِي وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ الْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ◯
english_translation: 2. If any men among you Divorce their wives byZihār(Calling them mothers), They cannot be their mothers : None can be their mothers Except those who gave them Birth. And in fact They use words (both) iniquitous And false : but truly God is One that blots out (Sins), and forgives (Again and again).

arabic_text: ٣- وَالَّذِينَ يُظَاهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَائِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَاسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 3. But those who divorce Their wives byZihār, Then wish to go back On the words they uttered,– (It is ordained that Such a one) Should free a slave Before they touch each other : This are ye admonished To perform : and God is Well-acquainted with (all) That ye do.

arabic_text: ٤- فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَاسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 4. And if any has not (The wherewithal) He should fast for Two months consecutively Before they touch each other. But if any is unable To do so, he should feed Sixty indigent ones. This, that ye may show Your faith in God And His Apostle. Those are limits (set By) God. For those who Reject (Him), there is A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٥- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ كُبِتُوا كَمَا كُبِتَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ ۚ وَلِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 5. Those who resist God And His Apostle will be Humbled to dust, as were Those before them : for We Have already sent down Clear Signs. And the Unbelievers (Will have) a humiliating Penalty,–

arabic_text: ٦- يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّـهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا ۚ أَحْصَاهُ اللَّـهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 6. On the Day that God will raise them All up (again) and show Them the truth (and meaning) Of their conduct. God has Reckoned its (value), though They may have forgotten it, For God is Witness To all things.

arabic_text: ٧- أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَا أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَا أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 7.Seest thou not that God doth know (all) that is In the heavens and On earth? There is not A secret consultation Between three, but He Makes the fourth among them,– Nor between five but He makes the sixth,– Nor between fewer nor more, But He is in their midst, Wheresoever they be : In the end will He Tell them the truth Of their conduct, on the Day Of Judgment. For God Has full knowledge Of all things.

arabic_text: ٨- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نُهُوا عَنِ النَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَاجَوْنَ بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَاءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّـهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّـهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 8. Turnest thou not thy sight Towards those who were Forbidden secret counsels Yet revert to that which They were forbidden (to do) ? And they hold secret counsels Among themselves for iniquity And hostility, and disobedience To the Apostle. And when They come to thee, They salute thee, Not as God salutes thee (But in crooked ways) : And they say to themselves “ Why does not God Punish us for our words ? ” Enough for them is Hell : In it will they burn, And evil is that destination !

arabic_text: ٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَنَاجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ الرَّسُولِ وَتَنَاجَوْا بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ الَّذِي إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.Oye who believe ! When ye hold secret counsel, Do it not for iniquity And hostility, and disobedience To the Prophet ; but do it For righteousness and self-restraint ; And fear God, to Whom Ye shall be brought back.

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّمَا النَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ لِيَحْزُنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَيْسَ بِضَارِّهِمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. Secret counsels are only (Inspired) by the Evil One, In order that he may Cause grief to the Believers ; But he cannot harm them In the least, except as God permits ; and on God Let the Believers Put their trust.

arabic_text: ١١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا يَفْسَحِ اللَّـهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ انشُزُوا فَانشُزُوا يَرْفَعِ اللَّـهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 11.Oye who believe! When ye are told To make room In the assemblies, (Spread out and) make room : (Ample) room will God provide For you. And when Ye are told to rise up, Rise up: God will Raise up, to (suitable) ranks (And degrees), those of you Who believe and who have Been granted (mystic) Knowledge. and God is well-acquainted With all ye do.

arabic_text: ١٢- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نَاجَيْتُمُ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَةً ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 12.Oye who believe! When ye consult The Apostle in private, Spend something in charity Before your private consultation. That will be best for you, And most conducive To purity (of conduct). But if ye find not (The wherewithal), God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٣- أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَتَابَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. Is it that ye are Afraid of spending sums In charity before your Private consultation (with him) ? If, then, ye do not so, And God forgives you, Then (at least) establish Regular prayer ; practice Regular charity ; and obey God and His Apostle. And God is well-acquainted With all that ye do.

arabic_text: ١٤- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 14.Turnest thou not Thy attention to those Who turn (in friendship) To such as have the Wrath Of God upon them ? They are neither of you Nor of them, and they Swear to falsehood knowingly.

arabic_text: ١٥- أَعَدَّ اللَّـهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. God has prepared for them A severe Penalty : evil Indeed are their deeds.

arabic_text: ١٦- اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ◯
english_translation: 16. They have made their oaths A screen (for their misdeeds) : Thus they obstruct (men) From the Path of God : Therefore shall they have A humiliating Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٧- لَّن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَالُهُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ شَيْئًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. Of no profit whatever To them, against God, Will be their riches Nor their sons : They will be Companions Of the Fire, to dwell Therein (for aye) !

arabic_text: ١٨- يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّـهُ جَمِيعًا فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ ۚ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. One day will God Raise them all up (For Judgment) : then Will they swear to Him As they swear to you : And they think that they Have something (to stand upon). No, indeed ! they are But liars !

arabic_text: ١٩- اسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَأَنسَاهُمْ ذِكْرَ اللَّـهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ حِزْبُ الشَّيْطَانِ ۚ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ الشَّيْطَانِ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. The Evil One has Got the better of them : So he has made them Lose the remembrance Of God. They are the Party Of the Evil One. Truly, it is the Party Of the Evil One That will perish !

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ◯
english_translation: 20.Those who resist God and His Apostle Will be among those Most humiliated.

arabic_text: ٢١- كَتَبَ اللَّـهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِي ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ◯
english_translation: 21. God has decreed : “ It is I and My apostles Who must prevail ” : For God is One Full of strength, Able to enforce His Will.

arabic_text: ٢٢- لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْمًا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ يُوَادُّونَ مَنْ حَادَّ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلَوْ كَانُوا آبَاءَهُمْ أَوْ أَبْنَاءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوَانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ كَتَبَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْإِيمَانَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحٍ مِّنْهُ ۖ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ رَضِيَ اللَّـهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ حِزْبُ اللَّـهِ ۚ أَلَا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّـهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. Thou wilt not find Any people who believe In God and the Last Day, Loving those who resist God and His Apostle, Even though they were Their fathers or their sons, Or their brothers, or Their kindred. For such He has written Faith In their hearts, and strengthened Them with a spirit From Himself. And He Will admit them to Gardens Beneath which Rivers flow, To dwell therein (for ever). God will be well pleased With them, and they with Him. They are the Party Of God. Truly it is The Party of God that Will achieve Felicity.

arabic_text: ١- سَبَّحَ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 1.Whatever is In the heavens and On earth, let it declare The Praises and Glory Of God : for He is The Exalted in Might, The Wise.

arabic_text: هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ ۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن يَخْرُجُوا ۖ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ فَأَتَاهُمُ اللَّـهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا ۖ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ ۚ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ◯
english_translation: 2.It is He Who got out The Unbelievers among The People of the Book From their homes At the first gathering (Of the forces). Little did ye think That they would get out : And they thought That their fortresses Would defend them from God ! But the (Wrath of) God Came to them from quarters From which they little Expected (it), and cast Terror into their hearts, So that they destroyed Their dwellings by their own Hands and the hands Of the Believers. Take warning, then, O ye with eyes (to see) !

arabic_text: ٢- وَلَوْلَا أَن كَتَبَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْجَلَاءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابُ النَّارِ◯
english_translation: 3. And had it not been That God has decreed Banishment for them, He would certainly have Punished them in this world : And in the Hereafter They shall (certainly) have The Punishment of the Fire.

arabic_text: ٣- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۖ وَمَن يُشَاقِّ اللَّـهَ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 4. That is because they Resisted God and His Apostle : And if any one resists God, Verily God is severe In Punishment.

arabic_text: ٤- مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَائِمَةً عَلَىٰ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ الْفَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 5. Whether ye cut down (O ye Muslims !) The tender palm-trees, Or ye left them standing On their roots, it was By leave of God, and In order that He might Cover with shame The rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ٥- وَمَا أَفَاءَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ وَلَا رِكَابٍ وَلَـٰكِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 6.What God has bestowed On His Apostle (and taken Away) from them—for this Ye made no expedition With either cavalry or camelry : But God gives power To His apostles over Any He pleases : and God Has power over all things.

arabic_text: ٦- مَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّـهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ كَيْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةً بَيْنَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانتَهُوا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ◯
english_translation: 7. What God has bestowed On His Apostle (and taken Away) from the people Of the townships,—belongs To God,—to His Apostle And to kindred and orphans, The needy and the wayfarer ; In order that it may not (Merely) make a circuit Between the wealth among you. So take what the Apostle Assigns to you, and deny Yourselves that which he Withholds from you. And fear God ; for God Is strict in Punishment.

arabic_text: ٧- لِلْفُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الَّذِينَ أُخْرِجُوا مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأَمْوَالِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَرِضْوَانًا وَيَنصُرُونَ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الصَّادِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. (Some part is due) To the indigent Muhājirs, Those who were expelled From their homes and their property, While seeking Grace from God And (His) Good Pleasure, And aiding God and His Apostle : Such are indeed The sincere ones ;—

arabic_text: ٨- وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُوا الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِّمَّا أُوتُوا وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ ۚ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. But those who Before them, had homes (In Medina) And had adopted the Faith,— Show their affection to such As came to them for refuge, And entertain no desire In their hearts for things Given to the (latter), But give them preference Over themselves, even though Poverty was their (own lot). And those saved from The covetousness of their own Souls,—they are the ones That achieve prosperity.

arabic_text: ٩- وَالَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 10. And those who came After them say : “ Our Lord ! Forgive us, and our brethren Who came before us Into the Faith, And leave not, In our hearts, Rancour (or sense of injury) Against those who have believed. Our Lord ! Thou art Indeed Full of Kindness, Most Merciful. ”

arabic_text: ١٠- أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَانِهِمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمْ أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْ وَاللَّـهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 11.Hast thou not observed The Hypocrites say To their misbelieving brethren Among the People of the Book ?— “ If ye are expelled, We too will go out With you, and we will Never hearken to any one In your affair ; and if Ye are attacked (in fight) We will help you. ” But God is witness That they are indeed liars.

arabic_text: ١١- لَئِنْ أُخْرِجُوا لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُوا لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ الْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. If they are expelled, Never will they go out With them ; and if they Are attacked (in fight), They will never help them ; And if they do help them, They will turn their backs ; So they will receive no help.

arabic_text: ١٢- لَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ اللَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. Of a truth ye are Stronger (than they) Because of the terror In their hearts, (Sent) by God. This is because they are Men devoid of understanding.

arabic_text: ١٣- لَا يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعًا إِلَّا فِي قُرًى مُّحَصَّنَةٍ أَوْ مِن وَرَاءِ جُدُرٍ ۚ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدٌ ۚ تَحْسَبُهُمْ جَمِيعًا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتَّىٰ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَ◯
english_translation: 14. They will not fight you (Even) together, except In fortified townships, Or from behind walls. Strong is their fighting (spirit) Amongst themselves : Thou wouldst think They were united, But their hearts are divided : That is because they Are a people devoid Of wisdom.

arabic_text: ١٤- كَمَثَلِ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيبًا ۖ ذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 15. Like those who lately Preceded them, they have Tasted the evil result Of their conduct ; and (In the Hereafter there is) For them a grievous Penalty ;—

arabic_text: ١٥- كَمَثَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلْإِنسَانِ اكْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّنكَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ اللَّـهَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 16. (Their allies deceived them), Like the Evil One, When he says to man, “ Deny God ” : but when (Man) denies God, (The Evil One) says, “ I am free of thee : I do fear God, The Lord of the Worlds ! ”

arabic_text: ١٦- فَكَانَ عَاقِبَتَهُمَا أَنَّهُمَا فِي النَّارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. The end of both will be That they will go Into the Fire, dwelling Therein for ever. Such is the reward Of the wrong-doers.

arabic_text: ١٧- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 18.Oye who believe ! Fear God, And let every soul look To what (provision) he has Sent forth for the morrow. Yea, fear God : For God is well-acquainted With (all) they ye do.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ نَسُوا اللَّـهَ فَأَنسَاهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. And be ye not like Those who forgot God ; And He made them forget Their own souls ! Such Are the rebellious transgressors !

arabic_text: ١٩- لَا يَسْتَوِي أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ وَأَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ ۚ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمُ الْفَائِزُونَ◯
english_translation: 20. Not equal are The Companions of the Fire And the Companions Of the Garden : It is the Companions of the Garden, That will achieve Felicity.

arabic_text: ٢٠- لَوْ أَنزَلْنَا هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٍ لَّرَأَيْتَهُ خَاشِعًا مُّتَصَدِّعًا مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَتِلْكَ الْأَمْثَالُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 21.Had We sent down This Qur-ān on a mountain, Verily, thou would have seen It humble itself and cleave Asunder for fear of God. Such are the similitudes Which We propound to men, That they may reflect.

arabic_text: ٢١- هُوَ اللَّـهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ ۖ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ◯
english_translation: 22.God is He, than Whom There is no other god ;— Who knows (all things) Both secret and open ; He, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٢٢- هُوَ اللَّـهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْمَلِكُ الْقُدُّوسُ السَّلَامُ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ الْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّـهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 23.
