God is He, than Whom There is no other god ;— The Sovereign, the Holy One, the Source of Peace (and Perfection), The Guardian of Faith, The Preserver of Safety, The Exalted in Might, The Irresistible, the Supreme : Glory to God ! (High is He) Above the partners They attribute to Him.

arabic_text: ٢٣- هُوَ اللَّـهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 24. He is God, the Creator, The Evolver, The Bestower of Forms (Or Colours). To Him belong The Most Beautiful Names : Whatever is in The heavens and on earth, Doth declare His Praises and Glory : And He is the Exalted In Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِمَا جَاءَكُم مِّنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۙ أَن تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي ۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنتُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ◯
english_translation: 1.Oye who believe ! Take not My enemies And yours as friends (Or protectors),—offering them (Your) love, even though They have rejected the Truth That has come to you, And have (on the contrary) Driven out the Prophet And yourselves (from your homes), (Simply) because ye believe In God your Lord ! If ye have come out To strive in My Way And to seek My Good Pleasure, (Take them not as friends), Holding secret converse Of love (and friendship) With them : for I know Full well all that ye Conceal and all that ye Reveal. And any of you That does this has strayed From the Straight Path.

arabic_text: ٢- إِن يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. If they were to get The better of you, They would behave to you As enemies, and stretch forth Their hands and their tongues Against you for evil ; And they desire that ye Should reject the Truth.

arabic_text: ٣- لَن تَنفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 3. Of no profit to you Will be your relatives And your children On the Day of Judgment : He will judge between you : For God sees well All that ye do.

arabic_text: ٤- قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ إِذْ قَالُوا لِقَوْمِهِمْ إِنَّا بُرَآءُ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّـهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَاءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَا أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّـهِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 4.There is for you An excellent example (to follow) In Abraham and those with him, When they said To their people : “ We are clear of you And of whatever ye worship Besides God : we have rejected You, and there has arisen, Between us and you, enmity And hatred for ever,—unless Ye believe in God And Him alone ” : But not when Abraham Said to his father : “ I will pray for forgiveness For thee, though I have No power (to get) aught On thy behalf from God. ” (They prayed) : “ Our Lord ! In Thee do we trust, And to Thee do we turn In repentance : to Thee Is (our) final Goal.

arabic_text: ٥- رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 5. “ Our Lord ! Make us not A (test and) trial For the Unbelievers, But forgive us, our Lord ! For Thou art the Exalted In Might, the Wise. ”

arabic_text: ٦- لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّـهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ◯
english_translation: 6. There was indeed in them An excellent example for you To follow,–for those Whose hope is in God And in the Last Day. But if any turn away, Truly God is Free of all Wants, Worthy of all Praise.

arabic_text: ٧- عَسَى اللَّـهُ أَن يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةً ۚ وَاللَّـهُ قَدِيرٌ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 7.It may be that God Will grant love (and friendship) Between you and those whom Ye (now) hold as enemies. For God has power (Over all things) ; And God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٨- لَّا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّـهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيَارِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوا إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. God forbids you not, With regard to those who Fight you not for (your) Faith Nor drive you out Of your homes, From dealing kindly and justly With them : For God loveth Those who are just.

arabic_text: ٩- إِنَّمَا يَنْهَاكُمُ اللَّـهُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ قَاتَلُوكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيَارِكُمْ وَظَاهَرُوا عَلَىٰ إِخْرَاجِكُمْ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. God only forbids you, With regard to those who Fight you for (your) Faith, And drive you out Of your homes, and support (Others) in driving you out, From turning to them (For friendship and protection). It is such as turn to them (In these circumstances), That do wrong.

arabic_text: ١٠- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا جَاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ مُهَاجِرَاتٍ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ ۖ اللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِهِنَّ ۖ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِنَاتٍ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ ۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ ۖ وَآتُوهُم مَّا أَنفَقُوا ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۚ وَلَا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوَافِرِ وَاسْأَلُوا مَا أَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْأَلُوا مَا أَنفَقُوا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّـهِ ۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 10.Oye who believe ! When there come to you Believing women refugees, Examine (and test) them : God knows best as to Their Faith : if ye ascertain That they are Believers, Then send them not back To the Unbelievers. They are not lawful (wives) For the Unbelievers, nor are The (Unbelievers) lawful (husbands) For them. But pay The Unbelievers what they Have spent (on their dower). And there will be no blame On you if ye marry them On payment of their dower To them. But hold not To the guardianship of Unbelieving women : ask For what ye have spent On their dowers, and let The (Unbelievers) ask for What they have spent (On the dowers of women Who come over to you). Such is the command Of God : He judges (With justice) between you. And God is Full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

arabic_text: ١١- وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَيْءٌ مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَآتُوا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْوَاجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَا أَنفَقُوا ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ الَّذِي أَنتُم بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. And if any Of your wives deserts you To the Unbelievers, And ye have an accession (By the coming over of A woman from the other side), Then pay to those Whose wives have deserted The equivalent of what they Had spent (on their dower). And fear God, In Whom ye believe.

arabic_text: ١٢- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّـهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ ۙ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّـهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 12.OProphet ! When believing women come To thee to take the oath Of fealty to thee, that they Will not associate in worship Any other thing whatever With God, that they Will not steal, that they Will not commit adultery (Or fornication), that they Will not kill their children, That they will not utter Slander, intentionally forging Falsehood, and that they Will not disobey thee In any just matter,– Then do thou receive Their fealty, and pray to God For the forgiveness (of Their sins) : for God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٣- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْمًا غَضِبَ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُوا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْقُبُورِ◯
english_translation: 13.Oye who believe ! Turn not (for friendship) To people on whom Is the Wrath of God. Of the Hereafter they are Already in despair, just as The Unbelievers are In despair about those (Buried) in graves.

arabic_text: ١- سَبَّحَ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 1.Whatever is In the heavens and On earth, let it declare The Praises and Glory Of God : for He is The Exalted in Might, The Wise.

arabic_text: ٢- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 2.Oye who believe ! Why say ye that Which ye do not ?

arabic_text: ٣- كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ اللَّـهِ أَن تَقُولُوا مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. Grievously odious is it In the sight of God That ye say that Which ye do not.

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ اللَّـهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَانٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ◯
english_translation: 4. Truly God loves those Who fight in His Cause In battle array, as if They were a solid Cemented structure.

arabic_text: ٥- وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّـهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّـهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 5.And remember, Moses said To his people : “ O my people ! Why do ye vex and insult Me, though ye know That I am the apostle Of God (sent) to you ? ” Then when they went wrong, God let their hearts go wrong. For God guides not those Who are rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّـهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 6.And remember, Jesus, The son of Mary, said : “ O Children of Israel ! I am the apostle of God (Sent) to you, confirming The Law (which came) Before me, and giving Glad Tidings of an Apostle To come after me, Whose name shall be Ahmad. ” But when he came to them With Clear Signs, They said, “ This is Evident sorcery ! ”

arabic_text: ٧- وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّـهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 7.Who doth greater wrong Than one who invents Falsehood against God, Even as he is being invited to Islām ? And God Guides not those Who do wrong.

arabic_text: ٨- يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِئُوا نُورَ اللَّـهِ بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَاللَّـهُ مُتِمُّ نُورِهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. Their intention is To extinguish God’s Light (By blowing) with their mouths : But God will complete (The revelation of) His Light, Even though the Unbelievers May detest (it).

arabic_text: ٩- هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. It is He Who has sent His Apostle with Guidance and the Religion of Truth, That he may proclaim it Over all religion, Even though the Pagans May detest (it).

arabic_text: ١٠- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ تِجَارَةٍ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 10.Oye who believe ! Shall I lead you To a bargain that will Save you from A grievous Penalty ?—

arabic_text: ١١- تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَتُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. That ye believe in God And His Apostle, and that Ye strive (your utmost) In the Cause of God, With your property And your persons : That will be best for you, If ye but knew !

arabic_text: ١٢- يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ وَمَسَاكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 12. He will forgive you Your sins, and admit you To Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, and to beautiful Mansions in Gardens Of Eternity : that is indeed The supreme Achievement.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌ مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَفَتْحٌ قَرِيبٌ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. And another (favour will He bestow), which ye Do love, — help from God and a speedy victory. So give the Glad Tidings To the Believers.

arabic_text: ١٤- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا أَنصَارَ اللَّـهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّينَ مَنْ أَنصَارِي إِلَى اللَّـهِ ۖ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ اللَّـهِ ۖ فَآمَنَت طَّائِفَةٌ مِّن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّائِفَةٌ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا ظَاهِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 14.Oye who believe ! Be ye helpers of God : As said Jesus the son of Mary To the Disciples, “ Who will be My helpers to (the work Of) God ? ” Said the Disciples,  “ We are God’s helpers ! ” Then a portion of the Children Of Israel believed, and A portion disbelieved : But We gave power To those who believed, Against their enemies, And they became The ones that prevailed.

arabic_text: ١- يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ◯
english_translation: 1. Whatever is In the heavens and On earth, doth declare The Praises and Glory of God,— the Sovereign, The Holy One, the Exalted In Might, the Wise.

arabic_text: ٢- هُوَ الَّذِي بَعَثَ فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا مِن قَبْلُ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 2. It is He Who has sent Amongst the Unlettered An apostle from among Themselves, to rehearse To them His Signs, To sanctify them, and To instruct them in Scripture And Wisdom,— although They had been, before, In manifest error ;—

arabic_text: ٣- وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 3. As well as (to confer All these benefits upon) Others of them, who Have not already joined them : And He is Exalted In Might, Wise.

arabic_text: ٤- ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّـهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 4. Such is the Bounty of God, Which He bestows On whom He will : And God is the Lord Of the highest bounty.

arabic_text: ٥- مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّوْرَاةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ الْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 5.The similitude of those Who were charged With the (obligations Of the) Mosaic Law, But who subsequently failed In those (obligations), is That of a donkey Which carries huge tomes (But understands them not). Evil is the similitude Of people who falsify The Signs of God : And God guides not People who do wrong.

arabic_text: ٦- قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ هَادُوا إِن زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ لِلَّـهِ مِن دُونِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. Say: “ O ye that Stand on Judaism ! If ye think that ye Are friends to God, To the exclusion of (Other) men, then express Your desire for Death, If ye are truthful! ”

arabic_text: ٧- وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُ أَبَدًا بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ بِالظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 7. But never will they Express their desire (For Death), because of The (deeds) their hands Have sent on before them ! And God knows well Those that do wrong !

arabic_text: ٨- قُلْ إِنَّ الْمَوْتَ الَّذِي تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مُلَاقِيكُمْ ۖ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. Say : “ The Death from which Ye flee will truly Overtake you : then will Ye be sent back To the Knower of things Secret and open : and He Will tell you (the truth Of) the things that ye did ! ”

arabic_text: ٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ مِن يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوْا إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ وَذَرُوا الْبَيْعَ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.Oye who believe ! When the call is proclaimed To prayer on Friday (The Day of Assembly), Hasten earnestly to the Remembrance Of God, and leave off Business (and traffic) : That is best for you If ye but knew !

arabic_text: ١٠- فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَانتَشِرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَابْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِ اللَّـهِ وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّـهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 10. And when the Prayer Is finished, then may ye Disperse through the land, And seek of the Bounty of God : and celebrate The Praises of God Often (and without stint) : That ye may prosper.

arabic_text: ١١- وَإِذَا رَأَوْا تِجَارَةً أَوْ لَهْوًا انفَضُّوا إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَائِمًا ۚ قُلْ مَا عِندَ اللَّـهِ خَيْرٌ مِّنَ اللَّـهْوِ وَمِنَ التِّجَارَةِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 11.But when they see Some bargain or some Amusement, they disperse Headlong to it, and leave Thee standing. Say : “ The (blessing) from the Presence of God is better than Any amusement or bargain ! And God is the Best To provide (for all needs).”

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَاللَّـهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُ وَاللَّـهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَكَاذِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.When the Hypocrites Come to thee, they say, “ We bear witness that thou Art indeed the Apostle Of God. ” Yea, God Knoweth that thou art Indeed His Apostle, And God beareth witness That the Hypocrites are Indeed liars.

arabic_text: ٢- اتَّخَذُوا أَيْمَانَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ سَاءَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. They have made their oaths A screen (for their misdeeds): Thus they obstruct (men) From the Path of God: Truly evil are their deeds.

arabic_text: ٣- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا فَطُبِعَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. That is because they believed, Then they rejected Faith: So a seal was set On their hearts: therefore They understand not.

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَقُولُوا تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ ۖ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ هُمُ الْعَدُوُّ فَاحْذَرْهُمْ ۚ قَاتَلَهُمُ اللَّـهُ ۖ أَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 4.When thou lookest At them, their exteriors Please thee; and when They speak, thou listenest To their words. They are As (worthless as hollow) Pieces of timber propped up, (Unable to stand on their own). They think that every Cry is against them. They are the enemies; So beware of them. The curse of God be On them! How are they Deluded (away from the Truth)!

arabic_text: ٥- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّـهِ لَوَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. And when it is said To them, “ Come, the Apostle Of God will pray for your Forgiveness ”, they turn aside Their heads, and thou wouldst See them turning away Their faces in arrogance.

arabic_text: ٦- سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ لَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّـهُ لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 6.It is equal to them Whether thou pray for Their forgiveness or not. God will not forgive them. Truly God guides not Rebellious transgressors.

arabic_text: ٧- هُمُ الَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُوا عَلَىٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اللَّـهِ حَتَّىٰ يَنفَضُّوا ۗ وَلِلَّـهِ خَزَائِنُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. They are the ones who say, “ Spend nothing on those Who are with God’s Apostle, To the end that they May disperse (and quit Medinah). ” But to God belong The treasures of the heavens And the earth; but The Hypocrites understand not.

arabic_text: ٨- يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ ۚ وَلِلَّـهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 8. They say, “ If we Return to Medinah, surely The more honourable (element) Will expel therefrom the meaner ”. But honour belongs to God And His Apostle, and To the Believers; but The Hypocrites know not.

arabic_text: ٩- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُلْهِكُمْ أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 9.Oye who believe! Let not your riches Or your children divert you From the remembrance of God. If any act thus, The loss is their own.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَنفِقُوا مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَاكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. And spend something (in charity) Out of the substance Which We have bestowed On you, before Death Should come to any of you And he should say, “ O my Lord ! Why didst Thou not give me Respite for a little while? I should then have given (Largely) in charity, and I Should have been one Of the doers of good ”.

arabic_text: ١١- وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّـهُ نَفْسًا إِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهَا ۚ وَاللَّـهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 11. But to no soul Will God grant respite When the time appointed (For it) has come; and God Is well acquainted With (all) that ye do.

arabic_text: ١- يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّـهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 1.Whatever is In the heavens and On earth, doth declare The Praises and Glory Of God : to Him belongs Dominion, and to Him belongs Praise : and He has power Over all things.

arabic_text: ٢- هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 2. It is He Who has Created you ; and of you Are some that are Unbelievers, and some That are Believers : And God sees well All that ye do.

arabic_text: ٣- خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 3. He has created the heavens And the earth In just proportions, And has given you shape, And made your shapes Beautiful : and to Him Is the final Goal.

arabic_text: ٤- يَعْلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 4. He knows what is In the heavens And on earth ; And He knows what Ye conceal and what Ye reveal : yea, God Knows well the (secrets) Of (all) hearts.

arabic_text: ٥- أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 5.Has not the story Reached you, of those Who rejected Faith aforetime? So they tasted the evil Result of their conduct ; And they had A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ٦- ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا وَتَوَلَّوا ۚ وَّاسْتَغْنَى اللَّـهُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 6. That was because there Came to them apostles With Clear Signs, But they said : “Shall (mere) human beings Direct us?” So they rejected (The Message) and turned away. But God can do without (them) : And God is Free of all needs, Worthy of all praise.

arabic_text: ٧- زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّـهِ يَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 7.The Unbelievers think That they will not be Raised up (for Judgment). Say : “Yea, by my Lord, Ye shall surely be Raised up : then shall ye Be told (the truth) of All that ye did. And that is easy for God.”

arabic_text: ٨- فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 8. Believe, therefore, in God And His Apostle, and In the Light which We Have sent down. And God Is well acquainted With all that ye do.

arabic_text: ٩- يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّـهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ◯
english_translation: 9. The Day that He assembles You (all) for a day Of Assembly,— that will be A day of mutual loss And gain (among you). And those who believe In God and work righteousness,— He will remove from them Their ills, and He will admit Them to gardens beneath which Rivers flow, to dwell therein For ever : that will be The Supreme Achievement.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 10. But those who reject Faith And treat Our Signs As falsehoods, they will be Companions of the Fire, To dwell therein for aye : And evil is that Goal.

arabic_text: ١١- مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّـهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّـهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 11.No kind of calamity Can occur, except By the leave of God : And if any one believes In God, (God) guides his Heart (aright) : for God Knows all things.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّـهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ◯
english_translation: 12. So obey God, and obey His Apostle : but if Ye turn back, the duty Of Our Apostle is but To proclaim (the Message) Clearly and openly.

arabic_text: ١٣- اللَّـهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّـهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 13. God! There is no god But He : and on God, Therefore, let the Believers Put their trust.

arabic_text: ١٤- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 14. O ye who believe ! Truly, among your wives And your children are (some That are) enemies to Yourselves : so beware Of them! But if ye Forgive and overlook, And cover up (their faults) Verily God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 15. Your riches and your children May be but a trial : But in the Presence of God, Is the highest Reward.

arabic_text: ١٦- فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ◯
english_translation: 16.So fear God As much as ye can ; Listen and obey ; And spend in charity For the benefit of Your own souls. And those saved from The covetousness of their own Souls,— they are the ones That achieve prosperity.

arabic_text: ١٧- إِن تُقْرِضُوا اللَّـهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 17. If ye loan to God A beautiful loan, He Will double it to Your (credit), and He Will grant you Forgiveness : For God is most Ready To appreciate (service), Most Forbearing,—

arabic_text: ١٨- عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 18. Knower of what is hidden And what is open, Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِن بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّـهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّـهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ ۚ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّـهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا◯
english_translation: 1.OProphet ! When ye Do divorce women, Divorce them at their Prescribed periods, And count (accurately) Their prescribed periods : And fear God your Lord : And turn them not out Of their houses, nor shall They (themselves) leave, Except in case they are Guilty of some open lewdness, Those are limits, Set by God : and any Who transgresses the limits Of God, does verily Wrong his (own) soul : Thou knowest not if Perchance God will Bring about thereafter Some new situation.

arabic_text: ٢- فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّـهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّـهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّـهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا◯
english_translation: 2. Thus when they fulfill Their term appointed, Either take them back On equitable terms Or part with them On equitable terms ; And take for witness Two persons from among you, Endued with justice, And establish the evidence (As) before God. Such Is the admonition given To him who believes In God and the Last Day. And for those who fear God, He (ever) prepares A way out,

arabic_text: ٣- وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّـهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّـهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا◯
english_translation: 3. And He provides for him From (sources) he never Could imagine. And if Any one puts his trust In God, sufficient is (God) For him. For God will Surely accomplish His purpose : Verily for all things Has God appointed A due proportion.

arabic_text: ٤- وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّـهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 4.Such of your women As have passed the age Of monthly courses, for them The prescribed period, if ye Have any doubts, is Three months, and for those Who have no courses (It is the same) : For those who carry (Life within their wombs), Their period is until They deliver their burdens : And for those who Fear God, He will Make their path easy.

arabic_text: ٥- ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّـهِ أَنزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّـهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا◯
english_translation: 5. That is the Command of God, which He Has sent down to you : And if any one fears God, He will remove his ills From him, and will enlarge His reward.

arabic_text: ٦- أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6.Let the women live (In ‘iddat) in the same Style as ye live, According to your means : Annoy them not, so as To restrict them. And if they carry (life In their wombs), then Spend (your substance) on them Until they deliver Their burden : and if They suckle your (offspring), Give them their recompense : And take mutual counsel Together, according to What is just and reasonable. And if ye find yourselves In difficulties, let another Woman suckle (the child) On the (father’s) behalf.

arabic_text: ٧- لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّـهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّـهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّـهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 7. Let the man of means Spend according to His means : and the man Whose resources are restricted, Let him spend according To what God has given him. God puts no burden On any person beyond What He has given him. After a difficulty, God Will soon grant relief.

arabic_text: ٨- وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا◯
english_translation: 8.How many populations That insolently opposed The command of their Lord And of His apostles, Did We not then Call to account,— To severe account?— And We imposed on them An exemplary Punishment.

arabic_text: ٩- فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 9. Then did they taste The evil result of Their conduct, and the End of their conduct was Perdition.

arabic_text: ١٠- أَعَدَّ اللَّـهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّـهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ اللَّـهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا◯
english_translation: 10. God has prepared for them A severe Punishment (In the Hereafter). Therefore fear God, O ye men of understanding— Who have believed!— For God hath indeed Sent down to you A Message

arabic_text: ١١- رَّسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّـهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّـهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّـهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا◯
english_translation: 11. An Apostle, who rehearses To you the Signs of God Containing clear explanations, That he may lead forth Those who believe And do righteous deeds From the depths of Darkness Into Light. And those who Believe in God and work Righteousness, He will admit To Gardens beneath which rivers Flow, to dwell therein For ever : God has indeed Granted for them A most excellent provision.

arabic_text: ١٢- اللَّـهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّـهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّـهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا◯
english_translation: 12. God is He Who Created seven Firmaments And of the earth A similar number. Through the midst Of them (all) descends His Command : that ye may Know that God has power Over all things, and that God comprehends all things In (His) Knowledge.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّـهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 1.OProphet ! Why Holdest thou to be forbidden That which God has Made lawful to thee ? Thou seekest to please Thy consorts. But God is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ٢- قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّـهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ◯
english_translation: 2. God has already ordained For you, (O men), The dissolution of your oaths (In some cases) : and God Is your Protector, and He Is Full of Knowledge And Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّـهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَن بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 3.When the Prophet disclosed A matter in confidence To one of his consorts And she then divulged it (To another), and God made it Known to him, he confirmed Part thereof and repudiated A part. Then when he Told her thereof, she said, “ Who told thee this ? ” He said, “ He told me Who knows and is well-acquainted (With all things) ”

arabic_text: ٤- إِن تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّـهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّـهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 4. If ye two turn in repentance To Him, your hearts Are indeed so inclined ; but if ye back up Each other against him, Truly God is his Protector, And Gabriel, and (every) Righteous one among those Who believe,— and furthermore, The angels— will back (him) up.

arabic_text: ٥- عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُّؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا◯
english_translation: 5.It may be, if he Divorced you (all), That God will give him In exchange Consorts Better than you,— Who submit (their wills), Who believe, who are devout, Who turn to God in repentance, Who worship (in humility), Who travel (for Faith) and fast,— Previously married or virgins.

arabic_text: ٦- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ اللَّـهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. O ye who believe! Save yourselves and your Families from a Fire Whose fuel is Men And Stones, over which Are (appointed) angels Stern (and) severe, Who flinch not (from Executing) the Commands They receive from God, but do (precisely) what They are commanded.

arabic_text: ٧- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. (They will say), “ O ye Unbelievers ! Make no excuses This day ! Ye are being But requited for All that ye did ! ”

arabic_text: ٨- يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّـهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّـهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 8.Oye who believe! Turn to God With sincere repentance : In the hope that Your Lord will remove From you your ills And admit you to Gardens Beneath which Rivers flow,— The Day that God Will not permit To be humiliated The Prophet and those Who believe with him. Their Light will run Forward before them And by their right hands, While they say, “ Our Lord ! Perfect our Light for us, And grant us Forgiveness ; For Thou hast power Over all things. ”

arabic_text: ٩- يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 9.OProphet ! Strive hard Against the Unbelievers And the Hypocrites, And be firm against them. Their abode is Hell,— An evil refuge (indeed).

arabic_text: ١٠- ضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّـهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 10.God sets forth, For an example To the Unbelievers, the wife of Noah And the wife of Lūṭ : They were (respectively) Under two of Our righteous Servants, but they were False to their (husbands), And they profited nothing Before God on their account, But were told : “ Enter ye The Fire along with (Others) that enter ! ”

arabic_text: ١١- وَضَرَبَ اللَّـهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 11. And God sets forth, As an example To those who believe, The wife of Pharaoh : Behold she said : “ O my Lord ! build For me, in nearness To Thee, a mansion In the Garden, And save me from Pharaoh And his doings And save me from Those that do wrong ” ;

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ◯
english_translation: 12. And Mary the daughter Of ‘ Imran, who guarded Her chastity; and We Breathed into (her body) Of Our spirit ; and she Testified to the truth Of the words of her Lord And of His Revelations, And was one of the Devout (servants).

arabic_text: ١-تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 1.Blessed be He In Whose hands Is Dominion ; And He over all things Hath Power ;—

arabic_text: ٢-الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ◯
english_translation: 2.  He Who created Death And Life, that He May try which of you Is best in deed : And He is the Exalted In Might, Oft-Forgiving ;—

arabic_text: ٣-الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ◯
english_translation: 3.  He Who created The seven heavens One above another : No want of proportion Wilt thou see In the Creation Of (God) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again : Seest thou any flaw ?

arabic_text: ٤-ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 4.  Again turn thy vision A second time : (thy) vision Will come back to thee Dull and discomfited, In a state worn out.

arabic_text: ٥-وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 5.  And We have, (From of old), Adorned the lowest heaven With Lamps, and We Have made such (Lamps) (As) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, And have prepared for them The Penalty Of the Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ٦-وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ◯
english_translation: 6.  For those who reject Their Lord (and Cherisher) Is the Penalty of Hell : And evil is (such) destination.

arabic_text: ٧-إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ◯
english_translation: 7.  When they are cast therein, They will hear The (terrible) drawing in Of its breath Even as it blazes forth,

arabic_text: ٨-تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 8.  Almost bursting with fury : Every time a Group Is cast therein, its Keepers Will ask, “ Did no Warner Come to you ? ”

arabic_text: ٩-قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّـهُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 9.  They will say: “Yes indeed ; A Warner did come to us, But we rejected him And said, ‘ God never Sent down any (Message) : Ye are in nothing but An egregious delusion ! ’ ”

arabic_text: ١٠- وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 10. They will further say : “ Had we but listened Or used our intelligence, We should not (now) Be among the Companions Of the Blazing Fire ! ”

arabic_text: ١١- فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ◯
english_translation: 11. They will then confess Their sins : but far Will be (Forgiveness) From the Companions Of the Blazing Fire!

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 12.As for those who Fear their Lord unseen, For them is Forgiveness And a great Reward.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 13. And whether ye hide Your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, Of the secrets of (all) hearts.

arabic_text: ١٤- أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 14. Should He not know,— He that created ? And He is the One That understands the finest Mysteries (and) is Well-acquainted (with them).

arabic_text: ١٥- هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ◯
english_translation: 15.It is He Who has Made the earth manageable For you, so traverse Ye through its tracts And enjoy of the Sustenance Which He furnishes : but Unto Him is the Resurrection.

arabic_text: ١٦- أَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ◯
english_translation: 16. Do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven Will not cause you To be swallowed up By the earth when it Shakes (as in an earthquake) ?

arabic_text: ١٧- أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ◯
english_translation: 17. Or do ye feel secure That He Who is in Heaven Will not send against you A violent tornado (With showers of stones), So that ye shall Know how (terrible) Was My warning ?

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ◯
english_translation: 18. But indeed men before them Rejected (My warning) : Then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them) ?

arabic_text: ١٩- أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 19.Do they not observe The birds above them, Spreading their wings And folding them in ? None can uphold them Except (God) Most Gracious : Truly it is He That watches over all things.

arabic_text: ٢٠- أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ◯
english_translation: 20. Nay, who is there That can help you, (Even as) an army, Besides (God) Most Merciful ? In nothing but delusion Are the Unbelievers.

arabic_text: ٢١- أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ◯
english_translation: 21. Or who is there That can provide you With Sustenance if He Were to withhold His provision ? Nay, they obstinately persist In insolent impiety And flight (from the Truth).

arabic_text: ٢٢- أَفَمَن يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰ أَمَّن يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 22.Is then one who Walks headlong, with his face Grovelling, better guided,— Or one who walks Evenly on a Straight Way ?

arabic_text: ٢٣- قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. Say : “ It is He Who Has created you (and made You grow), and made For you the faculties Of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding : Little thanks it is ye give.”

arabic_text: ٢٤- قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ◯
english_translation: 24. Say : “ It is He Who Has multiplied you Through the earth, And to Him shall ye Be gathered together. ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 25.They ask : When will This promise be (fulfilled) ?— If ye are telling The truth.

arabic_text: ٢٦- قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّـهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 26. Say : “ As to the knowledge Of the time, it is With God alone : I am (sent) only To warn plainly in public. ”

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. At length, when they See it close at hand, Grieved will be the faces Of the Unbelievers, And it will be said (To them) : “ This is (the promise fulfilled), Which ye were calling for ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّـهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 28.Say : “ See ye ? If God were To destroy me, And those with me, Or if He bestows His Mercy on us,— Yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from A grievous Penalty?”

arabic_text: ٢٩- قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ◯
english_translation: 29. Say : “ He is (God) Most Gracious : we have Believed in Him, And on Him have we Put our trust : So, soon will ye know Which (of us) it is That is in manifest error. ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَاءٍ مَّعِينٍ◯
english_translation: 30. Say : “See ye ?— If your stream be Some morning lost (In the underground earth), Who then can supply you With clear-flowing water ? ”

arabic_text: ١- ن ۚ وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.Nun. By the Pen And by the (Record) Which (men) write,—

arabic_text: ٢- مَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 2. Thou art not, By the grace of thy Lord, Mad or possessed.

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 3. Nay, verily for thee Is a Reward unfailing :

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 4. And thou (standest) On an exalted standard Of character.

arabic_text: ٥- فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Soon wilt thou see, And they will see,

arabic_text: ٦- بِأَييِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ◯
english_translation: 6. Which of you is Afflicted with madness.

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ◯
english_translation: 7. Verily it is thy Lord That knoweth best, Which (among men) Hath strayed from His Path : And He knoweth best Those who receive (True) Guidance.

arabic_text: ٨- فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 8.So hearken not To those who deny (the Truth).

arabic_text: ٩- وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 9. Their desire is that Thou shouldst be pliant : So would they be pliant.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ◯
english_translation: 10. Need not the type Of despicable man,— Ready with oaths,

arabic_text: ١١- هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 11. A slanderer, going about With calumnies,

arabic_text: ١٢- مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 12. (Habitually) hindering (all) good, Transgressing beyond bounds, Deep in sin,

arabic_text: ١٣- عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 13. Violent (and cruel),— With all that, base-born,—

arabic_text: ١٤- أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ◯
english_translation: 14. Because he possesses Wealth and (numerous) sons.

arabic_text: ١٥- إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 15. When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, “ Tales of the Ancients ”, He cries !

arabic_text: ١٦- سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ◯
english_translation: 16. Soon shall We brand (The beast) on the snout !

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 17.Verily We have tried them As We tried the People Of the Garden, When they resolved to gather The fruits of the (garden) In the morning,

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ◯
english_translation: 18. But made no reservation, (“ If it be God’s Will ”).

arabic_text: ١٩- فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 19. Then there came On the (garden) A visitation from thy Lord, (Which swept away) all around, While they were asleep.

arabic_text: ٢٠- فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ◯
english_translation: 20. So the (garden) became, By the morning, like A dark and desolate spot, (Whose fruit had been gathered).

arabic_text: ٢١- فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 21. As the morning broke, They called out, One to another,—

arabic_text: ٢٢- أَنِ اغْدُوا عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَارِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 22. “ Go ye to your tilth (Betimes) in morning, if ye would gather The fruits. ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَانطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. So they departed, conversing In secret low tones, (saying)—

arabic_text: ٢٤- أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ◯
english_translation: 24. “ Let not a single indigent Person break in upon you Into the (garden) this day. ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَغَدَوْا عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 25.And they opened the morning, Strong in an (unjust) resolve.

arabic_text: ٢٦- فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ◯
english_translation: 26. But when they saw The (garden), they said: “ We have surely lost our way :

arabic_text: ٢٧- بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. “Indeed we are shut out (Of the fruits of our labor) !”

arabic_text: ٢٨- قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. Said one of them, More just (than the rest) : “ Did I not say to you, ‘ Why not glorify (God) ? ’ ”

arabic_text: ٢٩- قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. They said: “ Glory To our Lord! Verily we Have been doing wrong ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. Then they turned, one Against another, in reproach.

arabic_text: ٣١- قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. They said: “ Alas for us ! We have indeed transgressed !

arabic_text: ٣٢- عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَا أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. “ It may be that our Lord Will give us in exchange A better (garden) than this : for we do turn to Him (In repentance) ! ”

arabic_text: ٣٣- كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. Such is the Punishment (In this life) ; but greater Is the Punishment In the Hereafter,— If only they knew !

arabic_text: ٣٤- إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 34. Verily, for the Righteous, Are Gardens of Delight, In the Presence Of their Lord.

arabic_text: ٣٥- أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 35. Shall We then treat The People of Faith Like the People of Sin ?

arabic_text: ٣٦- مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. What is the matter With you ? How judge ye ?

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. Or have ye a Book Through which ye learn—

arabic_text: ٣٨- إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 38. That ye shall have, Through it whatever Ye choose ?

arabic_text: ٣٩- أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. Or have ye Covenants With Us on oath, Reaching to the Day Of Judgment, (providing) That ye shall have Whatever ye shall demand ?

arabic_text: ٤٠- سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 40. Ask thou of them, Which of them will stand Surety for that !

arabic_text: ٤١- أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ◯
english_translation: 41. Or have they some “ Partners ” (in Godhead) ? Then let them produce Their “ partners ”, If they are truthful !

arabic_text: ٤٢- يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ◯
english_translation: 42.The Day that the Shin Shall be laid bare, And they shall be summoned To bow in adoration, But they shall not be able,—

arabic_text: ٤٣- خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. Their eyes will be Cast down,— ignominy will Cover them ; seeing that They had been summoned Aforetime to bow in adoration, While they were whole, (And had refused).

arabic_text: ٤٤- فَذَرْنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Then leave Me alone With such as reject This Message : by degrees Shall We punish them From directions they perceive not.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ◯
english_translation: 45. A (long) respite will I Grant them : truly Powerful is My plan.

arabic_text: ٤٦- أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. Or is it that thou dost Ask them for a reward, So that they are burdened With a load of debt ?—

arabic_text: ٤٧- أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ◯
english_translation: 47. Or that the Unseen Is in their hands, so that They can write it down ?

arabic_text: ٤٨- فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ◯
english_translation: 48.So wait with patience For the Command Of thy Lord, and be not Like the Companion Of the Fish,— when he Cried out in agony.

arabic_text: ٤٩- لَّوْلَا أَن تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ◯
english_translation: 49. Had not Grace From His Lord Reached him, he Would indeed have been Cast off on the naked Shore, in disgrace.

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ◯
english_translation: 50. Thus did his Lord Choose him and make him Of the company Of the Righteous.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَإِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ◯
english_translation: 51.And the Unbelievers Would almost trip thee up With their eyes when they Hear the Message ; and they Say : “ Surely he is possessed ! ”

arabic_text: ٥٢- وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 52. But it is nothing less Than a Message To all the worlds.

arabic_text: ١- الْحَاقَّةُ◯
english_translation: 1.The Sure Reality !

arabic_text: ٢- مَا الْحَاقَّةُ◯
english_translation: 2. What is the Sure Reality ?

arabic_text: ٣- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ◯
english_translation: 3. And what will make Thee realise what The Sure Reality is ?

arabic_text: ٤- كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ◯
english_translation: 4.TheThamūd And the ‘Ād people (Branded) as false The Stunning Calamity!

arabic_text: ٥- فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ◯
english_translation: 5. But theThamūd,— They were destroyed By a terrible Storm Of thunder and lightning !

arabic_text: ٦- وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 6. And the ‘Ād,— They were destroyed By a furious Wind, Exceedingly violent ;

arabic_text: ٧- سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 7. He made it rage Against them seven nights And eight days in succession : So that thou couldst see The (whole) people lying Prostrate in its (path), As if they had been Roots of hollow palm-trees Tumbled down !

arabic_text: ٨- فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّن بَاقِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 8. Then seest thou any Of them left surviving ?

arabic_text: ٩- وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ◯
english_translation: 9.And Pharaoh, And those before him, And the Cities Overthrown, Committed habitual Sin,

arabic_text: ١٠- فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً◯
english_translation: 10. And disobeyed (each) The apostle of their Lord ; So He punished them With an abundant Penalty.

arabic_text: ١١- إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ◯
english_translation: 11. We, when the water (Of Noah’s flood) overflowed Beyond its limits, Carried you (mankind), In the floating (Ark),

arabic_text: ١٢- لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 12. That We might Make it a Message Unto you, and that ears (That should hear the tale And) retain its memory Should bear its (lessons) In remembrance.

arabic_text: ١٣- فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ◯
english_translation: 13.Then, when one Blast is sounded On the Trumpet,

arabic_text: ١٤- وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً◯
english_translation: 14. And the earth is moved, And its mountains, And they are crushed to powder At one stroke,—

arabic_text: ١٥- فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ◯
english_translation: 15. On that Day Shall the (Great) Event Come to pass,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَانشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 16. And the sky will be Rent asunder, for it will That Day be flimsy,

arabic_text: ١٧- وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰ أَرْجَائِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 17. And the angels will be On its sides, And eight will, that Day, Bear the Throne Of thy Lord above them.

arabic_text: ١٨- يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 18.That Day shall ye be Brought to Judgment : Not an act of yours That ye hide will be hidden.

arabic_text: ١٩- فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 19. Then he that will be Given his Record In his right hand Will say : “ Ah here ! Read ye my Record

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 20. “ I did really understand That my Account would (One Day) reach me ! ”

arabic_text: ٢١- فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 21. And he will be In a life of Bliss,

arabic_text: ٢٢- فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 22. In a Garden on high,

arabic_text: ٢٣- قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 23. The Fruits whereof (Will hang in bunches) Low and near.

arabic_text: ٢٤- كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ◯
english_translation: 24. “ Eat ye and drink ye, With full satisfaction ; Because of the (good) That ye sent before you, In the days that are gone ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 25.And he that will Be given his Record In his left hand, Will say : “ Ah ! would That my record had not Been given to me !

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 26. “ And that I had never Realised how My account (stood) !

arabic_text: ٢٧- يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ◯
english_translation: 27. “ Ah ! would that (Death) Had made an end of me !

arabic_text: ٢٨- مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 28. “ Of no profit to me Has been my wealth !

arabic_text: ٢٩- هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 29. “ My power has Perished from me ! ”…

arabic_text: ٣٠- خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ◯
english_translation: 30. (The stern command will say) : “ Seize ye him, And bind ye him,

arabic_text: ٣١- ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ◯
english_translation: 31. “ And burn ye him In the Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ٣٢- ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ◯
english_translation: 32. “ Further, make him march In a chain, whereof The length is seventy cubits !

arabic_text: ٣٣- إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّـهِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 33. “ This was he that Would not believe In God Most High,

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ◯
english_translation: 34. “ And would not encourage The feeding of the indigent !

arabic_text: ٣٥- فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 35. “ So no friend hath he Here this Day.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ◯
english_translation: 36. “ Nor hath he any food Except the corruption From the washing of wounds,

arabic_text: ٣٧- لَّا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِئُونَ◯
english_translation: 37. “ Which none do eat But those in sin. ”

arabic_text: ٣٨- فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 38.So I do Call to witness What ye see

arabic_text: ٣٩- وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. And what ye see not,

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 40. That this is Verily the word Of an honoured apostle ;

arabic_text: ٤١- وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 41. It is not the word Of a poet : Little it is Ye believe !

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. Nor is it the word Of a soothsayer : Little admonition it is Ye receive.

arabic_text: ٤٣- تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 43. (This is) a Message Sent down from the Lord Of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ◯
english_translation: 44. And if the apostle Were to invent Any sayings in Our name,

arabic_text: ٤٥- لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 45. We should certainly seize him By his right hand,

arabic_text: ٤٦- ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ◯
english_translation: 46. And We should certainly Then cut off the artery Of his heart :

arabic_text: ٤٧- فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. Nor could any of you Withhold him (From Our wrath).

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ◯
english_translation: 48.But verily this Is a Message for The God-fearing.

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. And We certainly know That there are amongst you Those that reject (it).

arabic_text: ٥٠- وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 50. But truly (Revelation) Is a cause of sorrow For the Unbelievers.

arabic_text: ٥١- وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ◯
english_translation: 51. But verily it is Truth Of assured certainty.

arabic_text: ٥٢- فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 52. So glorify the name Of thy Lord Most High.

arabic_text: ١- سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ◯
english_translation: 1.Aquestioner asked About a Penalty To befall—

arabic_text: ٢- لِّلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ◯
english_translation: 2. The Unbelievers, The which there is none To ward off,—

arabic_text: ٣- مِّنَ اللَّـهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ◯
english_translation: 3. (A Penalty) from God, Lord of the Ways Of Ascent.

arabic_text: ٤- تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ◯
english_translation: 4.The angels and The Spirit ascend Unto Him in a Day The measure whereof Is (as) fifty thousand years :

arabic_text: ٥- فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا◯
english_translation: 5. Therefore do thou hold Patience,—a Patience Of beautiful (contentment).

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا◯
english_translation: 6. They see the (Day) indeed As a far-off (event) :

arabic_text: ٧- وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا◯
english_translation: 7. But We see it (Quite) near.

arabic_text: ٨- يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ◯
english_translation: 8.The Day that The sky will be like Molten brass,

arabic_text: ٩- وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ◯
english_translation: 9. And the mountains will be Like wool,

arabic_text: ١٠- وَلَا يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا◯
english_translation: 10. And no friend will ask After a friend,

arabic_text: ١١- يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ◯
english_translation: 11. Though they will be put In sight of each other,— The sinner’s desire will be : Would that he could Redeem himself from The Penalty of that Day By (sacrificing) his children,

arabic_text: ١٢- وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ◯
english_translation: 12. His wife and his brother,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ◯
english_translation: 13. His kindred who sheltered him,

arabic_text: ١٤- وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ◯
english_translation: 14. And all, all that is On earth,—so it could Deliver him :

arabic_text: ١٥- كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ◯
english_translation: 15. By no means ! For it would be The Fire of Hell !—

arabic_text: ١٦- نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 16. Plucking out (his being) Right to the skull !—

arabic_text: ١٧- تَدْعُو مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 17. Inviting (all) such As turn their backs And turn away their faces (From the Right),

arabic_text: ١٨- وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 18. And collect (wealth) And hide it (from use) !

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا◯
english_translation: 19.Truly man was created Very impatient;—

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا◯
english_translation: 20. Fretful when evil Touches him ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا◯
english_translation: 21. And niggardly when Good reaches him ;—

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ◯
english_translation: 22. Not so those devoted To Prayer ;—

arabic_text: ٢٣- الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. Those who remain steadfast To their prayer ;

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ◯
english_translation: 24. And those in whose wealth Is a recognised right

arabic_text: ٢٥- لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ◯
english_translation: 25. For the (needy) who asks And him who is prevented (For some reason from asking) ;

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 26. And those who hold To the truth of the Day Of Judgment ;

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَالَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 27. And those who fear The displeasure of their Lord,—

arabic_text: ٢٨- إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ◯
english_translation: 28. For their Lord’s displeasure Is the opposite of Peace And Tranquillity ;—

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. And those who guard Their chastity

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ◯
english_translation: 30. Except with their wives And the (captives) whom Their right hands possess,— For (then) they are not To be blamed,

arabic_text: ٣١- فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ◯
english_translation: 31. But those who trespass Beyond this are transgressors ;—

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ◯
english_translation: 32. And those who respect Their trusts and covenants ;

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 33. And those who stand firm In their testimonies ;

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. And those who guard (The sacredness) of their worship ;—

arabic_text: ٣٥- أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. Such will be The honoured ones In the Gardens (of Bliss).

arabic_text: ٣٦- فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 36.Now what is The matter with the Unbelievers That they rush madly Before thee—

arabic_text: ٣٧- عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. From the right And from the left In crowds ?

arabic_text: ٣٨- أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 38. Does every man of them Long to enter The Garden of Bliss ?

arabic_text: ٣٩- كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 39. By no means ! For We have created them Out of the (base matter) They know !

arabic_text: ٤٠- فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 40.Now I do Call to witness The Lord of all points In the East and the West That We can certainly—

arabic_text: ٤١- عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ◯
english_translation: 41. Substitute for them Better (men) than they ; And We are not To be defeated (In Our Plan).

arabic_text: ٤٢- فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. So leave them To plunge in vain talk And play about, Until they encounter That Day of theirs which They have been promised !—

arabic_text: ٤٣- يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. The Day whereon They will issue From their sepulchres In sudden haste As if they were Rushing to a goal-post (Fixed for them),—

arabic_text: ٤٤- خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ◯
english_translation: 44. Their eyes lowered In dejection,— Ignominy covering them (All over) ! Such is the Day The which they Are promised !

arabic_text: ١- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 1.We sent Noah To his People (With the Command) :  “ Do thou warn thy People Before there comes to them A grievous Penalty. ”

arabic_text: ٢- قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ◯
english_translation: 2. He said : “ O my People! I am to you A Warner, clear and open :

arabic_text: ٣- أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ◯
english_translation: 3. “ That ye should worship God, fear Him, And obey me :

arabic_text: ٤- يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّـهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. “ So He may forgive you Your sins and give you Respite for a stated Term : For when the Term given By God is accomplished, It cannot be put forward : If ye only knew. ”

arabic_text: ٥- قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا◯
english_translation: 5.He said : “ O my Lord ! I have called to my People Night and day :

arabic_text: ٦- فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا◯
english_translation: 6. “ But my call only Increases (their) flight (From the Right).

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا◯
english_translation: 7. “ And every time I have Called to them, that Thou Mightest forgive them, They have (only) thrust Their fingers into their ears, Covered themselves up with Their garments, grown obstinate And given themselves up To arrogance.

arabic_text: ٨- ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا◯
english_translation: 8. “ So I have called to them Aloud ;

arabic_text: ٩- ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا◯
english_translation: 9. “ Further I have spoken To them in public And secretly in private,

arabic_text: ١٠- فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا◯
english_translation: 10. “ Saying ‘ Ask forgiveness From your Lord ; For He is Oft-Forgiving ;

arabic_text: ١١- يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا◯
english_translation: 11. “ ‘ He will send rain To you in abundance ;

arabic_text: ١٢- وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا◯
english_translation: 12. “ ‘ Give you increase In wealth and sons ; And bestow on you Gardens and bestow on you Rivers (of flowing water).

arabic_text: ١٣- مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّـهِ وَقَارًا◯
english_translation: 13. “ ‘ What is the matter With you, that ye Place not your hope For kindness and long-suffering In God,—

arabic_text: ١٤- وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا◯
english_translation: 14. “ ‘ Seeing that it is He That has created you In diverse stages ?

arabic_text: ١٥- أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّـهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا◯
english_translation: 15. “ ‘ See ye not How God has created The seven heavens One above another,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا◯
english_translation: 16. “ ‘ And made the moon A light in their midst, And made the sun As a (Glorious) Lamp ?

arabic_text: ١٧- وَاللَّـهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا◯
english_translation: 17. “ ‘ And God has produced You from the earth, Growing (gradually),

arabic_text: ١٨- ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا◯
english_translation: 18. “ ‘ And in the End He will return you Into the (earth) And raise you forth (Again at the Resurrection) ?

arabic_text: ١٩- وَاللَّـهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا◯
english_translation: 19. “ ‘ And God has made The earth for you As a carpet (spread out),

arabic_text: ٢٠- لِّتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا◯
english_translation: 20. “ ‘ That ye may go about Therein, in spacious roads. ’ ”

arabic_text: ٢١- قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا◯
english_translation: 21.Noah said: “ O my Lord ! They have disobeyed me, But they follow (men) Whose wealth and children Give them no Increase But only Loss.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا◯
english_translation: 22. “ And they have devised A tremendous Plot.

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا◯
english_translation: 23. “ And they have said (To each other), ‘ Abandon not your gods : Abandon neither Wadd Nor Suwā‘, neither Yagūth nor Ya‘ūq, Nor Nasr ’ ;—

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا◯
english_translation: 24. “ They have already Misled many ; and Grant Thou no increase To the wrong-doers but in Straying (from their mark). ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّـهِ أَنصَارًا◯
english_translation: 25. Because of their sins They were drowned (In the flood), And were made to enter The Fire (of Punishment) : And they found— In lieu of God— None to help them.

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا◯
english_translation: 26.And Noah said : “ O my Lord ! Leave not Of the Unbelievers, A single one on earth !

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا◯
english_translation: 27. “ For, if Thou dost leave (Any of) them, they will But mislead Thy devotees, And they will breed none But wicked ungrateful ones.

arabic_text: ٢٨- رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا◯
english_translation: 28. “ O my Lord ! Forgive me, My parents, all who Enter my house in Faith, And (all) believing men And believing women : And to the wrong-doers Grant Thou no increase But in Perdition ! ”

arabic_text: ١- قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا◯
english_translation: 1.Say : It has been Revealed to me that A company of Jinns Listened (to the Qur-ān). They said, ‘ We have Really heard a wonderful Recital !

arabic_text: ٢- يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 2. ‘ It gives guidance To the Right, And we have believed therein : We shall not join (in worship) Any (gods) with our Lord.

arabic_text: ٣- وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا◯
english_translation: 3. ‘ And exalted is the Majesty Of our Lord : He has Taken neither a wife Nor a son.

arabic_text: ٤- وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّـهِ شَطَطًا◯
english_translation: 4. ‘ There were some foolish ones Among us, who used To utter extravagant lies Against God ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّـهِ كَذِبًا◯
english_translation: 5. ‘ But we do think That no man or spirit Should say aught that is Untrue against God.

arabic_text: ٦- وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا◯
english_translation: 6. ‘True, there were persons Among mankind who took shelter With persons among the Jinns, But they increased them In folly.
