arabic_text: ٧- وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 7. ‘ And they (came to) think As ye thought, that God Would not raise up Any one (to Judgment).

arabic_text: ٨- وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا◯
english_translation: 8. ‘ And we pried into The secrets of heaven ; But we found it filled With stern guards And flaming fires.

arabic_text: ٩- وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا◯
english_translation: 9. ‘ We used, indeed, to sit there In (hidden) stations, to (steal) A hearing ; but any Who listens now Will find a flaming fire Watching him in ambush.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا◯
english_translation: 10. ‘ And we understand not Whether ill is intended To those on earth, Or whether their Lord (Really) intends to guide Them to right conduct.

arabic_text: ١١- وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا◯
english_translation: 11. ‘There are among us Some that are righteous, And some the contrary : We follow divergent paths.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّـهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا◯
english_translation: 12. ‘ But we think that we Can by no means frustrate God throughout the earth, Nor can we frustrate Him By flight.

arabic_text: ١٣- وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا◯
english_translation: 13. ‘ And as for us, Since we have listened To the Guidance, we have Accepted it : and any Who believes in his Lord Has no fear, either Of a short (account) Or of any injustice.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا◯
english_translation: 14. ‘ Amongst us are some That submit their wills (To God), and some That swerve from justice. Now those who submit Their wills—they have Sought out (the path) Of right conduct :

arabic_text: ١٥- وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا◯
english_translation: 15. ‘ But those who swerve,— They are (but) fuel For Hell-Fire  ’—

arabic_text: ١٦- وَأَن لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا◯
english_translation: 16. (And God’s Message is) : “ If they (The pagans) Had (only) remained On the (right) Way, We should certainly have Bestowed on them Rain In abundance.

arabic_text: ١٧- لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا◯
english_translation: 17. “ That We might try them By that (means). But if any turns away From the remembrance Of his Lord, He will Cause him to undergo A severe Penalty.

arabic_text: ١٨- وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّـهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّـهِ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 18. “ And the places of worship Are for God (alone) : So invoke not any one Along with God ;

arabic_text: ١٩- وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّـهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا◯
english_translation: 19. “ Yet when the Devotee Of God stands forth To invoke Him, they just Make round him a dense crowd. ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 20.Say : “ I do No more than invoke My Lord, and I join not With Him any (false god). ”

arabic_text: ٢١- قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا◯
english_translation: 21. Say : “ It is not In my power to cause You harm, or to bring You to right conduct. ”

arabic_text: ٢٢- قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّـهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 22. Say : “ No one can Deliver me from God (If I were to disobey Him), Nor should I find refuge Except in Him,

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِّنَ اللَّـهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّـهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا◯
english_translation: 23. “ Unless I proclaim what I receive from God And His Messages : For any that disobey God And His Apostle,—for them Is Hell : they shall dwell Therein for ever. ”

arabic_text: ٢٤- حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا◯
english_translation: 24.At length, when they See (with their own eyes) That which they are promised,— Then will they know Who it is that is Weakest in (his) helper And least important In point of numbers.

arabic_text: ٢٥- قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا◯
english_translation: 25. Say : “ I know not whether The (Punishment) which ye Are promised is near, Or whether my Lord Will appoint for it A distant term.

arabic_text: ٢٦- عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا◯
english_translation: 26. “ He (alone) knows the Unseen, Nor does He make any one Acquainted with His Mysteries,—

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا◯
english_translation: 27. “ Except an apostle Whom He has chosen : And then He makes A band of watchers March before him And behind him,

arabic_text: ٢٨- لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا◯
english_translation: 28. “ That he may know That they have (truly) Brought and delivered The Messages of their Lord : And He surrounds (All the mysteries) that are With them, and takes account Of every single thing. ”

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ◯
english_translation: 1.Othou folded In garments !

arabic_text: ٢- قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 2. Stand (to prayer) by night, But not all night,—

arabic_text: ٣- نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 3. Half of it,— Or a little less,

arabic_text: ٤- أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا◯
english_translation: 4. Or a little more ; And recite the Qur-ān In slow, measured rhythmic tones.

arabic_text: ٥- إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا◯
english_translation: 5.Soon shall We send down To thee a weighty Message.

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا◯
english_translation: 6. Truly the rising by night Is most potent for governing (The soul), and most suitable For (framing) the Word (Of Prayer and Praise).

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 7. True, there is for thee By day prolonged occupation With ordinary duties :

arabic_text: ٨- وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا◯
english_translation: 8. But keep in remembrance The name of thy Lord And devote thyself To Him whole-heartedly.

arabic_text: ٩- رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا◯
english_translation: 9. (He is) Lord of the East And the West : there is No god but He : Take Him therefore For (thy) Disposer of Affairs.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا◯
english_translation: 10.And have patience with what They say, and leave them With noble (dignity).

arabic_text: ١١- وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 11. And leave Me (Alone to deal with) Those in possession of The good things of life, Who (yet) deny the Truth ; And bear with them For a little while.

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا◯
english_translation: 12. With Us are Fetters (To bind them), and a Fire (To burn them),

arabic_text: ١٣- وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 13. And a Food that chokes, And a Penalty Grievous.

arabic_text: ١٤- يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا◯
english_translation: 14. One Day the earth And the mountains Will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be As a heap of sand Poured out and flowing down.

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا◯
english_translation: 15.We have sent to you, (O men !) an apostle, To be a witness concerning you, Even as We sent An apostle to Pharaoh.

arabic_text: ١٦- فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 16. But Pharaoh disobeyed The apostle ; so We Seized him with A heavy Punishment.

arabic_text: ١٧- فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا◯
english_translation: 17. Then how shall ye, If ye deny (God), Guard yourselves against A Day that will make Children hoary-headed ?—

arabic_text: ١٨- السَّمَاءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا◯
english_translation: 18. Whereon the sky will be Cleft asunder ? His Promise needs must Be accomplished.

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 19. Verily this is an Admonition : Therefore, whoso will, let him Take a (straight) path To his Lord !

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّـهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّـهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّـهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّـهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّـهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ◯
english_translation: 20.Thy Lord doth know That thou standest forth (To prayer) nigh two-thirds Of the night, or half The night, or a third Of the night, and so doth A party of those with thee. But God doth appoint Night And Day in due measure. He knoweth that ye are Unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (In mercy) : read ye, Therefore, of the Qur-ān As much as may be Easy for you. He knoweth That there may be (some) Among you in ill-health ; Others traveling through the land, Seeking of God’s bounty ; Yet others fighting In God’s Cause. Read ye, Therefore, as much of the Qur’an As may be easy (for you) ; And establish regular Prayer And give regular Charity ; and loan to God A Beautiful Loan. And whatever good Ye send forth For your souls, Ye shall find it In God’s Presence,— Yea, better and Greater, in Reward. And seek ye the Grace Of God : for God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

arabic_text: ١- يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ◯
english_translation: 1.Othou wrapped up (In a mantle) !

arabic_text: ٢- قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ◯
english_translation: 2. Arise and deliver thy warning !
3. And thy Lord Do thou magnify !

arabic_text: ٤- وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ◯
english_translation: 4. And thy garments Keep free from stain !

arabic_text: ٥- وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ◯
english_translation: 5. And all abomination shun !

arabic_text: ٦- وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ◯
english_translation: 6. Nor expect, in giving, Any increase (for thyself) !

arabic_text: ٧- وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ◯
english_translation: 7. But, for thy Lord’s (Cause), Be patient and constant !

arabic_text: ٨- فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ◯
english_translation: 8.Finally, when the trumpet Is sounded,

arabic_text: ٩- فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 9. That will be—that Day— A Day of Distress,—

arabic_text: ١٠- عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ◯
english_translation: 10. Far from easy For those without Faith.

arabic_text: ١١- ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا◯
english_translation: 11.Leave Me alone, (to deal) With the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone !—

arabic_text: ١٢- وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا◯
english_translation: 12. To whom I granted Resources in abundance,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا◯
english_translation: 13. And sons to be By his side !—

arabic_text: ١٤- وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا◯
english_translation: 14. To whom I made (Life) smooth and comfortable !

arabic_text: ١٥- ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ◯
english_translation: 15. Yet is he greedy— That I should add (Yet more);—

arabic_text: ١٦- كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِآيَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا◯
english_translation: 16. By no means ! For to Our Signs He has been refractory !

arabic_text: ١٧- سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا◯
english_translation: 17. Soon will I visit him With a mount of calamities !
18. For he thought And he plotted ;—

arabic_text: ١٩- فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ◯
english_translation: 19. And woe to him ! How he plotted !—
20. Yea, woe to him : How he plotted !—
21. Then he looked round ;
22. Then he frowned And he scowled ;

arabic_text: ٢٣- ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ◯
english_translation: 23. Then he turned back And was haughty ;

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ◯
english_translation: 24. Then said he : “ This is nothing but magic, Derived from of old ; ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ◯
english_translation: 25. “ This is nothing but The word of a mortal ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٦- سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ◯
english_translation: 26.Soon will I Cast him into Hell-Fire !

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ◯
english_translation: 27. And what will explain To thee what Hell-Fire is ?

arabic_text: ٢٨- لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ◯
english_translation: 28. Naught doth it permit To endure, and naught Doth it leave alone !—

arabic_text: ٢٩- لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ◯
english_translation: 29. Darkening and changing The colour of man !

arabic_text: ٣٠- عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ◯
english_translation: 30.Over it are Nineteen.

arabic_text: ٣١- وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّـهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّـهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ◯
english_translation: 31. And We have set none But angels as guardians Of the Fire ; and We Have fixed their number Only as a trial For Unbelievers,—in order That the people of the Book May arrive at certainty, And the Believers may increase In Faith,— and that no doubts May be left for the People Of the Book and the Believers, And that those in whose hearts Is a disease and the Unbelievers May say, “ What symbol Doth God intend by this ? ” Thus doth God leave to stray Whom He pleaseth and guide Whom He pleaseth : and none Can know the forces Of the Lord, except He. And this is no other than A warning to mankind.

arabic_text: ٣٢- كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ◯
english_translation: 32.Nay, verily : By the Moon,

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ◯
english_translation: 33. And by the Night As it retreateth,

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ◯
english_translation: 34. And by the Dawn As it shineth forth,—

arabic_text: ٣٥- إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ◯
english_translation: 35. This is but one Of the mighty (portents),

arabic_text: ٣٦- نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ◯
english_translation: 36. A warning to mankind,—

arabic_text: ٣٧- لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ◯
english_translation: 37. To any of you that Chooses to press forward, Or to follow behind ;—

arabic_text: ٣٨- كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ◯
english_translation: 38.Every soul will be (held) In pledge for its deeds.

arabic_text: ٣٩- إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 39. Except the Companions Of the Right Hand.

arabic_text: ٤٠- فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 40. (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight) : they will Question each other,

arabic_text: ٤١- عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 41. And (ask) of the Sinners :

arabic_text: ٤٢- مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ◯
english_translation: 42. “ What led you into Hell-Fire ? ”

arabic_text: ٤٣- قَالُوا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ◯
english_translation: 43. They will say: “ We were not of those Who prayed ; ”

arabic_text: ٤٤- وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. “ Nor were we of those Who fed the indigent ; ”

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. “ But we used to talk Vanities with vain talkers ; ”

arabic_text: ٤٦- وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 46. “ And we used to deny The Day of Judgment, ”

arabic_text: ٤٧- حَتَّىٰ أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ◯
english_translation: 47. “ Until there came to us (The Hour) that is certain. ”

arabic_text: ٤٨- فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ◯
english_translation: 48. Then will no intercession Of (any) intercessors Profit them.

arabic_text: ٤٩- فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ◯
english_translation: 49.Then what is The matter with them That they turn away From admonition ?—

arabic_text: ٥٠- كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 50. As if they were Affrighted asses,

arabic_text: ٥١- فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍ◯
english_translation: 51. Fleeing from a lion !

arabic_text: ٥٢- بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً◯
english_translation: 52. Forsooth, each one of them Wants to be given Scrolls (of revelation) spread out !

arabic_text: ٥٣- كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ الْآخِرَةَ◯
english_translation: 53. By no means! But They fear not the Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٥٤- كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 54. Nay, this surely Is an admonition :

arabic_text: ٥٥- فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 55. Let any who will, Keep it in remembrance !

arabic_text: ٥٦- وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ◯
english_translation: 56. But none will keep it In remembrance except As God wills : He Is the Lord of Righteousness, And the Lord of Forgiveness.

arabic_text: ١- لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ◯
english_translation: 1. Ido call to witness The Resurrection Day ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ◯
english_translation: 2. And I do call to witness The self-reproaching spirit : (Eschew Evil).

arabic_text: ٣- أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ◯
english_translation: 3.Does man think that We Cannot assemble his bones ?

arabic_text: ٤- بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ◯
english_translation: 4. Nay, We are able to put Together in perfect order The very tips of his fingers.

arabic_text: ٥- بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ◯
english_translation: 5. But man wishes to do Wrong (even) in the time In front of him.

arabic_text: ٦- يَسْأَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ◯
english_translation: 6. He questions: “ When Is the Day of Resurrection ? ”

arabic_text: ٧- فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ◯
english_translation: 7.At length, when The Sight is dazed,

arabic_text: ٨- وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ◯
english_translation: 8. And the moon is Buried in darkness.

arabic_text: ٩- وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ◯
english_translation: 9. And the sun and moon Are joined together,—

arabic_text: ١٠- يَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ◯
english_translation: 10. That Day will Man say : “ Where is the refuge ? ”

arabic_text: ١١- كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ◯
english_translation: 11. By no means ! No place of safety !

arabic_text: ١٢- إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ◯
english_translation: 12. Before thy Lord (alone), That Day will be The place of rest.

arabic_text: ١٣- يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ◯
english_translation: 13. That Day will Man Be told (all) that he Put forward, and all That he put back.

arabic_text: ١٤- بَلِ الْإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 14. Nay, man will be Evidence against himself,

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ◯
english_translation: 15. Even though he were To put up his excuses.

arabic_text: ١٦- لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ◯
english_translation: 16.Move not thy tongue Concerning the (Qur-ān) to make haste therewith.

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ◯
english_translation: 17. It is for Us to collect it And to promulgate it :

arabic_text: ١٨-فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ◯
english_translation: 18. But when We have Promulgated it, follow thou Its recital (as promulgated) :

arabic_text: ١٩- ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ◯
english_translation: 19. Nay more, it is For Us to explain it (And make it clear) :

arabic_text: ٢٠- كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ◯
english_translation: 20.Nay, (ye men !) But ye love The fleeting life,

arabic_text: ٢١- وَتَذَرُونَ الْآخِرَةَ◯
english_translation: 21. And leave alone The Hereafter.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 22. Some faces, that Day, Will beam (in brightness And beauty);—

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 23. Looking towards their Lord ;

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 24. And some faces that Day, Will be sad and dismal,

arabic_text: ٢٥- تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 25. In the thought that some Back-breaking calamity was about To be inflicted on them ;

arabic_text: ٢٦- كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ◯
english_translation: 26. Yea, when (the soul) Reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ◯
english_translation: 27. And there will be a cry, “ Who is a magician (To restore him) ? ”

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ◯
english_translation: 28. And he will conclude That it was (the Time) Of Parting ;

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ◯
english_translation: 29. And one leg will be Joined with another :

arabic_text: ٣٠- إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ◯
english_translation: 30. That Day the Drive Will be (all) to thy Lord !

arabic_text: ٣١- فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 31.So he gave nothing In charity, nor Did he pray !—

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 32. But on the contrary, He rejected Truth And turned away !

arabic_text: ٣٣- ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 33. Then did he stalk To his family In full conceit !

arabic_text: ٣٤- أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 34. Woe to thee, (O man !) yea, woe !

arabic_text: ٣٥- ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 35. Again, woe to thee, (O man !), yea, woe !

arabic_text: ٣٦- أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى◯
english_translation: 36.Does Man think That he will be left Uncontrolled, (without purpose)?

arabic_text: ٣٧- أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 37. Was he not a drop Of sperm emitted (In lowly form) ?

arabic_text: ٣٨- ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 38. Then did he become A leech-like clot ; Then did (God) make And fashion (him) In due proportion.

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ◯
english_translation: 39. And of him He made Two sexes, male And female.

arabic_text: ٤٠- أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ◯
english_translation: 40. Has not He, (the same), The power to give life To the dead ?

arabic_text: ١- هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئًا مَّذْكُورًا◯
english_translation: 1.Has there not been Over Man a long period Of Time, when he was Nothing—(not even) mentioned ?

arabic_text: ٢- إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 2. Verily We created Man from a drop Of mingled sperm, In order to try him : So We gave him (the gifts). Of Hearing and Sight.

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 3. We showed him the Way : Whether he be grateful Or ungrateful (rests on his will).

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَ وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 4.For the Rejecters We have prepared Chains, Yokes and A Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ٥- إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا◯
english_translation: 5.As to the Righteous, They shall drink Of a Cup (of Wine) Mixed with Kafur,—

arabic_text: ٦- عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّـهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا◯
english_translation: 6. A Fountain where The Devotees of God Do drink, making it Flow in unstinted abundance.

arabic_text: ٧- يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا◯
english_translation: 7. They perform (their) vows, And they fear a Day Whose evil flies far and wide.

arabic_text: ٨- وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 8. And they feed, for the love Of God, the indigent, The orphan, and the captive,–

arabic_text: ٩- إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّـهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا◯
english_translation: 9. (Saying), “ We feed you for the sake of God alone : No reward do we desire From you nor thanks.

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا◯
english_translation: 10. “ We only fear a Day Of distressful Wrath From the side of our Lord. ”

arabic_text: ١١- فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّـهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا◯
english_translation: 11. But God will deliver Them from the evil Of that Day, and will Shed over them a light Of Beauty and A (blissful) Joy.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَجَزَاهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا◯
english_translation: 12.And because they were Patient and constant, He will Reward them with a Garden And (garments of) silk.

arabic_text: ١٣- مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا◯
english_translation: 13. Reclining in the (Garden) On raised thrones, They will see there neither The sun’s (excessive heat) Nor (the moon’s) excessive cold.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا◯
english_translation: 14. And the shades of the (Garden) Will come low over them, And the bunches (of fruit), There, will hang low In humility.

arabic_text: ١٥- وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا◯
english_translation: 15.And amongst them will be Passed round vessels of silver And goblets of crystal,–

arabic_text: ١٦- قَوَارِيرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا◯
english_translation: 16. Crystal-clear, made of silver : They will determine The measure thereof (According to their wishes).

arabic_text: ١٧- وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 17. And they will be given To drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed With Zanjabil,–

arabic_text: ١٨- عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 18. A fountain there, Called Salsabil.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا◯
english_translation: 19. And round about them Will (serve) youths Of perpetual (freshness) : If thou seest them, Thou wouldst think them Scattered Pearls.

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا◯
english_translation: 20. And when thou lookest, It is there thou wilt see A Bliss and A Realm Magnificent.

arabic_text: ٢١- عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوا أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا◯
english_translation: 21. Upon them will be Green Garments of fine silk And heavy brocade, And they will be adorned With Bracelets of silver ; And their Lord will Give to them to drink Of a Wine Pure and Holy.

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا◯
english_translation: 22. “ Verily this is a Reward For you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised. ”

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلًا◯
english_translation: 23. It is We Who Have sent down the Qur-ān To thee by stages.

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا◯
english_translation: 24. Therefore be patient With constancy to the Command Of thy Lord, and hearken not To the sinner or the ingrate Among them.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا◯
english_translation: 25. And celebrate the name Of thy Lord morning And evening,

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا◯
english_translation: 26. And part of the night, Prostrate thyself to Him ; And glorify Him ; A long night through.

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا◯
english_translation: 27.As to these, they love The fleeting life, And put away behind them A Day (that will be) hard.

arabic_text: ٢٨- نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا◯
english_translation: 28. It is We Who created Them, and We have made Their joints strong ; But, when We will, We can substitute The like of them By a complete change.

arabic_text: ٢٩- إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا◯
english_translation: 29. This is an admonition : Whosoever will, let him Take a (straight) Path to his Lord.

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّـهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا◯
english_translation: 30. But ye will not, Except as God wills ; For God is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

arabic_text: ٣١- يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا◯
english_translation: 31. He will admit To His Mercy Whom He will ; But the wrong-doers,— For them has He prepared A grievous Penalty.

arabic_text: ١- وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا◯
english_translation: 1.By the (Winds) Sent Forth One after another (To man’s profit) ;

arabic_text: ٢- فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا◯
english_translation: 2. Which then blow violently In tempestuous Gusts,

arabic_text: ٣- وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا◯
english_translation: 3. And scatter (things) Far and wide ;

arabic_text: ٤- فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا◯
english_translation: 4. Then separate them, One from another,

arabic_text: ٥- فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا◯
english_translation: 5. Then spread abroad A Message,

arabic_text: ٦- عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا◯
english_translation: 6. Whether of Justification Or of Warning ;—

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ◯
english_translation: 7. Assuredly, what ye are Promised must come to pass.

arabic_text: ٨- فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ◯
english_translation: 8. Then when the stars Become dim ;

arabic_text: ٩- وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ◯
english_translation: 9. When the heaven Is cleft asunder ;

arabic_text: ١٠- وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ◯
english_translation: 10. When the mountains are Scattered (to the winds) as dust ;

arabic_text: ١١- وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ◯
english_translation: 11. And when the apostles Are (all) appointed a time (To collect) ;—
12. For what Day Are these (Portents) deferred ?

arabic_text: ١٣- لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ◯
english_translation: 13. For the Day of Sorting out.

arabic_text: ١٤- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ◯
english_translation: 14. And what will explain To thee what is The Day of Sorting out ?

arabic_text: ١٥- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 15. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ١٦- أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 16.Did We not destroy The men of old (For their evil) ?

arabic_text: ١٧- ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْآخِرِينَ◯
english_translation: 17. So shall We make Later (generations) Follow them.

arabic_text: ١٨- كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 18. Thus do We deal With men of sin.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 19. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٢٠- أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ◯
english_translation: 20.Have We not created You from a fluid (Held) despicable ?—

arabic_text: ٢١- فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ◯
english_translation: 21. The which We placed In a place of rest, Firmly fixed,

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ◯
english_translation: 22. For a period (of gestation) Determined (according to need)?

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. For We do determine (According to need) ; for We Are the Best to determine (things).

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 24. Ah woe, that Day ! To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٢٥- أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا◯
english_translation: 25.Have We not made The earth (as a place) To draw together

arabic_text: ٢٦- أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا◯
english_translation: 26. The living and the dead,

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّاءً فُرَاتًا◯
english_translation: 27. And made therein Mountains standing firm, Lofty (in stature) ; And provided for you Water sweet (and wholesome) ?

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 28. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٢٩- انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 29. (It will be said :) “ Depart ye to that Which ye used to reject As false !

arabic_text: ٣٠- انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ◯
english_translation: 30. “ Depart ye to a Shadow (Of smoke ascending) In three columns,

arabic_text: ٣١- لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّـهَبِ◯
english_translation: 31. “ (Which yields) no shade Of coolness, and is Of no use against The fierce Blaze.

arabic_text: ٣٢- إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ◯
english_translation: 32. “ Indeed it throws about Sparks (huge) as Forts,

arabic_text: ٣٣- كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ◯
english_translation: 33. “ As if there were (A string of) yellow camels (Marching swiftly). ”

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 34. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٣٥- هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ◯
english_translation: 35.That will be a Day When they shall not Be able to speak,

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. Nor will it be Open to them To put forth pleas.

arabic_text: ٣٧- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 37. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٣٨- هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 38.That will be a Day Of Sorting out ! We shall Gather you together And those before (you) !

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ◯
english_translation: 39. Now, if ye have A trick (or plot), use it against Me !

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 40. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٤١- إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ◯
english_translation: 41.As to the Righteous, They shall be amidst (Cool) shades and springs (Of water).

arabic_text: ٤٢- وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ◯
english_translation: 42. And (they shall have) Fruits,— all they desire.

arabic_text: ٤٣- كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 43. “ Eat ye and drink ye To your heart’s content : For that ye worked (Righteousness). ”

arabic_text: ٤٤- إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ◯
english_translation: 44. Thus do We certainly Reward the Doers of Good.

arabic_text: ٤٥- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 45. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٤٦- كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ◯
english_translation: 46. (Oye Unjust !) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (But) a little while, For that ye are Sinners.

arabic_text: ٤٧- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 47. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٤٨- وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ◯
english_translation: 48.And when it is said To them, “ Prostrate yourselves ! ” They do not so.

arabic_text: ٤٩- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 49. Ah woe, that Day, To the Rejecters of Truth !

arabic_text: ٥٠- فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 50. Then what Message, After that, Will they believe in ?

arabic_text: ١- عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.Concerning what Are they disputing ?

arabic_text: ٢- عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ◯
english_translation: 2. Concerning the Great News,

arabic_text: ٣- الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. About which they Cannot agree.

arabic_text: ٤- كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Verily, they shall soon (Come to) know !

arabic_text: ٥- ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Verily, verily they shall Soon (come to) know !

arabic_text: ٦- أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا◯
english_translation: 6.Have We not made The earth as a wide Expanse,

arabic_text: ٧- وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا◯
english_translation: 7. And the mountains as pegs ?

arabic_text: ٨- وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا◯
english_translation: 8. And (have We not) created You in pairs,

arabic_text: ٩- وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا◯
english_translation: 9. And made your sleep For rest,

arabic_text: ١٠- وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا◯
english_translation: 10. And made the night As a covering,

arabic_text: ١١- وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا◯
english_translation: 11. And made the day As a means of subsistence ?

arabic_text: ١٢- وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا◯
english_translation: 12. And (have We not) Built over you The seven firmaments,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا◯
english_translation: 13. And placed (therein) A Light of Splendour ?

arabic_text: ١٤- وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا◯
english_translation: 14. And do We not send down From the clouds water In abundance,

arabic_text: ١٥- لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا◯
english_translation: 15. That We may produce Therewith corn and vegetables,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا◯
english_translation: 16. And gardens of luxurious growth ?

arabic_text: ١٧- إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا◯
english_translation: 17.Verily the Day Of Sorting Out Is a thing appointed,—

arabic_text: ١٨- يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا◯
english_translation: 18. The Day that the Trumpet Shall be sounded, and ye Shall come forth in crowds ;

arabic_text: ١٩- وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا◯
english_translation: 19. And the heavens Shall be opened As if there were doors,

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا◯
english_translation: 20. And the mountains Shall vanish, as if They were a mirage.

arabic_text: ٢١- إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا◯
english_translation: 21.Truly Hell is As a place of ambush,—

arabic_text: ٢٢- لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا◯
english_translation: 22. For the transgressors A place of destination :

arabic_text: ٢٣- لَّابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا◯
english_translation: 23. They will dwell therein For ages.

arabic_text: ٢٤- لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا◯
english_translation: 24. Nothing cool shall they tastes Therein nor any drink.

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا◯
english_translation: 25. Save a boiling fluid And a fluid, dark murky, Intensely cold,—

arabic_text: ٢٦- جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا◯
english_translation: 26. A fitting recompense (For them).

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا◯
english_translation: 27. For that they used not To fear any account (For their deeds),

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا◯
english_translation: 28. But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا◯
english_translation: 29. And all things have We Preserved on record.

arabic_text: ٣٠- فَذُوقُوا فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا◯
english_translation: 30. “ So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); For no increase Shall We grant you, Except in Punishment. ”

arabic_text: ٣١- إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا◯
english_translation: 31.Verily for the Righteous There will be A fulfilment of (The Heart’s) desires ;

arabic_text: ٣٢- حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا◯
english_translation: 32. Gardens enclosed, and Grapevines ;

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا◯
english_translation: 33. Companions of Equal Age ;

arabic_text: ٣٤- وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا◯
english_translation: 34. And a Cup full (To the Brim).

arabic_text: ٣٥- لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا◯
english_translation: 35. No Vanity shall they hear Therein, nor Untruth;—

arabic_text: ٣٦- جَزَاءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا◯
english_translation: 36. Recompense from thy Lord, A Gift, (amply) sufficient,—

arabic_text: ٣٧- رَّبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا◯
english_translation: 37. (From) the Lord Of the heavens And the earth, And all between,— (God) Most Gracious : None shall have power To argue with Him.

arabic_text: ٣٨- يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا◯
english_translation: 38.The Day that The Spirit and the angels Will stand forth in ranks, None shall speak Except any who is Permitted by (God) Most Gracious, And he will say What is right.

arabic_text: ٣٩- ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا◯
english_translation: 39. That Day will be The sure Reality : Therefore, whoso will, let him Take a (straight) Return to his Lord !

arabic_text: ٤٠- إِنَّا أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا◯
english_translation: 40. Verily, We have warned you Of a Penalty near,— The Day when man will See (the Deeds) which His hands have sent forth, And the Unbeliever will say, “ Woe unto me ! Would that I were (mere) dust ! ”

arabic_text: ١- وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا◯
english_translation: 1.By the (angels) Who tear out (The souls of the wicked) With violence ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا◯
english_translation: 2. By those who gently Draw out (the souls Of the blessed) ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا◯
english_translation: 3. And by those who glide Along (on errands of mercy),

arabic_text: ٤- فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا◯
english_translation: 4. Then press forward As in a race,

arabic_text: ٥- فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا◯
english_translation: 5. Then arrange to do (The Commands of their Lord),—

arabic_text: ٦- يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ◯
english_translation: 6. One Day everything that Can be in commotion will Be in violent commotion,

arabic_text: ٧- تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ◯
english_translation: 7. Followed by oft-repeated (Commotions) :

arabic_text: ٨- قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ◯
english_translation: 8. Hearts that Day Will be in agitation ;

arabic_text: ٩- أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Cast down will be (Their owners’) eyes.

arabic_text: ١٠- يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ◯
english_translation: 10.They say (now) : “ What ! Shall we indeed be Returned to (our) former state ?—

arabic_text: ١١- أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَّخِرَةً◯
english_translation: 11. “ What !— when we shall Have become rotten bones ? ”

arabic_text: ١٢- قَالُوا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 12. They say : “ It would, In that case, be A return with loss ! ”

arabic_text: ١٣- فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ◯
english_translation: 13.But verily, it will Be but a single (Compelling) Cry,

arabic_text: ١٤- فَإِذَا هُم بِالسَّاهِرَةِ◯
english_translation: 14. When, behold, they Will be in the (full) Awakening (to Judgment).

arabic_text: ١٥- هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ◯
english_translation: 15.Has the story Of Moses reached thee ?

arabic_text: ١٦- إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى◯
english_translation: 16. Behold, thy Lord did call To him in the sacred valley Of Tuwā :—

arabic_text: ١٧- اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ◯
english_translation: 17. “ Go thou to Pharaoh, For he has indeed Transgressed all bounds :

arabic_text: ١٨- فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 18. “ And say to him, ‘ Wouldst thou that thou Shouldst be purified (From sin) ?—

arabic_text: ١٩- وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 19. “ ‘And that I guide thee To thy Lord, so thou Shouldst fear Him?’ ”

arabic_text: ٢٠- فَأَرَاهُ الْآيَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 20. Then did (Moses) show him The Great Sign.
21. But (Pharaoh) rejected it And disobeyed (guidance);

arabic_text: ٢٢- ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 22. Further he turned his back Striving hard (against God).

arabic_text: ٢٣- فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ◯
english_translation: 23. Then he collected (his men) And made a proclamation,

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْأَعْلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 24. Saying, “ I am your Lord, Most High ”.

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّـهُ نَكَالَ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 25. But God did punish him, (And made an) example Of him,—in the Hereafter, As in this life.

arabic_text: ٢٦- إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 26. Verily in this is An instructive warning For whosoever feareth (God).

arabic_text: ٢٧- أَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا◯
english_translation: 27.What ! Are ye the more Difficult to create Or the heaven (above)? (God) hath constructed it :

arabic_text: ٢٨- رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 28. On high hath He raised Its canopy, and He hath Given it order and perfection.

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا◯
english_translation: 29. Its night doth He Endow with darkness, And its splendour doth He Bring out (with light).

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا◯
english_translation: 30. And the earth, moreover, Hath He extended (To a wide expanse);

arabic_text: ٣١- أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا◯
english_translation: 31. He draweth out Therefrom its moisture And its pasture ;

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا◯
english_translation: 32. And the mountains Hath He firmly fixed ;

arabic_text: ٣٣- مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ◯
english_translation: 33. For use and convenience To you and your cattle.

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 34.Therefore, when there comes The great, overwhelming (Event),—

arabic_text: ٣٥- يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 35. The Day when Man Shall remember (all) That he strove for,

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 36. And Hell-Fire shall be Placed in full view For (all) to see,—

arabic_text: ٣٧- فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ◯
english_translation: 37. Then, for such as had Transgressed all bounds,

arabic_text: ٣٨- وَآثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا◯
english_translation: 38. And had preferred The life of this world,

arabic_text: ٣٩- فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 39. The Abode will be Hell-Fire ;

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 40. And for such as had Entertained the fear Of standing before Their Lord’s (tribunal) And had restrained (Their) soul from lower Desires,

arabic_text: ٤١- فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 41. Their Abode will be The Garden.

arabic_text: ٤٢- يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا◯
english_translation: 42.They ask thee About the Hour,—‘When Will be its appointed time ?’

arabic_text: ٤٣- فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَاهَا◯
english_translation: 43. Wherein art thou (concerned) With the declaration thereof ?

arabic_text: ٤٤- إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَاهَا◯
english_translation: 44. With thy Lord is The Limit fixed therefor.

arabic_text: ٤٥- إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَاهَا◯
english_translation: 45. Thou art but a Warner For such as fear it.

arabic_text: ٤٦- كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا◯
english_translation: 46. The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they Had tarried but a single Evening, or (at most till) The following morn !

arabic_text: ١- عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 1. (The Prophet) frowned And turned away,

arabic_text: ٢- أَن جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَىٰ◯
english_translation: 2. Because there came to him The blind man (interrupting).

arabic_text: ٣- وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 3. But what could tell thee But that perchance he might Grow (in spiritual understanding) ?—

arabic_text: ٤- أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 4. Or that he might receive Admonition, and the teaching Might profit him ?

arabic_text: ٥- أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 5. As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,

arabic_text: ٦- فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 6. To him dost thou attend ;

arabic_text: ٧- وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. Though it is no blame To thee if he grow not (In spiritual understanding).

arabic_text: ٨- وَأَمَّا مَن جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 8. But as to him who came To thee striving earnestly,

arabic_text: ٩- وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 9. And with fear (In his heart),

arabic_text: ١٠- فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 10. Of him wast thou unmindful.

arabic_text: ١١- كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 11.By no means (Should it be so) ! For it is indeed A Message of instruction :

arabic_text: ١٢- فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 12. Therefore let whoso will, Keep it in remembrance.

arabic_text: ١٣- فِي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ◯
english_translation: 13. (It is) in Books Held (greatly) in honour,
14. Exalted (in dignity), Kept pure and holy,

arabic_text: ١٥- بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ◯
english_translation: 15. (Written) by the hands Of scribes —

arabic_text: ١٦- كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ◯
english_translation: 16. Honorable and Pious and Just.

arabic_text: ١٧- قُتِلَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 17.Woe to man! What hath made him Reject God ?

arabic_text: ١٨- مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ◯
english_translation: 18. From what stuff Hath He created him ?

arabic_text: ١٩- مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ◯
english_translation: 19. From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then Mouldeth him in due proportions ;

arabic_text: ٢٠- ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ◯
english_translation: 20. Then doth He make His path smooth for him ;

arabic_text: ٢١- ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 21. Then He causeth him to die, And putteth him in his Grave ;

arabic_text: ٢٢- ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنشَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 22. Then, when it is His will, He will Raise him up (again).

arabic_text: ٢٣- كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 23. By no means hath he Fulfilled what God Hath commanded him.

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ◯
english_translation: 24.Then let man look At his Food, (And how We provide it) :

arabic_text: ٢٥- أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا◯
english_translation: 25. For that We pour forth Water in abundance,

arabic_text: ٢٦- ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا◯
english_translation: 26. And We split the earth In fragments,

arabic_text: ٢٧- فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا◯
english_translation: 27. And produce therein Corn,

arabic_text: ٢٨- وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا◯
english_translation: 28. And Grapes and nutritious Plants,

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا◯
english_translation: 29. And Olives and Dates,

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا◯
english_translation: 30. And enclosed Gardens, Dense with lofty trees,

arabic_text: ٣١- وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا◯
english_translation: 31. And Fruits and Fodder, —

arabic_text: ٣٢- مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ◯
english_translation: 32. For use and convenience To you and your cattle.

arabic_text: ٣٣- فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ◯
english_translation: 33.At length when there comes the Deafening Noise, —

arabic_text: ٣٤- يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ◯
english_translation: 34. That Day shall a man Flee from his own brother,

arabic_text: ٣٥- وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ◯
english_translation: 35. And from his mother And his father.

arabic_text: ٣٦- وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ◯
english_translation: 36. And from his wife And his children.

arabic_text: ٣٧- لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ◯
english_translation: 37. Each one of them, That Day, will have Enough concern (of his own) To make him indifferent To the others.

arabic_text: ٣٨- وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 38.Some Faces that Day Will be beaming,

arabic_text: ٣٩- ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 39. Laughing, rejoicing.

arabic_text: ٤٠- وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 40. And other faces that Day Will be dust-stained ;

arabic_text: ٤١- تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ◯
english_translation: 41. Blackness will cover them :

arabic_text: ٤٢- أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ◯
english_translation: 42. Such will be The Rejecters of God, The Doers of Iniquity.

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 1.When the sun (With its spacious light) Is folded up ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انكَدَرَتْ◯
english_translation: 2. When the stars Fall, losing their lustre ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 3. When the mountains vanish (Like a mirage) ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ◯
english_translation: 4. When the she-camels, Ten months with young, Are left untended ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ◯
english_translation: 5. When the wild beasts Are herded together (In human habitations) ;

arabic_text: ٦- وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 6. When the oceans Boil over with a swell ;

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ◯
english_translation: 7. When the souls Are sorted out, (Being joined, like with like) ;

arabic_text: ٨- وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ◯
english_translation: 8. When the female (infant), Buried alive, is questioned—

arabic_text: ٩- بِأَيِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ◯
english_translation: 9. For what crime She was killed ;

arabic_text: ١٠- وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ◯
english_translation: 10. When the Scrolls Are laid open ;

arabic_text: ١١- وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ◯
english_translation: 11. When the World on High Is unveiled ;

arabic_text: ١٢- وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 12. When the Blazing Fire Is kindled to fierce heat ;

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ◯
english_translation: 13. And when the Garden Is brought near ;—

arabic_text: ١٤- عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا أَحْضَرَتْ◯
english_translation: 14. (Then) shall each soul know What it has put forward.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ◯
english_translation: 15.So verily I call To witness the Planets— That recede,

arabic_text: ١٦- الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ◯
english_translation: 16. Go straight, or hide ;

arabic_text: ١٧- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ◯
english_translation: 17. And the Night As it dissipates ;

arabic_text: ١٨- وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ◯
english_translation: 18. And the Dawn As it breathes away The darkness ;—

arabic_text: ١٩- إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 19. Verily this is the word Of a most honorable Messenger,

arabic_text: ٢٠- ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ◯
english_translation: 20. Endued with Power, With rank before The Lord of the Throne,

arabic_text: ٢١- مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ◯
english_translation: 21. With authority there, (And) faithful to his trust.

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 22.And (O people !) Your Companion is not One possessed ;

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ◯
english_translation: 23. And without doubt he saw him In the clear horizon.

arabic_text: ٢٤- وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ◯
english_translation: 24. Neither doth he withhold Grudgingly a knowledge Of the Unseen.

arabic_text: ٢٥- وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 25. Nor is it the word Of an evil spirit accursed.

arabic_text: ٢٦- فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ◯
english_translation: 26.Then whither go ye ?

arabic_text: ٢٧- إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 27. Verily this is no less Than a Message To (all) the Worlds :

arabic_text: ٢٨- لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ◯
english_translation: 28. (With profit) to whoever Among you wills To go straight :

arabic_text: ٢٩- وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّـهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 29. But ye shall not will Except as God wills,— The Cherisher of the Worlds.

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انفَطَرَتْ◯
english_translation: 1.When the Sky Is cleft asunder ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَإِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انتَثَرَتْ◯
english_translation: 2. When the Stars Are scattered ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 3. When the Oceans Are suffered to burst forth ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ◯
english_translation: 4. And when the Graves Are turned upside down ;—

arabic_text: ٥- عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ◯
english_translation: 5. (Then) shall each soul know What it hath sent forward And (what it hath) kept back.

arabic_text: ٦- يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ◯
english_translation: 6.Oman ! what has Seduced thee from Thy Lord Most Beneficent ?—

arabic_text: ٧- الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ◯
english_translation: 7. Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, And gave thee a just bias ;

arabic_text: ٨- فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ◯
english_translation: 8. In whatever Form He wills, Does He put thee together.

arabic_text: ٩- كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 9.Nay ! but ye do Reject Right and Judgment !

arabic_text: ١٠- وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. But verily over you (Are appointed angels) To protect you,—

arabic_text: ١١- كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 11. Kind and honorable,— Writing down (your deeds) :

arabic_text: ١٢- يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 12. They know (and understand) All that ye do.

arabic_text: ١٣- إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 13.As for the Righteous, They will be in Bliss ;

arabic_text: ١٤- وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 14. And the Wicked— They will be in the Fire,

arabic_text: ١٥- يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 15. Which they will enter On the Day of Judgment,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ◯
english_translation: 16. And they will not be Able to keep away therefrom.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 17.And what will explain To thee what the Day Of Judgment is ?

arabic_text: ١٨- ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 18. Again, what will explain To thee what the Day Of Judgment is ?

arabic_text: ١٩- يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّـهِ◯
english_translation: 19. (It will be) the Day When no soul shall have Power (to do) aught For another : For the Command, that Day, Will be (wholly) with God.

arabic_text: ١- وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ◯
english_translation: 1.Woe to those That deal in fraud,—

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. Those who when they Have to receive by measure From men, exact full measure,

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. But when they have To give by measure Or weight to men, Give less than due.

arabic_text: ٤- أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Do they not think That they will be called To account ?—

arabic_text: ٥- لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 5. On a Mighty Day,

arabic_text: ٦- يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ◯
english_translation: 6. A Day when (all) mankind Will stand before The Lord of the Worlds ?

arabic_text: ٧- كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ.◯
english_translation: 7.Nay ! Surely the Record Of the Wicked is (Preserved) inSijjīn.

arabic_text: ٨- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ◯
english_translation: 8. And what will explain To thee whatSijjīnis?

arabic_text: ٩- كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ◯
english_translation: 9. (There is) a Register (Fully) inscribed.

arabic_text: ١٠- وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ◯
english_translation: 10. Woe, that Day, to those That deny—

arabic_text: ١١- الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 11. Those that deny The Day of Judgment.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 12. And none can deny it But the Transgressor Beyond bounds, The Sinner !

arabic_text: ١٣- إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ◯
english_translation: 13. When Our Signs are rehearsed To him, he says, “Tales of the Ancients !”

arabic_text: ١٤- كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ◯
english_translation: 14.By no means ! But on their hearts Is the stain of the (ill) Which they do !

arabic_text: ١٥- كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ◯
english_translation: 15. Verily, from (the Light Of) their Lord, that Day, Will they be veiled.

arabic_text: ١٦- ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُو الْجَحِيمِ◯
english_translation: 16. Further, they will enter The Fire of Hell.

arabic_text: ١٧- ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 17. Further, it will be said To them : “This is The (reality) which ye Rejected as false !”

arabic_text: ١٨- كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ◯
english_translation: 18.Nay, verily the Record Of the Righteous is (Preserved) in’Illīyīn.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ◯
english_translation: 19. And what will explain To thee what’Illīyīn.is?

arabic_text: ٢٠- كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ◯
english_translation: 20. (There is) a Register (Fully) inscribed,

arabic_text: ٢١- يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 21. To which bear witness Those Nearest (to God).

arabic_text: ٢٢- إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 22.Truly the Righteous Will be in Bliss :

arabic_text: ٢٣- عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. On Thrones (of Dignity) Will they command a sight (Of all things) :

arabic_text: ٢٤- تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 24. Thou wilt recognize In their Faces The beaming brightness of Bliss.

arabic_text: ٢٥- يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ◯
english_translation: 25. Their thirst will be slaked With Pure Wine sealed :

arabic_text: ٢٦- خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ◯
english_translation: 26. The seal thereof will be Musk : and for this Let those aspire, Who have aspirations :

arabic_text: ٢٧- وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 27. With it will be (given) A mixture ofTasnīm:

arabic_text: ٢٨- عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 28. A spring, from (the waters) Whereof drink Those Nearest to God.

arabic_text: ٢٩- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 29.Those in sin used To laugh at those who believed,

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ◯
english_translation: 30. And whenever they passed By them, used to wink At each other (in mockery) ;

arabic_text: ٣١- وَإِذَا انقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ◯
english_translation: 31. And when they returned To their own people, They would return jesting ;

arabic_text: ٣٢- وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ◯
english_translation: 32. And whenever they saw them, They would say, “Behold ! These are the people Truly astray !”

arabic_text: ٣٣- وَمَا أُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ◯
english_translation: 33. But they had not been Sent as Keepers over them !

arabic_text: ٣٤- فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ◯
english_translation: 34. But on this Day The Believers will laugh At the Unbelievers :

arabic_text: ٣٥- عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ◯
english_translation: 35. On Thrones (of Dignity) They will command (a sight) (Of all things).

arabic_text: ٣٦- هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ◯
english_translation: 36. Will not the Unbelievers Have been paid back For what they did ?

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انشَقَّتْ◯
english_translation: 1.When the Sky is Rent asunder,

arabic_text: ٢- وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ◯
english_translation: 2. And hearkens to (The Command of) its Lord,— And it must needs (Do so);—

arabic_text: ٣- وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ◯
english_translation: 3. And when the Earth is flattened out,

arabic_text: ٤- وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ◯
english_translation: 4. And casts forth What is within it And becomes (clean) empty,

arabic_text: ٥- وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ◯
english_translation: 5. And hearkens to (The Command of) its Lord,— And it must needs (Do so);—(then will come Home the full Reality).

arabic_text: ٦- يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ◯
english_translation: 6.Othou man ! Verily thou art ever Toiling on towards the Lord— Painfully toiling,— but thou Shalt meet Him.

arabic_text: ٧- فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ◯
english_translation: 7. Then he who is given His Record in his Right hand,

arabic_text: ٨- فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا◯
english_translation: 8. Soon will his account Be taken by an easy reckoning,

arabic_text: ٩- وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا◯
english_translation: 9. And he will turn To his people, rejoicing !

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ◯
english_translation: 10. But he who is given His Record behind his back,—

arabic_text: ١١- فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا◯
english_translation: 11. Soon will he cry For Perdition,

arabic_text: ١٢- وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا◯
english_translation: 12. And he will enter A Blazing Fire.

arabic_text: ١٣- إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا◯
english_translation: 13. Truly, did he go about Among his people, rejoicing!

arabic_text: ١٤- إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ◯
english_translation: 14. Truly, did he think That he would not Have to return (to Us) !

arabic_text: ١٥- بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا◯
english_translation: 15. Nay nay ! for his Lord Was (ever) watchful of him !

arabic_text: ١٦- فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ◯
english_translation: 16.So I do call To witness the ruddy glow Of Sunset ;

arabic_text: ١٧- وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ◯
english_translation: 17. The Night and its Homing ;

arabic_text: ١٨- وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ◯
english_translation: 18. And the Moon In her Fullness :

arabic_text: ١٩- لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ◯
english_translation: 19. Ye shall surely travel From stage to stage.

arabic_text: ٢٠- فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ◯
english_translation: 20.What then is the matter With them, that they Believe not ?—

arabic_text: ٢١- وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَالسجدة◯
english_translation: 21. And when the Qur-ān Is read to them, they Fall not prostrate,

arabic_text: ٢٢- بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ◯
english_translation: 22. But on the contrary The Unbelievers reject (it).

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَاللَّـهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ◯
english_translation: 23. But God has full Knowledge Of what they secrete (in their breasts)

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 24. So announce to them A Penalty Grievous,

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 25. Except to those who believe And work righteous deeds : For them is a Reward That will never fail.

arabic_text: ١- وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Sky, (displaying) The Zodiacal Signs ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ◯
english_translation: 2. By the promised Day (Of Judgment) ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ◯
english_translation: 3. By one that witnesses, And the subject of the witness ;—

arabic_text: ٤- قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ◯
english_translation: 4. Woe to the makers Of the pit (of fire),

arabic_text: ٥- النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ◯
english_translation: 5. Fire supplied (abundantly) With Fuel :

arabic_text: ٦- إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ◯
english_translation: 6. Behold ! they sat Over against the (fire),

arabic_text: ٧- وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ◯
english_translation: 7. And they witnessed (All) that they were doing Against the Believers.

arabic_text: ٨- وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّـهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ◯
english_translation: 8. And they ill-treated them For no other reason than That they believed in God, Exalted in Power Worthy of all Praise !—

arabic_text: ٩- الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّـهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Him to Whom belongs The dominion of the heavens And the earth ! And God is Witness To all things.

arabic_text: ١٠- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ◯
english_translation: 10.Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) The Believers, men and women, And do not turn In repentance, will have The Penalty of Hell : They will have the Penalty Of the Burning Fire.

arabic_text: ١١- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ◯
english_translation: 11. For those who believe And do righteous deeds, Will be Gardens, Beneath which Rivers flow : That is the great Salvation, (The fulfillment of all desires),

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 12.Truly strong is the Grip (And Power) of thy Lord.

arabic_text: ١٣- إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ◯
english_translation: 13. It is He Who creates From the very beginning, And He can restore (life).

arabic_text: ١٤-وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ◯
english_translation: 14. And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of loving-kindness,

arabic_text: ١٥- ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ◯
english_translation: 15. Lord of the Throne of Glory,

arabic_text: ١٦- فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ◯
english_translation: 16. Doer (without let) Of all that He intends.

arabic_text: ١٧- هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ◯
english_translation: 17.Has the story Reached thee, Of the Forces—

arabic_text: ١٨- فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ◯
english_translation: 18. Of Pharaoh and theThamud ?

arabic_text: ١٩- بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ◯
english_translation: 19. And yet the Unbelievers (Persist) in rejecting (The Truth) !

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَاللَّـهُ مِن وَرَائِهِم مُّحِيطٌ◯
english_translation: 20. But God doth Encompass them From behind !

arabic_text: ٢١- بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 21.Nay, this is A Glorious Qur-ān

arabic_text: ٢٢- فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ◯
english_translation: 22. (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!

arabic_text: ١- وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Sky And the Night-Visitant (Therein);—

arabic_text: ٢- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ◯
english_translation: 2. And what will explain to thee What the Night-Visitant is?—

arabic_text: ٣- النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ◯
english_translation: 3. (It is) the Star Of piercing brightness;–

arabic_text: ٤- إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ◯
english_translation: 4. There is no soul but has A protector over it.

arabic_text: ٥- فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ◯
english_translation: 5.Now let man but think From what he is created !

arabic_text: ٦- خُلِقَ مِن مَّاءٍ دَافِقٍ◯
english_translation: 6. He is created from a drop emitted—

arabic_text: ٧- يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ◯
english_translation: 7. Proceeding from between The backbone and the ribs :

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ◯
english_translation: 8. Surely (God) is able To bring him back (To life) !

arabic_text: ٩- يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ◯
english_translation: 9.The Day that (All) things secret Will be tested.

arabic_text: ١٠- فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ◯
english_translation: 10. (Man) will have No power, And no helper.

arabic_text: ١١- وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ◯
english_translation: 11.By the Firmament Which returns (in its round),

arabic_text: ١٢- وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ◯
english_translation: 12. And by the Earth Which opens out (For the gushing of springs Or the sprouting of vegetation),—

arabic_text: ١٣- إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ◯
english_translation: 13. Behold this is the Word That distinguishes (Good From Evil) :

arabic_text: ١٤- وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ◯
english_translation: 14. It is not a thing For amusement.

arabic_text: ١٥- إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا◯
english_translation: 15.As for them, they Are but plotting a scheme,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا◯
english_translation: 16. And I am planning A scheme.

arabic_text: ١٧- فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا◯
english_translation: 17. Therefore grant a delay To the unbelievers: Give respite to them Gently (for a while).

arabic_text: ١- سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى◯
english_translation: 1.Glorify the name Of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 2. Who hath created And further, given Order and proportion ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 3. Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 4. And Who bringeth out The (green and luscious) pasture,

arabic_text: ٥- فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 5. And then doth make it (But) swarthy stubble.

arabic_text: ٦- سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6.By degrees shall We Teach thee to declare (The Message), so thou Shalt not forget,

arabic_text: ٧- إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّـهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. Except as God wills : For He knoweth What is manifest And what is hidden.

arabic_text: ٨- وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 8.And We will make it Easy for thee (to follow) The simple (Path).

arabic_text: ٩- فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 9. Therefore give admonition In case the admonition Profits (the hearer).

arabic_text: ١٠- سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 10. The admonition will be received By those who fear (God) :

arabic_text: ١١- وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى◯
english_translation: 11. But it will be avoided By those most unfortunate ones,

arabic_text: ١٢- الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 12. Who will enter The Great Fire,

arabic_text: ١٣- ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ◯
english_translation: 13. In which they will then Neither die nor live.

arabic_text: ١٤- قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 14.But those will prosper Who purify themselves,

arabic_text: ١٥- وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 15. And glorify the name Of their Guardian-Lord, And (lift their hearts) In Prayer.

arabic_text: ١٦- بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا◯
english_translation: 16.Nay (behold), ye prefer The life of this world ;

arabic_text: ١٧- وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ◯
english_translation: 17. But the Hereafter Is better and more enduring.

arabic_text: ١٨- إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 18.And this is In the Books Of the earliest (Revelations),—

arabic_text: ١٩- صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ◯
english_translation: 19. The Books of Abraham and Moses.

arabic_text: ١- هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ◯
english_translation: 1.Has the story Reached thee, of The Overwhelming (Event) ?

arabic_text: ٢- وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ◯
english_translation: 2. Some faces, that Day Will be humiliated,

arabic_text: ٣- عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ◯
english_translation: 3. Laboring (hard), weary,—

arabic_text: ٤- تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً◯
english_translation: 4. The while they enter The Blazing Fire,—

arabic_text: ٥- تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 5. The while they are given, To drink, of a boiling hot spring,

arabic_text: ٦- لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ◯
english_translation: 6. No food will there be For them but a bitterDhari’

arabic_text: ٧- لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ◯
english_translation: 7. Which will neither nourish Nor satisfy hunger.

arabic_text: ٨- وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ◯
english_translation: 8. (Other) faces that Day Will be joyful,

arabic_text: ٩- لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Pleased with their Striving,—

arabic_text: ١٠- فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 10. In a Garden on high,

arabic_text: ١١- لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً◯
english_translation: 11. Where they shall hear No (word) of vanity :

arabic_text: ١٢- فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 12. Therein will be A bubbling spring :

arabic_text: ١٣- فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ◯
english_translation: 13. Therein will be Thrones (Of dignity), raised on high,

arabic_text: ١٤- وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ◯
english_translation: 14. Goblets placed (ready),

arabic_text: ١٥- وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ◯
english_translation: 15. And Cushions set in rows,

arabic_text: ١٦- وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ◯
english_translation: 16. And rich carpets (All) spread out.

arabic_text: ١٧- أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ◯
english_translation: 17.Do they not look At the Camels, How they are made ?—

arabic_text: ١٨- وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ◯
english_translation: 18. And at the Sky, How it is raised high ?—

arabic_text: ١٩- وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ◯
english_translation: 19. And at the Mountains, How they are fixed firm ?—

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ◯
english_translation: 20. And at the Earth, How it is spread out ?

arabic_text: ٢١- فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ◯
english_translation: 21.Therefore do thou give Admonition, for thou art One to admonish.

arabic_text: ٢٢- لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ◯
english_translation: 22. Thou art not one To manage (men’s) affairs.

arabic_text: ٢٣- إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ◯
english_translation: 23. But if any turn away And reject God,—

arabic_text: ٢٤- فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّـهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ◯
english_translation: 24. God will punish him With a mighty Punishment.

arabic_text: ٢٥- إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 25. For to Us will be Their Return ;

arabic_text: ٢٦- ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم◯
english_translation: 26. Then it will be for Us To call them to account.

arabic_text: ١- وَالْفَجْرِ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Break of Day ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ◯
english_translation: 2. By the Nights twice five ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ◯
english_translation: 3. By the Even And Odd (contrasted) ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ◯
english_translation: 4. And by the Night When it passeth away :—

arabic_text: ٥- هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ◯
english_translation: 5. Is there (not) in these An adjuration (or evidence) For those who understand ?

arabic_text: ٦- أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ◯
english_translation: 6.Seest thou not How thy Lord dealt With the ‘Ad (people),—

arabic_text: ٧- إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ◯
