english_translation: 7. Of the (city of) Iram, With lofty pillars,

arabic_text: ٨- الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ◯
english_translation: 8. The like of which Were not produced In (all) the land ?

arabic_text: ٩- وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ◯
english_translation: 9. And with theThamud (People), who cut out (Huge) rocks in the valley ?—

arabic_text: ١٠- وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ◯
english_translation: 10. And with Pharaoh, Lord of Stakes ?

arabic_text: ١١- الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ◯
english_translation: 11. (All) these transgressed Beyond bounds in the lands.

arabic_text: ١٢- فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ◯
english_translation: 12. And heaped therein Mischief (on mischief).

arabic_text: ١٣- فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ◯
english_translation: 13. Therefore did thy Lord Pour on them a scourge Of diverse chastisements :

arabic_text: ١٤- إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ◯
english_translation: 14. For thy Lord is (As a Guardian) On a watch-tower.

arabic_text: ١٥- فَأَمَّا الْإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ◯
english_translation: 15.Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, Giving him honor and gifts, Then saith he, (puffed up), “ My Lord hath honoured me ”

arabic_text: ١٦- وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ◯
english_translation: 16. But when He trieth him, Restricting his subsistence For him, then saith he (In despair), “ My Lord hath humiliated me ! ”

arabic_text: ١٧- كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ◯
english_translation: 17.Nay, nay ! But ye Honour not the orphans !

arabic_text: ١٨- وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ◯
english_translation: 18. Nor do ye encourage One another To feed the poor !—

arabic_text: ١٩- وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا◯
english_translation: 19. And ye devour Inheritance— All with greed,

arabic_text: ٢٠- وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا◯
english_translation: 20. And ye love wealth With inordinate love !

arabic_text: ٢١- كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا◯
english_translation: 21.Nay! When the earth Is pounded to powder,

arabic_text: ٢٢- وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا◯
english_translation: 22. And thy Lord cometh, And His angels, Rank upon rank,

arabic_text: ٢٣- وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 23. And Hell, that Day, Is brought (face to face),— On that Day will man Remember, but how will That remembrance profit him ?

arabic_text: ٢٤- يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي◯
english_translation: 24. He will say : “ Ah ! Would that I had Sent forth (Good Deeds) For (this) my (Future) Life ! ”

arabic_text: ٢٥- فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 25. For, that Day, His Chastisement will be Such as none (else) Can inflict,

arabic_text: ٢٦- وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 26. And His bonds Will be such as None (other) can bind.

arabic_text: ٢٧- يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ◯
english_translation: 27. (To the righteous soul Will be said :) “ O (thou) soul, In (complete) rest And satisfaction !

arabic_text: ٢٨- ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً◯
english_translation: 28. “ Come back thou To thy Lord,— Well pleased (thyself), And well-pleasing Unto Him !

arabic_text: ٢٩- فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي◯
english_translation: 29. “ Enter thou, then, Among my Devotees !

arabic_text: ٣٠- وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي◯
english_translation: 30. “Yea, enter thou My Heaven ! ”

arabic_text: ١- لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ◯
english_translation: 1.Ido call to witness This City ;—

arabic_text: ٢- وَأَنتَ حِلٌّ بِهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ◯
english_translation: 2. And thou art a freeman Of this City ;—

arabic_text: ٣- وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ◯
english_translation: 3. And (the mystic ties of) Parent and Child ;—

arabic_text: ٤- لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ◯
english_translation: 4. Verily We have created Man into toil and struggle.

arabic_text: ٥- أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 5.Thinketh he, that none Hath power over him ?

arabic_text: ٦- يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا◯
english_translation: 6. He may say (boastfully) : “ Wealth have I squandered In abundance ! ”

arabic_text: ٧- أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 7. Thinketh he that none Beholdeth him ?

arabic_text: ٨- أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ عَيْنَيْنِ◯
english_translation: 8.Have We not made For him a pair of eyes ?—

arabic_text: ٩- وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ◯
english_translation: 9. And a tongue, And a pair of lips ?—

arabic_text: ١٠- وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ◯
english_translation: 10. And shown him The two highways ?

arabic_text: ١١- فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ◯
english_translation: 11. But he hath made no haste On the path that is steep.

arabic_text: ١٢- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ◯
english_translation: 12. And what will explain To thee the path that is steep ?—
13. (It is : ) freeing the bondman ;

arabic_text: ١٤- أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ◯
english_translation: 14. Or the giving of food In a day of privation

arabic_text: ١٥- يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ◯
english_translation: 15. To the orphan With claims of relationship,

arabic_text: ١٦- أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ◯
english_translation: 16. Or to the indigent (Down) in the dust.

arabic_text: ١٧- ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ◯
english_translation: 17.Then will he be Of those who believe, And enjoin patience, (constancy, And self-restraint), and enjoin Deeds of kindness and compassion.

arabic_text: ١٨- أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ◯
english_translation: 18. Such are the Companions Of the Right Hand.

arabic_text: ١٩- وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ◯
english_translation: 19.But those who reject Our Signs, they are The (unhappy) Companions Of the Left Hand.

arabic_text: ٢٠- عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌ◯
english_translation: 20. On them will be Fire Vaulted over (all round).

arabic_text: ١- وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا◯
english_translation: 1.By the Sun And his (glorious) splendor ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا◯
english_translation: 2. By the Moon As she follows him ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 3. By the Day as it Shows up (the Sun’s) glory ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا◯
english_translation: 4. By the Night as it Conceals it ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا◯
english_translation: 5. By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure ;

arabic_text: ٦- وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا◯
english_translation: 6. By the Earth And its (wide) expanse;

arabic_text: ٧- وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 7. By the Soul, And the proportion and order Given to it ;

arabic_text: ٨- فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا◯
english_translation: 8. And its enlightenment As to its wrong And its right ;—

arabic_text: ٩- قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 9. Truly he succeeds That purifies it,

arabic_text: ١٠- وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 10. And he fails That corrupts it !

arabic_text: ١١- كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا◯
english_translation: 11.TheThamud (people) Rejected (their prophet) Through their inordinate Wrong-doing.

arabic_text: ١٢- إِذِ انبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا◯
english_translation: 12. Behold the most wicked Man among them was Deputed (for impiety).

arabic_text: ١٣- فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّـهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّـهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا◯
english_translation: 13. But the apostle of God Said to them: “ It is A She-camel of God ! And (bar her not From) having her drink ! ”

arabic_text: ١٤- فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا◯
english_translation: 14. Then they rejected him (As a false prophet), And they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account Of their crime, obliterated Their traces and made them Equal (in destruction, High and low) !

arabic_text: ١٥- وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا◯
english_translation: 15. And for Him Is no fear Of its consequences.

arabic_text: ١- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Night as it Conceals (the light) ;

arabic_text: ٢- وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 2. By the Day as it Appears in glory ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ◯
english_translation: 3. By (the mystery of) The creation of male And female ;—

arabic_text: ٤- إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 4. Verily, (the ends) ye Strive for are diverse.

arabic_text: ٥- فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ◯
english_translation: 5.So he who gives (In charity) and fears (God),

arabic_text: ٦- وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6. And (in all sincerity) Testifies to the Best,—

arabic_text: ٧- فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. We will indeed Make smooth for him The path to Bliss.

arabic_text: ٨- وَأَمَّا مَن بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 8. But he who is A greedy miser And thinks himself Self-sufficient,

arabic_text: ٩- وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 9. And gives the lie To the Best,–

arabic_text: ١٠- فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 10. We will indeed Make smooth for him The Path to Misery ;

arabic_text: ١١- وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 11. Nor will his wealth Profit him when he Falls headlong (into the Pit).

arabic_text: ١٢- إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْـهُدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 12.Verily We take Upon Ourselves to guide,

arabic_text: ١٣- وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 13. And verily unto Us (Belong) the End And the Beginning,

arabic_text: ١٤- فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 14.Therefore do I warn you Of a Fire blazing fiercely ;

arabic_text: ١٥- لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى◯
english_translation: 15. None shall reach it But those most unfortunate ones

arabic_text: ١٦- الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 16. Who give the lie to Truth And turn their backs.

arabic_text: ١٧- وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى◯
english_translation: 17.But those most devoted To God shall be Removed far from it,—

arabic_text: ١٨- الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 18. Those who spend their wealth For increase in self-purification,

arabic_text: ١٩- وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ◯
english_translation: 19. And have in their minds No favor from anyone For which a reward Is expected in return,

arabic_text: ٢٠- إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 20. But only the desire To seek for the Countenance Of their Lord Most High ;

arabic_text: ٢١- وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ◯
english_translation: 21. And soon will they Attain (complete) satisfaction.

arabic_text: ١- وَالضُّحَىٰ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Glorious Morning Light,

arabic_text: ٢- وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ◯
english_translation: 2. And by the Night When it is still,—

arabic_text: ٣- مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ◯
english_translation: 3. Thy Guardian-Lord Hath not forsaken thee, Nor is He displeased.

arabic_text: ٤- وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ◯
english_translation: 4. And verily the hereafter Will be better for thee Than the present.

arabic_text: ٥- وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ◯
english_translation: 5. And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (That wherewith) thou Shalt be well-pleased.

arabic_text: ٦- أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6.Did He not find thee An orphan and give thee Shelter (and care) ?

arabic_text: ٧- وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. And He found thee Wandering, and He gave Thee guidance.

arabic_text: ٨- وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 8. And He found thee In need, and made Thee independent.

arabic_text: ٩- فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ◯
english_translation: 9. Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,

arabic_text: ١٠- وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ◯
english_translation: 10. Nor repulse the petitioner (Unheard) ;

arabic_text: ١١- وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ◯
english_translation: 11. But the Bounty Of thy Lord— Rehearse and proclaim !

arabic_text: ١- أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ◯
english_translation: 1.Have We not Expanded thee thy breast ?—

arabic_text: ٢- وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ◯
english_translation: 2. And removed from thee Thy burden

arabic_text: ٣- الَّذِي أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ◯
english_translation: 3. The which did gall Thy back ?—

arabic_text: ٤- وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ◯
english_translation: 4. And raised high the esteem (In which) thou (art held) ?

arabic_text: ٥- فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 5.So verily, With every difficulty, There is relief :

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا◯
english_translation: 6. Verily, with every difficulty There is relief.

arabic_text: ٧- فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ◯
english_translation: 7. Therefore, when thou art Free (from thine immediate task), Still labor hard,

arabic_text: ٨- وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب◯
english_translation: 8. And to thy Lord Turn (all) thy attention.

arabic_text: ١- وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ◯
english_translation: 1.By the Fig And the Olive,

arabic_text: ٢- وَطُورِ سِينِينَ◯
english_translation: 2. And the Mount Of Sinai,

arabic_text: ٣- وَهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ◯
english_translation: 3. And this City Of security,—

arabic_text: ٤- لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ◯
english_translation: 4. We have indeed created man In the best of molds,

arabic_text: ٥- ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ◯
english_translation: 5. Then do We abase him (To be) the lowest Of the low,—

arabic_text: ٦- إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ◯
english_translation: 6. Except such as believe And do righteous deeds : For they shall have A reward unfailing.

arabic_text: ٧- فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 7. Then what can, After this, contradict thee, As to the Judgment (To come) ?

arabic_text: ٨- أَلَيْسَ اللَّـهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ◯
english_translation: 8. Is not God The wisest of Judges ?

arabic_text: ١- اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ◯
english_translation: 1.Proclaim ! (or Read !) in the name Of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٢- خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ◯
english_translation: 2. Created man out of A (mere) clot Of congealed blood :
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٣- اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ◯
english_translation: 3. Proclaim ! And thy Lord Is Most Bountiful,—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٤- الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ◯
english_translation: 4. He Who taught (The use of) the Pen,—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٥- عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ◯
english_translation: 5. Taught man that Which he knew not.
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٦- كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَيَطْغَىٰ◯
english_translation: 6.Nay but man doth Transgress all bounds,
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٧- أَن رَّآهُ اسْتَغْنَىٰ◯
english_translation: 7. In that he looketh Upon himself as self-sufficient.
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَىٰ◯
english_translation: 8. Verily, to thy Lord Is the return (of all).
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ٩- أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَىٰ◯
english_translation: 9.Seest thou one Who forbids—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٠- عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 10. A votary when he (Turns) to pray ?
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١١- أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ◯
english_translation: 11. Seest thou if He is on (the road Of) Guidance ?—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٢- أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰ◯
english_translation: 12. Or enjoins Righteousness ?
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٣- أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ◯
english_translation: 13. Seest thou if he Denies (Truth) and turns away ?
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٤- أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ اللَّـهَ يَرَىٰ◯
english_translation: 14.Knoweth he not That God doth see ?
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٥- كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ◯
english_translation: 15. Let him beware ! If he Desist not, We will Drag him by the forelock,—
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٦- نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ◯
english_translation: 16. A lying, sinful forelock !
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٧- فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ◯
english_translation: 17. Then, let him call (For help) to his council (Of comrades) :
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٨- سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ◯
english_translation: 18. We will call On the angels of punishment (To deal with him) !
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١٩- كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِبالسجدة◯
english_translation: 19.Nay heed him not : But bow down in adoration, And bring thyself The closer (to God) !
surah_meaning: Read or Proclaim/The Clot of Congealed Blood

arabic_text: ١- إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ◯
english_translation: 1.We have indeed revealed This (Message) In the Night of Power :

arabic_text: ٢- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ◯
english_translation: 2. And what will explain To thee what the Night Of Power is ?

arabic_text: ٣-لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ◯
english_translation: 3. The Night of Power Is better than A thousand Months.

arabic_text: ٤- تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ◯
english_translation: 4. Therein come down The angels and the Spirit By God’s permission, on every errand :

arabic_text: ٥- سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ◯
english_translation: 5. Peace! … This Until the rise of Morn !

arabic_text: ١- لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ◯
english_translation: 1.Those who reject (Truth) Among the People of the Book And among the Polytheists, Were not going to depart (From their ways) until There should come to them Clear Evidence,—

arabic_text: ٢- رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّـهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً◯
english_translation: 2. An apostle from God, Rehearsing scriptures Kept pure and holy :

arabic_text: ٣- فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ◯
english_translation: 3. Wherein are laws (or decrees) Right and straight.

arabic_text: ٤- وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ◯
english_translation: 4.Nor did the People Of the Book Make schisms, Until after there came To them Clear Evidence.

arabic_text: ٥- وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّـهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ◯
english_translation: 5. And they have been commanded No more than this : To worship God, Offering Him sincere devotion, being True (in faith) ; To establish regular Prayer ; And to practice regular Charity ; And that is the Religion Right and Straight.

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ◯
english_translation: 6.Those who reject (Truth) Among the People of the Book And among the Polytheists, Will be in hell-fire, To dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.

arabic_text: ٧- إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ◯
english_translation: 7. Those who have faith And do righteous deeds,— They are the best of creatures.

arabic_text: ٨- جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِيَ اللَّـهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ◯
english_translation: 8. Their reward is with God : Gardens of Eternity, Beneath which rivers flow ; They will dwell therein For ever ; God well pleased With them, and they with Him : All this for such as Fear their Lord and Cherisher.

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا◯
english_translation: 1.When the Earth is Shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,

arabic_text: ٢- وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا◯
english_translation: 2. And the Earth throws up Her burdens (from within),

arabic_text: ٣- وَقَالَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا لَهَا◯
english_translation: 3. And man cries (distressed) : ‘ What is the matter with her ? ’—

arabic_text: ٤- يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا◯
english_translation: 4. On that Day will she Declare her tidings :

arabic_text: ٥- بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا◯
english_translation: 5. For that thy Lord will Have given her inspiration.

arabic_text: ٦- يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْاأَعْمَالَهُمْ◯
english_translation: 6. On that Day will men Proceed in companies sorted out, To be shown the Deeds That they (had done).

arabic_text: ٧- فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 7. Then shall anyone who Has done an atom’s weight Of good, see it !

arabic_text: ٨- وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ◯
english_translation: 8. And anyone who Has done an atom’s weight Of evil, shall see it.

arabic_text: ١- وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا◯
english_translation: 1.By the (Steeds) That run, with panting (breath),

arabic_text: ٢- فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا◯
english_translation: 2. And strike sparks of fire,

arabic_text: ٣- فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا◯
english_translation: 3. And push home the charge In the morning,

arabic_text: ٤- فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا◯
english_translation: 4. And raise the dust In clouds the while,

arabic_text: ٥- فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا◯
english_translation: 5. And penetrate forthwith Into the midst (of the foe)En masse;—

arabic_text: ٦- إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ◯
english_translation: 6. Truly Man is, To his Lord, Ungrateful ;

arabic_text: ٧- وَإِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 7. And to that (fact) He bears witness (By his deeds) ;

arabic_text: ٨- وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ◯
english_translation: 8. And violent is he In his love of wealth.

arabic_text: ٩- أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ◯
english_translation: 9.Does he not know,— When that which is In the graves is Scattered abroad

arabic_text: ١٠- وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ◯
english_translation: 10. And that which is (Locked up) in (human) breasts Is made manifest—

arabic_text: ١١- إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ◯
english_translation: 11. That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (Even to) that Day ?

arabic_text: ١- الْقَارِعَةُ◯
english_translation: 1.The (Day) of Noise and Clamour :
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٢- مَا الْقَارِعَةُ◯
english_translation: 2. What is the (Day) Of Noise and Clamour ?
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٣- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ◯
english_translation: 3. And what will explain To thee what the (Day) Of Noise and Clamour is ?
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٤- يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ◯
english_translation: 4. (It is) a Day whereon Men will be like moths Scattered about,
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٥- وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنفُوشِ◯
english_translation: 5. And the mountains Will be like carded wool.
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٦- فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ◯
english_translation: 6. Then, he whose Balance (of good deeds) Will be (found) heavy,
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٧- فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ◯
english_translation: 7. Will be in a Life Of good pleasure and satisfaction.
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٨- وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ◯
english_translation: 8. But he whose Balance (of good deeds) Will be (found) light,—
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ٩- فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 9. Will have his home In a (bottomless) Pit.
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ١٠- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ◯
english_translation: 10. And what will explain To thee what this is ?
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ١١- نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ◯
english_translation: 11. (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely !
surah_meaning: The Day of Noise and Clamour

arabic_text: ١- أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ◯
english_translation: 1.The mutual rivalry For piling up (the good things Of this world) diverts you (From the more serious things),

arabic_text: ٢- حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ◯
english_translation: 2. Until ye visit the graves.

arabic_text: ٣- كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 3. But nay, ye soon shall Know (the reality).

arabic_text: ٤- ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ◯
english_translation: 4. Again, ye soon shall know !

arabic_text: ٥- كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ◯
english_translation: 5. Nay, were ye to know With certainty of mind, (Ye would beware !)

arabic_text: ٦- لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ◯
english_translation: 6. Ye shall certainly see Hell-fire !

arabic_text: ٧- ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ◯
english_translation: 7. Again, ye shall see it With certainty of sight !

arabic_text: ٨- ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ◯
english_translation: 8. Then, shall ye be Questioned that Day About the joy (Ye indulged in !)

arabic_text: ١- وَالْعَصْرِ◯
english_translation: 1.By (the Token of) Time (through the Ages),

arabic_text: ٢- إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ◯
english_translation: 2. Verily Man is in loss,

arabic_text: ٣- إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ◯
english_translation: 3. Except such as have Faith, And do righteous deeds, And (join together) In the mutual teaching Of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.

arabic_text: ١- وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ◯
english_translation: 1.Woe to every (Kind of) scandal-monger And backbiter,

arabic_text: ٢- الَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ◯
english_translation: 2. Who pileth up wealth And layeth it by,

arabic_text: ٣- يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ◯
english_translation: 3. Thinking that his wealth Would make him last For ever !

arabic_text: ٤- كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ◯
english_translation: 4.By no means ! He will Be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces.

arabic_text: ٥- وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ◯
english_translation: 5. And what will explain To thee That which Breaks To Pieces?

arabic_text: ٦- نَارُ اللَّـهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ◯
english_translation: 6. (It is) the Fire Of (the Wrath of) God Kindled (to a blaze),

arabic_text: ٧- الَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ◯
english_translation: 7. The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts :

arabic_text: ٨- إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ◯
english_translation: 8. It shall be made Into a vault over them,

arabic_text: ٩- فِي عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ◯
english_translation: 9. In columns outstretched.

arabic_text: ١- أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ◯
english_translation: 1.Seest thou not How thy Lord dealt With the Companions Of the Elephant ?

arabic_text: ٢- أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ◯
english_translation: 2. Did He not make Their treacherous plan Go astray ?

arabic_text: ٣- وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ◯
english_translation: 3. And He sent against them Flights of Birds,

arabic_text: ٤- تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ◯
english_translation: 4. Striking them with stones Of baked clay.

arabic_text: ٥- فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍ◯
english_translation: 5. Then did He make them Like an empty field Of stalks and straw (Of which the corn) Has been eaten up.

arabic_text: ١- لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ◯
english_translation: 1.For the covenants (Of security and safeguard Enjoyed) by the Quraish,

arabic_text: ٢- إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ◯
english_translation: 2. Their covenants (covering) journeys By winter and summer,—

arabic_text: ٣- فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَـٰذَا الْبَيْتِ◯
english_translation: 3. Let them adore the Lord Of this House,

arabic_text: ٤- الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ◯
english_translation: 4. Who provides them With food against hunger, And with security Against fear (of danger).

arabic_text: ١- أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ◯
english_translation: 1.Seest thou oneWho denies the Judgment(To come) ?

arabic_text: ٢- فَذَٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ◯
english_translation: 2. Then such is the (man)Who repulses the orphan(With harshness),

arabic_text: ٣- وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ◯
english_translation: 3. And encourages notThe feeding of the indigent.

arabic_text: ٤- فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ◯
english_translation: 4.So woe to the worshippers

arabic_text: ٥- الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ◯
english_translation: 5. Who are neglectfulOf their Prayers,

arabic_text: ٦- الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ◯
english_translation: 6. Those who (want but)To be seen (of men),

arabic_text: ٧- وَيَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ◯
english_translation: 7. But refuse (to supply)(Even) neighbourly needs.

arabic_text: ١- إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ◯
english_translation: 1.To thee have WeGranted the Fount(of Abundance).

arabic_text: ٢- فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ◯
english_translation: 2. Therefore to thy LordTurn in PrayerAnd Sacrifice.

arabic_text: ٣- إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ◯
english_translation: 3. For he who hateth thee,—Hewill be cut off(From Future Hope).

arabic_text: ١- قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ◯
english_translation: 1.Say: O yeThat reject Faith !

arabic_text: ٢- لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ◯
english_translation: 2. I worship not thatWhich ye worship,

arabic_text: ٣-وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ◯
english_translation: 3. Nor will ye worshipThat which I worship.

arabic_text: ٤- وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ◯
english_translation: 4. And I will not worshipThat which ye have beenWont to worship,

arabic_text: ٥- وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ◯
english_translation: 5. Nor will ye worshipThat which I worship.

arabic_text: ٦- لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ◯
english_translation: 6. To you be your Way,And to me mine.

arabic_text: ١- إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّـهِ وَالْفَتْحُ◯
english_translation: 1.When comes the HelpOf God, and Victory,

arabic_text: ٢- وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّـهِ أَفْوَاجًا◯
english_translation: 2. And thou dost seeThe People enter God’s ReligionIn crowds,

arabic_text: ٣- فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا◯
english_translation: 3. Celebrate the PraisesOf thy Lord, and prayFor His Forgiveness :For He is Oft-Returning(In Grace and Mercy).

arabic_text: ١- تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ◯
english_translation: 1.Perish the handsOf the Father of Flame !Perish he !

arabic_text: ٢- مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ◯
english_translation: 2. No profit to himFrom all his wealth,And all his gains !

arabic_text: ٣- سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ◯
english_translation: 3. Burnt soon will he beIn a FireOf blazing Flame !

arabic_text: ٤- وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ◯
english_translation: 4. His wife shall carryThe (crackling) wood—As fuel !—

arabic_text: ٥- فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍ◯
english_translation: 5. A twisted ropeOf palm-leaf fibreRound her (own) neck !

arabic_text: ١- قُلْ هُوَ اللَّـهُ أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 1.Say: He is God,The One and Only ;

arabic_text: ٢- اللَّـهُ الصَّمَدُ◯
english_translation: 2. God, the Eternal, Absolute ;

arabic_text: ٣- لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ◯
english_translation: 3. He begetteth not,Nor is He begotten ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ◯
english_translation: 4. And there is noneLike unto Him.

arabic_text: ١- قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ◯
english_translation: 1.Say: I seek refugeWith the Lord of the Dawn,

arabic_text: ٢- مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ◯
english_translation: 2. From the mischiefOf created things ;

arabic_text: ٣- وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ◯
english_translation: 3. From the mischiefOf Darkness as it overspreads ;

arabic_text: ٤- وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ◯
english_translation: 4. From the mischiefOf those who practiceSecret Arts ;

arabic_text: ٥- وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ◯
english_translation: 5. And from the mischiefOf the envious oneAs he practices envy.

arabic_text: ١. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 1.Say: I seek refugeWith the LordAnd Cherisher of Mankind,

arabic_text: ٢. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 2. The King (or Ruler)Of Mankind,

arabic_text: ٣. إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 3. The God (or Judge)Of Mankind, —

arabic_text: ٤. مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 4. From the mischiefOf the Whisperer(Of Evil) who withdraws(After his whisper),—

arabic_text: ٥. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 5. (The same) who whispersInto the hearts of Mankind,—

arabic_text: ٦. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ◯
english_translation: 6. Among JinnsAnd among Men.
